articles.title: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

paras.en: How Paper-Based Friction Materials Power Modern Machinery

Have you ever wondered what enables everything from roaring construction machinery to agricultural machinery plowing the fields to industrial equipment shuttling through factories—the precise starting, smooth operation, and reliable braking they achieve?

The answer lies in a seemingly insignificant yet crucial core component: friction material. It acts as the "safety guard" and "power link" of machinery, ensuring every brake is safe and effective, and every power transmission is smooth and flawless.

Among the vast family of friction materials, wet friction materials are becoming the new favorite in modern machinery due to their exceptional reliability, safety, and exceptionally long lifespan. Among wet materials, paper-based friction materials stand out as a leading force thanks to their excellent overall performance, cost-effectiveness, and broad application prospects.
Today, let's delve deeper into the fascinating world of this "unsung hero"—paper-based friction materials.
What is Paper-Based Friction Material? — A Sponge-Like Power Core
Imagine a "sponge" with countless tiny pores—that's the most intuitive image of paper-based friction material.

It is a material with a reticular porous structure composed of three core components: reinforcing fibers, functional fillers, and a binder resin. This unique structure gives it extraordinary capabilities:
- Oil Storage Capacity: The porous structure acts like a miniature "oil depot," capable of storing large quantities of lubricant.

- Dynamic Lubrication: When the friction plate and mating plate engage and are subjected to pressure, the lubricant within the material is instantly squeezed onto the friction surface, forming a tough lubricant film, enabling smooth, gentle "wet" friction.
- Self-Recovery: When the friction plates separate, the material rebounds like memory foam, "absorbing" the lubricant back into the pores, ready for the next operation.

It is this dynamic cycle of "oil storage-oil squeezing-oil return" that allows paper-based friction materials to perform well in an oil bath environment, achieving a perfect combination of high durability and stable friction performance.
Exploring Core Performance: How Do Three Key Factors Affect It?

The performance of paper-based friction materials is not static. Like a top athlete, its performance is influenced by the "field," "equipment," and "condition." Let's examine how these three key factors shape its performance.
Factor 1: The "Stage Effect" of Lubricants

Paper-based friction materials are highly sensitive to lubricants, and different lubricants create distinct "stages" for their performance. Even the same friction material can exhibit significantly different friction characteristics (especially the kinetic friction coefficient) when exposed to different lubricants.
Figure 1: Kinetic friction coefficient curve for a paper-based friction material in gear oil
Figure 2: Dynamic friction coefficient curve of the same material in hydraulic oil

Interpretation: The above chart clearly shows that the same material behaves very differently in gear oil and hydraulic fluid. Furthermore, various additives added to lubricating oils (such as dispersants and anti-wear agents) can interact complexly with the material surface, further affecting its friction properties. Therefore, choosing the right oil for paper-based friction materials is the first step in achieving optimal performance.
Density is a trump card for paper-based friction materials. It is directly related to the material's porosity, leading to a delicate balancing act in terms of performance.

High density (low porosity) means a denser material, resulting in better strength and thermal conductivity, lower wear rate, and longer life. However, the downside is reduced oil storage capacity, which can lead to a lower coefficient of friction and compromise power transmission.

Low density (high porosity) means the material is more porous, resulting in greater oil storage capacity and a higher coefficient of friction, which can provide greater braking force or transmit torque. However, the downside is reduced mechanical strength and wear resistance, shortening service life.
Figure 3: Comparison of the dynamic coefficient of friction for materials of varying densities (Type 2 to Type 6, increasing density)
Figure 4: Comparison of wear rates of materials with different densities

Interpretation: Figures 3 and 4 vividly illustrate this balancing act. There's no such thing as absolute good or bad, only suitability. When selecting a paper-based friction material, the optimal trade-off between friction coefficient and durability must be determined based on specific application requirements (e.g., high torque versus long life).
Factor 3: Extreme Challenges of Operating Conditions

In addition to oil type and density, actual operating conditions, such as surface pressure, sliding speed, and oil temperature, pose extreme challenges to paper-based friction materials. These factors directly affect the temperature of the friction interface, the thickness and stability of the oil film, and thus dynamically alter the coefficient of friction.

Therefore, please remember: the coefficient of friction of a particular paper-based friction material is not a fixed value, but rather a performance range determined through extensive and repeated testing under specific operating conditions.
Broad Applications: Injecting a Powerful "Heart" into Machinery

Thanks to its excellent overall performance and customizability, Carlisle Brake & Friction's paper-based friction materials have been successfully applied to the core components of various heavy-duty machinery, becoming their powerful and reliable "heart."
We understand that different machines and applications require significantly different friction materials. For example:
- Service brakes for construction machinery (such as excavators and loaders) require materials that provide a stable, powerful braking force under high loads to ensure safety.
- Powershift transmissions for agricultural machinery (such as tractors) require materials that provide smooth engagement and excellent heat resistance to handle frequent shifting.
- Clutches for industrial machinery require materials that respond quickly and have a long lifespan to ensure continuous and efficient operation of production lines.

To this end, Carlisle Brake & Friction has developed a series of special paper-based friction materials for different application scenarios, providing each customer with the most suitable and reliable solution.
Continuous Innovation, Driving the Future
Technological advancement is endless. To meet increasingly demanding application requirements and broaden market prospects, Carlisle Brake & Friction remains at the forefront of innovation.

We are not only continuously optimizing the formulation and processing of paper-based friction materials to push their performance limits, but are also actively exploring next-generation wet friction materials with even higher performance. These R&D efforts have made significant progress, aiming to provide global customers with more diverse and advanced options, driving the infinite possibilities of future machinery.

articles.title: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

paras.en: Celebrating 100-Years with Medina Mayor and Employees

MEDINA, OHIO — September 24, 2025 — Carlisle Brake & Friction (CBF), a global leader in the development and manufacture of high-performance brake and friction solutions, today welcomed Medina Mayor Dennis Hanwell, Economic Development Director Kimberly Marshall, and Executive Director of the Medina Chamber of Commerce Jaclyn Ringstmeier, for a special photo op at the company’s headquarters, located at 920 Lake Road. The event was a commemorative celebration of CarlisleCBF’s 100-year anniversary and its enduring presence in the Medina community.

paras.en: The photo op featured Mayor Hanwell alongside Carlisle’s Operations Leader, David Smith, and a number of employees who have been with the company for decades. The occasion honored CarlisleCBF’s century of innovation and its deep roots in the Medina area, where it has been a significant employer and community partner.

"We are incredibly proud of our history and our strong connection to the city of Medina," said David Smith. "This milestone is a testament to the hard work and dedication of our employees, many of whom have been with us for decades. We are grateful for the continued support of Mayor Hanwell and the entire Medina community."

The photo op followed a recent employee and family event at the Medina plant that celebrated the 100-year milestone. The celebration was filled with games, face painting, food, and fun for all ages, reinforcing the company's commitment to its employees and their families.

Mayor Hanwell expressed his gratitude for CarlisleCBF’s presence in the city. “Carlisle has been a part of the Medina community for nearly 65 years, providing good jobs and a strong economic foundation,” said Mayor Hanwell. "We are proud to celebrate their 100-year anniversary and recognize the significant role they have played in our city’s growth and prosperity."
CarlisleCBF, a brand of CentroMotion, was founded in 1925 and has grown to become a global leader in its field, serving a wide range of markets including agriculture, construction, and mining.

Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a leading global provider of highly engineered and integrated brake and friction solutions for a wide range of industrial applications. With over 100 years of experience, the company is dedicated to delivering innovative, reliable, and high-performance products to its customers worldwide.

articles.title: SCANGRIP Introduces SPRAYMATCH Spray Gun LED Work Light
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: To help professional painters improve quality control in automotive refinishing and industrial coating applications, SCANGRIP has introduced SPRAYMATCH.

Designed for use with spray guns, the professional LED work light delivers bright, uniform illumination directly onto the wet surface. This helps painters evaluate coverage more accurately and detect imperfections early in the refinish process.

SPRAYMATCH is attached directly to the spray cup, making it easy to use across different spray guns commonly found in automotive and industrial environments. In addition, the work light is EX certified, allowing safe and legal use inside spraybooths.

articles.title: NABC Announces Winner of 2026 Changing and Saving Lives Award
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The National Auto Body Council (NABC) announced that Shyllo Michaelis, chief strategy officer of Texas Collision Centers (TCC), was named the NABC Changing and Saving Lives Award winner for 2026 at the Collision Industry Red Carpet Awards event on Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. She was also honored as part of the 2026 NABC SEMA Celebration.

The NABC Changing and Saving Lives Award recognizes individuals in the collision repair industry who have delivered exemplary service in the NABC mission of Changing and Saving Lives Every Day, far beyond their role in the industry.

TCC is an 18-store, family-owned MSO dedicated to serving its communities and giving back to those who serve others. Since 2021, Michaelis has played an instrumental role in TCC’s partnership with the Recycled Rides program, helping restore and provide reliable transportation to individuals and families facing significant transportation challenges. Under her leadership, TCC has refurbished and donated numerous vehicles through the program each year.

“We are incredibly proud at Texas Collision Centers to be the recipient of the NABC Changing and Saving Lives award,” said Michaelis. “Texas Collision Centers is very grateful to be a member of the National Auto Body Council for a number of years and present some 30 NABC Recycled Rides in our community. We really appreciate the partnership with the insurance carriers who donate these vehicles and our paint, parts and service providers who help support the giftings. It’s an honor to give back to those in need and recognize the men and women who have served our country.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: In 2025, Michaelis and the TCC team refurbished 19 vehicles for the NABC, including a single-day presentation of 16 vehicles to 16 Texas veterans on Veterans Day — the largest single Recycled Rides gifting to date. Michaelis and TCC continued their commitment in 2026, gifting two additional vehicles and remaining focused on providing dependable transportation to those in need.

Michaelis’s commitment to service extends beyond the automotive industry. She is engaged in the Dallas Fort Worth community, volunteering her time, coordinating charitable drives and providing financial support to organizations serving those in need. Her efforts include involvement with the Plano Christmas Cops program, providing toys for children, organizing sock and toiletry drives for deployed military service members, and supporting several local first-responder organizations.

TCC’s philanthropic efforts focus on active-duty military members, veterans, first responders and educators — the individuals who dedicate themselves to protecting, serving, educating and strengthening communities.
Through her leadership, Michaelis has helped make service and generosity part of TCC’s culture. Her efforts are measured by the lives touched, burdens eased, and individuals honored along the way.

“As our organization has grown and evolved, we have an opportunity to work with so many great leaders, companies and charities across the country,” said Debby Robinson, executive director of the NABC. “We were honored to present the 2026 NABC Changing and Saving Lives Award to Shyllo Michaelis from Texas Collision Centers. We are excited to recognize our partners who help us serve communities across the country.”
For more information on the NABC, visit nationalautobodycouncil.org.

articles.title: CREF’s 2026 Benchmark Awards Deliver $475,000 to Collision Schools
articles.author: Jason Stahl

paras.en: The Collision Repair Education Foundation (CREF) announced that 71 collision schools will receive a combined $475,000 through its 2026 Benchmark Awards program. Recipients were announced at CREF’s Benchmark Awards Breakfast held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas during the 2026 SEMA Show.

Schools were selected through CREF’s 2026 Collision School Career Readiness Benchmark Awards program, which provides financial assistance to help collision education programs overcome budgetary limitations and prepare students for careers. Benchmark Awards can be used, in line with the award category, to enhance program capabilities, attract new students or fuel innovative approaches to collision education.

These funds will help instructors strengthen programs, invest in tools and equipment, and provide hands-on training and technical skills. Based on current enrollment figures, the investments are expected to benefit more than 3,580 students this year, with improvements continuing to support future classes.

“Congratulations to the 2026 Benchmark Award recipients,” said Brenda Hogen, chair of CREF. “The Collision Repair Education Foundation is incredibly grateful to our industry partners whose generosity makes these awards possible year after year. Their continued investment demonstrates a shared commitment to strengthening collision education and ensuring that the next generation of repair professionals has the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in our industry. I also want to recognize the dedicated instructors who take the time to apply for these awards, demonstrating their determination to provide students with the best possible education despite the challenges they face.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: “Collision repair programs are the foundation of our industry’s future workforce, and the instructors leading those programs play an essential role in preparing students for successful careers. By connecting industry support with schools in need, CREF helps educators strengthen their programs, expand opportunities for hands-on learning and better prepare students to enter the workforce. We’re proud to be part of that process and grateful to the many organizations that recognize the importance of investing in tomorrow’s collision professionals.”

paras.en: Added CREF Director of Operations and Impact Melissa Marscin, “For the schools receiving these awards, that industry support translates into opportunities to address some of the most persistent challenges facing collision repair education. Many instructors struggle just to maintain their existing equipment and resources, making it even more difficult to introduce new technologies, update training materials or expand their programs to keep pace with an evolving industry. The Benchmark Awards help bridge that financial gap by providing schools with resources they might otherwise be unable to afford, ultimately creating stronger learning environments for students preparing to enter the collision repair workforce.

articles.title: Building a roadmap for your technicians covered in IDEAS Collide
articles.author: Lurah Lowery

paras.en: As a 2026 Society of Collision Repair Specialists IDEAS Collide Showcase presenter, Maria Quintero, Body Builders Automotive owner, shared the importance of mapping out technician careers so collision repair shops can guide them toward their goals with proper training and incentives to learn, grow, and advance.

“Everybody here wants to know where we are, where we started, and where we’re going,” she said. “I think it’s just human nature, and our technicians are no different… The reality is we want to see growth, and our technicians want to know: how do I get there?”
The annual showcase was held Nov. 4 in Las Vegas as part of this year’s SEMA Show.

According to statistics Quintero shared from a September 2026 Robert Half survey, 55% of Gen Z professionals (ages 14–29) said they plan to look for a new job by year-end. Half said the reason was limited advancement. Fifty-three percent said they believe the way to make more money is to change employers.
Quintero also cited Resume.org survey findings from December 2025, which found 45% of Millennials (ages 30–45) were considering a job change.

“What does that translation look like for us? If a young technician sees a path to make more money and they don’t see it at your shop because we haven’t developed that roadmap, they’re going to assume that that path is down the street or not even in this industry,” Quintero said. “A roadmap answers that question before they can even go looking. We have to own the work, and we have to share the return.”
Before building the “technician roadmap,” Quintero said shops need to understand the operation they want their technicians to succeed in, and the numbers behind it.

In Quintero’s example, a shop’s annual sales goal is $4 million, with labor at 48% of that. That’s $1,920,000 to work with and a $768,000 gross profit. Now, fit the tech’s numbers in. The tech wants to make $85,000; that’s 11% of the shop’s total labor cost budget. For the tech to be paid $85,000, the shop needs to bring in $212,500 in labor sales. Nine techs earning that amount would meet the shop’s labor goal.
Here’s Quintero’s breakdown of building out the roadmap:
- Set an operation: What’s the skill that the technician is going to be tested on?
- Criteria: What’s the testing period? What does it take to pass?
- Pay rate: Start rate, raise per skill, and rate after.
- Trainer bonus: Pay your senior technicians to grow the next technician.
Remember, efficiencies with the shop and the techs build together, she said.

“On the profitability side, for the shop, we know revenue beating expenses is going to make us money; we all know that,” Quintero said. “For the technician, though, what is their personal ROI? What is their return on that investment? They invest their time, energy, and skill, and they should get paid. Their growth and their career: what does that look like? When the shop is profitable, it can churn the next rate increase.”

Maybe you start a new tech out in disassembly. From there, they can advance and move through each stage, meeting benchmarks to go on to the next position. And with each skill set achieved comes a pay raise, Quintero said.

“You’re giving them a roadmap of saying, ‘Your next pay increase isn’t dependent on how I feel about you. It isn’t dependent on if I like you this week or not. It’s dependent on how you showed up at work. What is the skill set you learned? I believe that if you bring the right attitude, you’re going to get the right output, but you got to have that in place… The raise is tied to the skill. It’s not tied to who asks the loudest, learns faster, or earns faster.”
Quintero shared four rules shops can follow to give techs unbiased raises based on their career progression:
- Test solo: No help from another technician.
- Checkpoint: A-tech or foreman signs off at each stage.
- Pass twice: One good repair isn’t a skill; two is.
- Set rates: Clear and non-negotiable, with the same rules for everyone.
She added that, along the way, training is built in based on each shop’s preferences for what should be learned and when.

“My challenge I ask of all of you is to go back and build yourselves a roadmap by listing the skills for every position in the shop, add a test and a raise to every skill, and then tie it back to your numbers,” Quintero said.
Featured image: Maria Quintero speaks during the 2026 SCRS IDEAS Collide Showcase. (Lurah Lowery/Repairer Driven News)

articles.title: State Farm agrees to $45 million settlement with Oklahoma for claims handling
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: State Farm Fire and Casualty Company has agreed to more than $45 million in settlement following an investigation by the Oklahoma Insurance Department (OID) into the company’s handling of homeowners’ claims for wind and hail damage to roofs, according to an OID press release.
The settlement followed OID releasing a market conduct examination Friday, that found State Farm improperly denied or failed to pay for roof damage and necessary repairs on claims.

As a result, State Farm agreed to a settlement that includes a minimum of $35 million dedicated to making affected consumers whole, $10 million for Oklahoma’s Strengthen Oklahoma Homes grant program and an additional $2.86 million in fines and examination expenses payable to the department.

Eligible Oklahoma homeowners who had a claim for wind and hail damage closed without payment between Jan. 1, 2001 and Dec. 31, 2025 will have another opportunity to have their claims independently reviewed, the release states.
The release defines “closed without payment” as including claims that received partial payment or were determined to be under the deductible amount.

“Our responsibility is to stand up for Oklahoma consumers, and that means holding insurance companies accountable when they fail to meet their obligations to policyholders,” said Insurance Commissioner Glen Mulready in the release. “We weren’t willing to simply take State Farm’s word for how these claims were handled. We took action that no other state has done in a traditional examination, putting independent engineers in the field to inspect roofs and help determine whether claims were handled appropriately.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: State Farm will establish a claim reopening process at its own expense, the release states. An independent third-party claims administrator, mutually selected by OID and State Farm will review each eligible claim. This will include evaluating the original claim file and any additional documentation or evidence submitted by the policyholder.
If an administrator determines that a claim qualifies for payment, State Farm will pay the claim in accordance with the insured’s individual policy, the release states.
State Farm and OID will agree upon an additional amount of funds, if more funds are needed to pay all claims, the release adds.

Eligible homeowners will receive written notices from State Farm that have been approved by OID. It will explain the review process and how to opt in.The Department also plans to help educate consumers throughout the process.

“I cannot stress enough how important it is for eligible homeowners to take advantage of this opportunity and opt in,” Mulready said. “If your roof claim was closed without payment during this period, don’t assume the decision was the final word. This process gives eligible Oklahomans another chance to have their claims independently evaluated. We want consumers to know this opportunity is real, understand how to participate, and have confidence that their claims will receive an independent review.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: The $10 million donated to the department’s Strengthen Oklahoma Homes grant programs will help Oklahoma consumers strengthen their homes against severe weather by installing fortified roofs designed to better withstand Oklahoma’s weather conditions. Homeowners who participate are seeing an average homeowners’ insurance premium savings of $700.
Additional information about eligibility, timelines, and the claims review process will be released as details are finalized.
If you have questions about other insurance issues, please contact the Oklahoma Insurance Department at 800-522-0071 or visit their website at www.oid.ok.gov.

articles.title: Law firm analysis finds airbag defects the deadliest vehicle defect
articles.author: Teresa Moss

paras.en: A Florida law firm’s analysis on recall and consumer complaints regarding vehicle defects found faulty airbags pose the greatest risk to consumers with about 500 deaths in a decade.

“Most drivers don’t think about a defect until it shows up on the road, and by then they’re dealing with it at speed,” Steven Frankl, attorney with Frankl Kominsky Injury Lawyers, says in an email. “The parts that cause the most harm are often the ones you never notice working, right up until the moment you need them.”

The November report, completed by Frankl Kominsky Injury Lawers examined 39 vehicle defect categories across the U.S. from airbags and brakes to steering and electrical systems. It counted the safety recalls tied to each category between 2015 and 2025. The number of consumer complaints, crashes, injuries, and deaths were pulled from the federal documents, the law firm says in an email.

“These figures were combined into a single score out of 100, with deaths weighted most heavily, followed by injuries and crashes, showing which defects are tied to the most serious outcomes for drivers,” the email says.

Airbags received a score of 100 with 97,700 complaints and 494 deaths. Electrical systems received the next highest score of 42, with 126,700 complaints and 209 deaths. Vehicle speed control received a score of 31, with 29,300 complaints and 267 deaths.

Airbag defects range from defective inflators and sensors to trouble with deployment, including airbags that fail to go off during crashes, the email states. Airbags had 114 million recalls between 2015 and 2025.
Electrical systems include wiring, batteries, electrical connections, and components, according to the email. There were 1,535 safety recalls between 2015 and 2025, the email adds.
“A fault in one of them can stop the system it belongs to from working,” the email states.
Speed control defects included cruise control, acceleration, and throttle responses.
“A defect here can leave a car speeding up or slowing down on its own, without any input from the driver,” the email states.
It adds that complaints about speed control defects included 2,336 injuries.
Service brakes were the third most dangerous defect in the report, receiving a score of 28, with 58,800 complaints and 93 deaths.

“This category covers general brake problems, from poor brake performance to faults in how the brake system operates, and hydraulic, air, and electric brake parts fall into categories of their own,” the email states. “For a driver, that means a car that does not slow down or stop the way it should when the pedal is pressed.”
There were 6,410 crash reports for brake defects, the email adds and 3,529 injuries were reported.
Engine trouble ranked as the fifth most dangerous with a risk score of 27. There were 132,900 complaints filed and 125 deaths connected to the defects.
“The category takes in engines that stall, run unreliably, or do not perform the way they should, and engine cooling problems are counted as a separate defect,” the email states.
Frankl adds that a recall letter deserves the same attention as a warning light on the dashboard.

“If the car brakes, speeds up, or steers in a way that feels wrong, write down what happened, report it, and get it looked at,” Frankl adds. “Every complaint adds to the record, and that record helps get problems fixed for the next driver.”
NHTSA announced earlier this month that it will invest $1.5 million to help states improve vehicle recall rates to keep roads safe.

“A vehicle with an open recall creates an avoidable hazard on our roads,” said NHTSA Administrator Jonathan Morrison in a news release. “By giving states the resources to flag open recalls when drivers register or renew their vehicles, we can keep dangerous cars off our roads and American families safe.”

NHTSA learned during the Takata airbag recalls that convincing consumers to remedy a recall is complicated, he said. Researchers found some consumers were confused about what the recall meant or simply didn’t remember receiving the notices.

Lee White, NHTSA’s deputy administrator, said during the Society of Collision Repair Specialists’ (SCRS) OEM Summit held during the 2026 SEMA Show last week, that collision repairers are the final checkpoint for roadway safety.
One way repairers can be a checkpoint for vehicle defects on safety systems is by performing vehicle inspections.

Mike Anderson, Collision Advice co-owner, said during a Collision Industry Conference meeting earlier this year that every OEM manufacturer has procedures in their electric service manuals (ESM) that state inspections need to be done when a vehicle is in a collision. He said this could include inspections of seatbelts, steering columns, and airbags.

Anderson said that the industry is minimizing the importance of safety inspections. He said there has been recent focus on ADAS calibrations, but safety inspections are just as, if not more, important.

“At the end of the day, the OEM says it needs to be done,” Anderson said. “At the end of the day, the insurance company doesn’t want to pay for it. The shop is stuck in the middle. Nobody wants to indemnify the shop. It is just wrong; it is wrong on every level.”
If a shop is found liable for not following OEM procedures, it could be sued and lose everything, Anderson added.

articles.title: SHOWA Goes Off-Road with New High-Performance Shocks
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Astemo Americas, Inc. has launched the SHOWA Performance premium shock brand, its first product offering built for four-wheel vehicles, bringing a podium-proven, 60-plus-year legacy from two-wheel racing to the off-road truck and SUV market.
paras.zh: Astemo Americas, Inc. 推出了 SHOWA Performance 高端减震器品牌，这是该公司面向四轮车辆的首款产品，将两轮赛车领域 60 多年经赛场验证的传统带入越野卡车和 SUV 市场。

paras.en: Available in early 2027, the new line ranges from entry-level to race-ready shocks, with applications for today’s most popular off-road vehicles and custom builds. Designed and manufactured in the USA, every single SHOWA Performance product delivers on one core principle: “Control. Mastered.”
paras.zh: 该新系列将于2027年初上市，产品范围从入门级到赛用级减震器不等，适用于当今最受欢迎的越野车和定制车型。每一款SHOWA Performance产品均在美国设计和制造，秉承“掌控。驾驭。”这一核心原则。

paras.en: “SHOWA has spent decades winning on two wheels, and everything we’ve learned is built into these shocks,” said Nathan Beskow, general manager of SHOWA Performance. “Enthusiasts want to push hard on the trails, dunes, rocks and track – and they want more control and consistency from their shocks. We’re bringing that knowledge to four wheels, and we’ll keep innovating every step of the way.”
paras.zh: SHOWA Performance总经理Nathan Beskow表示：“SHOWA在两轮车领域取得了数十年的成功，我们所学到的一切都融入了这些减震器中。“爱好者们希望在越野道、沙丘、岩石和赛道上全力以赴，他们希望减震器能够提供更好的操控性和一致性。我们将这些知识带到四轮车上，并将在这条道路上的每一步都不断创新。”

paras.en: As the products roll out across North America in 2027, the SHOWA Performance brand will be proving its technology at many popular off-road races and events, including King of the Hammers, the Ultra4 series and Jeep Jamboree USA. The brand’s racing program will be led by Director of Motorsport Brian Novak.
paras.zh: 随着产品于2027年在北美全面上市，SHOWA Performance品牌将在多项热门越野赛事和活动中展示其技术，包括“锤王”（King of the Hammers）、Ultra4系列和美国吉普盛会（Jeep Jamboree USA）。该品牌的赛车项目将由赛车运动总监Brian Novak领导。

paras.en: “We’re ready to write racing history in the four-wheel world with SHOWA Performance,” said Novak. “It all starts at the 2027 King of the Hammers with a SHOWA-equipped 4600-class rig driven by Sergio Pinillos.”
paras.zh: “我们已经准备好与SHOWA Performance一起在四轮赛车界谱写历史。”Novak表示。“这一切都将从2027年锤王越野赛开始，Sergio Pinillos将驾驶一辆配备SHOWA减震器的4600级赛车参赛。”

paras.en: Built to the same standards that put SHOWA on the podium, the new SHOWA Performance shock absorber line for lifted trucks and SUVs includes entry-level to race-ready shocks such as ORC off-road control monotube shocks, PSD position-sensitive damping shocks and SPIRE high-performance, adjustable and rebuildable monotubes.
paras.zh: 全新的SHOWA Performance减震器系列专为升高型皮卡和SUV打造，采用与SHOWA登顶产品相同的标准，涵盖从入门级到赛用级的各种减震器，例如ORC越野控制单筒减震器、PSD位置敏感型减震器以及SPIRE高性能、可调且可重装的单筒减震器。

paras.en: SHOWA Performance ORC 2.0 monotube shocks feature a premium corrosion-resistant, Cerakote-finished1 steel body design that includes a large 45mm bore and precision-engineered internals to deliver more control and fast, precise response. These shocks also include a graphite-impregnated floating piston band to help deliver a better shock response on any type of terrain.
paras.zh: SHOWA Performance ORC 2.0单筒减振器采用优质耐腐蚀的Cerakote涂层1钢制主体设计，包括45毫米大孔径和精密设计的内部结构，以提供更好的操控性和快速、精准的响应。这些减震器还包括一个石墨浸渍浮动活塞带，有助于在任何类型的地形上提供更好的减震响应。

paras.en: SHOWA PSD 2.25 shocks include a Cerakote-finished, 57mm-diameter steel body for maximum heat dissipation and fade resistance even in the harshest off-road conditions. The units also feature patented Hydraulic Compression Stop (HCS) and Hydraulic Rebound Stop (HRS), exclusive innovations that increase damping force near full compression and full rebound to cushion hard bottom-outs and help prevent top-outs. Combined, HCS and HRS provide greater control over how the suspension absorbs impacts and recovers, improving ride comfort, vehicle stability and off-road performance. PSD shocks also feature an 18mm hardened chrome rod for extreme durability, long service life and corrosion resistance.

paras.en: SPIRE 2.5-inch aluminum-body high-performance monotubes feature ARC 2 technology, a dual-speed, external compression adjuster that lets drivers fine-tune low- and high-speed damping by hand in the field, with no tools needed. These shocks are available in universal and application-specific configurations. Universal units come in 12- to 14-inch stroke lengths for custom builds, with piggyback and remote reservoir options in both coilover and non-coilover styles. Application-specific shocks are tuned for popular stock and lifted trucks and SUVs.

paras.en: “At every level of the SHOWA Performance line, our engineers pushed for more innovation and more precise control, because that’s what off-road drivers ask for,” said Mike Sype, SHOWA brand manager. “These shocks build on SHOWA’s global technology heritage, and our goal is simple: to be the suspension brand off-road enthusiasts in North America reach for first.”

Visit www.showa-performance.com to see how SHOWA Performance shocks bring “Control. Mastered.” to any four-wheel build. Follow SHOWA Performance on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn to see how the brand is changing the off-road shock game, and to have a little fun, too.

articles.title: Tool Time Podcast: Launch Tech USA
articles.author: Eric Garbe

paras.en: In this conversation between Eric Pagliughi, vice president of Launch Tech USA and TechShop’s Eric Garbe, learn how Launch Tech USA has evolved since 2002, expanding from its strengths in European and Asian vehicle diagnostics to comprehensive coverage for domestic vehicles, heavy-duty applications, powersports and electric vehicles.
paras.zh: 在Launch Tech USA副总裁Eric Pagliughi与TechShop的Eric Garbe之间的这次对话中，了解Launch Tech USA自2002年以来的发展历程，从其在欧亚车辆诊断方面的优势扩展到对美国本土车辆、重型车辆应用、动力运动车辆和电动车辆的全面覆盖。

paras.en: The conversation explores the challenges facing today’s repair shops, including increasingly complex vehicle systems, access to OEM diagnostic information and the growing need for technician education. Pagliughi emphasizes that successful technology adoption requires more than purchasing equipment; technicians must understand how to maximize its capabilities.
paras.zh: 这次对话探讨了当今维修厂面临的挑战，包括日益复杂的车辆系统、获取原始设备制造商（OEM）诊断信息以及对技术人员培训的日益增长的需求。Pagliughi强调，成功采用技术不仅仅是购买设备；技术人员必须了解如何最大限度地发挥其功能。

paras.en: Looking toward 2027, Launch Tech USA is introducing an expanded product lineup, including updated Pro line diagnostic scan tools, the X613 alignment system and X939 ADAS/alignment equipment. These solutions focus on affordability, simplified operation and helping shops expand their service capabilities.
paras.zh: 展望2027年，Launch Tech USA将推出扩大的产品阵容，包括升级版Pro系列诊断扫描工具、X613校准系统和X939 ADAS/校准设备。这些解决方案的重点是经济实惠、操作简便，并帮助维修厂拓展服务能力。

paras.en: A recurring theme throughout the episode is Launch Tech’s commitment to developing products around the real-world needs of shop owners and technicians. By integrating familiar repair information platforms, offering flexible equipment packages and expanding training opportunities, Launch Tech aims to make advanced automotive technology more accessible.
paras.zh: 贯穿整集的反复出现的主题是，Launch Tech致力于围绕修理厂老板和技师的实际需求来开发产品。通过整合熟悉的维修信息平台、提供灵活的设备套餐以及增加培训机会，Launch Tech旨在让先进的汽车技术更加触手可及。

paras.en: The episode concludes with Pagliughi outlining the company’s commitment to stronger technical support and expanded hands-on training in 2027, helping technicians improve diagnostic efficiency, maximize tool investments and confidently service increasingly sophisticated vehicles.
paras.zh: 本集最后，Pagliughi概述了公司对2027年加强技术支持和扩大实践培训的承诺，以帮助技术人员提高诊断效率，最大限度地利用工具投资，并自信地为日益复杂的车辆提供服务。

paras.zh: - 汽车行业的挑战：OEM 扫描工具、新兴车辆技术、维修信息访问和技术人员培训。（2:03）

paras.en: - New Technology for 2027: Updated Pro line scan tools, alignment equipment and repair information integrations. (4:15)

paras.zh: - 车轮定位和ADAS设备：X613升级、地面水平定位功能和经济实惠的ADAS校准选项。（7:12）

paras.en: - Scan Tool Product Lineup: New DIY, professional, heavy-duty and powersports diagnostic solutions. (11:38)
paras.zh: - 扫描工具产品系列：全新DIY、专业、重型和动力运动诊断解决方案。（11:38）

paras.zh: - 电动汽车服务：可扩展的电动汽车诊断解决方案、电池服务设备和扩展的维修车间能力。（21:44）

articles.title: Got a Great Teaching Idea? NACAT Wants It
articles.author: Doug Kaufman

paras.en: Great automotive instructors know that some of the best teaching ideas come from sharing experiences with their peers. Whether it’s a new approach to explaining a complicated system, an innovative classroom exercise or a better way to prepare students for the realities of the service bay, those ideas deserve to be shared.
paras.zh: 优秀的汽车讲师深知，一些最棒的教学理念源自与同行分享经验。无论是解释复杂系统的新方法、创新的课堂练习，还是让学员为维修车间的实际情况做好准备的更好方式，这些想法都值得分享。

paras.en: The North American Council of Automotive Teachers (NACAT) is inviting automotive educators and industry professionals to submit course proposals for the 2027 Automotive Educators Conference (AEC), scheduled for July 11-15, 2027, in Nashville, TN. But time is running out: The submission deadline is Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
paras.zh: 北美汽车教师委员会（NACAT）诚邀汽车教育工作者和行业专业人士为2027年汽车教育工作者大会（AEC）提交课程提案。该大会定于2027年7月11日至15日在田纳西州纳什维尔举行。但时间不多了：提交截止日期为2026年11月25日（星期三）。

paras.en: The annual conference brings together automotive instructors from across North America to exchange ideas, strengthen technical skills and explore new approaches to automotive education. From emerging vehicle technologies and diagnostic procedures to curriculum development, hands-on training and student engagement, AEC offers opportunities for educators to learn from one another.
paras.zh: 年度会议汇聚了来自北美各地的汽车教员，他们将在此交流思想、强化技术技能并探索汽车教育的新方法。从新兴的汽车技术和诊断程序，到课程开发、实践培训和学生参与，AEC为教育工作者提供了相互学习的机会。

paras.en: The 2026 Automotive Educators Conference demonstrated the value of that collaboration, emphasizing technical training, innovative teaching strategies and practical solutions that instructors can bring back to their classrooms.
paras.zh: 2026年汽车教育工作者大会展示了这种合作的价值，强调了技术培训、创新教学策略以及教师可以带回课堂的实用解决方案。

paras.en: Have you developed a lesson that consistently gets students engaged? Found a creative way to teach electrical diagnostics? Developed an effective approach to EV safety, ADAS or other emerging technologies? Perhaps you’ve discovered a better way to connect students with employers or build stronger relationships with local repair shops.
paras.zh: 您是否设计过一门始终能激发学生积极参与的课程？找到了教授电气诊断的创新方法？是否制定了针对电动汽车安全、ADAS或其他新兴技术的有效方法？也许您已经找到了更好的方法，将学生与雇主联系起来，或与当地维修店建立更牢固的关系。

paras.en: Those experiences could provide the foundation for a valuable conference session.
paras.zh: 这些经验可以为有价值的会议奠定基础。

paras.en: Presenting at AEC is an opportunity to showcase your expertise, connect with fellow educators and contribute to the professional development of the people preparing tomorrow’s automotive technicians. You don’t need to have all the answers to make a difference. Sometimes, sharing what has worked in your classroom can inspire another instructor to try something new.
paras.zh: 在AEC上发言是一个展示您的专业知识、与同行教育工作者建立联系并为培养明日汽车技术人员的人员的专业发展做出贡献的机会。您不必知道所有答案，也能有所作为。有时，分享您在课堂上行之有效的方法，可以激励其他讲师尝试新事物。

paras.en: The deadline for course submissions is Wednesday, November 25, 2026.
paras.zh: 课程提交截止日期为2026年11月25日（星期三）。

paras.en: For additional information about presenting at the 2027 Automotive Educators Conference, contact Heather Sebben at [email protected] or 816-766-1515.
paras.zh: 如需了解有关在2027年汽车教育工作者大会上发言的更多信息，请通过[email protected]或816-766-1515联系Heather Sebben。

paras.en: Your next great teaching idea might be exactly what another automotive educator needs to hear.
paras.zh: 您的下一个出色教学创意可能正是另一位汽车教育工作者需要听到的。

articles.title: Autel Awards Five Automotive Education Scholarships
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Autel announced five recipients of its second annual Awarding Excellence Scholarships. The scholarships are part of Autel Cares, the company’s philanthropic initiative supporting automotive education and community causes.
paras.zh: Autel 宣布了第二届年度卓越奖学金的五名获奖者。这些奖学金是Autel Cares的一部分，这是该公司支持汽车教育和社区事业的慈善计划。

paras.en: The 2026 program awards five $5,000 scholarships, totaling $25,000. The awards support students pursuing education and training in automotive repair and service.
paras.zh: 2026年计划将颁发五笔5,000美元的奖学金，总额为25,000美元。该奖学金旨在支持接受汽车维修和服务方面教育和培训的学生。

paras.en: Recipients can use the scholarships for tuition, tools, books, supplies and other education-related expenses. The students are preparing for careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 获奖者可以将奖学金用于学费、工具、书籍、学习用品和其他与教育相关的开支。这些学生正在为从事汽车维修行业的职业生涯做好准备。

paras.en: This year, Autel expanded eligibility beyond recent high school graduates. Adult learners returning to school or transitioning from another career also qualified.
paras.zh: 今年，Autel 将资格范围扩大到近期高中毕业生以外的人群。重返校园的成人学员或从其他职业转行的学员也符合资格。

paras.en: The 2026 recipients represent students at different stages of life and training. Their interests include automotive technology, collision repair, manufacturer-level service and automotive cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 2026年获奖者代表了处于不同人生阶段和培训阶段的学生。他们的兴趣包括汽车技术、碰撞维修、制造商级服务和汽车网络安全。

paras.en: “Last year, selecting our first scholarship recipients was difficult. This year was even more challenging because we received so many outstanding applications from students with compelling stories, clear goals, and a genuine commitment to automotive education,” said Chloe Hung, CEO of Autel U.S.
paras.zh: “去年，选出首批奖学金获得者并不容易。今年难度更大，因为我们收到了许多优秀学生的申请，他们有着引人入胜的故事、明确的目标，以及对汽车教育的真诚承诺。”Autel美国首席执行官Chloe Hung表示。

paras.en: “The five recipients selected this year reflect the many different paths people take into the automotive repair industry, from students beginning their training to adults continuing or returning to school. Autel is proud to support their education and invest in the skilled professionals who will help shape the future of automotive repair.”
paras.zh: “今年选出的五位获奖者反映了人们进入汽车维修行业的多种不同途径，从刚刚开始接受培训的学生到继续学业或重返校园的成年人。Autel很荣幸能够为他们的学业提供支持，并投资于将帮助塑造汽车维修行业未来的技术专业人才。”

paras.en: The 2026 Autel Awarding Excellence Scholarship recipients are:
paras.zh: 2026年Autel卓越奖学金获得者名单如下：

paras.en: - Shawn Clark, of Deer Lodge, Montana, attends Highlands College of Montana Tech. Clark is beginning a new chapter in automotive education at age 50. He is pursuing an associate degree in automotive technology. His application reflects this year’s expanded eligibility for adult learners returning to school. Clark plans to build a new career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - 来自蒙大拿州迪尔洛奇的Shawn Clark就读于蒙大拿理工大学高地学院。Clark在50岁时开启了汽车教育的新篇章。他正在攻读汽车技术副学士学位。他的申请反映了今年返校成人学习者的资格范围有所扩大。Clark计划在汽车维修领域开创新的职业生涯。

paras.en: - Jacob Heinrichs, of Austin, Texas, attends Universal Technical Institute of Texas Inc. Heinrichs already works in the field and has three years of experience as an automotive technician. His selection reflects Autel’s support for working technicians seeking additional training. Heinrichs aims to advance his skills and career opportunities.
paras.zh: - 来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀的 Jacob Heinrichs 就读于德克萨斯州通用技术学院。Heinrichs 已在该领域工作，并拥有三年汽车技师经验。他的入选反映了Autel对希望接受更多培训的在职技术人员的支持。Heinrichs 的目标是提升自己的技能和职业机会。

paras.en: - Marisa Rueger, of Harleysville, Pennsylvania, attends Automotive Training Center-Warminster. Rueger is pursuing collision repair and holds a 4.0 GPA. In her application, she described collision repair as her art. She also emphasized her desire to continue learning, growing and succeeding in the field.
paras.zh: - Marisa Rueger来自宾夕法尼亚州哈利斯维尔，就读于沃明斯特汽车培训中心。Rueger正在攻读碰撞维修专业，GPA为4.0。在申请书中，她将碰撞维修描述为自己的艺术。她还强调了自己希望继续学习、成长并在这个领域取得成功的愿望。

paras.en: - Logan Mercier, of Claremont, California, attends Universal Technical Institute of California Inc. Mercier aims to complete school with a 4.0 GPA. He also plans to build advanced diagnostic skills and work toward becoming a master technician. His application focuses on academic achievement, professional growth and building a career in automotive repair.
paras.zh: - 来自加州克莱蒙特的Logan Mercier就读于加州通用技术学院。Mercier的目标是以4.0的GPA成绩毕业。他还计划培养高级诊断技能，并努力成为一名高级技师。他的申请重点在于学业成绩、专业成长以及在汽车维修领域发展职业生涯。

paras.en: - Kristof Adam, of Stillwater, Minnesota, attends Century College. Adam is pursuing a career in automotive cybersecurity. He has a strong interest in hands-on vehicle work and advanced automotive technology. His application highlights the growing importance of technical education as vehicles become more connected, complex and software-driven.
paras.zh: - Kristof Adam来自明尼苏达州斯蒂尔沃特，就读于Century College。Adam正在从事汽车网络安全方面的职业。他对车辆的实际操作和先进的汽车技术有着浓厚的兴趣。他的申请凸显了随着车辆变得更加互联、更加复杂和更加由软件驱动，技术教育的重要性日益凸显。

paras.en: Applicants submitted either a 500- to 600-word essay or a two- to three-minute video. They described the path that led them to pursue automotive repair education.
paras.zh: 申请人提交了500至600字的论文或2至3分钟的视频。他们描述了自己走上汽车维修教育之路的历程。

paras.en: Applicants also explained how the scholarship would support their training. They discussed their goals, obstacles and planned careers in the automotive repair industry.
paras.zh: 申请人还阐述了奖学金将如何为他们的培训提供支持。他们讨论了各自的目标、障碍以及在汽车维修行业的职业规划。

articles.title: Momentum USA Adds 12 Brake Part Numbers
articles.author: Alex Crissey

paras.en: Momentum USA added 12 new part numbers to its brake friction and rotor catalog. This update expands coverage to over 5.3 million Vehicles in Operation (VIO) across North America.
paras.zh: Momentum USA在其刹车摩擦片和刹车盘目录中新增了12个零件编号。此次更新将覆盖范围扩展至北美地区超过530万辆在用车辆（VIO）。

paras.en: The new products include rotors for luxury and performance vehicles, and expanded offerings for Hyundai, Kia and Honda vehicles.
paras.zh: 新产品包括用于豪华车和高性能车的刹车盘，以及为现代、起亚和本田汽车提供的更多产品。

paras.en: A more detailed list of import applications is as follows:
paras.zh: 更详细的进口申请清单如下：

paras.en: - Hyundai, Kia & Honda: Expanded coverage across models including the Hyundai Palisade, Santa Fe, and Santa Cruz; Kia Sorento and Carnival (PTC2381); as well as the Honda HR-V and Honda Clarity (PRC2116 / CE2116).
paras.zh: - 现代、起亚和本田：扩大了车型覆盖范围，包括现代帕利塞德、胜达和圣克鲁斯；起亚索兰托和嘉华（PTC2381）；以及本田HR-V和本田Clarity（PRC2116/CE2116）。

paras.en: - Mercedes-Benz, Land Rover & Volvo: Added seven new Coated and R90 Euro Rotor SKUs to serve luxury sedans, sports coupes, and performance SUVs—including Mercedes-Benz S-Class, SLK, and C-Class models, Land Rover Defender and Range Rover Sport models (537200), and the Volvo XC60 (521480).
paras.zh: - 梅赛德斯-奔驰、路虎和沃尔沃：新增了七款涂层和R90 Euro刹车盘SKU，适用于豪华轿车、跑车和高性能SUV，包括梅赛德斯-奔驰S级、SLK和C级车型、路虎卫士和揽胜运动版车型（537200）以及沃尔沃XC60（521480）。

articles.title: Race Winning Brands Appoints Brian Cassady CEO
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Race Winning Brands (RWB), designer, manufacturer and distributor of branded aftermarket automotive and powersports performance products, has hired Brian Cassady as CEO. He succeeds Olivier Blechner of Portage Point Partners, who has been serving as interim CEO of RWB since December, 2025.
paras.zh: Race Winning Brands (RWB)是一家知名售后汽车和动力运动性能产品的设计、制造和分销商，该公司已聘请Brian Cassady担任首席执行官。他接替Portage Point Partners的Olivier Blechner，后者自2025年12月起一直担任RWB的临时首席执行官。

paras.en: Cassady is a branded product executive with experience leading international engineered product manufacturers, according to RWB.
paras.zh: 据RWB称，Cassady是一位品牌产品高管，曾领导多家国际工程产品制造商。

paras.en: “I am excited and honored to become the new CEO of Race Winning Brands,” said Cassady. “RWB has a great portfolio of some of the most recognized and valuable brands in street racing and powersports. I am really looking forward to working with the RWB team to continue to evolve the portfolio, nurture core brands and generate organic growth.”
paras.zh: 卡萨迪表示：“我很高兴也很荣幸成为 Race Winning Brands 的新任首席执行官。” “RWB 拥有一系列街头赛车和动力运动领域最受认可和最有价值的品牌组合。我非常期待与 RWB 团队合作，继续发展产品组合、培育核心品牌并实现有机增长。”

paras.en: RWB’s product portfolio includes pistons, transmission components, exhausts and air intakes, engine electronics, springs, connecting rods, engine blocks and valves. Its product portfolio includes Corsa exhaust systems, Haltech engine control modules, JP and Manley pistons, PAC racing springs and Rekluse clutch systems.
paras.zh: RWB的产品组合包括活塞、传动部件、排气和进气系统、发动机电子设备、弹簧、连杆、发动机缸体和气门。其产品组合包括Corsa排气系统、Haltech发动机控制模块、JP和Manley活塞、PAC赛车弹簧和Rekluse离合器系统。

paras.en: The company also distributes a lineup of powersports components in the U.S. and Europe through its ProX division.
paras.zh: 该公司还通过其 ProX 部门在美国和欧洲分销一系列动力运动组件。

paras.en: Prior to RWB, Cassady was CEO of Live Comfortably LLC, North America’s largest manufacturer of branded pillows, comforters and mattress pads/protectors. His automotive, racing and powersports experience includes serving as CEO of Jason Holdings, manufacturer of motorcycle, ATV and off-road vehicle seats, and CEO of Fansteel Inc., manufacturer of cylinder heads for Toyota Racing, OEM gears for GM and Mitsubishi, and OEM components for Navistar’s Maxxforce family of diesel engines. Cassady led each of these companies through periods of organic growth, according to RWB.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Recent Transactions and Leadership Updates
paras.zh: 近期交易和领导层变动

paras.en: Hiring Cassady is the latest move in the transformation of RWB following its acquisition by MiddleGround Capital in 2021. The company acquired PAC Racing (springs), TPT Solutions (RevMax, TransGo and Transmission Specialties brand transmission products), Haltech (engine controls) and TMG Performance (Corsa and Volant brand exhaust and air intakes) in 2022. It subsequently divested TransGo and K1 Technologies (crankshafts and connecting rods) in 2024.
paras.zh: 聘请Cassady是RWB在2021年被MiddleGround Capital收购后转型过程中的最新举措。2022年，该公司收购了PAC Racing（弹簧）、TPT Solutions（RevMax、TransGo和Transmission Specialties品牌的变速器产品）、Haltech（发动机控制）和TMG Performance（Corsa和Volant品牌的排气和进气系统）。随后，该公司于2024年剥离了TransGo和K1 Technologies（曲轴和连杆）。

paras.en: In September, 2026, the company augmented its management team with the appointment of Mindy Toth as chief human resources officer and Ivan Martinez as COO. Toth was previously global vice president of HR and marketing at Fives North American Combustion. Martinez was previously COO of KSI Auto Parts and also spent 15 years in operations at LKQ.
paras.zh: 2026年9月，公司任命Mindy Toth为首席人力资源官，Ivan Martinez为首席运营官，从而壮大了管理团队。Toth此前曾担任Fives North American Combustion的人力资源和营销全球副总裁。Martinez 曾任 KSI Auto Parts 的首席运营官，还在 LKQ 的运营部门工作了 15 年。

paras.en: “I am thrilled to welcome Brian to Race Winning Brands,” stated Ryan McComb, managing director at MiddleGround. “RWB is at a critical inflection point. We have built a portfolio of iconic performance brands and strengthened the leadership team, and now the focus is on accelerating growth. Brian has a proven record of driving organic growth at branded, engineered product manufacturers. He brings the right mix of commercial leadership, product development focus and operational discipline to speed up new product launches and keep raising the level of service to our customers. I also want to thank Olivier Blechner for his outstanding interim leadership and business improvement of RWB over the past 11 months.”
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

articles.title: AI & the Aftermarket: NTN Bearing Corporation of America’s Charles Harris
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: AftermarketNews asked executives from leading manufacturers/suppliers about how their companies are using artificial intelligence, what problems they hope to solve and how they see AI impacting their business in the coming years. It is our pleasure to share their insights and, today, we hear from Charles Harris, Vice President – Automotive Aftermarket, NTN Bearing Corporation of America.
paras.zh: AftermarketNews 向领先制造商/供应商的高管询问了他们的公司如何使用人工智能、他们希望解决哪些问题以及他们如何看待人工智能在未来几年影响他们的业务。我们很高兴分享他们的见解，今天，我们听到了美国 NTN 轴承公司汽车售后市场副总裁 Charles Harris 的发言。

paras.en: How is your company currently using artificial intelligence?
paras.zh: 贵公司目前使用人工智能的情况如何？

paras.en: At NTN, we are applying AI across multiple areas of the business, with our Business Innovation team working alongside IT and functional leaders to identify opportunities that improve efficiency and decision-making. AI tools are helping employees streamline tasks such as document creation, data analysis, and research and information management.
paras.zh: 在NTN，我们正在将人工智能应用于业务的多个领域，我们的业务创新团队与IT和职能部门领导携手合作，以识别能够提高效率和决策水平的机会。人工智能工具正在帮助员工简化文档创建、数据分析以及研究和信息管理等任务。

paras.en: Across the global NTN Group, AI is also being used in manufacturing and engineering. We are integrating AI-powered inspection technologies to enhance quality verification and consistency in production environments. In automotive engineering, NTN has implemented machine learning technology within its wheel hub bearing development process, enabling engineers to evaluate designs significantly faster and identify optimal solutions more efficiently. By combining engineering simulations with AI-driven optimization, we can accelerate product development while maintaining the quality and reliability customers expect.
paras.zh: 在全球NTN集团，人工智能也被应用于制造和工程领域。我们正在集成人工智能检测技术，以增强生产环境中的质量验证和一致性。在汽车工程领域，NTN 在其轮毂轴承开发流程中实施了机器学习技术，使工程师能够更快地评估设计并更有效地确定最佳解决方案。通过将工程模拟与人工智能驱动的优化相结合，我们可以加速产品开发，同时保持客户期望的质量和可靠性。

paras.en: What specific business challenges are you hoping to solve through AI?
paras.zh: 您希望通过人工智能解决哪些具体的业务挑战？

paras.en: One area of focus is improving the speed and accuracy of customer order processing. AI has the potential to help automate the handling of orders received in a variety of formats, allowing customer relations teams to spend more time supporting customers and less time on repetitive administrative tasks. By streamlining order intake and fulfillment processes, AI also helps ensure our customers receive the parts they need, when they need them.
paras.zh: 重点领域之一是提高客户订单处理的速度和准确性。人工智能有潜力帮助自动化处理各种格式收到的订单，使客户关系团队能够将更多时间花在支持客户上，而减少重复性管理任务的时间。通过简化订单接收和履行流程，人工智能还有助于确保我们的客户在需要时收到他们需要的零件。

paras.en: More broadly, AI is helping address challenges related to workforce efficiency, product complexity and speed-to-market. In manufacturing, AI supports quality assurance through advanced inspection capabilities. In engineering, AI-assisted design tools enable faster analysis of complex automotive components, helping reduce development cycles and bring innovative products to market more quickly.
paras.zh: 更广泛地说，人工智能正在帮助解决与劳动力效率、产品复杂性和上市速度相关的挑战。在制造领域，人工智能通过先进的检测功能支持质量保证。在工程领域，人工智能辅助设计工具可以更快地分析复杂的汽车零部件，有助于缩短开发周期并更快地将创新产品推向市场。

paras.en: Looking ahead three to five years, where do you see AI having the greatest impact on the aftermarket?
paras.zh: 展望未来三至五年，您认为人工智能将在售后市场的哪些方面产生最大影响？

paras.en: We expect AI to have a growing impact across the entire automotive product lifecycle. Connected vehicles will generate more diagnostic and maintenance information, creating opportunities to improve service planning, parts identification and customer support.
paras.zh: 我们预计人工智能将在整个汽车产品生命周期中产生越来越大的影响。联网车辆将生成更多诊断和维护信息，为改进服务规划、零件识别和客户支持创造机会。

paras.en: From NTN’s perspective, one of the most significant opportunities is in product development. AI-assisted engineering is already helping accelerate wheel hub bearing design and performance evaluation. As these capabilities continue to advance, manufacturers will be able to respond more quickly to new vehicle platforms, expand coverage faster and continue improving product performance and quality. AI will also play an increasingly important role in manufacturing quality, supply chain planning and technical support, helping the automotive aftermarket become more responsive and efficient.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: At NTN, we view AI as an enabler of smarter engineering, more efficient operations and higher-quality products. Our focus is on applying AI where it delivers tangible value for customers and strengthens our ability to serve the evolving automotive aftermarket.
paras.zh: 在 NTN，我们将人工智能视为更智能的工程、更高效的运营和更高质量的产品的推动者。我们的重点是应用人工智能，为客户提供有形的价值，并增强我们服务不断发展的汽车售后市场的能力。

articles.title: HDAD 2027 Panel: Real-World View of the Aftermarket
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: MEMA announced participants for the ‘Real-World View of the Aftermarket’ panel, which will take place January 18, during Heavy Duty Aftermarket Dialogue 2027 at the Gaylord Texan Resort & Convention Center in Grapevine, TX.
paras.zh: MEMA宣布了“售后市场现实视图”小组讨论的参与者名单，该小组讨论将于1月18日在德克萨斯州格雷普韦恩的盖洛德德州度假村及会议中心举行的2027年重型车售后市场对话期间举行。

paras.en: - Puneet Cheema, President, TSE Brakes, MEMA Heavy Duty Business Forum Member
paras.zh: - TSE Brakes总裁、MEMA重型车业务论坛成员Puneet Cheema

paras.en: - Dan Griffin, President, Aftermarket Solutions, PHINIA, MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers CEO Council Member
paras.zh: - Dan Griffin，PHINIA 售后解决方案总裁、MEMA 售后供应商首席执行官委员会成员

paras.en: - DJ Kimsey, President, Vehicle Aftermarket, North America, SKF Group, MEMA Aftermarket Suppliers CEO Council Member
paras.zh: - SKF集团北美区汽车售后市场总裁、MEMA售后市场供应商首席执行官委员会成员DJ Kimsey

paras.en: They will discuss how commercial vehicle aftermarket suppliers are navigating today’s biggest challenges while positioning their businesses for what’s next.
paras.zh: 他们将讨论商用车售后市场供应商如何应对当今最大的挑战，同时为未来的业务定位。

paras.en: From shifting market dynamics to evolving customer expectations, CV aftermarket suppliers face no shortage of challenges, MEMA said. The industry executive panel will share how their organizations are responding, adapting and preparing for the road ahead.
paras.zh: MEMA 表示，从不断变化的市场动态到不断变化的客户期望，商用车售后市场供应商面临着不少挑战。行业执行小组将分享他们的组织如何应对、适应和为未来的道路做好准备。

articles.title: APA’s Gatsby Gala Brings Roaring ’20s Glamour to AAPEX
articles.author: Mary DellaValle

paras.en: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) brought a touch of Roaring ’20s glamour to this year’s AWDA and AAPEX festivities with its annual industry cocktail party. This year’s party, The Gatsby Gala, was held November 3, 2026, at 1923 Prohibition Bar in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: Automotive Parts Associates (APA) 举办的年度行业鸡尾酒会为今年的 AWDA 和 AAPEX 庆祝活动增添了一丝咆哮的 20 年代魅力。今年的派对“盖茨比晚会”于 2026 年 11 月 3 日在拉斯维加斯 1923 Prohibition 酒吧举行。

paras.en: Guests stepped back in time for an evening of drinks, networking, and old-school elegance. Adding to the occasion, APA staff dressed in 1920s-inspired attire, helping bring the spirit of the Jazz Age to life at the Prohibition-era venue.
paras.zh: 客人们回到过去，度过了一个畅饮、社交和老式优雅的夜晚。为庆祝这一盛事，APA 工作人员身着 1920 年代风格的服装，帮助在禁酒令时代的场馆将爵士乐时代的精神带入生活。

paras.en: “One of the best parts of AWDA and AAPEX is the opportunity to bring people together outside of the day-to-day business. The Gatsby Gala gave us a chance to celebrate the relationships that make this industry special while enjoying a memorable evening with our shareholders, members and supplier partners,” said Steve Tucker, president of Automotive Parts Associates.
paras.zh: “AWDA和AAPEX的一大亮点在于，它们为人们提供了在日常业务之外欢聚一堂的机会。Automotive Parts Associates总裁Steve Tucker表示：“盖茨比晚宴为我们提供了一个机会，让我们能够与股东、会员和供应商合作伙伴共度一个难忘的夜晚，同时庆祝那些让这个行业与众不同的关系。”

paras.en: The evening brought together APA shareholders, TruStar members, NEXUS representatives, and industry supplier partners for an opportunity to connect with fellow aftermarket professionals, strengthen existing relationships, and enjoy a night away from the busy trade show floor.
paras.zh: 当晚，APA 股东、TruStar 会员、NEXUS 代表和行业供应商合作伙伴齐聚一堂，有机会与售后市场专业人士建立联系、加强现有关系，并享受远离繁忙贸易展览场地的夜晚。

paras.en: The Gatsby Gala carried on APA/TruStar’s tradition of hosting an annual gathering during one of the busiest weeks in the automotive aftermarket. Beyond the party, APA also held a dinner for its Board of Directors on Saturday night and met with more than 70 supplier partners during AWDA and on the AAPEX show floor.
paras.zh: Gatsby Gala 延续了 APA/TruStar 在汽车售后市场最繁忙的几周举办年度聚会的传统。除了派对之外，APA 还在周六晚为其董事会举办了晚宴，并在 AWDA 期间和 AAPEX 展厅与 70 多家供应商合作伙伴会面。

articles.title: The Group Launches Toys for Tots Drive
articles.author: Jeff White

paras.en: For the 15th consecutive year, participating Automotive Parts Services Group (The Group) members are supporting the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots campaign by collecting toy and monetary donations for children in need in their communities.
paras.zh: 连续第 15 年，参与活动的汽车零部件服务集团 (集团) 成员通过为社区中有需要的儿童收集玩具和金钱捐款来支持美国海军陆战队为幼儿储备玩具活动。

paras.en: “Over the years, our Toys for Tots partnership has continued to grow as we collect toys and raise funds to bring holiday cheer to children in need across the country,” said John Marcum, director of marketing at Federated Auto Parts. “The Group’s members have played an important role in growing the campaign through their commitment to promoting the program and encouraging community support. What began as a holiday effort has grown into a year-round initiative. We extend our sincere thanks to the Federated Alliance, The Pronto Network and our supplier partners for their ongoing generosity and commitment to this cause.”
paras.zh: Federated Auto Parts 营销总监约翰·马库姆 (John Marcum) 表示：“多年来，我们与 Toys for Tots 的合作不断发展，我们收集玩具并筹集资金，为全国有需要的儿童带来节日欢乐。” “集团成员致力于推广该计划并鼓励社区支持，在推动这项活动方面发挥了重要作用。最初的假日活动已发展成为一项全年活动。我们衷心感谢联邦联盟、Pronto Network 和我们的供应商合作伙伴对这一事业的持续慷慨和承诺。”

paras.en: The Group Raises Over $4 Million for Toys For Tots
paras.zh: 该集团为幼儿玩具筹集了超过 400 万美元

paras.en: Since partnering with the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve Toys for Tots Program, The Group, its members and vendor partners have helped raise over $4 million for Toys for Tots. In addition to toy donations at participating locations, financial contributions can be made online by visiting The Group’s Toys for Tots website and clicking on “Make a Donation.” Donors can use a credit card securely or print out a form and mail it with a check made payable to Toys for Tots.
paras.zh: 自从与美国海军陆战队后备儿童玩具计划合作以来，该集团、其成员和供应商合作伙伴已帮助为儿童玩具筹集了超过 400 万美元的资金。除了在参与地点捐赠玩具外，还可以通过访问该集团的 Toys for Tots 网站并点击“捐赠”来在线捐款。捐赠者可以安全地使用信用卡，也可以打印表格并附上抬头为 Toys for Tots 的支票邮寄。

paras.en: “All donations made online or at participating member locations are distributed in the area where the toys and money are collected, helping make the holidays brighter for deserving children in their own communities,” said Marcum.
paras.zh: 马库姆说：“所有在线或在参与会员地点进行的捐款都会分发到收集玩具和金钱的区域，帮助他们自己社区的孩子们度过一个更加美好的假期。”

paras.en: Last year, the campaign delivered 24 million toys to nearly 11 million children and since 1947, the Marine Toys for Tots Foundation has distributed more than 732 million toys to more than 325 million children.
paras.zh: 去年，该活动向近 1100 万儿童分发了 2400 万件玩具，自 1947 年以来，海洋儿童玩具基金会已向超过 3.25 亿儿童分发了超过 7.32 亿件玩具。

articles.title: Man's 'silly experiment' at work led to a fatal 'rectal explosion'
articles.author: Mindy Weisberger

paras.en: The patient: A 35-year-old man in the Czech Republic
paras.zh: 患者：捷克35岁男性

paras.en: The symptoms: The man was injured while working in a factory. His co-workers learned he'd been hurt after he crawled from the ground floor to the first floor and shouted for help. He had severe abdominal pain and rectal bleeding, and he said he had been injured while conducting "a silly experiment" involving a pressurized air system. However, he did not describe exactly what had happened.
paras.zh: 症状：该男子在工厂工作时受伤。他从一楼爬到一楼并大声呼救后，他的同事才得知他受伤了。他有严重的腹痛和直肠出血，他说自己在进行涉及加压空气系统的“愚蠢实验”时受伤。不过，他没有具体描述发生了什么。

paras.en: "He repeatedly stressed that the incident was his own fault," doctors later wrote in a report of his case.
paras.zh: “他反复强调，这起事件是他自己的错，”医生后来在他的病例报告中写道。

paras.en: What happened next: The man was flown by helicopter to a nearby hospital, but during the flight, he became unresponsive and showed signs of hemorrhagic shock — a type of shock caused by significant blood loss over a short period. Shock, broadly, is when organs and body tissues don't receive enough oxygen due to decreased blood flow; if untreated, it can lead to organ failure and death.
paras.zh: 接下来发生的事情：该男子被直升机送往附近的一家医院，但在飞行过程中，他变得反应迟钝，并出现失血性休克的症状——一种因短时间内大量失血而引起的休克。从广义上讲，休克是指器官和身体组织由于血流量减少而无法获得足够的氧气。如果不治疗，可能会导致器官衰竭和死亡。

paras.en: Medical attendants in the helicopter worked to revive the man, but he died before he could be admitted to the hospital. Because the fatal injury occurred at the man's workplace, the police ordered a medicolegal autopsy, which both identifies the cause of death and collects details for law enforcement agencies, as part of an inquest procedure.
paras.zh: 直升机上的医护人员努力抢救该男子，但他在被送往医院之前就去世了。由于致命伤害发生在该男子的工作场所，警方下令进行法医学尸检，作为调查程序的一部分，既可以查明死因，又可以为执法机构收集详细信息。

paras.en: The autopsy: The coroner examined the body and noted that the soft tissues of the man's face were swollen and abnormally distended from retained air. The man's anus and genital areas were similarly distended and densely coated with dried blood, with radial tears in the skin surrounding the anus.
paras.zh: 尸检：验尸官检查了尸体，发现该男子脸部的软组织因滞留空气而肿胀且异常膨胀。该男子的肛门和生殖器区域同样肿胀，并密布干涸的血液，肛门周围的皮肤有放射状撕裂。

paras.en: Next, the coroner conducted an internal examination. The man's brain was swollen, and he had air bubbles in his brain and chest cavity. Blood had collected around his diaphragm (the large muscle that helps inflate and deflate the lungs). It had also accumulated in the wall between the heart chambers on the left side, in tubes leading to his lungs, and in the membranes covering his lungs and heart. Reservoirs of blood also pooled in the man's abdominal cavity, in the tube leading to his right kidney, and in his digestive organs.
paras.zh: 接下来，验尸官进行了内部检查。该男子脑部肿胀，脑部和胸腔内都有气泡。血液聚集在他的膈肌（帮助肺部膨胀和收缩的大肌肉）周围。它还积聚在左侧心室之间的壁、通向肺部的管道中以及覆盖肺部和心脏的膜中。该男子的腹腔、通向右肾的管道以及消化器官中也积满了血液。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: The man's heart was "shrunken and empty," according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，这名男子的心脏“萎缩且空虚”。

paras.en: The autopsy also revealed foreign objects stuck between loops of the man's small intestine. These included three pieces of a black rubber pipe stopper and scraps of a plastic bag. His rectum — the final straight portion of the large intestine — had detached violently from his anus. It was surrounded by blood and marked with a laceration that was nearly circular, indicating that an "explosive rectal injury" had triggered hemorrhagic shock and caused the man's death, the coroner concluded.
paras.zh: 尸检还发现，该男子的小肠袢之间卡有异物。其中包括三块黑色橡胶管塞和一个塑料袋的碎片。他的直肠——大肠最后的直部分——猛烈地从肛门上脱落。验尸官得出的结论是，伤口周围全是血，并有一道近乎圆形的裂口，表明“直肠爆炸伤”引发了失血性休克并导致该男子死亡。

paras.en: Further investigation: Additional evidence from the factory and rubber fragments in the man's small intestine provided the police with further insight into his injuries; additional clues came from his internet search history, including photos of himself that he'd submitted to an amateur sex website.
paras.zh: 进一步调查：来自工厂的额外证据和该男子小肠中的橡胶碎片为警方进一步了解了他的伤情；其他线索来自他的互联网搜索历史，包括他提交给业余色情网站的自己的照片。

paras.en: The police concluded that the man had been performing autoerotic anal stimulation while at work, using a rubber inflatable pipe stopper measuring 2 to 3 inches (50 to 70 millimeters) in diameter, and an air gun, a handheld device for directing powerful jets of compressed air.
paras.zh: 警方得出结论，该男子在工作时使用直径为 2 至 3 英寸（50 至 70 毫米）的橡胶充气管塞和气枪（一种用于引导强力压缩空气射流的手持设备）进行自体肛门刺激。

paras.en: They suggested that the man likely attached the expandable pipe stopper to the muzzle of the air gun, which was in turn connected to the factory's air distribution system by a long, high-pressure hose. He then covered the pipe stopper with a plastic bag, inserted it into his rectal cavity, and pressed the air gun's trigger, causing "an unexpected abrupt inflation and explosive bursting of the pipe stopper within his rectum," the doctors wrote in the case report.
paras.zh: 他们认为，该男子可能将可膨胀的管塞安装在气枪的枪口上，而气枪又通过一根长的高压软管连接到工厂的空气分配系统。医生在病例报告中写道，然后他用塑料袋盖住管塞，将其插入直肠腔，并按下气枪的扳机，导致“直肠内的管塞意外突然充气和爆炸性爆裂”。

paras.en: What makes the case unique: This case is the first recorded example of a person dying from a "rectal explosion during self-gratification," the doctors wrote. Piecing together the circumstances leading up to the man's injury was important for the hospital's doctors and law enforcement to understand how the fatality likely occurred, the authors said.
paras.zh: 该病例的独特之处：医生写道，该病例是第一个有记录的因“自我满足时直肠爆炸”而死亡的例子。作者说，拼凑导致该男子受伤的情况对于医院医生和执法部门了解死亡可能是如何发生的非常重要。

paras.en: When performed responsibly and consensually, rectal insertion of foreign bodies typically does not cause significant injury, the authors added. However, "the introduction of some objects into the rectum might have unpredictable and even fatal effects."
paras.zh: 作者补充说，如果负责任且双方同意，直肠插入异物通常不会造成严重伤害。然而，“将某些物体引入直肠可能会产生不可预测的甚至致命的影响。”

paras.en: For more intriguing medical cases, check out our Diagnostic Dilemma archives.
paras.zh: 如需更多有趣的医疗案例，请查看我们的诊断困境档案。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.zh: 你能猜出这些奇怪医疗病例的诊断吗？通过我们的诊断困境测验找出答案！

paras.en: Mindy Weisberger is a science journalist and author of "Rise of the Zombie Bugs: The Surprising Science of Parasitic Mind-Control" (Hopkins Press). She formerly edited for Scholastic and was a channel editor and senior writer for Live Science. She has reported on general science, covering climate change, paleontology, biology and space. Mindy studied film at Columbia University; prior to LS, she produced, wrote and directed media for the American Museum of Natural History in NYC. Her videos about dinosaurs, astrophysics, biodiversity and evolution appear in museums and science centers worldwide, earning awards such as the CINE Golden Eagle and the Communicator Award of Excellence. Her writing has also appeared in Scientific American, The Washington Post, How It Works Magazine and CNN.
paras.zh: 明迪·韦斯伯格（Mindy Weisberger）是一名科学记者，也是《僵尸虫的崛起：寄生精神控制的令人惊奇的科学》（霍普金斯出版社）的作者。她曾担任 Scholastic 的编辑，也是 Live Science 的频道编辑和高级作家。她报道了普通科学，涵盖气候变化、古生物学、生物学和太空。明迪在哥伦比亚大学学习电影；在加入 LS 之前，她为纽约美国自然历史博物馆制作、撰写和指导媒体。她有关恐龙、天体物理学、生物多样性和进化的视频出现在世界各地的博物馆和科学中心，赢得了电影金鹰奖和杰出传播者奖等奖项。她的文章还发表在《科学美国人》、《华盛顿邮报》、《How It Works》杂志和 CNN 上。

articles.title: Neanderthal genes linked to lower risk of schizophrenia in modern humans
articles.author: Charles Q. Choi

paras.en: A newfound genetic variant inherited from Neanderthals may shrink a part of modern-human brains without having any meaningful effects on mental ability, and it might also reduce the risk of schizophrenia, a new study finds.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，从尼安德特人继承的一种新发现的遗传变异可能会缩小现代人类大脑的一部分，但不会对智力产生任何有意义的影响，而且还可能降低患精神分裂症的风险。

paras.en: "Genetic differences between Neanderthals and modern humans still influence our brains today," study co-author Hugo Zeberg, an evolutionary geneticist at the Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology in Germany, told Live Science. Zeberg and his colleague Svante Pääbo detailed their findings Nov. 16 in the journal PNAS.
paras.zh: “尼安德特人和现代人类之间的基因差异至今仍然影响着我们的大脑，”该研究的合著者、德国马克斯·普朗克进化人类学研究所的进化遗传学家雨果·泽伯格（Hugo Zeberg）告诉《生活科学》。 Zeberg 和他的同事 Svante Pääbo 于 11 月 16 日在《PNAS》杂志上详细介绍了他们的发现。

paras.en: Before they went extinct around 40,000 years ago, Neanderthals were among the closest relatives of modern humans. More than a decade of research has shown that Neanderthals and modern humans once interbred. Most people not of sub-Saharan ancestry living today possess about 2% Neanderthal ancestry.
paras.zh: 在大约 4 万年前灭绝之前，尼安德特人是现代人类最近的亲戚之一。十多年的研究表明，尼安德特人和现代人类曾经杂交过。今天生活的大多数非撒哈拉以南地区血统的人拥有大约 2% 的尼安德特人血统。

paras.en: Neanderthals' skulls were larger and more elongated than modern humans'. One reason for the differences has to do with the occipital lobe, the smallest of the brain's four lobes, which sits in the back of the skull. The occipital lobe houses the visual cortex, which helps process signals from the eyes. This area was relatively larger in Neanderthals than it is in modern humans.
paras.zh: 尼安德特人的头骨比现代人类的头骨更大、更长。造成差异的原因之一与枕叶有关，枕叶是大脑四个叶中最小的一个，位于头骨后部。枕叶拥有视觉皮层，有助于处理来自眼睛的信号。尼安德特人的这个区域比现代人类的要大。

paras.en: In the new study, the researchers analyzed modern-human genomes for genetic variants that are related to occipital lobe size and were also likely inherited from Neanderthals. They discovered one such variant associated with the DAAM1 gene, which a 2019 study linked with brain development. This genetic variant was found only in modern humans outside Africa and was seen in five Neanderthal genomes.
paras.zh: 在这项新研究中，研究人员分析了现代人类基因组中与枕叶大小相关的遗传变异，这些变异也可能是从尼安德特人遗传而来的。他们发现了一种与 DAAM1 基因相关的变异，2019 年的一项研究表明该变异与大脑发育有关。这种遗传变异仅在非洲以外的现代人类中发现，并在五个尼安德特人基因组中发现。

paras.en: Curiously, the Neanderthal variant the scientists detected in modern-human genomes led to an approximately 0.05-cubic-inch (0.85 cubic centimeters) reduction in occipital lobe size per copy of the variant in an individual. This means that the Neanderthal gene was linked to a slightly smaller brain size in modern humans.
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，科学家在现代人类基因组中检测到的尼安德特人变异导致个体每个变异拷贝的枕叶尺寸减少约 0.05 立方英寸（0.85 立方厘米）。这意味着尼安德特人的基因与现代人的大脑尺寸稍小有关。

paras.en: This effect is the opposite of what experts expected based on Neanderthals' large skull size, Tony Capra, an evolutionary geneticist at the University of California, San Francisco, who was not involved in the research, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的加州大学旧金山分校进化遗传学家托尼·卡普拉（Tony Capra）告诉《生活科学》杂志，这种效应与专家根据尼安德特人大头骨尺寸所预期的结果相反。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: However, it's important to remember that this one gene variant "does not reflect the full set of variations that might have been present in Neanderthals that might have affected the shape and size of their brain structures," Capra noted.
paras.zh: 然而，重要的是要记住，这一基因变异“并不能反映尼安德特人中可能存在的全套变异，这些变异可能会影响其大脑结构的形状和大小，”卡普拉指出。

paras.en: Zeberg and Pääbo also discovered that having two copies of the DAAM1 gene variant was associated with a nearly 10% reduction in the chances of having schizophrenia in modern humans. But there was no apparent link between the variant and intelligence in modern humans.
paras.zh: Zeberg 和 Pääbo 还发现，拥有两个 DAAM1 基因变异拷贝与现代人患精神分裂症的几率降低近 10% 相关。但这种变异与现代人类的智力之间没有明显的联系。

paras.en: "A Neanderthal variant can have a relatively strong effect on brain anatomy without affecting intelligence, while also reducing schizophrenia risk," Zeberg said.
paras.zh: 泽伯格说：“尼安德特人的变异可以对大脑解剖结构产生相对较强的影响，而不影响智力，同时还可以降低患精神分裂症的风险。”

paras.en: - Neanderthal DNA still survives in our human family tree. What were our ancient relatives' relationships like?
paras.zh: - 尼安德特人的 DNA 仍然存在于我们人类的家谱中。我们古代的亲戚关系是怎样的？

paras.en: - 'Major disruption in Neanderthal history': 65,000 years ago, all Neanderthals in Europe died out except for one lineage
paras.zh: -“尼安德特人历史的重大破坏”：65,000年前，欧洲所有尼安德特人除了一个血统外都灭绝了

paras.en: - Neanderthals passed on a gene that helps modern humans pack on more muscle — but only a few people have it
paras.zh: - 尼安德特人遗传了一种帮助现代人类增加肌肉的基因——但只有少数人拥有这种基因

paras.en: Symptoms of schizophrenia can include altered perceptions of reality, such as visual hallucinations and problems with processing visual signals. This makes it "tempting to speculate" that this Neanderthal gene variant's effects on schizophrenia might be associated with the visual cortex. However, there is currently no evidence for such a link, Zeberg said.
paras.zh: 精神分裂症的症状可能包括对现实的感知改变，例如视觉幻觉和处理视觉信号的问题。这使得人们“很容易推测”这种尼安德特人基因变异对精神分裂症的影响可能与视觉皮层有关。然而，泽伯格说，目前没有证据表明存在这种联系。

paras.en: Future research along these lines could analyze how other Neanderthal genetic variants influenced modern humans, Capra said, "to see if they had a consistent effect on us." Looking into Neanderthal variants that are missing from modern-human genomes could "show us what makes us modern humans as opposed to them," Capra added.
paras.zh: 卡普拉说，未来沿着这些思路的研究可以分析其他尼安德特人的基因变异如何影响现代人类，“看看它们是否对我们有一致的影响。”卡普拉补充说，研究现代人类基因组中缺失的尼安德特人变异可以“向我们展示是什么让我们成为现代人类而不是他们”。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Zeberg, H., & Pääbo, S. (2026). A Neandertal-derived genetic variant reduces occipital brain volume in present-day humans. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 123(48). https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2624837123
paras.zh: Zeberg, H. 和 Pääbo, S. (2026)。源自尼安德特人的遗传变异减少了现代人类枕叶的大脑体积。美国国家科学院院刊，123(48)。 https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2624837123
