Despite wearing a press jacket, they accused him of being the party's cameraman. "They wanted to collect the camera. I was struggling with them because I didn't want them to take it away. In the process, my middle finger was broken," he said.
paras.zh: 阿德班乔跑向停车场，希望能找到地方躲起来。但一些袭击者发现了他并追赶。当地报纸《有线电视》的记者被五名男子包围，他们开始殴打他，迫使他放开相机。尽管穿着记者服，他们还是指责他是聚会的摄影师。 “他们想收回相机。我和他们挣扎，因为我不想让他们把它拿走。在这个过程中，我的中指被折断了，”他说。

paras.en: During the struggle, one of the thugs raised his axe and struck it towards his wrist. "I used my hand to guard it. I was expecting blood. I never knew it landed on my wristwatch, and that's when it hit me that they're not joking, and that I had to let go of my equipment."
paras.zh: 打斗过程中，一名暴徒举起斧头，朝他的手腕砍去。 “我用手保护它。我以为会有血。我从来不知道它落在了我的手表上，就在那时我意识到他们不是在开玩笑，我不得不放弃我的装备。”

paras.en: He was left in agonizing pain. By the time the violence subsided and he was taken to the hospital, he had sustained a broken middle finger and internal injuries around his ribs. The attack also left several other people injured and properties, including vehicles belonging to supporters of the party, destroyed.
paras.zh: 他陷入了极度的痛苦之中。当暴力平息并被送往医院时，他的中指骨折，肋骨周围受伤。这次袭击还造成其他几人受伤，包括该党支持者的车辆在内的财产被毁。

paras.en: As the January 16, 2027 general election inches closer, incidents like this are becoming increasingly common, as incumbent Bola Tinubu battles for re-election on a ticket that revolves around combating insecurity and resolving the country's biting economic crisis.
paras.zh: 随着 2027 年 1 月 16 日大选的临近，此类事件变得越来越常见，因为现任总统博拉·蒂努布 (Bola Tinubu) 围绕消除不安全局势和解决该国严重的经济危机来争取连任。

paras.en: Adebanjo's experience is not an isolated incident. According to the National Peace Committee, 109 breaches of the National Peace Accord have been recorded across the country's 26 states and the federal capital, Abuja.
paras.zh: 阿德班乔的经历并不是一个孤立的事件。据国家和平委员会称，该国 26 个州和联邦首都阿布贾已发生 109 起违反《国家和平协议》的事件。

paras.en: Between August 19, when the campaign kicked off in the West African country, and October 27, political violence and thuggery, as well as misinformation and disinformation, top the violations, accounting for 33 and 29 incidents respectively.
paras.zh: 从 8 月 19 日运动在这个西非国家开始到 10 月 27 日，政治暴力和谋杀以及错误信息和虚假信息是违规行为中最多的，分别占 33 起和 29 起事件。

paras.en: Campaign rallies, town hall meetings and other political events organized by parties have been marred by violence, threats and intimidation, prompting analysts to caution that rising violence could taint the credibility of the elections and discourage voter participation.
paras.zh: 政党组织的竞选集会、市政厅会议和其他政治活动都受到暴力、威胁和恐吓的破坏，这促使分析人士警告称，暴力事件的增加可能会损害选举的可信度并阻碍选民的参与。

paras.en: On November 15, a group of men attacked the campaign convoy of former Kano state governor and National Democratic Congress vice-presidential candidate Rabiu Kwankwaso during a visit to the Bichi area of Kano. Similar incidents were recorded in both Sokoto and Kebbi when former Vice President Atiku Abubakar took his campaign to the northwestern states.
paras.zh: 11月15日，一群男子在访问卡诺比奇地区时袭击了前卡诺州州长、全国民主党大会副总统候选人拉比乌·宽夸索(Rabiu Kwankwaso)的竞选车队。当前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔在西北部各州开展竞选活动时，索科托和凯比都发生了类似事件。

paras.en: Civil society groups, including Amnesty International, have condemned the spate of election-related violence and intimidation across the country, urging security agencies to bring perpetrators to book. President Tinubu has also condemned the rising incidents of violence at political events, warning that intimidation and political thuggery capable of disrupting public order would not be tolerated.
paras.zh: 包括国际特赦组织在内的民间社会团体谴责全国各地发生的一系列与选举有关的暴力和恐吓行为，敦促安全机构将肇事者绳之以法。蒂努布总统还谴责政治活动中不断增加的暴力事件，警告称不会容忍能够扰乱公共秩序的恐吓和政治暴行。

paras.en: Political violence is not new to Nigeria; nearly all of the country's elections have been tainted by violence and intimidation, including the deadly post-election violence that followed the 2011 elections, where at least 800 people were killed over days of rioting in states across northern Nigeria.
paras.zh: 政治暴力对尼日利亚来说并不新鲜。该国几乎所有选举都受到暴力和恐吓的影响，包括 2011 年选举后发生的致命的选举后暴力事件，尼日利亚北部各州连续几天发生骚乱，造成至少 800 人死亡。

paras.en: Raheem Mutiu, a Nigerian researcher at Armed Conflict Location & Event Data (ACLED), a global organization that collects data on conflicts and political violence worldwide, told DW that the pattern ahead of the coming polls is shaping up to show "political groups more agitated and determined to win elections by all means."
paras.zh: 武装冲突地点和事件数据（ACLED）是一个收集全球冲突和政治暴力数据的全球组织，尼日利亚研究员拉希姆·穆蒂乌（Raheem Mutiu）告诉德国之声，即将举行的民意调查的趋势正在显现，“政治团体更加激动，决心不惜一切手段赢得选举”。

paras.en: Mutiu described the spate of violence since the campaign was flagged off as mind-boggling. "Within the period of two months, we have recorded over 30 politically linked attacks with 10 fatalities. But what this one points to is that politically linked attacks have become more frequent and geographically widespread ahead of the January 2027 general election," he said.
paras.zh: 穆蒂乌描述了自竞选活动结束以来发生的一系列暴力事件令人难以置信。 “两个月内，我们记录了 30 多起与政治有关的袭击事件，造成 10 人死亡。但这一次事件表明，在 2027 年 1 月大选之前，与政治有关的袭击变得更加频繁，地理范围也更加广泛​​，”他说。

paras.en: The country's multiparty politics has entrenched a winner-takes-all system that fuels fierce competition among parties and, at times, a willingness to resort to violence. There's also a growing intolerance for opposition among party supporters, although perpetrators are difficult to identify because they often act anonymously and as proxies for the interests they support.
paras.zh: 该国的多党政治巩固了赢家通吃的制度，加剧了政党之间的激烈竞争，有时甚至导致诉诸暴力的意愿。政党支持者对反对派的容忍度也越来越高，尽管肇事者很难识别，因为他们经常匿名行事，并作为他们支持的利益的代理人。

paras.en: "What we have seen again is that supporters across the political spectrum are involved in the attacks, but intensity of their violence and engagement largely depends on their local stronghold and territorial dominance," Mutiu added.
paras.zh: 穆蒂乌补充说：“我们再次看到的是，各个政治派别的支持者都参与了袭击，但他们的暴力和参与的强度很大程度上取决于他们当地的据点和领土主导地位。”

paras.en: A voter choosing under threat is not choosing freely, Dengiyefa Angalapu, a researcher at the Abuja-based Center for Democracy and Development, told DW. He noted that apart from the physical attacks, the spread of fake news and hate speech narratives, which form part of the non-physical breaches of the peace accord, "can deceive voters and undermine trust in genuine information."
paras.zh: 阿布贾民主与发展中心研究员登吉耶法·安加拉普 (Dengiyefa Angalapu) 告诉德国之声，在威胁下做出选择的选民并不是自由选择。他指出，除了人身攻击之外，假新闻和仇恨言论的传播也是对和平协议的非实体破坏的一部分，“可能会欺骗选民并破坏对真实信息的信任”。

paras.en: Angalapu stressed that the growing threat of electoral violence could further undermine voter participation in a country already struggling with low turnout. More than 103 million Nigerians are registered to vote in the 2027 general elections, according to the country's electoral authority.
paras.zh: 安加拉普强调，选举暴力的威胁日益严重，可能会进一步削弱这个已经陷入低投票率的国家的选民参与度。据该国选举机构称，超过 1.03 亿尼日利亚人登记参加 2027 年大选。

paras.en: However, the country has consistently recorded low voter participation, with the 2023 general elections witnessing the lowest turnout since Nigeria's return to democratic rule in 1999. Only 27% of the nearly 94 million registered voters cast their ballots.
paras.zh: 然而，该国的选民参与率一直很低，2023 年大选的投票率是尼日利亚 1999 年恢复民主统治以来的最低水平。在近 9400 万登记选民中，只有 27% 参加了投票。

paras.en: "Intimidation adds another pressure: someone who fears punishment for their political preference may avoid meetings or withdraw from politics altogether," Angalapu added.
paras.zh: 安加拉普补充说：“恐吓增加了另一种压力：担心自己的政治偏好受到惩罚的人可能会避免参加会议或完全退出政治。”

paras.en: Adebanjo is still recovering from his injuries. The attack has left him with a bigger question about safety ahead of the polls: "If this could happen to me, a journalist, how much more to the citizens? I am not sure, at this stage, people will even come out to vote."
paras.zh: 阿德班乔的伤势仍在恢复中。这次袭击让他在投票前面临一个更大的安全问题：“如果这种事发生在我这个记者身上，更何况是公民呢？我不确定，现阶段人们是否会出来投票。”

articles.title: Almost 1 in 4 children live in conflict zones — report

paras.en: A record number of children were living in a conflict zone in 2025, Save the Children findings revealed on Thursday.
paras.zh: 救助儿童会周四公布的调查结果显示，2025 年生活在冲突地区的儿童数量将创历史新高。

paras.en: In the latest report in the "Stop the War on Children" series, the humantarian group said 589 million children worldwide lived in conflict zones. That's the highest number since records began in 1990, and more than double the total in the mid-1990s.
paras.zh: 在“停止对儿童的战争”系列的最新报告中，该人道主义组织表示，全球有5.89亿儿童生活在冲突地区。这是自 1990 年有记录以来的最高数字，是 20 世纪 90 年代中期总数的两倍多。

paras.en: "For millions of children, fear, violence and displacement are part of every day life," said Save the Children Germany CEO Florian Westphal.
paras.zh: 德国救助儿童会首席执行官弗洛里安·韦斯特法尔 (Florian Westphal) 表示：“对于数百万儿童来说，恐惧、暴力和流离失所是日常生活的一部分。”

paras.en: He said this needed to be a "wake-up call" for the international community.
paras.zh: 他表示，这需要为国际社会敲响“警钟”。

paras.en: Where children are living in conflict zones
paras.zh: 儿童生活在冲突地区

paras.en: Around two in five children in both Africa and the Middle East were living in conflict zones in 2025, the report found. Africa, alone, accounted for 44% of all children living in conflict zones worldwide.
paras.zh: 报告发现，到 2025 年，非洲和中东约有五分之二的儿童生活在冲突地区。仅非洲就占全球冲突地区儿童总数的 44%。

paras.en: In terms of regional proportions, 40.2% of children in the Middle East were living in conflict zones in 2025. That represented roughly two in five children across the region, and a particularly steep rise in the number of children affected. The figure jumped by nearly 29% from 52 million in 2024 to 67 million last year.
paras.zh: 从地区比例来看，到 2025 年，中东地区有 40.2% 的儿童生活在冲突地区。这相当于该地区大约五分之二的儿童，而且受影响儿童的数量急剧增加。这一数字从 2024 年的 5200 万跃升至去年的 6700 万，增长了近 29%。

paras.en: Children's exposure to conflict in Africa has more than tripled over the past 15 years, with the share of children living in conflict zones rising from 12% in 2010 to 39% in 2025.
paras.zh: 过去 15 年里，非洲儿童遭受冲突的风险增加了两倍多，生活在冲突地区的儿童比例从 2010 年的 12% 上升到 2025 年的 39%。

paras.en: Grave violations against children in armed conflict zones increase
paras.zh: 武装冲突地区严重侵害儿童的行为有所增加

paras.en: The report highlighted the dramatic increase in the denial of humanitarian access.
paras.zh: 报告强调了拒绝人道主义准入的情况急剧增加。

paras.en: A total of 8,322 verified incidents of denying access to humanitarian aid to children were recorded in 2025, a 16-fold rise over the past decade. The figure was 509 in 2015, and only eight incidents were reported when the United Nations (UN) established the Monitoring and Reporting Mechanism (MRM) in 2005.
paras.zh: 2025 年，经核实，共有 8,322 起拒绝儿童获得人道主义援助的事件，比过去十年增加了 16 倍。 2015年这一数字为509起，而2005年联合国（UN）建立监测和报告机制（MRM）时仅报告了8起事件。

paras.en: The Palestinian Territories accounted for the vast majority of cases, with 5,946 incidents, or more than 70% of all verified cases globally.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦领土占病例的绝大多数，共有 5,946 起事件，占全球所有已核实病例的 70% 以上。

paras.en: "No grave violation has increased as dramatically or changed the overall pattern of verified violations as much as the denial of humanitarian access," the study noted.
paras.zh: 研究指出：“没有什么严重侵犯行为像拒绝人道主义准入那样急剧增加或改变了已核实的侵犯行为的总体模式。”

paras.en: According to the report, denial of humanitarian access rose from around 2% of all verified grave violations against children in 2015 to more than 21% in 2025, becoming the second-most frequently recorded violation after the killing and maiming of children.
paras.zh: 报告称，拒绝人道主义援助准入从 2015 年所有经核实的严重侵害儿童行为的 2% 左右上升到 2025 年的 21% 以上，成为继杀害和残害儿童之后第二常见的侵犯行为。

paras.en: Grave violations as laid out in the MRM also include the recruitment of children by armed forces, sexual violence, abduction and attacks on schools and hospitals.
paras.zh: MRM 中规定的严重违法行为还包括武装部队招募儿童、性暴力、绑架以及袭击学校和医院。

paras.en: Where violations against children were concentrated
paras.zh: 侵害儿童行为集中的地方

paras.en: The study found that, overall, 38,967 grave violations against children were verified by the UN.
paras.zh: 研究发现，联合国总共核实了 38,967 起严重侵害儿童行为。

paras.en: This was the second-highest annual total since the MRM was established, surpassed only by the record 41,763 violations documented in 2024.
paras.zh: 这是自 MRM 成立以来第二高的年度总数，仅次于 2024 年记录的 41,763 起违规事件。

paras.en: More than half of these took place in just three areas: the Palestinian Territories, the Democratic Republic of Congo and Nigeria. The Palestinian Territories alone accounted for 12,449 verified violations, nearly one-third of all cases.
paras.zh: 其中一半以上发生在三个地区：巴勒斯坦领土、刚果民主共和国和尼日利亚。仅巴勒斯坦领土就发生了 12,449 起经核实的违法行为，几乎占所有案件的三分之一。

paras.en: As well as the denial of humanitarian access, violations in 2025 included:
paras.zh: 除了拒绝人道主义准入外，2025 年的侵犯行为还包括：

paras.en: - 14,224 children killed or maimed in conflicts in 2025
paras.zh: - 2025年有14,224名儿童在冲突中丧生或致残

paras.en: - 1,787 cases of sexual violence, a 71% increase in the past decade
paras.zh: - 1,787 起性暴力案件，过去十年增加了 71%

paras.en: - A fifth straight year of increased attacks on schools and hospitals, at 2,930 cases
paras.zh: - 针对学校和医院的袭击连续第五年增加，达 2,930 起

paras.en: The Palestinian Territories recorded the highest number of attacks on schools or hospitals, with 837 incidents, followed by Ukraine with 643. Together, the two accounted for more than half of all reported cases worldwide.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦领土发生的针对学校或医院的袭击事件数量最多，共 837 起，其次是乌克兰，共 643 起。这两个地区合计占全球所有报告案件的一半以上。

paras.en: The sharpest rises in sexual violence incidents were recorded in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where cases jumped from 358 in 2024 to 592 in 2025, and Sudan, which saw an increase from 74 to 193. Around 86% of all cases were documented in African conflict zones.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国 (DRC) 的性暴力事件增幅最大，从 2024 年的 358 起增加到 2025 年的 592 起，苏丹则从 74 起增加到 193 起。所有案件中约 86% 发生在非洲冲突地区。

paras.en: "Children have the right to live free from violence. Changing the odds requires political choices that put children’s safety first, and a sustained commitment to stop the war on children," the NGO said.
paras.zh: 该非政府组织表示：“儿童有权生活在没有暴力的环境中。要改变这一局面，就需要做出将儿童安全放在首位的政治选择，并持续致力于制止针对儿童的战争。”

articles.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?

paras.en: Anthropic, the artificial intelligence (AI) giant, is set to make its Nasdaq debut Thursday in one of the largest share sales in history.
paras.zh: 人工智能 (AI) 巨头 Anthropic 将于周四在纳斯达克首次亮相，这是历史上最大的股票发行之一。

paras.en: The Claude maker offered 980 million shares at $83 (€76) per share, raising $81.3 billion. This values the firm at $1.5 trillion, well above market estimates of around $1.3 trillion.
paras.zh: 这家克劳德制造商以每股 83 美元（76 欧元）的价格发行了 9.8 亿股股票，筹集了 813 亿美元。该公司的估值为 1.5 万亿美元，远高于约 1.3 万亿美元的市场预期。

paras.en: This public listing is being seen as a key test of investor appetite for AI, as stock prices have swung wildly in recent months.
paras.zh: 由于近几个月来股价大幅波动，此次公开上市被视为投资者对人工智能兴趣的一次关键考验。

paras.en: 2026 was meant to be the year Wall Street’s trillion-dollar bet on what US President Donald Trump calls superintelligence (SI) started paying off.
paras.zh: 2026 年原本是华尔街对美国总统唐纳德·特朗普所谓的超级智能 (SI) 的数万亿美元赌注开始获得回报的一年。

paras.en: In the first half of the year, it did. Many AI stocks hit record highs as US hyperscalers like Google's Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft recorded bumper earnings.
paras.zh: 今年上半年，确实如此。随着谷歌旗下 Alphabet、Meta 和微软等美国超大规模企业录得丰厚盈利，许多人工智能股票创下历史新高。

paras.en: The second half of 2026, however, has brought a lot more uncertainty.
paras.zh: 然而，2026 年下半年带来了更多的不确定性。

paras.en: While the stock of chipmaker Nvidia pushed even higher last month, many hyperscalers and chip or memory firms have seen erratic movements in their stock prices.
paras.zh: 尽管芯片制造商英伟达 (Nvidia) 的股价上个月进一步走高，但许多超大规模企业和芯片或内存公司的股价走势却不稳定。

paras.en: Then, after the Democrats won control of the United States Congress in the midterm elections earlier this month, technology stocks sold off again dramatically.
paras.zh: 随后，民主党在本月初的中期选举中赢得美国国会控制权后，科技股再次大幅抛售。

paras.en: The Magnificent Seven — including Meta, Apple, Amazon and Tesla — lost more than $1 trillion in value in a single trading day.
paras.zh: 七巨头——包括 Meta、苹果、亚马逊和特斯拉——在一个交易日内损失了超过 1 万亿美元的价值。

paras.en: In a further twist, the AI sector took another hit last week as Nvidia shares plunged nearly 10% over two days.
paras.zh: 更进一步的是，人工智能行业上周再次遭受打击，英伟达股价在两天内暴跌近 10%。

paras.en: The sell-off followed revelations that CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman reportedly suspected by US intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
paras.zh: 此前，首席执行官黄仁勋与一名据报道被美国情报部门怀疑为中国间谍的女性有染的消息被曝光。

paras.en: Huang resigned from the chipmaker, sending Nvidia's shares lower still and prompting a campaign by current and former staffers, investors and other key figures in Silicon Valley to have him reinstated.
paras.zh: 黄仁勋从这家芯片制造商辞职，导致英伟达股价进一步走低，并促使硅谷现任和前任员工、投资者和其他关键人物发起运动，要求他复职。

paras.en: "Is this the best timing?" asked Dennis Dick, chief market strategist at the Canada-based Stock Trader Network, in an interview with DW last week.
paras.zh: “这是最好的时机吗？”加拿大Stock Trader Network首席市场策略师丹尼斯·迪克(Dennis Dick)上周在接受德国之声采访时问道。

paras.en: Dick said Anthropic's valuation depends on whether it can deliver on a forecast by Goldman Sachs of more than $600 billion in revenue by 2030.
paras.zh: 迪克表示，Anthropic 的估值取决于它是否能够实现高盛 (Goldman Sachs) 到 2030 年收入超过 6000 亿美元的预测。

paras.en: "If you get to a company with $600 billion in revenue, [a] $1.3 trillion [valuation] doesn’t sound that bad," he told DW. "But when you’re talking about a company with currently $52 billion in revenue, it sounds like it’s overvalued."
paras.zh: 他对德国之声表示：“如果你接触的是一家营收 6000 亿美元的公司，那么 1.3 万亿美元的[估值]听起来还不错。” “但当你谈论一家目前收入 520 亿美元的公司时，听起来它的估值被高估了。”

paras.en: Other analysts, like Vivek Seth, chief executive officer of Shaires Holdings, are more bullish about the Claude maker's prospects.
paras.zh: Shaires Holdings 首席执行官 Vivek Seth 等其他分析师对克劳德制造商的前景更加看好。

paras.en: "Anthropic is a once-in-a-generation company," Seth told Bloomberg last week, noting how it has grown rapidly and has strong institutional backing. "Its IPO will establish a market-clearing valuation as conditions stabilize."
paras.zh: “Anthropic 是一家百年一遇的公司，”塞斯上周告诉彭博社，并指出该公司如何快速发展并拥有强大的机构支持。 “随着情况稳定，其首次公开募股将建立市场出清估值。”

paras.en: Amid huge spending, big returns remain elusive
paras.zh: 巨额支出下，巨额回报仍难以实现

paras.en: Wall Street is growing increasingly cautious about the sheer size of the AI outlay, amid warnings that future earnings may not justify the huge spending.
paras.zh: 华尔街对人工智能支出的规模越来越谨慎，警告称未来的收益可能无法证明巨额支出的合理性。

paras.en: In September, investment bank Goldman Sachs estimated that hyperscalers need around $300 billion in annual AI revenue to break even on their spending, leaving a gap of roughly $230 billion.
paras.zh: 9 月份，投资银行高盛估计，超大规模企业每年需要约 3000 亿美元的人工智能收入才能实现支出平衡，缺口约为 2300 亿美元。

paras.en: "We're not in Kansas anymore," Dick quipped, borrowing a line from the classic movie "The Wizard of Oz," which means times have changed. Now, he said, investors are telling companies: "Show me the money."
paras.zh: “我们已经不在堪萨斯了，”迪克借用经典电影《绿野仙踪》中的一句台词打趣道，这意味着时代已经变了。他说，现在投资者告诉公司：“给我钱。”

paras.en: Other analysts, however, think it's too soon to expect the AI bubble to burst, including Kit Rees, investment strategist at London-based wealth manager Quilter, who thinks the post-election rout was a "healthy correction."
paras.zh: 然而，其他分析师认为现在预测人工智能泡沫破裂还为时过早，其中包括伦敦财富管理公司 Quilter 的投资策略师基特·里斯 (Kit Rees)，他认为选举后的溃败是一次“健康的调整”。

paras.en: "We’re still in the very early innings of the AI build-out," Rees told DW. "There’s still a lot of excitement around this technology and investors will want to have a slice of the pie."
paras.zh: 里斯告诉德国之声：“我们仍处于人工智能发展的早期阶段。” “这项技术仍然令人兴奋，投资者希望能分一杯羹。”

paras.en: In addition to the roughly $800 billion invested in capital expenditures this year, AI hyperscalers plan to spend a further $1.2 trillion in 2027 and $1.4 trillion in 2028, according to Goldman Sachs estimates.
paras.zh: 据高盛估计，除了今年投资约 8000 亿美元的资本支出外，人工智能超大规模企业还计划在 2027 年再支出 1.2 万亿美元，在 2028 年再支出 1.4 万亿美元。

paras.en: With many investors already running for the hills, Rees isn’t convinced the AI bubble will burst in the way skeptics expect. She thinks they should watch for stronger signs that the AI trade is maturing.
paras.zh: 由于许多投资者已经纷纷撤离，里斯并不相信人工智能泡沫会像怀疑者预期的那样破裂。她认为他们应该关注人工智能行业正在成熟的更强有力的迹象。

paras.en: This could be "a slowdown in AI-related revenues for companies, or signs of less demand or less appetite for financing companies’ AI plans, be it through debt or through equity offerings," Rees told DW.
paras.zh: 里斯告诉德国之声，这可能是“公司与人工智能相关的收入放缓，或者是对公司人工智能计划融资需求减少或兴趣减弱的迹象，无论是通过债务还是通过股票发行。”

paras.en: There are early signs that investors have less appetite for AI-related debt. Borrowing costs for AI infrastructure firms like CoreWeave and Oracle have soared recently. Even the cost of insuring Nvidia’s debt against default has risen 76% in a month, CNBC reported recently.
paras.zh: 早期迹象表明投资者对人工智能相关债务的兴趣减弱。 CoreWeave 和 Oracle 等人工智能基础设施公司的借贷成本最近飙升。据 CNBC 最近报道，就连为 Nvidia 债务违约提供保险的成本在一个月内也上涨了 76%。

paras.en: "They [Oracle] have been spending, some people say, like drunken sailors," Dick told DW. "They’ve compromised their balance sheet to a point where the stock’s fallen 65% from the highs."
paras.zh: “有人说，他们（甲骨文）一直在花钱，就像醉酒的水手一样，”迪克告诉德国之声。 “他们的资产负债表已经受到损害，股价已从高点下跌了 65%。”

paras.en: That has not stopped Oracle, along with Meta, Microsoft and Alphabet, from continuing to issue new AI bonds. Since the end of last month, the four AI giants have announced deals worth $67 billion.
paras.zh: 但这并没有阻止甲骨文、Meta、微软和 Alphabet 继续发行新的人工智能债券。自上月底以来，四大人工智能巨头已宣布价值670亿美元的交易。

paras.en: Rees said another sign could be any new regulations that make it harder to build out US data centers, due to pressure on local water and electricity supplies.
paras.zh: 里斯表示，另一个迹象可能是，由于当地水和电力供应面临压力，任何新规定都可能使美国数据中心的建设变得更加困难。

paras.en: Is AI next in a long line of bubbles that burst?
paras.zh: 人工智能会是一长串泡沫中的下一个破裂吗？

paras.en: In his upcoming book "AI Mania: Blather, Bluster, and the Bubble of All Bubbles," economist Gary Smith compares the AI boom with earlier frenzies around railways, automobiles, television and the internet. He warns of a "frightful crash" when the AI bubble eventually pops.
paras.zh: 经济学家加里·史密斯（Gary Smith）在他即将出版的新书《人工智能狂热：胡言乱语、狂言和所有泡沫中的泡沫》中，将人工智能的繁荣与早期围绕铁路、汽车、电视和互联网的狂热进行了比较。他警告说，当人工智能泡沫最终破灭时，将会出现“可怕的崩溃”。

paras.en: When the dot-com bubble burst in 2000, the tech-heavy Nasdaq stock market index lost nearly 80% of its value. Yet, previous bubbles have often lasted far longer than expected, making the timing of any crash hard to predict.
paras.zh: 2000 年互联网泡沫破裂时，以科技股为主的纳斯达克股市指数损失了近 80% 的价值。然而，之前的泡沫持续时间往往比预期长得多，因此很难预测任何崩盘的时间。

paras.en: Joachim Klement, head of market strategy at UK-based investment bank Panmure Liberum, believes a reckoning could happen as early as next year.
paras.zh: 英国投资银行 Panmure Liberum 市场策略主管约阿希姆·克莱门特 (Joachim Klement) 认为，清算最早可能会在明年发生。

paras.en: "My core conviction is that the AI bubble will either burst in 2027 or in 2028, so sometime in the next two years,” Klement told Bloomberg last month.
paras.zh: 克莱门特上个月对彭博社表示：“我的核心信念是，人工智能泡沫要么会在 2027 年或 2028 年破裂，要么在未来两年的某个时候破裂。”

paras.en: Editor's note: This article was first published on November 13, 2026 and was updated on November 18 and 19 to reflect the latest developments.
paras.zh: 编者注：本文首次发表于2026年11月13日，并于11月18日和19日更新以反映最新进展。

articles.title: Could Trump, Putin and Xi end the nuclear age?

paras.en: Excitement abounds around the possible tripartite meeting in Shenzhen, China, between Presidents Xi Jinping, Vladimir Putin, and Donald Trump during the November 18-19 Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
paras.zh: 习近平主席、弗拉基米尔·普京和唐纳德·特朗普总统可能在 11 月 18 日至 19 日举行的亚太经合组织峰会期间在中国深圳举行三方会晤，令人兴奋不已。

paras.en: Some are calling it Yalta 2.0. We’d rather think of it as Reykjavik 2.0, while also welcoming some of the broader diplomatic breakthroughs and global reordering achieved at Yalta almost 82 years ago.
paras.zh: 有些人称之为雅尔塔2.0。我们宁愿将其视为雷克雅未克 2.0，同时也欢迎近 82 年前在雅尔塔实现的一些更广泛的外交突破和全球重新秩序。

paras.en: Dmitri Trenin, who directed the Carnegie Moscow Center for many years and is now president of the Russian International Affairs Council, wrote encouragingly: “The US president has mentioned that an unprecedented trilateral meeting… would make sense if it were focused on denuclearisation.” Trenin wrote this in Al Jazeera while explaining why Russia could play a helpful role in negotiating a new nuclear agreement between its Iranian ally and the United States.
paras.zh: 多年担任卡内基莫斯科中心主任、现任俄罗斯国际事务委员会主席的德米特里·特列宁 (Dmitri Trenin) 令人鼓舞地写道：“美国总统提到，一场史无前例的三边会议……如果重点讨论无核化，那将是有意义的。”特雷宁在半岛电视台写下这篇文章，同时解释了为什么俄罗斯可以在其伊朗盟友与美国之间的新核协议谈判中发挥有益作用。

paras.en: While anything that might help end the dangerous, destructive, and potentially apocalyptic conflagration in Southwest Asia would be more than welcome, we think the leaders can and should aim even higher: Why not rekindle the spirit of the 1986 meeting between US President Ronald Reagan and Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev, at which they came within a hair’s breadth, arguably one word, of agreeing to eliminate not only all ballistic missiles, as Reagan originally proposed, but all nuclear weapons, as Gorbachev countered. Reagan replied, “Yes, all”, and Secretary of State George Shultz agreed. “Let’s do it,” he said.
paras.zh: 虽然任何可能有助于结束西南亚危险的、破坏性的、可能是世界末日的大火的事情都会受到欢迎，但我们认为领导人可以而且应该设定更高的目标：为什么不重燃 1986 年美国总统罗纳德·里根和苏联领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫会面的精神，当时他们差一点就同意不仅像里根最初提议的那样消除所有弹道导弹，而且可以消除所有核导弹。正如戈尔巴乔夫反驳的那样。里根回答说：“是的，全部”，国务卿乔治·舒尔茨表示同意。 “我们开始吧，”他说。

paras.en: The chance to achieve the most extraordinary diplomatic breakthrough in history slipped through Reagan’s grasp when he insisted on unlimited testing of his Strategic Defense Initiative (SDI) fantasy rather than limiting SDI to the laboratory for 10 years. The world’s hopes were dashed, and we have not come close since.
paras.zh: 当里根坚持无限地测试他的战略防御计划（SDI）幻想，而不是将SDI限制在实验室10年时，实现历史上最非凡的外交突破的机会就从他的手中溜走了。世界的希望破灭了，从那以后我们再也没有接近过。

paras.en: Sure, we’re up against obstacles, and the odds are long. Trump has responded to the midterm shellacking by appointing Stephen Miller as chief of staff, in effect giving the middle finger to those who didn’t support the Republicans, which is not a hopeful sign. Putin knows that much of Russia’s power comes not from its economic prowess or its conventional military but from possessing the largest nuclear arsenal in the world. And Xi has made it clear that China won’t engage in arms control talks until the largest nuclear arsenals are reduced – meanwhile, China has been rapidly increasing the size of its arsenal.
paras.zh: 当然，我们面临着障碍，而且可能性很小。特朗普任命斯蒂芬·米勒为幕僚长来回应中期选举的惨败，这实际上是对那些不支持共和党的人竖起了中指，这不是一个充满希望的迹象。普京知道，俄罗斯的实力很大程度上不是来自其经济实力或常规军事力量，而是来自拥有世界上最大的核武库。习近平明确表示，在削减最大核武库之前，中国不会参与军控谈判 — — 与此同时，中国一直在迅速扩大其核武库规模。

paras.en: That said, there are good reasons why all three could support this proposal. After his party’s midterm defeat, Trump, probably the most recalcitrant of the three, may be desperate for an achievement that could cement at least a piece of a positive legacy – and in this case a very big piece, a resounding piece. And he has been all over the map on the nuclear issue. In February 2025, he said, “There’s no reason for us to be building brand-new nuclear weapons. We already have so many. You could destroy the world 50 times over, 100 times over. And here we are building new nuclear weapons, and they’re building nuclear weapons.” He also said, “We’re all spending a lot of money that we could be spending on other things that are actually, hopefully, much more productive.”
paras.zh: 也就是说，这三个人都有充分的理由支持这项提议。在他的政党中期失败后，特朗普可能是三人中最顽固的一个，他可能迫切希望取得一项成就，以巩固至少一部分积极的遗产 — — 在这种情况下，这是一个非常大的遗产，一个响亮的遗产。他在核问题上也曾涉足过各个领域。 2025 年 2 月，他说：“我们没有理由建造全新的核武器。我们已经拥有这么多核武器。你可以摧毁世界 50 次、100 次。而我们在这里建造新的核武器，他们也在建造核武器。”他还表示，“我们都花了很多钱，这些钱本来可以花在其他实际上更有成效的事情上。”

paras.en: This is apparently something he’s been contemplating for many years. In 2016, he told Maggie Haberman and David Sanger of The New York Times: “I personally think it’s the biggest problem the world has, nuclear capability. I think it’s the single biggest problem… Power of weaponry today is beyond anything ever thought of, or even, you know, it’s unthinkable, the power… And to me, it’s the single biggest, it’s the single biggest problem.” He credits his “very brilliant” MIT physicist uncle, John Trump, with making him aware of this danger.
paras.zh: 这显然是他多年来一直在思考的事情。 2016年，他告诉《纽约时报》的玛吉·哈伯曼和大卫·桑格：“我个人认为，核能力是世界上最大的问题。我认为这是唯一最大的问题……当今武器的威力超出了任何人的想象，甚至，你知道，这是不可想象的……对我来说，这是最大的问题，这是唯一最大的问题。”他认为他“非常聪明”的麻省理工学院物理学家叔叔约翰·特朗普让他意识到了这种危险。

paras.en: In 1986, he sought the advice of Bernard Lown, cofounder of International Physicians for the Prevention of Nuclear War (IPPNW), which won the Nobel Peace Prize, on negotiating nuclear disarmament with Gorbachev. He told Lown he would get Reagan to send him to Moscow and that he would secure disarmament and end the Cold War in one hour. Lown commented, “I sat there dumbfounded. ‘Who is this self-inflated individual? Is he sane or what?’”
paras.zh: 1986年，他就与戈尔巴乔夫的核裁军谈判征求了诺贝尔和平奖获得者、国际防止核战争医生组织（IPPNW）联合创始人伯纳德·朗的建议。他告诉朗，他会让里根派他去莫斯科，并在一小时内确保裁军并结束冷战。洛恩评论道：“我坐在那里目瞪口呆。‘这个自我膨胀的人是谁？他神智正常吗？’”

paras.en: On January 23, 2025, Trump told the World Economic Forum in Davos: “And I will tell you that President Putin really liked the idea of – of cutting way back on nuclear. And I think the rest of the world, we would have gotten them to follow. And China would have come along too. China also liked it. Tremendous amounts of money are being spent on nuclear, and the destructive capability is something that we don’t even want to talk about today, because you don’t want to hear it. It’s too depressing. So, we want to see if we can denuclearise, and I think that’s very possible. And I can tell you that President Putin wanted to do it. He and I wanted to do it. We had a good conversation with China. They would have been involved, and that would have been an unbelievable thing for the planet.”
paras.zh: 2025 年 1 月 23 日，特朗普在达沃斯举行的世界经济论坛上表示：“我要告诉你们，普京总统真的很喜欢削减核能的想法。我认为我们会让世界其他国家效仿。中国也会跟着一起。中国也喜欢它。大量资金被花在核能上，而破坏性能力是我们今天甚至不想谈论的事情，因为你不想听到这太令人沮丧了，我们想看看是否可以实现无核化，我可以告诉你，普京总统想这么做，他们会参与其中，这对地球来说是一件难以置信的事情。”

paras.en: Whether Trump is sane is even more heatedly debated today than it was 40 years ago, but the possibility that he is iconoclastic enough to take a dramatic step that reverses the course of history should not be in doubt. The question is whether he’s capable of taking such a step in favour of humanity rather than against it.
paras.zh: 如今，与 40 年前相比，人们对特朗普是否神志清醒的争论更加激烈，但他有足够的反传统精神，采取戏剧性的一步来扭转历史进程，这是不容置疑的。问题是他是否有能力采取有利于人类而不是反对人类的步骤。

paras.en: The same is true of Putin. Putin told a meeting of the Valdai International Discussion Club in Sochi in 2017, “Should you ask me if nuclear disarmament is possible, I will tell you: Yes, it is possible. Does Russia wish to achieve universal nuclear disarmament or not? The answer is in the affirmative, too. Yes, it does, and it will be working for it.”
paras.zh: 普京也是如此。普京2017年在索契瓦尔代国际讨论俱乐部的一次会议上表示，“如果你问我核裁军是否可能，我会告诉你：是的，有可能。俄罗斯是否希望实现普遍核裁军？答案也是肯定的。是的，确实如此，而且俄罗斯将为此努力。”

paras.en: Shortly before the invasion of Ukraine, the leaders of the US, Russia, China, France, and the United Kingdom jointly declared: “We affirm that a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought… We remain committed to our Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) obligations, including our Article VI obligation to pursue negotiations in good faith on effective measures relating to cessation of the nuclear arms race at an early date and to nuclear disarmament.”
paras.zh: 入侵乌克兰前不久，美国、俄罗斯、中国、法国和英国领导人联合宣布：“我们申明，核战争不可能获胜，也决不能打……我们仍然致力于履行《核不扩散条约》（NPT）义务，包括我们的第六条义务，真诚地就早日停止核军备竞赛和核裁军的有效措施进行谈判。”

paras.en: Sceptics will rightly point out that this was before the invasion of Ukraine and a series of slightly veiled nuclear threats that Putin issued. But it at least offers a glimmer of hope, especially in the context of a security agreement that promises peaceful coexistence for all participants.
paras.zh: 怀疑论者会正确地指出，这是在入侵乌克兰和普京发出一系列略显隐蔽的核威胁之前。但它至少带来了一线希望，特别是在一项承诺所有参与者和平共处的安全协议的背景下。

paras.en: In 2017, in a speech at the United Nations Office in Geneva, Xi said clearly, “Nuclear weapons, the Sword of Damocles that hangs over humankind, should be completely prohibited and ultimately destroyed over time to make the world free of nuclear weapons.”
paras.zh: 2017年，习近平在联合国日内瓦办事处发表演讲时明确表示，“核武器是悬在人类头顶的达摩克利斯之剑，应该全面禁止并最终销毁，使世界成为无核武器的国家”。

paras.en: While not disavowing this sentiment, Xi has more recently indicated that China would not participate in arms control discussions until the gap between its arsenal and those of the largest nuclear powers – the United States and Russia – had narrowed. Fine. To most people, that means China increasing the size of its arsenal to the 5,000-plus weapons that both Russia and the United States possess.
paras.zh: 习近平虽然没有否认这种情绪，但最近表示，在其核武库与最大核大国（美国和俄罗斯）之间的差距缩小之前，中国不会参与军控讨论。美好的。对大多数人来说，这意味着中国将其军火库规模扩大到俄罗斯和美国都拥有的 5000 多件武器。

paras.en: We have a different proposal: How about if the US and Russia reduce their arsenals to the 600 or so that China now possesses?
paras.zh: 我们有一个不同的建议：如果美国和俄罗斯把它们的核武库减少到中国现在拥有的600个左右怎么样？

paras.en: We see this being done in three four-year stages, much as Reagan and Gorbachev envisioned 40 years ago. In the first stage, the US and Russia pare down their arsenals, while China forgoes its expansion. During this trust-building stage, the wars in Iran and Ukraine would need to end quickly, alongside a recommitment to the UN Charter and peaceful development by not just China, Russia, and the US, but all nuclear-armed states.
paras.zh: 我们认为这将分三个四年阶段完成，就像里根和戈尔巴乔夫 40 年前的设想一样。第一阶段，美国和俄罗斯削减核武库，中国放弃扩张。在这个建立信任的阶段，伊朗和乌克兰的战争需要迅速结束，同时不仅是中国、俄罗斯和美国，而且所有核武器国家都需要重新致力于《联合国宪章》和和平发展。

paras.en: The second four-year stage would be more complex, as it would involve bilateral, trilateral, and multilateral negotiations among all nine nuclear-armed states to address the specific reasons why each of the states possesses nuclear weapons and find ways to reduce or eliminate those incentives. Intense diplomacy would be required during this period, resulting in all nine nuclear powers joining the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW). The TPNW would give all nine states a 10-year timeline to eliminate their arsenals.
paras.zh: 第二个四年阶段将更加复杂，因为它将涉及所有九个核武器国家之间的双边、三边和多边谈判，以解决每个国家拥有核武器的具体原因，并找到减少或消除这些激励措施的方法。在此期间需要加强外交努力，促使所有九个核国家加入《禁止核武器条约》（TPNW）。 TPNW 将给所有九个州一个 10 年的期限来消除他们的武库。

paras.en: However, they could accomplish this in four years, given that the starting point would be arsenals of no more than 600 nuclear warheads. This last four-year stage would involve reductions, verification, and eventual elimination of arsenals. It could be done in plenty of time for the centennial celebration of the United Nations and the centennial commemoration of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
paras.zh: 然而，考虑到其核弹头数量不超过 600 枚，他们可以在四年内完成这一任务。最后四年阶段将涉及裁减、核查以及最终消除武库。联合国成立一百周年庆祝活动以及广岛和长崎原子弹爆炸一百周年纪念活动有足够的时间来完成。

paras.en: The nuclear age should end well before it turns 100.
paras.zh: 核时代应该会在 100 岁之前结束。

paras.en: If Reagan and Gorbachev could come so close 40 years ago, we should not rule out the possibility that Putin, Xi, and Trump could do so today. As John Kennedy said in his great American University commencement address in 1963: “Our problems are man-made – therefore, they can be solved by man. And man can be as big as he wants. No problem of human destiny is beyond human beings. Man’s reason and spirit have often solved the seemingly unsolvable – and we believe they can do it again.”
paras.zh: 如果40年前里根和戈尔巴乔夫能够如此接近，我们不应该排除普京、习近平和特朗普今天也能做到这一点。正如约翰·肯尼迪在 1963 年伟大的美利坚大学毕业典礼演讲中所说：“我们的问题是人为的——因此，它们可以由人来解决。人可以随心所欲地发展。人类命运的问题没有超越人类的能力。人类的理性和精神常常解决了看似无法解决的问题——我们相信他们可以再次做到这一点。”

paras.en: A version of this article first appeared on Al Jazeera Arabic.
paras.zh: 本文的一个版本首先出现在半岛电视台阿拉伯语上。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Netanyahu’s last stand and the dangerous politics of survival

paras.en: Israel’s caretaker Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has used the weeks since Israel’s October 27 election to launch a series of attacks on his opponents, and has called into question the legitimacy of the vote’s result.
paras.zh: 以色列看守总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡自10月27日以色列大选以来的几周内对其对手发起一系列攻击，并对投票结果的合法性提出质疑。

paras.en: The longtime Israeli leader is likely on his way out of power – as long as the country’s opposition, led by Gadi Eisenkot, can form a viable government.
paras.zh: 只要加迪·艾森科特领导的该国反对派能够组建一个可行的政府，这位长期担任以色列领导人的人很可能即将下台。

paras.en: That may involve leaning on parties representing Palestinian citizens of Israel, and Netanyahu has taken the opportunity to use that to tarnish the reputations of the Arab parties, and baselessly accuse them of cheating in the elections.
paras.zh: 这可能涉及向代表以色列巴勒斯坦公民的政党倾斜，内塔尼亚胡借此机会玷污阿拉伯政党的声誉，并毫无根据地指责他们在选举中作弊。

paras.en: The environment that Netanyahu has helped generate has led to right-wing protesters threatening civil war, and critics have also accused him of deliberately fomenting war with Iran to retain office.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡帮助创造的环境导致右翼抗议者威胁内战，批评者还指责他故意煽动与伊朗的战争以保住职位。

paras.en: Separately, the Shin Bet domestic intelligence agency, led by Netanyahu’s ally David Zini, reportedly sought permission to tap the phones of five Arab lawmakers over suspected foreign interference, and to have politicians who are Palestinian citizens of Israel arrested on election day, requests the attorney general rejected.
paras.zh: 另外，据报道，内塔尼亚胡盟友大卫·齐尼(David Zini)领导的辛贝特(Shin Bet)国内情报机构因涉嫌外国干涉而寻求许可窃听五名阿拉伯议员的电话，并在选举日逮捕以色列巴勒斯坦公民政客，但请求被司法部长拒绝。

paras.en: Opposition leaders including Yair Lapid and Joint List chief Yousef Jabareen said the measures were evidence of an “attempted coup”. Meanwhile, law enforcement officials are said to be investigating whether the prime minister’s office itself fabricated the allegations of vote-buying.
paras.zh: 包括亚伊尔·拉皮德（Yair Lapid）和联合名单主席优素福·贾巴林（Yousef Jabareen）在内的反对派领导人表示，这些措施是“未遂政变”的证据。与此同时，据说执法官员正在调查总理办公室本身是否捏造了贿选指控。

paras.en: For analysts and a number of Israel’s politicians, Netanyahu’s actions reflect an overriding determination to stay in power, or, failing that, engineer a government that is reliant on the support of him and his allies.
paras.zh: 对于分析人士和一些以色列政客来说，内塔尼亚胡的行动反映了继续掌权的压倒一切的决心，或者，如果做不到这一点，就组建一个依赖他及其盟友支持的政府。

paras.en: Netanyahu faces numerous threats to both his legacy and even his freedom that, without the kind of influence he has wielded as prime minister, could prove far-reaching.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的遗产甚至自由都面临着无数威胁，如果没有他作为总理所施加的影响力，这些威胁可能会产生深远的影响。

paras.en: Calls for a state inquiry into Netanyahu and his government’s failings in the run-up to the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attack on Israel have persisted for almost as long as the genocidal war Israel launched on Gaza in response. Those calls have grown more urgent following a series of reports suggesting that Netanyahu had been personally warned by senior Egyptian and Emirati officials about a potential attack. Establishing a state inquiry also featured prominently on the legislative slate of the parliament’s new session last week.
paras.zh: 要求对内塔尼亚胡及其政府在哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击以色列之前的失误进行国家调查的呼声几乎自以色列针对加沙发动种族灭绝战争以来一直持续存在。在一系列报道表明埃及和阿联酋高级官员亲自警告内塔尼亚胡可能发生袭击之后，这些呼吁变得更加紧迫。建立国家调查也在上周议会新会议的立法名单上占据显着位置。

paras.en: Similarly, both the war in Gaza and the constitutional crisis triggered by Netanyahu’s attempts to weaken judicial oversight over the government have provided useful cover against the corruption charges he has faced since 2019. Accused of bribery, fraud and breach of trust in three separate cases, Netanyahu has seen his trial, running since May 2020, repeatedly delayed by his duties as prime minister. If found guilty, Netanyahu could face a prison sentence of up to a decade.
paras.zh: 同样，加沙战争以及内塔尼亚胡试图削弱对政府的司法监督引发的宪法危机，都为他自 2019 年以来面临的腐败指控提供了有用的掩护。内塔尼亚胡在三起不同的案件中被指控贿赂、欺诈和失信，自 2020 年 5 月以来的审判因他担任总理的职责而一再推迟。如果罪名成立，内塔尼亚胡可能面临最高十年的监禁。

paras.en: “Netanyahu is behaving like a wounded animal,” said Israeli analyst Ahron Bregman, of King’s College London. “For him, losing the elections is not just a political but also a personal matter, not least because of his corruption trial, which could result in him being sent to jail. Losing the premiership is losing his shield. Hence, for Netanyahu, nothing is off the table.”
paras.zh: 伦敦国王学院的以色列分析师阿伦·布雷格曼表示：“内塔尼亚胡的行为就像一只受伤的动物。” “对他来说，输掉选举不仅是政治问题，也是个人问题，尤其是因为他的腐败审判，这可能导致他被送进监狱。失去总理职位就失去了他的盾牌。因此，对于内塔尼亚胡来说，没有什么是不可能的。”

paras.en: The chance of political violence in Israel has increased. In the days after the election, right-wing protesters gathered outside Eisenkot’s home, warning him not to form a government with the Arab-led parties, and calling him a “traitor”.
paras.zh: 以色列发生政治暴力的可能性有所增加。选举后几天，右翼抗议者聚集在艾森科特家外，警告他不要与阿拉伯领导的政党组建政府，并称他为“叛徒”。

paras.en: And in a letter shared publicly, Rabbi Gedalia Axelrod, a former head of Haifa’s rabbinical court, evoked the religious edict of din rodef, the “law of the pursuer”, the same principle invoked by Yigal Amir to justify his killing of former Prime Minister Yitzhak Rabin in 1995 over the Oslo Accords agreement with the Palestinians.
paras.zh: 在公开分享的一封信中，海法拉比法庭前院长吉达利亚·阿克塞尔罗德拉比 (Rabbi Gedalia Axelrod) 援引了 din rodef 宗教法令，即“追捕者法则”，伊格尔·阿米尔 (Yigal Amir) 在 1995 年因与巴勒斯坦达成的《奥斯陆协议》而杀害前总理伊扎克·拉宾 (Yitzhak Rabin) 时，也援引了同样的原则。

paras.en: “The longer it takes for Eisenkot to form a government, the higher the risk of political violence becomes,” said Ofer Cassif, a member of parliament representing the left-wing Hadash party. “Netanyahu is willing to do anything, and I mean anything, to stay in power. He’s a psychopath. People on the right talk about civil war, and I’m not ready to discount that … Netanyahu built a cult around him, and it may easily raise arms against his rivals.”
paras.zh: “艾森科特组建政府的时间越长，政治暴力的风险就越高，”代表左翼哈达什党的议员奥弗·卡西夫说。 “内塔尼亚胡愿意做任何事情，我的意思是任何事情，以保持权力。他是一个精神病患者。右翼人士谈论内战，我不准备忽视这一点......内塔尼亚胡在他周围建立了一个邪教，它可能很容易举起武器反对他的对手。”

paras.en: It remains unclear what, if any, immediate legal consequences Netanyahu may face for his alleged efforts to undermine the legitimacy of the election.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚内塔尼亚胡可能因涉嫌破坏选举合法性的行为而面临什么直接法律后果（如果有的话）。

paras.en: Aides accused of passing false information to the police on the eve of the election could face criminal scrutiny, while Shin Bet chief Zini could see both his agency’s independence and his own position fundamentally undermined by allegedly participating in efforts to subvert the democratic process.
paras.zh: 被指控在选举前夕向警方传递虚假信息的助手可能会面临刑事调查，而辛贝特负责人齐尼可能会看到，他的机构的独立性和他自己的地位都因涉嫌参与颠覆民主进程而从根本上受到损害。

paras.en: “Netanyahu battles for his survival and doesn’t care if those around him disappear into oblivion, but he might not succeed this time,” said Yossi Mekelberg, a senior consulting fellow at Chatham House. “He doesn’t care about them, or even his political legacy. All he cares about is survival, about fighting for the next day and trying to cling on, no matter what the cost.”
paras.zh: 查塔姆研究所高级咨询研究员尤西·梅克尔伯格表示：“内塔尼亚胡为自己的生存而战，并不关心周围的人是否消失，但这一次他可能不会成功。” “他不关心他们，甚至也不关心他的政治遗产。他只关心生存，关心第二天的战斗，并努力坚持下去，无论付出什么代价。”

articles.title: ‘Too early’ to determine impact of US blockade on Iran, with Tehran defiant

paras.en: Tehran, Iran – Iran’s economy is expected to contract further due to the ongoing blockade of its ports by the United States, inflicting pain on tens of millions of Iranians. But experts say it is too early to tell whether Washington’s economic embargo on Tehran is having the desired outcome of either collapsing the Iranian government or forcing it to concede to US demands.
paras.zh: 伊朗德黑兰——由于美国持续封锁伊朗港口，伊朗经济预计将进一步萎缩，给数千万伊朗人带来痛苦。但专家表示，现在判断华盛顿对德黑兰的经济禁运是否达到了让伊朗政府垮台或迫使其屈服于美国要求的预期结果还为时过早。

paras.en: The US believes its naval blockade on Iran, overland trade disruptions and sanctions – part of its maximum pressure campaign on Tehran – are working. The US has also brought a third aircraft carrier into the region to support a potential military escalation, in what appears to be an attempt to force Tehran to capitulate further to its demands.
paras.zh: 美国认为，其对伊朗的海上封锁、陆路贸易中断和制裁——其对德黑兰极限施压行动的一部分——正在发挥作用。美国还向该地区派遣了第三艘航空母舰，以支持潜在的军事升级，这似乎是试图迫使德黑兰进一步屈服于其要求。

paras.en: After a deadlock in the US-Israel war on Iran, which began with strikes that killed Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei on February 28, Washington has demanded Tehran reopen the Strait of Hormuz and curb its nuclear programme.
paras.zh: 美以对伊战争以2月28日导致伊朗最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊身亡为开端，陷入僵局后，华盛顿要求德黑兰重新开放霍尔木兹海峡并遏制其核计划。

paras.en: However, Iranian authorities insist they can withstand the economic pressure and have put forward their demands. Strikes on US interests in the region this week, including radar systems in Bahrain, have been viewed as a defiant response to the US military and economic pressure. But there are signs that the country’s economy and common Iranians are suffering from the current conditions.
paras.zh: 然而，伊朗当局坚称他们能够承受经济压力，并提出了要求。本周针对美国在该地区利益的袭击，包括巴林的雷达系统，被视为对美国军事和经济压力的挑衅回应。但有迹象表明，该国经济和普通伊朗民众正在遭受当前状况的影响。

paras.en: Tehran-based economist Peyman Molavi said if current conditions persist, Iran’s inflation could rise considerably over the coming months.
paras.zh: 德黑兰经济学家佩曼·莫拉维表示，如果目前的情况持续下去，伊朗的通胀可能在未来几个月大幅上升。

paras.en: “This will impact parallel markets like foreign currencies, gold, the stock market and housing,” he told Al Jazeera. “But it will unfortunately have the largest impact on the commodities market, from energy to agricultural products, metals, and industrial products.”
paras.zh: “这将影响外汇、黄金、股市和房地产等平行市场，”他告诉半岛电视台。 “但不幸的是，这将对大宗商品市场产生最大的影响，从能源到农产品、金属和工业产品。”

paras.en: For decades, Iran’s governments have increasingly plugged their budget deficits by printing more money, which has saddled the country with a growing money supply, feeding chronic inflation. The foreign currency crunch from disrupted oil exports due to the US military blockade has only exacerbated the situation.
paras.zh: 几十年来，伊朗政府越来越多地通过印钞来填补预算赤字，这导致该国货币供应量不断增加，加剧了长期通货膨胀。美国军事封锁导致石油出口中断，导致外汇紧缩，这只会加剧局势。

paras.en: Molavi estimates that the year-on-year growth of the money supply in Iran could rise to 55-60 percent from its current figure of nearly 51 percent by the end of the Persian year in late March. Paired with negative economic growth, he said annual inflation could grow to about 85 percent, and point-to-point inflation to 100 percent.
paras.zh: 莫拉维估计，到3月下旬波斯年末，伊朗货币供应量的同比增长率可能会从目前近51%的数字上升到55-60%。他表示，伴随着经济负增长，年通胀率可能升至 85% 左右，点对点通胀率可能升至 100%。

paras.en: Iranian Central Bank Governor Abdolnaser Hemmati hit back at US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who has led Washington’s sanctions regime against Tehran.
paras.zh: 伊朗央行行长阿卜杜勒纳塞尔·赫马蒂 (Abdolnaser Hemmati) 回击了美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特 (Scott Bessent)，后者领导了华盛顿对德黑兰的制裁制度。

paras.en: “Like I said, he must still count his chickens at the end of autumn before moving to winter,” he said in reference to an Iranian proverb – “It’s too early to talk about winter”.
paras.zh: “就像我说的，在进入冬天之前，他仍然必须在秋末数鸡，”他引用一句伊朗谚语说道，“现在谈论冬天还为时过早”。

paras.en: Bessent has claimed the economic embargo will result in a 25 percent contraction of the Iranian economy by the year ending March 2027. Iran’s official figures indicated that the country’s gross domestic product (GDP) shrank by 10.1 percent year-on-year between March 21 and June 20, the first quarter of the Persian calendar year.
paras.zh: 贝森特声称，经济禁运将导致截至2027年3月的一年伊朗经济萎缩25%。伊朗官方数据显示，波斯历第一季度3月21日至6月20日期间，该国国内生产总值(GDP)同比萎缩10.1%。

paras.en: Hemmati said the central bank has secured $30bn in foreign currencies to weather the pressure over the coming months, prioritising procurement of essential goods for its citizens.
paras.zh: 赫马蒂表示，央行已获得 300 亿美元的外汇，以应对未来几个月的压力，优先为公民采购必需品。

paras.en: “American officials believe they can achieve their goals through threats and raise something new each time; from the possibility of collapse to military threats and intensified economic pressure,” Economy Minister Ali Madanizadeh said on Sunday.
paras.zh: 经济部长阿里·马达尼扎德周日表示：“美国官员相信，他们可以通过威胁来实现自己的目标，并且每次都会提出一些新的东西；从崩溃的可能性到军事威胁和加剧的经济压力。”

paras.en: All overland routes to and from Iran, except for one with Iraq that was closed due to security reasons, remain open despite the US efforts to isolate Iran from its neighbours, Madanizadeh insisted.
paras.zh: 马达尼扎德坚称，尽管美国努力将伊朗与其邻国隔离，但除因安全原因而关闭的一条通往伊拉克的线路外，所有往返伊朗的陆路路线均保持开放。

paras.en: For the seventh Iranian month of Mehr that ended on October 22, the 12-month average annual inflation was at 76.8 percent, according to the Statistical Centre of Iran. Point-to-point inflation, which compares just that month with the same month of the previous year, was at 88.7 percent.
paras.zh: 根据伊朗统计中心的数据，截至 10 月 22 日的伊朗第七个月，12 个月平均年通胀率为 76.8%。当月与去年同月相比，点对点通胀率为 88.7%。

paras.en: Essential goods have already been experiencing triple-digit inflation for months, with the category of food, beverages and tobacco experiencing year-on-year inflation of 113.4 percent in October, the centre said.
paras.zh: 该中心表示，几个月来，必需品的通胀率已经达到三位数，其中食品、饮料和烟草类别 10 月份的同比通胀率高达 113.4%。

paras.en: Iranian social media is increasingly filled with personal stories of how most people in the country of about 90 million are rapidly losing their purchasing power.
paras.zh: 伊朗社交媒体上越来越多地充斥着个人故事，讲述这个约 9000 万人口的国家中大多数人如何迅速失去购买力。

paras.en: “Everywhere you look, you could have bought the same commodity with one-fifth of the money last year,” one user wrote on X. “That’s no joke, millions of people have been crushed in between.”
paras.zh: “无论你走到哪里，你都可以用去年五分之一的钱购买同样的商品，”一位用户在 X 上写道。“这不是开玩笑，数百万人都被压垮了。”

paras.en: Saleh, a 37-year-old shopkeeper at Tehran’s Grand Bazaar who deals in electric motors for small industrial units, said both domestic and Chinese-made goods can still readily be found in the market. But supply and demand have decreased since US sanctions began to bite.
paras.zh: 萨利赫 (Saleh) 是德黑兰大集市的一名 37 岁店主，专门为小型工业单位经营电动马达，他表示，国内和中国制造的商品在市场上仍然很容易找到。但自美国制裁开始生效以来，供应和需求均有所下降。

paras.en: “The reason is that commodities are expensive, and there’s been a stagnation in the market and also uncertainty over what will happen next,” he told Al Jazeera, asking not to use his full name due to security reasons.
paras.zh: “原因是大宗商品价格昂贵，市场停滞不前，而且接下来会发生什么也存在不确定性，”他告诉半岛电视台，出于安全原因，他要求不要使用他的全名。

paras.en: “Everyone’s looking at the dollar price, and manufacturers and clients are making their decisions based on price changes. If we sold 10 items before, now we’re selling three or four, but the price increase maintained some profit. I don’t see the market being near collapse, but there’s less business.”
paras.zh: “每个人都在关注美元价格，制造商和客户根据价格变化做出决定。如果我们以前卖10件，现在我们卖三四件，但价格上涨保持了一些利润。我不认为市场接近崩溃，但生意减少了。”

paras.en: Companies with an established client base are proving more resilient, he added.
paras.zh: 他补充说，事实证明，拥有成熟客户群的公司更具弹性。

paras.en: Bessent hailed what is happening in Iran as “one of the fastest collapses in history”, and described the Trump-directed sanctions campaign against Iran as “the greatest economic isolation in the history of the world against a single country”.
paras.zh: 贝森特称赞伊朗正在发生的事情是“历史上最快的崩溃之一”，并将特朗普主导的针对伊朗的制裁行动描述为“世界历史上针对单一国家的最大经济孤立”。

paras.en: He also compared the situation in Iran with the period preceding the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, saying the country’s economy had shrunk 22 percent over three years before the union collapsed.
paras.zh: 他还将伊朗的情况与 1991 年苏联解体之前的时期进行了比较，称在苏联解体之前的三年里，该国经济萎缩了 22%。

paras.en: Economist Molavi said the comparison may not necessarily translate into immediate economic collapse for Iran as they have fundamentally different economic models.
paras.zh: 经济学家莫拉维表示，这种比较不一定会导致伊朗经济立即崩溃，因为两国的经济模式根本不同。

paras.en: But he pointed out that Iran’s nominal GDP has fallen from $645bn in 2012 to about $300bn now and that it could decline further if the sanctions continue.
paras.zh: 但他指出，伊朗的名义GDP已从2012年的6450亿美元降至目前的约3000亿美元，如果制裁继续下去，可能会进一步下降。

paras.en: “With the current [level] of underinvestment, halted oil sales, disrupted exports and the sense of suspension in the economy, our economic growth will become even more negative,” he said.
paras.zh: 他表示：“鉴于目前投资不足、石油销售停止、出口中断以及经济停滞的感觉，我们的经济增长将变得更加负增长。”

articles.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
paras.zh: 特朗普抵达中国，将与习近平和普京举行重要会晤

paras.en: SHENZHEN, China — President Donald Trump plans to meet separately with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday in China, in addition to their already scheduled three-way meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping, a U.S. official confirmed.
paras.zh: 中国深圳——一位美国官员证实，除了已经安排好的与中国国家主席习近平的三方会晤之外，唐纳德·特朗普总统还计划周四在中国单独会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京。

paras.en: Trump's meeting with Putin would be the first time that the leaders have held talks since their discussions in Alaska last year that failed to broker a deal to ease Russia's war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 特朗普与普京的会面将是自去年两国领导人在阿拉斯加会谈未能达成缓和俄罗斯乌克兰战争的协议以来首次举行会谈。

paras.en: Trump has frequently boasted of his rapport with Putin as relations between the United States and Ukraine appear to have cratered recently. Trump rejected new Russia sanctions while Kyiv was undermined by disruptions in satellite support for its drones during the war.
paras.zh: 随着美国和乌克兰之间的关系最近似乎陷入困境，特朗普经常吹嘘他与普京的融洽关系。特朗普拒绝了对俄罗斯的新制裁，而基辅则因战争期间对其无人机的卫星支持中断而受到损害。

paras.en: The U.S. official who confirmed the Trump-Putin meeting in China spoke to The Associated Press on the condition of anonymity to share plans that were not yet public.
paras.zh: 确认特朗普与普京在中国会面的美国官员在不愿透露姓名的情况下向美联社透露了尚未公开的计划。

paras.en: The exact timing of the meeting on Thursday was unclear. Trump already had public plans for a separate meeting with Xi and a historic trilateral meeting with Xi and Putin.
paras.zh: 周四会议的具体时间尚不清楚。特朗普已经公开计划与习近平单独会晤，并与习近平和普京举行历史性的三边会晤。

paras.en: Trump said he plans to talk with Xi and Putin in their joint meeting about limiting nuclear weapons and bringing an end to the war in Ukraine, which began in 2022 with Russia's invasion. Analysts are not expecting substantive breakthroughs despite the unprecedented nature of the meeting.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他计划在联席会议上与习近平和普京讨论限制核武器和结束乌克兰战争的问题。乌克兰战争于2022年因俄罗斯入侵而开始。尽管这次会议规模空前，但分析师预计不会取得实质性突破。

paras.en: Before the trip, Trump's aides told reporters that the war in Ukraine would not be on the agenda. But Trump said on Tuesday that the deaths of tens of thousands of Russian troops every month had created an opening to resolve the conflict.
paras.zh: 出访前，特朗普的助手告诉记者，乌克兰战争不会提上议程。但特朗普周二表示，每月数万名俄罗斯士兵的死亡为解决冲突创造了机会。

paras.en: "I think it's very close to getting it done," the Republican president said. "We're going to have a good meeting on that."
paras.zh: 这位共和党总统说：“我认为这已经非常接近完成了。” “我们将就此问题进行一次很好的会议。”

paras.en: Trump lands in China's tech hub as outages cause concerns at home
paras.zh: 特朗普登陆中国科技中心，因停电引发国内担忧

paras.en: Trump landed in China on Wednesday seeking to reinforce America's status as the world's leading technology power, but a distressing series of technical outages back home has left his administration scrambling to calm the U.S. public.
paras.zh: 特朗普周三抵达中国，寻求巩固美国作为世界领先技术强国的地位，但国内一系列令人痛苦的技术故障让他的政府忙于安抚美国公众。

paras.en: The issues put the administration on the defensive at a moment when the president wants to project strength and certainty before the meeting with Xi and Putin.
paras.zh: 在总统希望在与习近平和普京会面之前展示实力和确定性之际，这些问题使政府处于守势。

paras.en: As he began his trip to Asia, Trump initially had been nonchalant about the outages that left people in the U.S. worried about accessing their email, checking their bank accounts or safely flying on an airplane.
paras.zh: 当特朗普开始亚洲之行时，特朗普最初对那些让美国人担心访问电子邮件、检查银行账户或安全乘坐飞机的网络中断表现得漠不关心。

paras.en: "It's fine," Trump said Tuesday from the Philippine capital of Manila, suggesting it was all just a consequence of being a nation that is "big and powerful."
paras.zh: 特朗普周二在菲律宾首都马尼拉表示，“没关系”，他暗示这只是作为一个“大国”的国家的结果。

paras.en: But then the outages involving Microsoft, the Federal Aviation Administration, JPMorgan Chase and the National Security Agency's communications network began to overshadow Trump's visit. They raised the specter that artificial intelligence can disrupt daily life, as new cyber vulnerabilities identified require software to be constantly upgraded to fix flaws or other security holes, known as patching, which is supposed to improve how the technology runs.
paras.zh: 但随后涉及微软、联邦航空管理局、摩根大通和国家安全局通信网络的中断开始给特朗普的访问蒙上阴影。他们提出了人工智能可能会扰乱日常生活的担忧，因为发现的新网络漏洞需要不断升级软件以修复缺陷或其他安全漏洞，即所谓的补丁，这应该可以改善技术的运行方式。

paras.en: At the start of the second day of Trump's trip, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stepped in to reassure Americans on Trump's behalf. Rubio told reporters there was "zero" evidence that the outages were connected or were tied to rival nations, cyber hackers or criminals.
paras.zh: 在特朗普第二天的行程开始时，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥出面代表特朗普安抚美国人。卢比奥告诉记者，“零”证据表明这次中断与敌对国家、网络黑客或犯罪分子有关或有关。

paras.en: "Sometimes when you are going in to fix your system because you've identified a vulnerability, it creates a short-term disruption," said Rubio, who is also Trump's national security adviser.
paras.zh: 兼任特朗普国家安全顾问的卢比奥表示：“有时，当你因为发现了漏洞而打算修复系统时，就会造成短期中断。”

paras.en: Trump is trying to project strength in Asia, but the outages challenge that image
paras.zh: 特朗普试图在亚洲展现实力，但停电挑战了这一形象

paras.en: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture by the American leader during Xi's state visit to Washington in September.
paras.zh: 空军一号抵达深圳后，习近平在停机坪上向特朗普致以特别的敬意，以回应这位美国领导人在习近平9月对华盛顿进行国事访问期间的举动。

paras.en: Trump and Xi greeted each other on Wednesday at the foot of the airplane's stairs in a handshake that became a hug as a group of dancers waved flowers and flags. When Putin arrived earlier in the day, Xi did not greet him at the airport despite their long-standing friendship.
paras.zh: 周三，特朗普和习近平在飞机楼梯下互相致意，握手后来变成了拥抱，一群舞者挥舞着鲜花和旗帜。当普京当天早些时候抵达时，尽管两国友谊悠久，但习近平并没有到机场迎接他。

paras.en: Trump has signaled that he wants to take an improvised approach during his time in Shenzhen, the skyscraper-filled tech hub that is hosting world leaders for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit. It's a bet that his unscripted brand of diplomacy based on personal relationships can create some kind of legacy to reshape world affairs during his final two years in the White House.
paras.zh: 特朗普已表示，他希望在深圳期间采取临时措施。深圳是一座摩天大楼林立的科技中心，世界领导人将出席亚太经合组织峰会。人们打赌，他基于个人关系的即兴外交可以创造某种遗产，在他在白宫的最后两年重塑世界事务。

paras.en: As leaders were introduced on Wednesday night before an APEC group photo, Putin approached Trump. They shook hands and traded greetings.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，在亚太经合组织合影前介绍领导人时，普京走近特朗普。他们握手并互致问候。

paras.en: The White House said Trump was scheduled earlier Wednesday to have separate meetings with Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney before the official APEC greeting ceremony. Trump has previously voiced his disapproval of the U.S. trade pact with Canada and Mexico that was negotiated during his first term.
paras.zh: 白宫表示，特朗普定于周三早些时候在亚太经合组织正式问候仪式之前与墨西哥总统克劳迪娅·谢因鲍姆和加拿大总理马克·卡尼分别举行会晤。特朗普此前曾表示不赞成在其第一任期内谈判达成的美国与加拿大和墨西哥的贸易协定。

paras.en: Trump has a reunion with old friend Imelda Marcos
paras.zh: 特朗普与老朋友伊梅尔达·马科斯重聚

paras.en: Before he landed in Shenzhen, Trump had lunch in Manila with President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. at the Malacañang Presidential Palace.
paras.zh: 在抵达深圳之前，特朗普在马尼拉总统府与小费迪南德·马科斯总统共进午餐。

paras.en: Marcos noted that he had sent fried chicken from the Philippine chain Jollibee to the U.S. delegation for a late-night snack Tuesday and he complimented Trump for "working very hard."
paras.zh: 马科斯指出，他周二已将菲律宾连锁店快乐蜂的炸鸡送给美国代表团作为夜宵，并称赞特朗普“工作非常努力”。

paras.en: Trump praised the U.S. bond with the Philippines and the interior decoration of the presidential palace.
paras.zh: 特朗普称赞美国与菲律宾的关系以及总统府的内部装饰。

paras.en: "Our people share common history, common values, common interests, common architectural tastes," Trump said. "I love what you've done here."
paras.zh: 特朗普说：“我们的人民拥有共同的历史、共同的价值观、共同的利益、共同的建筑品味。” “我喜欢你在这里所做的一切。”

paras.en: He said after their meeting that the two nations had reached a trade deal on Wednesday, though he had also said last year that an agreement had been reached.
paras.zh: 他在会面后表示，两国已于周三达成贸易协议，尽管他去年也曾表示已达成协议。

paras.en: Trump also had a short reunion with Imelda Marcos, the country's former first lady who is the mother of the Philippines' current president. Famed for her lavish shoe collection, Imelda Marcos knew Trump decades ago through the New York City party scene.
paras.zh: 特朗普还与该国前第一夫人、菲律宾现任总统的母亲伊梅尔达·马科斯进行了短暂的团聚。伊梅尔达·马科斯 (Imelda Marcos) 以其奢华的鞋子收藏而闻名，几十年前，她通过纽约市的派对现场认识了特朗普。

paras.en: What's on the agenda for Trump's meetings with Xi and Putin
paras.zh: 特朗普与习近平和普京会晤的议程是什么

paras.en: The prospect of Trump meeting with two of America's largest geopolitical rivals has been a source of unease because Trump has been less welcoming of historic allies such as Canada and NATO partners in Europe.
paras.zh: 特朗普与美国最大的两个地缘政治对手会面的前景一直令人不安，因为特朗普不太欢迎加拿大和欧洲北约伙伴等历史盟友。

paras.en: His tariffs that were intended to curb China's trade surplus have done little to stop the progress of the world's dominant manufacturer, which for the second straight year will have exported $1 trillion more in goods than what it imported.
paras.zh: 他的关税旨在遏制中国的贸易顺差，但并没有阻止这个世界主导制造商的进步，中国的出口商品将连续第二年比进口商品多出1万亿美元。

paras.en: Even without the digital outages in the U.S., questions about how to handle AI loom over the summit.
paras.zh: 即使美国没有发生数字中断，有关如何处理人工智能的问题也笼罩在峰会上。

paras.en: The technology is viewed as key to unlocking faster economic growth, but its rapid development has meant it poses national security risks and could evolve in ways that put AI beyond human control.
paras.zh: 该技术被视为实现更快经济增长的关键，但其快速发展意味着它会带来国家安全风险，并可能以超出人类控制范围的方式发展。

paras.en: Trump's close tech industry ally Jensen Huang was recently removed as the CEO of Nvidia after he admitted to an affair with a woman alleged to be an agent of the Chinese government. Beijing has denied that she was a spy, yet the affair raised concerns about how China has been able to access Nvidia computer chips to develop its own AI models that are competing with the U.S.
paras.zh: 特朗普在科技行业的亲密盟友黄仁勋最近被免去英伟达首席执行官的职务，因为他承认与一名据称是中国政府特工的女性有染。北京否认她是间谍，但这一事件引发了人们对中国如何能够使用英伟达计算机芯片来开发自己的人工智能模型以与美国竞争的担忧。

articles.title: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
articles.author: Esme Nicholson

paras.en: Greetings from a Berlin square, where an artist's statue watches over children at play
paras.zh: 来自柏林广场的问候，那里的艺术家雕像注视着玩耍的孩子们

paras.en: If you were listening to this, you'd hear what isn't pictured: the whoops and wails of children playing on the swings and slides behind me, all under the watchful eye of Käthe Kollwitz cast in bronze. The German expressionist lived just off this square in Berlin — named after her, Kollwitzplatz — and, at the turn of the 20th century, her children probably played here, too.
paras.zh: 如果你在听这个，你会听到图中没有的内容：孩子们在我身后的秋千和滑梯上玩耍的呼喊声和哭声，这一切都在青铜铸成的凯绥·珂勒惠支的注视下。这位德国表现主义者就住在柏林的这个广场附近——以她的名字命名的科尔维茨广场——在 20 世纪之交，她的孩子们可能也在这里玩耍。

paras.en: In the wake of World War I, Kollwitz's lithographs, woodcuts and sculptures fixated on the suffering and futility of war. They depict undernourished, wide-eyed children in the protective arms of mothers whose anguish is etched into their faces. Her statue, The Grieving Parents, stands in Belgium where her son Peter died at the front, aged 18.
paras.zh: 第一次世界大战结束后，科尔维茨的石版画、木刻和雕塑专注于战争的苦难和徒劳。它们描绘了营养不良、睁大眼睛的孩子们，他们被母亲保护着，脸上的痛苦铭刻在他们的脸上。她的雕像《悲伤的父母》矗立在比利时，她 18 岁的儿子彼得在前线牺牲。

paras.en: As I turn my back briefly on the playground and aim my camera at Kollwitz, a boy jumps into the shot, up onto the statue's plinth. Playing hide and seek, he conceals himself behind Kollwitz. His friend finds him quickly and the two boys chase each other around the statue, inadvertently embracing Kollwitz like she does her own boys in her lithograph renderings.
paras.zh: 当我在操场上短暂转身并将相机对准科尔维茨时，一个男孩跳进镜头，跳到雕像的底座上。他玩捉迷藏，躲在科尔维茨身后。他的朋友很快就找到了他，两个男孩绕着雕像互相追逐，不经意间拥抱了科尔维茨，就像她在版画效果图中拥抱自己的男孩一样。

paras.en: The Kollwitz statue's presence is calm. She sits, charcoal in hand, poised to draw the happy hubbub of children growing up in a city that is safe. But with wars not so far away and Germany bringing back military service for a new generation, I feel a sudden urge to wrap my arms around my own child, just as Kollwitz did.
paras.zh: 科尔惠支雕像的存在是平静的。她坐着，手里拿着木炭，准备吸引在安全城市长大的孩子们的快乐喧闹。但战争已经不远了，德国又为新一代重新服兵役，我突然有一种冲动想要拥抱自己的孩子，就像科尔维茨那样。

paras.en: For more Far-Flung Postcards, click here.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多遥远的明信片，请点击此处。

articles.title: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's joint summit with leaders of China and Russia
articles.author: Leila Fadel

paras.en: Former U.S. ambassador on Trump's joint summit with leaders of China and Russia
paras.zh: 美国前大使谈特朗普与中国和俄罗斯领导人的联合峰会

paras.en: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks to Nicholas Burns, former U.S. ambassador to China and NATO, about President Trump's planned meeting with the leaders of China and Russia.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的莱拉·法德尔 (Leila Fadel) 与美国前驻华和北约大使尼古拉斯·伯恩斯 (Nicholas Burns) 谈论了特朗普总统计划与中国和俄罗斯领导人会面的情况。

paras.en: Let's turn now to Nicholas Burns. He served as the Biden administration's U.S. ambassador to China and as the U.S. ambassador to NATO under President George W. Bush. He's now an international relations scholar at Harvard University. Good morning, Ambassador. And welcome back to the program.
paras.zh: 现在让我们转向尼古拉斯·伯恩斯。他曾担任拜登政府的美国驻华大使以及乔治·W·布什总统领导下的美国驻北约大使。他现在是哈佛大学的国际关系学者。早上好，大使。欢迎回到该计划。

paras.en: NICHOLAS BURNS: Good morning, Leila. Thank you.
paras.zh: 尼古拉斯·伯恩斯：早上好，莱拉。谢谢。

paras.en: FADEL: So let's start with the trilateral meeting between Trump, Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin. What message does it send to U.S. allies to have the three of them appearing together exclusively?
paras.zh: 法德尔：让我们从特朗普、习近平和俄罗斯总统普京之间的三方会晤开始。他们三人独家亮相，向美国盟友传递了什么信息？

paras.en: BURNS: Leila, I think that our allies - Japan, South Korea, the Philippines, NATO allies - very worried about this meeting. Here you have the first-ever meeting among President Trump, President Xi and President Putin. And Ukraine's on the agenda - without Ukraine in the room. And I think it's really a major mistake not to have President Zelenskyy there. We can't have a situation in this decade where the fate of a country - Ukraine - is being talked about, maybe even decided about, by three other leaders. And so I think that's a major mistake by the United States to put itself in this position.
paras.zh: 伯恩斯：莱拉，我认为我们的盟友——日本、韩国、菲律宾、北约盟友——对这次会议非常担心。特朗普总统、习主席和普京总统在这里举行有史以来的首次会面。乌克兰也提上了议程——但乌克兰不在场。我认为没有泽伦斯基总统出席确实是一个重大错误。在这十年里，我们不能出现这样的情况：一个国家——乌克兰——的命运正在由另外三位领导人谈论，甚至可能决定。所以我认为美国把自己置于这样的境地是一个重大错误。

paras.en: The other country that should be at that table is Japan. China and Russia have been engaged in a massive intimidation operation of Japan over the last year - economic boycotts, Russian and Chinese military maneuvers around the Japanese home islands. Japan's our No. 1 ally in Asia - not at the table. So I think the imagery here - and the photo op's going to be a major part of this meeting. It's a short meeting. It's really wrong for the United States. Our allies are so much more important to us than China and Russia.
paras.zh: 另一个应该坐在这张桌子上的国家是日本。去年，中国和俄罗斯对日本进行了大规模的恐吓行动——经济抵制、俄罗斯和中国在日本本土周围进行军事演习。日本是我们在亚洲的第一大盟友——但不是在谈判桌上。所以我认为这里的图像和拍照将成为本次会议的主要部分。这是一次短暂的会议。这对美国来说确实是错误的。我们的盟友对我们来说比中国和俄罗斯重要得多。

paras.en: FADEL: When you say it's a major mistake, what would the consequences of that mistake be?
paras.zh: FADEL：当你说这是一个重大错误时，这个错误会带来什么后果？

paras.en: BURNS: Well, anxiety in ally capitals and loss of confidence in the United States. I think particularly, a lot of people have said this meeting looks somewhat like the Yalta meeting, February 1945 - Stalin, FDR, Churchill deciding the fate of Eastern Europe over the heads of the Eastern Europeans. There are a lot of differences between 81 years ago and now. But the fact that the three very strong countries in the world will be discussing what should happen in Ukraine, when Putin's the aggressor and Zelenskyy is the victim, I think is a major problem for U.S. credibility in the NATO alliance, certainly, and also with the Ukrainians.
paras.zh: 伯恩斯：嗯，是盟友首都的焦虑和对美国失去信心。我特别认为，很多人都说这次会议有点像1945年2月的雅尔塔会议——斯大林、罗斯福、丘吉尔在东欧人的头上决定东欧的命运。 81年前和现在有很多不同。但事实上，当普京是侵略者而泽连斯基是受害者时，世界上三个非常强大的国家将讨论乌克兰应该发生什么，我认为这对于美国在北约联盟以及乌克兰人的信誉来说无疑是一个重大问题。

paras.en: FADEL: I wonder, also - I mean, China is hosting here. But there are things that China probably does not want to talk about with the U.S. And that includes this recent concern about spying when it comes to Nvidia. There are tightened export controls on AI chips, as well. How will that affect the meeting between Trump and Xi?
paras.zh: 法德尔：我也想知道 - 我的意思是，中国在这里主办。但有些事情中国可能不想与美国讨论，其中包括最近对英伟达间谍活动的担忧。人工智能芯片的出口管制也更加严格。这将如何影响特朗普和习近平的会面？

paras.en: BURNS: Well, you know, that's the elephant in the room, Leila. President Trump has said he's not going to raise it. I'm quite sure President Xi Jinping will not raise it. But certainly, there'll be senior level contacts between the U.S. and China in Shenzhen about what has happened - the allegation of espionage, the fact that China has been trying to acquire - illicitly - American advanced semiconductors for their AI competition with us. And now the United States finally has acted.
paras.zh: 伯恩斯：嗯，你知道，这就是房间里的大象，莱拉。特朗普总统已表示他不会提出这个问题。我确信习近平主席不会提出这个问题。但可以肯定的是，美国和中国之间将会在深圳就所发生的事情进行高层接触——间谍活动的指控，以及中国一直试图非法获取美国先进半导体以与我们进行人工智能竞争的事实。而现在美国终于行动了。

paras.en: Justice and Commerce Departments announced two days ago that the United States would cut off all access to these Chinese shell companies in Southeast Asia funneling these advanced semiconductors up into the Chinese market. That's a good decision. It's a late decision. It should have been done a year ago. And because of that decision, the Chinese foreign ministry spokesman said today - he said there could be Chinese countermeasures. So despite all of the good feeling President Xi meeting President Trump at the airport - which was really quite extraordinary - in Shenzhen, there's competition below the surface here. And I don't exclude the possibility of a mini trade war between the two, because China is always going to try to respond to what the United States has done.
paras.zh: 美国司法部和商务部两天前宣布，美国将切断这些中国在东南亚的空壳公司将这些先进半导体输送到中国市场的所有准入。这是一个很好的决定。这是一个迟到的决定。它应该在一年前就完成了。中国外交部发言人今天表示，由于这一决定，中国可能会采取反制措施。因此，尽管习近平主席在深圳机场会见特朗普总统的感觉非常好——这确实非常非同寻常——但这里却存在着潜在的竞争。我不排除两国之间爆发小型贸易战的可能性，因为中国总是会试图对美国的所作所为做出回应。

paras.en: FADEL: Now, President Trump also wants to focus on non-proliferation of nuclear weapons as China expands its weapons program. Is this something China wants to talk about?
paras.zh: 法德尔：现在，随着中国扩大其武器计划，特朗普总统还希望关注核武器不扩散问题。这是中方想谈的吗？

paras.en: BURNS: I think President Trump is right to raise it. This is - and - but China doesn't want to talk about it. China is engaged in the greatest buildup of its nuclear weapons force of any country in the world. And it's completely nontransparent. When I was ambassador in China, I raised the issue with them - as did others in our administration - and got nowhere. So the fact is that we're going to have a period of time in the 2030s when China and Russia will outweigh and outnumber the United States in nuclear weapons - strategic nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 伯恩斯：我认为特朗普总统提出这个问题是正确的。这是——并且——但中国不想谈论它。中国正在世界上最大规模地建设核武器力量。而且它是完全不透明的。当我担任驻华大使时，我向他们提出了这个问题——就像我们政府中的其他人一样——但毫无结果。因此，事实是，到 2030 年代，中国和俄罗斯的核武器（战略核武器）数量将超过美国。

paras.en: This is the first time since the dawn of the nuclear age that will have happened. So I think the U.S. and our allies - Japan and the NATO allies - have to raise this with the Chinese and try to force them to be more transparent. I don't think that President Xi will agree to that today. But I do think that President Trump is right to raise the issue.
paras.zh: 这是自核时代到来以来第一次发生这种情况。因此，我认为美国和我们的盟国——日本和北约盟国——必须向中国提出这个问题，并试图迫使他们变​​得更加透明。我认为习主席今天不会同意这一点。但我确实认为特朗普总统提出这个问题是正确的。

paras.en: FADEL: Nicholas Burns, former U.S. ambassador to China, now at Harvard. Thank you for your time.
paras.zh: 法德尔：尼古拉斯·伯恩斯，前美国驻华大使，现就读于哈佛大学。感谢您抽出时间。
