articles.title: 'The View' co-host Whoopi Goldberg demands Dems impeach RFK Jr, 'get his a-- out of there'

paras.en: ABC's "The View" co-host Whoopi Goldberg demanded that the incoming Democratic Congress impeach U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. after the country lost its measles elimination status Tuesday.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司《观点》联合主持人乌比·戈德堡要求即将上任的民主党国会弹劾美国卫生与公众服务部 (HHS) 部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪，因为美国周二失去了消除麻疹的地位。

paras.en: The panel on Wednesday's show discussed the Pan American Health Organization announcing that for the first time in 26 years, the U.S. lost its measles elimination status after more than 5,400 confirmed cases were reported this year.
paras.zh: 周三节目中，小组讨论了泛美卫生组织宣布美国在今年报告了 5,400 多例确诊病例后，26 年来首次失去麻疹消除状态。

paras.en: The hosts largely blamed Kennedy for the outbreak, pointing to his past scrutiny of vaccines as a cause for the rise in cases, with Goldberg going as far as to hold him responsible for measles-related deaths.
paras.zh: 东道主主要将疫情爆发归咎于肯尼迪，指出他过去对疫苗的审查是病例上升的原因，戈德堡甚至要求他对麻疹相关死亡负责。

paras.en: "I’m just gonna say it: get his a-- out of there!" Goldberg said to a cheering audience. "Just impeach him! Impeach him! Impeach him. I don’t wanna say it, but I feel like he’s responsible for many people not making it. Get him gone, man!"
paras.zh: “我只想说：把他赶出去！”戈德堡对欢呼的观众说道。 “弹劾他！弹劾他！弹劾他。我不想这么说，但我觉得他对很多人没能成功负有责任。让他走吧，伙计！”

paras.en: When co-host Joy Behar remarked that members of President Donald Trump's cabinet could still remain in office for two more years, Goldberg doubled down on Kennedy's impeachment.
paras.zh: 当联合主持人乔伊·贝哈尔表示唐纳德·特朗普总统的内阁成员仍可继续任职两年时，戈德堡加大了对肯尼迪弹劾的力度。

paras.en: "Start with this one!" Goldberg continued. "Start with this one, and then go to [Secretary of War Pete] Hegseth, and then go to the other ones, and get people in these positions who can actually do the damn job! We are tired of this! People are dying! Children are dying! Stop it! Impeach him!"
paras.zh: “就从这个开始吧！”戈德堡继续说道。 “从这个开始，然后去找[战争部长皮特]赫格斯，然后去找其他人，让那些真正能完成这项该死工作的人担任这些职位！我们厌倦了这个！人们正在死去！孩子们正在死去！停止！弹劾他！”

paras.en: In a comment to Fox News Digital, White House spokeswoman Allison Schuster defended Kennedy and said that the Trump administration has repeatedly encouraged measles vaccination, citing an ABC News interview with Trump from April 2025.
paras.zh: 白宫发言人艾莉森·舒斯特在接受福克斯新闻数字频道采访时，为肯尼迪辩护，并援引 2025 年 4 月 ABC 新闻对特朗普的采访表示，特朗普政府一再鼓励接种麻疹疫苗。

paras.en: "President Trump and Secretary Kennedy have both stated that vaccination is the best way to prevent measles infections. In response to outbreaks, the President and Secretary have repeatedly encouraged measles vaccination, coordinated with states, and facilitated the deployment of vaccine doses across the country," Schuster said.
paras.zh: “特朗普总统和肯尼迪国务卿都表示，疫苗接种是预防麻疹感染的最佳方法。为了应对疫情，总统和国务卿多次鼓励麻疹疫苗接种，与各州协调，并促进在全国范围内部署疫苗剂量，”舒斯特尔说。

paras.en: Fox News Digital also reached out to HHS and ABC for comment but did not immediately receive a response.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字版还联系了美国卫生与公众服务部和美国广播公司征求意见，但没有立即收到回复。

paras.en: "The View" panel has frequently criticized Kennedy's leadership, sometimes making extreme accusations. Earlier this year, Behar similarly accused Kennedy of "trying to kill us."
paras.zh: “观点”小组经常批评肯尼迪的领导，有时甚至提出极端的指控。今年早些时候，贝哈尔同样指责肯尼迪“试图杀死我们”。

paras.en: "Here you’ve got a guy who is in charge of our health, who is a former heroin addict ... he swam in sewage! Who does that?" Behar said in April. "And [he] snorted cocaine off a toilet seat. This is who is in charge of your health, America. We’re in a lot of trouble."
paras.zh: “这里有一个负责我们健康的人，他曾经是一名海洛因成瘾者......他在污水中游泳！谁干的？”贝哈尔在四月份说道。 “他从马桶座圈上吸了可卡因。美国，这才是你们健康的负责人。我们有很多麻烦了。”

articles.title: Lane Kiffin’s roster fight set the stage, Will Wade just threw a grenade in LSU-SEC war with RJ Luis

paras.en: The LSU Tigers officially escalated the legal battle with the SEC on Wednesday night when basketball coach Will Wade sent RJ Luis Jr. off the bench and into the game against Louisiana-Monroe.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，路易斯安那州立大学老虎队正式升级了与美国证券交易委员会的法律诉讼，当时篮球教练威尔·韦德将小 RJ·路易斯 (RJ Luis Jr.) 换下替补席，参加了与路易斯安那门罗队的比赛。

paras.en: Over the past five days, 19th Judicial District Court Judge William Jorden of Baton Rouge granted RJ Luis a preliminary injunction that allowed the LSU Tigers to roster the former professional athlete.
paras.zh: 在过去的五天里，巴吞鲁日第 19 区法院法官 William Jorden 向 RJ Luis 授予了一项初步禁令，允许路易斯安那州立大学老虎队将这位前职业运动员列入名单。

paras.en: This whole saga stems from the former St. John's player returning to college for another season, after already declaring for the draft following his final game at the collegiate level in March 2025. After signing a 2-way deal at the NBA level, Luis was seeking a return to college, and signed with LSU last spring.
paras.zh: 整个传奇故事源于这位前圣约翰球员在 2025 年 3 月大学级别的最后一场比赛后宣布参加选秀后，重返大学再打一个赛季。在与 NBA 级别签订双向协议后，路易斯寻求重返大学，并于去年春天与路易斯安那州立大学签约。

paras.en: Luis went undrafted in 2025, then ended up signing a 2-way contract with the Utah Jazz.
paras.zh: 路易斯在 2025 年落选，最终与犹他爵士队签订了一份双向合同。

paras.en: But, there have always been rules about former professional athletes coming back to college, though that did not stop Will Wade from recruiting RJ Luis to play basketball at LSU after the head coach returned to Baton Rouge.
paras.zh: 但是，对于前职业运动员重返大学一直都有规定，但这并没有阻止威尔·韦德在主教练回到巴吞鲁日后招募 RJ·路易斯到路易斯安那州立大学打篮球。

paras.en: And, for all of those that thought this was about college football, you were sorely mistaken.
paras.zh: 而且，对于所有认为这与大学橄榄球有关的人来说，你们大错特错了。

paras.en: "I'm gonna refer to our university statement from yesterday. I'll be happy to answer any questions on how he played. "Everybody we played tonight is eligible," Will Wade said postgame.
paras.zh: “我会参考昨天我们大学的声明。我很乐意回答有关他打球方式的任何问题。“我们今晚打球的每个人都有资格，”威尔·韦德赛后说道。

paras.en: Will Wade's basketball team was always the play, not Lane Kiffin
paras.zh: 威尔·韦德的篮球队总是最重要的，而不是莱恩·基芬

paras.en: Over the past three months, LSU had already been fighting the SEC and NCAA over its rules about athletes pursuing an additional year of eligibility based upon the new guidelines that were enacted around players having five years to play five seasons of competition.
paras.zh: 在过去的三个月里，路易斯安那州立大学已经与 SEC 和 NCAA 就其关于运动员追求额外一年资格的规定进行了斗争，这些规定是根据围绕球员有五年时间参加五个赛季比赛的新指导方针制定的。

paras.en: This has led to the LSU athletic department having to make a decision on whether to roster two football players one day before the Tigers faced Clemson in Baton Rouge.
paras.zh: 这导致路易斯安那州立大学体育部门必须在老虎队在巴吞鲁日对阵克莱姆森大学的前一天决定是否派出两名足球运动员。

paras.en: Ultimately, the Tigers' administration decided against officially adding the players to the roster.
paras.zh: 最终，老虎队管理层决定不将这些球员正式添加到名单中。

paras.en: That did not stop the legal saga around both LSU and the SEC, after the conference was enjoined in a lawsuit filed by the football players in September that then led to commissioner Greg Sankey taking the stand inside a Baton Rouge courtroom.
paras.zh: 但这并没有阻止围绕路易斯安那州立大学和美国证券交易委员会的法律传奇，9月份足球运动员提起的诉讼禁止会议召开，随后导致专员格雷格·桑基在巴吞鲁日法庭内出庭作证。

paras.en: Fast-forward two months, and the same situation has been playing out around the basketball court pertaining to RJ Luis.
paras.zh: 两个月过去了，RJ Luis 的篮球场上也出现了同样的情况。

paras.en: "They [LSU] are hiding behind a judge, and I don't know why they think they won't ultimately find a way to punish them," one Power-four head basketball coach told OutKick. "They are actually going to fight the conference over one player and watch the world burn in the process?
paras.zh: “他们（路易斯安那州立大学）躲在法官后面，我不知道为什么他们认为最终找不到惩罚他们的方法，”一位四强队主篮球教练告诉 OutKick。 “他们实际上是为了一名球员而与联盟展开斗争，并在这个过程中眼睁睁地看着世界燃烧？

paras.en: "I guess they are really not worried about the fallout, because this makes the whole administration look petty. No matter how you feel about the SEC, it's obvious how they [LSU] feel about [Greg] Sankey and their counterparts within the conference."
paras.zh: “我想他们真的不担心后果，因为这让整个政府看起来很小气。无论你对 SEC 的看法如何，很明显他们 [LSU] 对 [Greg] Sankey 和会议中的同行的看法。”

paras.en: After the same judge granted Luis an injunction against the SEC that would prohibit them from punishing LSU if it were to roster and play the basketball star this season, a war of legal words has led to a massive kerfuffle within the legal circles.
paras.zh: 在同一位法官向路易斯颁发了针对 SEC 的禁令，禁止路易斯安那州立大学在本赛季入选并与这位篮球明星比赛时对其进行惩罚，一场法律口水战导致了法律界的大规模混乱。

paras.en: The SEC stated that it would not impose any type of fines or penalties against LSU after the injunction was granted, but they were clearly testing Will Wade and the Tigers administration on whether they would actually put RJ Luis into a game.
paras.zh: 美国证券交易委员会表示，在禁令颁布后，不会对路易斯安那州立大学实施任何类型的罚款或处罚，但他们显然是在测试威尔·韦德和老虎队管理部门是否真的会让 RJ·路易斯 参加比赛。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the SEC released a statement that clearly let it be known that they did not agree with how LSU was interpreting a court order. The Tigers did not have to make the decision on actually putting RJ Luis on the court, which is where the main course of this argument starts.
paras.zh: 周二，美国证券交易委员会发布了一份声明，明确表示他们不同意路易斯安那州立大学对法院命令的解释方式。老虎队并不需要做出是否让 RJ Luis 上场的决定，而这正是本次争论的主要过程的开始。

paras.en: "LSU's decision today to rely on its own interpretation of the Court's order to justify its actions is inconsistent with the expectations and responsibilities of [SEC membership]. This is a deeply concerning and disappointing development."
paras.zh: “路易斯安那州立大学今天决定依靠自己对法院命令的解释来证明其行为的合理性，这与 [SEC 成员] 的期望和责任不一致。这是一个令人深感担忧和令人失望的事态发展。”

paras.en: On Wednesday night, the top officially blew off the lid. During their game against UL-Monroe, and mid-way through the first half, Will Wade subbed in RJ Luis.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，顶部正式揭开了盖子。在对阵 UL-Monroe 的比赛中，上半场中段，威尔·韦德 (Will Wade) 替换下 RJ·路易斯 (RJ Luis)。

paras.en: "He was eligible, and he played," Will Wade said following LSU's win.
paras.zh: “他符合资格，而且他参加了比赛，”路易斯安那州立大学获胜后威尔·韦德说道。

paras.en: If there ever was an official escalation to a war, this was it.
paras.zh: 如果说有一次正式升级为战争的话，那就是这一次了。

paras.en: LSU decides to officially go to war with the SEC in Federal Court
paras.zh: LSU 决定在联邦法院正式与 SEC 开战

paras.en: Not only did LSU defy what the SEC President and Chancellors had voted on in the past three months, they were clearly jumping into the deep end of this very large pool of legal waters that will undoubtably set-off another chain of events that involve legal filings.
paras.zh: 路易斯安那州立大学不仅违背了美国证券交易委员会主席和校长在过去三个月的投票结果，而且显然是跳入了这个非常大的法律水域的深处，这无疑将引发另一波涉及法律备案的连锁事件。

paras.en: The conference wants to be able to enforce its own rules. LSU is using a court's order to waddle around the rules of rostering and playing a former professional athlete by using a Baton Rouge judge as the scapegoat.
paras.zh: 会议希望能够执行自己的规则。路易斯安那州立大学利用法院的命令，以巴吞鲁日法官为替罪羊，绕过前职业运动员的名单和比赛规则。

paras.en: In addition to the arguments made in a Louisiana court, the SEC had filed its own lawsuit against LSU on the same day Commissioner Greg Sankey took the stand in Baton Rouge.
paras.zh: 除了在路易斯安那州法院提出的论点外，美国证券交易委员会还在专员格雷格·桑基在巴吞鲁日出庭的同一天对路易斯安那州立大学提起了诉讼。

paras.en: In an Alabama federal court, the SEC sued LSU President Wade Rousse, athletic director Verge Ausberry and other Tiger officials for violating their first amendment rights pertaining to enforcing conference rules.
paras.zh: 在阿拉巴马州联邦法院，美国证券交易委员会起诉路易斯安那州立大学校长 Wade Rousse、体育总监 Verge Ausberry 和其他老虎队官员，指控他们侵犯了与执行会议规则有关的第一修正案权利。

paras.en: This has led to both sides exchanging legal jabs, with the latest coming on Wednesday, as the SEC was asking a judge to strike certain language used in a motion-to-dismiss filed by LSU. Legal counsel for the Tigers claimed that the SEC had brought forth "hallucinated" claims against defendants.
paras.zh: 这导致双方交换了法律意见，最新的一次是在周三，因为美国证券交易委员会要求法官删除路易斯安那州立大学提交的驳回动议中使用的某些语言。老虎队的法律顾问声称，美国证券交易委员会对被告提出了“幻觉”的指控。

paras.en: A judge ordered LSU lawyers to release a public apology through a press release, which Louisiana attorney general Liz Murrill told the court was not going to happen through her own filing.
paras.zh: 法官命令路易斯安那州立大学律师通过新闻稿公开道歉，路易斯安那州总检察长利兹·穆里尔告诉法庭，她不会通过自己的文件进行道歉。

paras.en: In addition to the mess going on in an Alabama federal court, RJ Luis' attorney, Tony Clayton, filed a motion to hold the SEC in contempt of court that came in response to the conference's statement on Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 除了阿拉巴马州联邦法院发生的混乱之外，RJ Luis 的律师托尼·克莱顿 (Tony Clayton) 还提出了一项动议，要求 SEC 藐视法庭，该动议是对周二晚会议声明的回应。

paras.en: "We want to hold [Sankey] and the SEC in contempt for the threat," Tony Clayton said. "Their lawyer sent us an email that they would not take any actions against LSU or threaten any actions. And then Sankey or an SEC official issued the threat about what they're going to do to LSU."
paras.zh: “我们希望[桑基]和美国证券交易委员会蔑视这一威胁，”托尼·克莱顿说。 “他们的律师给我们发了一封电子邮件，表示他们不会对路易斯安那州立大学采取任何行动，也不会威胁采取任何行动。然后桑基或美国证券交易委员会的一名官员发出了他们将要对路易斯安那州立大学做什么的威胁。”

paras.en: Now, ten minutes into a game against Louisiana-Monroe on Wednesday night, the LSU administration decided to pull the pin and throw the grenade.
paras.zh: 现在，周三晚上对阵路易斯安那门罗队的比赛进行了十分钟后，路易斯安那州立大学管理部门决定拉开别针并投掷手榴弹。

articles.title: WNBA launches search for next commissioner, but outgoing Cathy Engelbert could stay into 2027

paras.en: The WNBA's search for Cathy Engelbert’s successor has officially kicked off. According to reports, the league will work to eventually narrow down a list of more than a dozen candidates.
paras.zh: WNBA寻找凯西·恩格尔伯特继任者的工作已经正式启动。据报道，联盟将努力最终缩小十多名候选人的名单。

paras.en: Engelbert’s eight-year, at-times tumultuous tenure is nearing its end, but she could remain in the role beyond 2026 if the search extends into 2027.
paras.zh: 恩格尔伯特时而动荡的八年任期即将结束，但如果搜寻工作延续到 2027 年，她可能会在 2026 年之后继续留任。

paras.en: Engelbert previously announced plans to retire at the end of the year but clarified that she would remain commissioner beyond Dec. 31 if a successor was not in place. She took over as commissioner in 2019.
paras.zh: 恩格尔伯特此前宣布计划在今年年底退休，但澄清说，如果继任者没有到位，她将在 12 月 31 日之后继续担任委员。她于 2019 年接任专员。

paras.en: Monday marked Engelbert’s final WNBA Board of Governors meeting. Representatives from all 15 current teams attended, along with officials from the three expansion franchises set to join the league over the next four years: Cleveland, Detroit and Philadelphia. NBA Commissioner Adam Silver also attended.
paras.zh: 周一是恩格尔伯特最后一次 WNBA 董事会会议。目前所有 15 支球队的代表以及来自未来四年将加入联盟的三个扩张球队的官员都出席了会议：克利夫兰、底特律和费城。 NBA总裁亚当·萧华也出席了会议。

paras.en: That meeting came a few days after Engelbert met with coaches, general managers and team presidents last week at the WNBA offices for the annual competition committee meetings.
paras.zh: 这次会议是在上周恩格尔伯特在 WNBA 办公室举行年度竞赛委员会会议与教练、总经理和球队主席会面几天后举行的。

paras.en: If the WNBA chooses not to extend Engelbert’s tenure beyond Dec. 31, it could consider NBA Deputy Commissioner Mark Tatum. Tatum served as interim WNBA commissioner for nine months before Engelbert was hired following Lisa Borders’ departure in 2018.
paras.zh: 如果WNBA选择不在12月31日之后将恩格尔伯特的任期延长，它可以考虑NBA副总裁马克·塔图姆。塔图姆担任 WNBA 临时总裁九个月，之后恩格尔伯特在 2018 年丽莎·博德斯离职后被聘用。

paras.en: The next commissioner of the league will inherit a host of issues, including officiating, the transgender debate, scheduling and improving a strained relationship with players.
paras.zh: 联盟的下一任专员将继承一系列问题，包括执法、跨性别辩论、日程安排以及改善与球员之间的紧张关系。

paras.en: The league thrived in many ways during Engelbert’s tenure. Under her leadership, the WNBA enjoyed record growth and popularity, and signed a record-breaking broadcasting deal. Players surpassed $1 million in annual salaries.
paras.zh: 在恩格尔伯特任职期间，联盟在许多方面蓬勃发展。在她的领导下，WNBA 取得了创纪录的增长和受欢迎程度，并签署了创纪录的转播协议。球员年薪超过100万美元。

paras.en: But despite her accomplishments, Engelbert’s relationship with players was cordial at best, confrontational at other times. New York Liberty star Breanna Stewart may have summed it up best when said players "respect" Engelbert.
paras.zh: 尽管恩格尔伯特取得了诸多成就，但她与球员的关系充其量只是友好，有时却是对抗性的。纽约自由队球星布里安娜·斯图尔特（Breanna Stewart）也许是最好的总结，他说球员们“尊重”恩格尔伯特。

paras.en: Late last month, Engelbert presented the WNBA championship trophy to the Golden State Valkyries after they defeated the Atlanta Dream in the league’s first Finals series to reach seven games.
paras.zh: 上个月末，恩格尔伯特向金州武神队颁发了 WNBA 冠军奖杯，金州武神队在联盟首个总决赛系列赛中击败亚特兰大梦想队，打进七场比赛。

paras.en: The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 美联社对此报道作出了贡献。

articles.title: ‘Remarkable luck’: wreck of first Australian-built warship discovered exactly 128 years after sinking
articles.author: Petra Stock

paras.en: The wreck of Australia’s first locally built warship has been discovered 128 years after sinking off the coast of far north Queensland.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚第一艘本地建造的军舰残骸在昆士兰州北部海岸沉没 128 年后被发现。

paras.en: Marine archaeologists found the remains of Ex HMCS Spitfire on 21 August, the anniversary of its sinking in 1898.
paras.zh: 8 月 21 日，即 1898 年沉没的纪念日，海洋考古学家发现了前 HMCS 喷火式战斗机的残骸。

paras.en: Celeste Jordan, the principal heritage officer at Queensland’s Department of the Environment, Tourism, Science and Innovation, said it was “remarkable luck”. Rediscovering lost shipwrecks would “help ensure the stories of our past are preserved, celebrated and protected for future generations”, she said.
paras.zh: 昆士兰州环境、旅游、科学和创新部首席遗产官员塞莱斯特·乔丹 (Celeste Jordan) 表示，这是“非常幸运的”。她说，重新发现失落的沉船将“有助于确保我们过去的故事为子孙后代保存、庆祝和保护”。

paras.en: The 19-metre wooden gunboat, designed and built in Sydney in 1855, was commissioned by the Australian colonial government to protect against Russian warships based at Vladivostok during the Crimean war and amid concern about the French military presence in New Caledonia. It was designed to carry a 32-pounder cannon, although evidence suggests the armament may never have been fitted.
paras.zh: 这艘 19 米长的木制炮艇于 1855 年在悉尼设计和建造，受澳大利亚殖民政府委托，在克里米亚战争期间以及对法国在新喀里多尼亚的军事存在的担忧中保护驻扎在符拉迪沃斯托克的俄罗斯军舰。它被设计为携带一门 32 磅大炮，尽管有证据表明该武器可能从未安装过。

paras.en: The clipper later served Queensland as a pilot vessel, before it was sold for £300 into private hands as a sea cucumber fishing vessel.
paras.zh: 这艘快船后来作为领航船服务于昆士兰州，之后以 300 英镑的价格出售给私人手中，作为海参捕捞船。

paras.en: A 1981 article in the Naval Historical Review described the boat as “a sturdy little vessel”. Constructed from ironbark and blackwood, and sheathed in copper, it was designed and built by the Sydney shipbuilder John Cuthbert, and launched by his wife Susan Cuthbert from Darling Harbour in 1855.
paras.zh: 1981 年《海军历史评论》上的一篇文章将这艘船描述为“一艘坚固的小船”。它由铁树皮和黑木建造，并用铜包裹，由悉尼造船商约翰·卡斯伯特 (John Cuthbert) 设计和建造，并由他的妻子苏珊·卡斯伯特 (Susan Cuthbert) 于 1855 年从达令港下水。

paras.en: On 21 August 1898, Spitfire developed a leak and foundered on a voyage off the coast of Queensland’s Cape York peninsula, according to the Australian National Maritime Museum. Its crew were rescued by the Japanese steamship Omi Maru.
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚国家海事博物馆称，1898 年 8 月 21 日，喷火战斗机在昆士兰约克角半岛海岸附近航行时发生泄漏并沉没。其船员被日本近江丸号轮船救起。

paras.en: A crew from the Australian National Maritime Museum, the Queensland government and the Royal Australian Navy found the wreck while aboard HMAS Diamantina, a minehunter vessel. The month-long expedition searched an area based on archival records, with sonar picking up the Spitfire as an acoustic anomaly.
paras.zh: 来自澳大利亚国家海事博物馆、昆士兰州政府和澳大利亚皇家海军的工作人​​员在皇家海军迪亚曼蒂纳号猎雷船上发现了这艘残骸。为期一个月的探险队根据档案记录搜索了一个地区，声纳发现喷火战斗机存在声学异常。

paras.en: The chief of navy, Vice Admiral Matthew Buckley, said the Spitfire occupied a unique place in Australia’s naval history. “For sailors today, this vessel represents the beginning of a story that continues in the Royal Australian Navy.”
paras.zh: 海军总长马修·巴克利中将表示，喷火战斗机在澳大利亚海军历史上占有独特的地位。 “对于今天的水手来说，这艘船代表了澳大利亚皇家海军故事的开始。”

paras.en: The wreck is protected under the Underwater Cultural Heritage Act, and is one of more than 8,000 shipwrecks, sunken aircraft and other heritage sites in Australian waters.
paras.zh: 该沉船受到《水下文化遗产法》的保护，是澳大利亚水域 8,000 多艘沉船、沉没的飞机和其他遗产地之一。

articles.title: Mother whose twin baby died was determined to have home birth despite advice of experts, NSW inquest hears
articles.author: Tory Shepherd

paras.en: Baby B’s mother was so determined to have a home birth she ignored the advice of experts – including her own midwife, an inquest has heard.
paras.zh: 一项调查获悉，婴儿 B 的母亲一心想要在家分娩，却忽视了专家的建议，其中包括她自己的助产士。

paras.en: The inquest heard she was pregnant with twins, which she described as a “wonderful shock”, and didn’t want a hospital birth because she had heard of others’ traumatic experiences.
paras.zh: 调查得知她怀上了双胞胎，她称这“令人震惊”，并且不想在医院分娩，因为她听说过其他人的创伤经历。

paras.en: The New South Wales coroner’s court in Lismore heard on Thursday that the local medical community in the Hunter Valley swung in to action, warning the mother – who cannot be named for legal reasons – that a home birth was risky while also preparing in case something went wrong.
paras.zh: 周四，位于利斯莫尔的新南威尔士验尸官法庭获悉，猎人谷当地医疗界迅速采取行动，警告这位因法律原因无法透露姓名的母亲，在家分娩存在风险，同时也要做好准备，以防出现问题。

paras.en: Baby B died of a bacterial infection, while the other baby got sick but survived.
paras.zh: 婴儿 B 死于细菌感染，而另一个婴儿则生病但幸存下来。

paras.en: Baby B’s death is part of an ongoing inquest into the deaths of four babies – Baby R, Baby D, Baby DH and Baby B – who were born in free births or home births in NSW’s northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024.
paras.zh: 婴儿 B 的死亡是对四名婴儿（婴儿 R、婴儿 D、婴儿 DH 和婴儿 B）死亡事件正在进行的调查的一部分，这四名婴儿于 2022 年至 2024 年间在新南威尔士州北部河流地区通过自由分娩或家庭分娩出生。

paras.en: The first three babies died after a free birth – where no medical professionals are present. By contrast, four midwives were part of the birthing plan for Baby B. The main midwife continued to support the woman.
paras.zh: 前三个婴儿在没有医疗专业人员在场的自由分娩后死亡。相比之下，婴儿 B 的分娩计划中有四名助产士参与。主要助产士继续为该妇女提供支持。

paras.en: “The alternative was that she would birth at home with no support whatsoever,” the midwife – whose name is suppressed – told the court.
paras.zh: “另一种选择是，她在没有任何支持的情况下在家中分娩，”这位不愿透露姓名的助产士告诉法庭。

paras.en: The court heard that expert opinion found that the midwives’ treatment was “reasonable and appropriate”, which was a clear distinction from the other three births being examined at the inquest.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，专家意见认为助产士的待遇“合理且适当”，这与验尸时正在检查的其他三名婴儿有明显区别。

paras.en: “It will also be clear from the expert evidence that a home birth was still considered by the experts to be not suitable in the circumstances,” the court heard.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉：“从专家证据中还可以清楚地看出，专家们仍然认为在这种情况下在家分娩是不合适的。”

paras.en: Expert witness, Prof Hannah Dahlen, said that was because it was a twin pregnancy, that it had continued beyond 41 weeks, that there had been no specialist review, that the family were far away from the hospital, and that “there was a possible need for urgent operative birth and the need to provide simultaneous skilled care and resuscitation for two babies”.
paras.zh: 专家证人汉娜·达伦教授表示，这是因为这是双胎妊娠，而且已经持续超过41周，没有经过专家审查，家人距离医院很远，“可能需要紧急手术分娩，并且需要同时为两个婴儿提供熟练的护理和复苏”。

paras.en: But the mother declined multiple checks, and her distrust of the medical system was only reinforced as the pregnancy progressed.
paras.zh: 但这位母亲拒绝了多次检查，随着怀孕的进展，她对医疗系统的不信任只会加剧。

paras.en: She had scans at 12 weeks and at 22 weeks, but chose not to have hospital antenatal care, or to consult with an obstetrician. A local doctor followed up, but she told them she was doing well.
paras.zh: 她在 12 周和 22 周时进行了扫描，但选择不去医院进行产前检查，也不咨询产科医生。当地医生跟进了情况，但她告诉他们自己情况良好。

paras.en: Her midwife recommended monthly ultrasounds, and induction at 36 to 37 weeks. She declined. The midwife told the court she warned the mother about the risks at every visit.
paras.zh: 她的助产士建议每月进行一次超声波检查，并在 36 至 37 周时进行引产。她拒绝了。助产士告诉法庭，她每次探望时都会警告母亲注意风险。

paras.en: In evidence read to the court, the mother said she had always planned to have a home birth after hearing traumatic birth stories from other people.
paras.zh: 在向法庭宣读的证据中，这位母亲表示，在听到其他人的痛苦分娩故事后，她一直计划在家分娩。

paras.en: “I did a lot of research and found the midwives, so … I felt comfortable to still home birth the twins,” she said.
paras.zh: “我做了很多研究并找到了助产士，所以……我觉得在家生双胞胎很舒服，”她说。

paras.en: She said she was “quite selective” finding midwives with home birth experience and had researched the experience online and in books.
paras.zh: 她说，她“非常有选择性”地寻找有在家分娩经验的助产士，并在网上和书籍中研究了这些经验。

paras.en: The court heard “a lot of staff” at the local hospital were concerned about the plan, and the ambulance service was worried enough to organise a second paediatric resuscitation kit. There was collaboration and communication between the midwife, obstetricians from the local hospital, and a local GP.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，当地医院的“很多工作人员”都对该计划表示担忧，救护车服务部门也非常担心，因此组织了第二个儿科复苏工具包。助产士、当地医院的产科医生和当地的全科医生之间进行了合作和沟通。

paras.en: In court, the midwife said the mother wouldn’t have hesitated to seek help if it was needed, and that she thought she could convince the mother to go to hospital, or at least somewhere closer to it.
paras.zh: 在法庭上，助产士表示，如果需要的话，母亲会毫不犹豫地寻求帮助，并且她认为她可以说服母亲去医院，或者至少去离医院较近的地方。

paras.en: But then ambulance officers – and later, police – turned up at the home to do a welfare check, making the mother angry, upset, and more determined not to enter the health system.
paras.zh: 但随后救护人员——后来是警察——出现在她家中进行福利检查，这让这位母亲感到愤怒、不安，并更加坚定了不进入医疗系统的决心。

paras.en: “She felt quite violated because they came to her home,” the midwife told the court. “They were coercing her to attend the hospital.”
paras.zh: “她感到很受侵犯，因为他们来到她家，”助产士告诉法庭。 “他们强迫她去医院。”

paras.en: The mother went into labour at home, and the first twin was born successfully. Baby B “gave an initial gasp”, “appeared stunned” and needed help to breathe spontaneously.
paras.zh: 母亲在家待产，第一对双胞胎顺利出生。婴儿 B“开始喘气”，“显得很震惊”，需要帮助才能自主呼吸。

paras.en: Everything seemed to be fine, the court heard. The mother said the next night she could hear the baby breathing, and did not notice any changes. But in the early hours of the morning, Baby B was no longer breathing. When emergency services arrived, they noted that Baby B was “pale, unresponsive and not breathing, with no pulse, although she was still warm to touch”.
paras.zh: 法庭获悉，一切似乎都很好。这位母亲说，第二天晚上她可以听到婴儿的呼吸声，但没有注意到任何变化。但凌晨时分，B宝宝已经没有了呼吸。当紧急服务人员到达时，他们注意到婴儿 B“脸色苍白，反应迟钝，没有呼吸，没有脉搏，但摸起来仍然温暖”。

paras.en: Hospital records show continued they continued to work for 45 mins to save her once she arrived there, but she was flatlining. Her blood sugar and temperature were low, and she died.
paras.zh: 医院记录显示，她到达医院后，他们继续奋战了 45 分钟来抢救她，但她的情况已经毫无进展。她的血糖和体温都很低，最终死亡。

paras.en: By that stage, the boy twin was limp and grey. He likely had the same infection but it was less severe, and he survived.
paras.zh: 到了那个阶段，双胞胎男孩已经四肢无力，脸色灰白。他很可能也感染了同样的病毒，但没有那么严重，所以他活了下来。

paras.en: The midwife said she surrendered her registration after the death, both because of its effect on her and because of the way the health system treated her.
paras.zh: 助产士说，她在死亡后放弃了登记，这既是因为这对她的影响，也是因为卫生系统对待她的方式。

paras.en: She said she wasn’t told when Baby B died. When someone from the hospital rang to ask about the surviving twin, she assumed they were asking about Baby B and asked whether she was being transferred to a bigger hospital.
paras.zh: 她说婴儿 B 死后没人告诉她。当医院的人打电话询问幸存双胞胎的情况时，她以为他们是在询问婴儿 B 的情况，并询问她是否要被转移到更大的医院。

paras.en: “Oh, she’ll be going to the coroner,” the midwife was told.
paras.zh: “哦，她要去验尸官那里，”助产士被告知。

articles.title: Tammy Shipley was supposed to be monitored in prison. Instead she died after drinking 20L of water
articles.author: Australian Associated Press

paras.en: The death of an Aboriginal woman who collapsed after drinking at least 20 litres of water in a New South Wales prison cell was preventable and the result of systemic failures, a coroner has found.
paras.zh: 一名验尸官发现，一名原住民妇女在新南威尔士州监狱牢房里喝了至少 20 升水后倒地而死，这是可以避免的，而且是系统故障的结果。

paras.en: Tammy Michelle Shipley, 47, died at Silverwater women’s correctional centre on 20 December 2022.
paras.zh: 塔米·米歇尔·希普利，47 岁，于 2022 年 12 月 20 日在银水女子惩教中心去世。

paras.en: State coroner Teresa O’Sullivan ruled on Thursday that her death was caused by low blood sodium levels resulting from excessive water consumption and complications of schizoaffective disorder.
paras.zh: 州验尸官特雷莎·奥沙利文周四裁定，她的死亡是由于过量饮水和分裂情感障碍并发症导致血钠水平较低所致。

paras.en: “I’m confident in finding that Tammy’s death was preventable,” O’Sullivan said.
paras.zh: “我有信心发现塔米的死亡是可以避免的，”奥沙利文说。

paras.en: The mother of five had been taken into custody on remand 11 days earlier, after being charged with shoplifting offences, but didn’t disclose her mental health issues to police. Police also didn’t double-check her answers about her health, despite the fact she had attended a police station two weeks earlier and told them she heard her neighbour talking in her head.
paras.zh: 这位五个孩子的母亲在被指控犯有入店行窃罪后，于 11 天前被还押候审，但她没有向警方透露她的心理健康问题。警方也没有仔细检查她关于健康状况的回答，尽管她两周前曾到过警察局并告诉他们她听到邻居在她的脑海里说话。

paras.en: O’Sullivan found there had been a missed opportunity to recognise the mental health issues that were present, and to potentially divert Shipley away from the criminal justice system.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文发现，他们错失了认识现有心理健康问题的机会，并有可能将希普利从刑事司法系统中转移出来。

paras.en: When she appeared in a local court over the shoplifting charges the next day, the magistrate was not told she had been refused bail on other charges, so made orders they thought would secure her release.
paras.zh: 第二天，当她因入店行窃指控出庭时，治安法官没有被告知她因其他指控而被拒绝保释，因此下达了他们认为可以确保她获释的命令。

paras.en: “There was a clear systems failure,” O’Sullivan found.
paras.zh: “存在明显的系统故障，”奥沙利文发现。

paras.en: Shipley should have been continually monitored – both physically and electronically – after twice attempting self-harm in custody.
paras.zh: 希普利在两次在押期间试图自残后，本应受到持续的身体和电子监控。

paras.en: It was a serious failure that this had not been done, O’Sullivan said.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文说，没有这样做是一个严重的失败。

paras.en: “If observations had been carried out at the intervals required, it was likely that Tammy’s excess consumption of water would have been … prevented,” she said.
paras.zh: “如果按照要求的时间间隔进行观察，塔米过度消耗水的情况很可能会被……阻止，”她说。

paras.en: She deemed it unsatisfactory that Shipley had not been seen by a psychiatrist or mental health nurse at any point during the 11 days before her death.
paras.zh: 她认为希普利在去世前 11 天期间没有任何时候接受过精神科医生或心理健康护士的检查，这一点令人不满意。

paras.en: She added that Shipley should have received medical care from the time she started vomiting, after 10am on the day of her death. Instead, she said, Shipley experienced seizures shortly before noon and was seen lying face down on the floor of her cell around an hour later.
paras.zh: 她补充说，希普利在死亡当天上午 10 点之后开始呕吐，就应该接受医疗护理。相反，她说，希普利在中午前不久出现了癫痫发作，大约一个小时后，有人看到她脸朝下躺在牢房的地板上。

paras.en: A period of 23 minutes lapsed between when she was first seen lying on the ground and the commencement of resuscitation attempts, which the coroner found was unacceptable.
paras.zh: 从第一次看到她躺在地上到开始进行复苏尝试之间相隔了 23 分钟，验尸官认为这是不可接受的。

paras.en: One corrective services officer had hastily closed the door to her cell after smelling faeces in the room earlier in the day.
paras.zh: 当天早些时候，一名惩教人员在房间里闻到粪便味后，匆忙关上了牢房的门。

paras.en: “It was completely inappropriate that Tammy, who was known to be suffering a mental health condition, was left in that condition in her cell,” O’Sullivan said.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文说：“众所周知，塔米患有精神健康问题，将她留在牢房里是完全不合适的。”

paras.en: O’Sullivan made 10 recommendations to NSW police, Corrective Services NSW and Justice Health, including a review of the “austere and depressing” unit in which Shipley was held, which was intended to be a therapeutic space but left the coroner gravely concerned.
paras.zh: 奥沙利文向新南威尔士州警方、新南威尔士州惩教署和司法健康部门提出了 10 项建议，其中包括对希普利关押的“严峻而压抑”的单位进行审查，该单位原本是一个治疗场所，但令验尸官深感担忧。

paras.en: She also recommended regular monitoring of footage inside the jail and improved maintenance and cross-checking of records related to mental health conditions.
paras.zh: 她还建议定期监控监狱内的录像，并改进与心理健康状况相关的记录的维护和交叉检查。

paras.en: The coroner acknowledged the jail had already made changes after Shipley’s death.
paras.zh: 验尸官承认希普利死后监狱已经做出了改变。

paras.en: Outside the court, Shipley’s mother, Vicki, said she hoped the findings would force the system to assess how people are treated.
paras.zh: 在法庭外，希普利的母亲维姬表示，她希望调查结果能够迫使系统评估人们的待遇。

paras.en: “I honestly thought that at this stage of our country’s development, we have moved past how convicts were treated,” she said.
paras.zh: “老实说，我认为在我们国家发展的现阶段，我们已经改变了对待罪犯的方式，”她说。

paras.en: “The system – every system – eventually caused trauma to my daughter, until eventually it killed her.”
paras.zh: “这个系统——每一个系统——最终给我女儿造成了创伤，直到最终杀死了她。”

paras.en: Vickey Shipley urged the NSW government to quickly implement the recommendations.
paras.zh: 维基·希普利敦促新南威尔士州政府迅速实施这些建议。

paras.en: “If they’re not made, there will be some other family standing here doing exactly the same thing that I am,” she said.
paras.zh: “如果它们没有被制作出来，就会有其他家庭站在这里做和我完全相同的事情，”她说。

paras.en: “All too often we hear the cry: ‘There’s not enough money.’
paras.zh: “我们经常听到这样的呼声：‘钱不够。’

articles.title: Elon Musk says record $446m spending on US midterms was 'pretty foolish'

paras.en: Elon Musk said on Wednesday that he felt "pretty foolish" about the record sum he spent on the US midterm elections, following sweeping Republican defeats.
paras.zh: 埃隆·马斯克周三表示，在共和党惨败后，他在美国中期选举上花费的创纪录资金让他感到“非常愚蠢”。

paras.en: The Tesla and SpaceX chief executive was the election's top individual donor, giving $446m (Â£339m) to support President Donald Trump's party, particularly in Texas where many of Musk's firms are based.
paras.zh: 这位特斯拉和 SpaceX 首席执行官是此次选举的最大个人捐助者，捐赠了 4.46 亿美元（3.39 亿英镑）来支持唐纳德·特朗普总统的政党，特别是在马斯克的许多公司所在地的德克萨斯州。

paras.en: Musk, who had backed Trump's second White House bid, also said he was "not Maga" - the Make America Great Again movement associated with the president.
paras.zh: 支持特朗普第二次入主白宫的马斯克也表示，他“不是马加”——与总统相关的“让美国再次伟大”运动。

paras.en: Democrats won control of the both chambers in the US Congress, flipping both swing seats and making historic gains in places that have for decades been controlled by Republicans.
paras.zh: 民主党赢得了美国国会参众两院的控制权，翻转了两个摇摆席位，并在数十年来由共和党控制的地方取得了历史性进展。

paras.en: The election was seen as a bruising defeat for Trump, who has faced pressure over the impact his policies have had on the cost of living in the US.
paras.zh: 这次选举被视为特朗普的惨败，他因其政策对美国生活成本的影响而面临压力。

paras.en: Musk was speaking virtually, external at the New York Times DealBook Summit, an annual conference hosted in the city attended by major business and political leaders.
paras.zh: 马斯克在纽约时报 DealBook 峰会上以虚拟方式对外发表讲话，这是在该市举办的年度会议，主要商界和政界领导人出席。

paras.en: "I'm not Maga," Musk said, referring to the right-wing political movement.
paras.zh: “我不是马加，”马斯克在谈到右翼政治运动时说道。

paras.en: He added: "I'm not sure what Maga means... if that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don't have that."
paras.zh: 他补充道：“我不确定马加意味着什么……如果这意味着盲目遵守共和党的一系列政策，那么我当然不这么认为。”

paras.en: This marks a major shift in tone by Musk, who has previously been seen wearing a Maga hat.
paras.zh: 这标志着马斯克语气的重大转变，此前人们曾看到他戴着马加帽。

paras.en: "I'm not just Maga, I'm dark Maga," he joked at a Trump rally in 2024.
paras.zh: “我不仅仅是 Maga，我还是黑暗 Maga，”他在 2024 年的特朗普集会上开玩笑说。

paras.en: For several months at the start of Trump's second term in the White House, Musk served as an unpaid "special government employee" and Senior Advisor to the President, leading the Department of Government Efficiency (Doge) to cut government spending.
paras.zh: 在特朗普入主白宫的第二个任期开始的几个月里，马斯克担任无薪“特殊政府雇员”和总统高级顾问，领导政府效率部（Doge）削减政府支出。

paras.en: In October 2026, the Pentagon named Musk as a co-lead of a future of warfare study called Project Meridian, while he continued to travel with and advise Trump.
paras.zh: 2026 年 10 月，五角大楼任命马斯克为名为“子午线计划”的未来战争研究的联合负责人，同时他继续与特朗普一起旅行并提供建议。

paras.en: Musk went on to say he did not see much for the money he had spent on the Republicans' campaign, though he added that it was likely that candidates would have fared worse without the spending.
paras.zh: 马斯克接着表示，他认为在共和党竞选活动上花的钱并没有多大用处，不过他补充说，如果没有这些支出，候选人的表现可能会更糟。

paras.en: The large number of Republican losses could have implications for Musk and his businesses.
paras.zh: 共和党的大量损失可能会对马斯克及其企业产生影响。

paras.en: Democrats coming into power in both the Senate and House of Representatives have pledged greater scrutiny of tech companies, including over the building of controversial data centres.
paras.zh: 在参议院和众议院上台的民主党人承诺对科技公司进行更严格的审查，包括建设有争议的数据中心。

paras.en: In Georgia, where SpaceX has data centre operations, the newly elected Democrat governor promised to limit the rollout of the massive buildings, as well as the tax breaks tech companies often get to build them.
paras.zh: 在 SpaceX 拥有数据中心业务的佐治亚州，新当选的民主党州长承诺限制大型建筑的铺设，以及科技公司建造这些建筑时经常获得的税收减免。

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers have also suggested that SpaceX, which has gained an estimated $10bn in new government contracts since Trump was re-elected, should be investigated.
paras.zh: 民主党议员还建议对 SpaceX 进行调查，自特朗普连任以来，该公司已获得估计 100 亿美元的新政府合同。

paras.en: One of the most striking midterms wins went to Democrat James Talarico, who beat Republican Ken Paxton for a US Senate seat in Texas.
paras.zh: 最引人注目的中期选举胜利之一是民主党人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico），他击败共和党人肯·帕克斯顿（Ken Paxton）获得德克萨斯州美国参议院席位。

paras.en: According to BBC analysis, Musk had spent at least $45m in support of Paxton.
paras.zh: 据 BBC 分析，马斯克至少花费了 4500 万美元来支持帕克斯顿。

paras.en: Texas is where key operations for Musk's car company Tesla and rocket and technology firm SpaceX are based.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州是马斯克的汽车公司 Tesla 以及火箭和技术公司 SpaceX 的主要业务所在地。

paras.en: Musk said on Wednesday that he believes Texas' new governor, Democrat Gina Hinojosa, is "going to be quite moderate".
paras.zh: 马斯克周三表示，他相信德克萨斯州新任州长、民主党人吉娜·伊诺霍萨“将相当温和”。

paras.en: Hinojosa defeated Republican Governor Greg Abbott, ending more than three decades of the party's control of the state.
paras.zh: 伊诺霍萨击败了共和党州长格雷格·阿博特，结束了该党对该州三十多年的控制。

paras.en: The Tesla boss added : "I don't think she's a far-left governor. And based on everything I've heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor."
paras.zh: 这位特斯拉老板补充道：“我不认为她是一位极左州长。根据我所听到的有关她的一切，我认为吉娜担任州长后，德克萨斯州的一切都会好起来的。”

articles.title: This is a remarkable diplomatic moment for China's Xi - but it comes with pitfalls

paras.en: Xi Jinping will believe he has achieved something no other world leader could in securing a historic summit with Vladimir Putin and Donald Trump in Shenzhen.
paras.zh: 习近平将相信，他在深圳与弗拉基米尔·普京和唐纳德·特朗普举行历史性峰会方面取得了其他世界领导人无法做到的成就。

paras.en: For decades, Washington and its western allies shaped the world order.
paras.zh: 几十年来，华盛顿及其西方盟友塑造了世界秩序。

paras.en: Yet it is China that has orchestrated the remarkable diplomatic spectacle of three of the world's most powerful protagonists sitting around the table.
paras.zh: 然而，正是中国精心策划了世界上最强大的三位主角坐在谈判桌旁的非凡外交场面。

paras.en: And surrounding it all is the futuristic display that is Shenzhen, with driverless cars cruising past as drones fly overhead and robots - literally - dance in the streets.
paras.zh: 围绕这一切的是深圳的未来主义展示，无人驾驶汽车巡航过去，无人机飞过头顶，机器人在街道上跳舞。

paras.en: Ostensibly, this is an economic summit for Asia Pacific leaders. But for Xi, it is also a demonstration of China's grip on the global economy and world politics.
paras.zh: 表面上，这是亚太地区领导人的经济峰会。但对习近平来说，这也体现了中国对全球经济和世界政治的控制力。

paras.en: His country is no longer just reacting to decisions made in Washington, London or Brussels - instead Beijing is at the heart of conversations which are reshaping the international order.
paras.zh: 他的国家不再仅仅对华盛顿、伦敦或布鲁塞尔做出的决定做出反应，相反，北京成为重塑国际秩序对话的核心。

paras.en: But this meeting is not without its pitfalls for Xi as there are many things he does not appear keen to discuss with Putin and Trump.
paras.zh: 但这次会议对习近平来说并非没有陷阱，因为他似乎并不热衷于与普京和特朗普讨论很多事情。

paras.en: First, China is not keen for the war in Ukraine, now well into its fifth year, to be on the agenda.
paras.zh: 首先，中国并不热衷于将已经进入第五个年头的乌克兰战争提上议程。

paras.en: This is a delicate balancing act for Xi who is aware his relationship with Putin may damage China's connections in Europe. The EU is a key market, especially now when the Chinese economy is heavily relying on exports.
paras.zh: 对于习近平来说，这是一种微妙的平衡行为，因为他意识到自己与普京的关系可能会损害中国在欧洲的关系。欧盟是一个重要市场，尤其是在中国经济严重依赖出口的情况下。

paras.en: However Xi also doesn't want the war to end in a way that will destabilise Russia, a key ally and neighbour.
paras.zh: 然而，习近平也不希望战争以破坏重要盟友和邻国俄罗斯稳定的方式结束。

paras.en: Beijing is still trying to maintain that it is neutral in this war and has repeatedly called for negotiations and a political settlement while avoiding condemnation of Russia's full-scale invasion.
paras.zh: 北京仍试图在这场战争中保持中立，并多次呼吁进行谈判和政治解决，同时避免谴责俄罗斯的全面入侵。

paras.en: The US, especially under the previous Biden administration, and Europe have accused China of sending Russia components that it could use in its war in Ukraine, while also propping up the country's economy by buying oil and gas.
paras.zh: 美国，尤其是上届拜登政府和欧洲指责中国向俄罗斯出口可用于乌克兰战争的零部件，同时还通过购买石油和天然气来支撑该国经济。

paras.en: Xi wants to keep Putin close, but not too close because he also doesn't want Russia's problems to become China's problems.
paras.zh: 习近平希望与普京保持密切关系，但又不能太近，因为他也不希望俄罗斯的问题成为中国的问题。

paras.en: Donald Trump has already made it clear he wants the three leaders to discuss limiting the world's supply of nuclear weapons.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普已经明确表示，他希望三位领导人讨论限制世界核武器供应的问题。

paras.en: The US and Russia possess the world's largest stockpile of nuclear warheads. But China is rapidly expanding its own arsenal, which is raising alarm bells in Washington.
paras.zh: 美国和俄罗斯拥有世界上最大的核弹头库存。但中国正在迅速扩大自己的武器库，这给华盛顿敲响了警钟。

paras.en: The last major US-Russian arms control treaty, known as New START, expired in February this year, triggering fears of an arms race. The agreement had set a cap to control the number of nuclear weapons in US and Russia's arsenal.
paras.zh: 美俄最后一项主要军控条约《新削减战略武器条约》于今年2月到期，引发了对军备竞赛的担忧。该协议设定了控制美国和俄罗斯武库中核武器数量的上限。

paras.en: Trump would like China to be included in any new agreement, but Beijing has pushed back.
paras.zh: 特朗普希望将中国纳入任何新协议中，但北京方面予以拒绝。

paras.en: Xi's argument will be that his arsenal is considerably smaller than what Washington and Moscow own, and, therefore, it would be unfair for Beijing to be bound by their limits. China also believes it should have the freedom to develop its own nuclear capabilities.
paras.zh: 习近平的论点是，他的核武库比华盛顿和莫斯科拥有的核武库要小得多，因此，北京受其限制的约束是不公平的。中国还认为它应该有发展自己核能力的自由。

paras.en: This subject could complicate Xi's bid for China to be recognised as a leader on the world stage - because the US could argue that the status includes being a responsible nuclear power.
paras.zh: 这个话题可能会让习近平争取中国在世界舞台上被认可为领导者的努力变得复杂——因为美国可能会辩称，这一地位包括成为一个负责任的核国家。

paras.en: Xi will want to control the optics of this meeting, from start to finish.
paras.zh: 习近平希望自始至终控制这次会​​议的气氛。

paras.en: Chinese officials like to nail down agendas with talking points and produce carefully choreographed speeches.
paras.zh: 中国官员喜欢通过谈话要点来确定议程，并发表精心设计的演讲。

paras.en: But in this unprecedented summit, Xi will have to live with two very unpredictable leaders.
paras.zh: 但在这次史无前例的峰会上，习近平将不得不与两位非常难以预测的领导人共存。

paras.en: Both Trump and Putin have their own agendas and the US President has already threatened to go off script.
paras.zh: 特朗普和普京都有自己的议程，美国总统已经威胁要不按剧本行事。

paras.en: There is a risk that they both dominate the meeting and Xi ends up looking like a host, rather than the architect of a major diplomatic moment.
paras.zh: 存在这样的风险：他们都主导了会议，而习近平最终看起来像东道主，而不是重大外交时刻的设计师。

paras.en: Of course, Xi may be ready for this. It may even play into his hands.
paras.zh: 当然，习近平可能已经做好了准备。这甚至可能对他有利。

paras.en: The Chinese leader has been trying to portray himself as a stable global leader - at this summit he will be flanked by two men embroiled in wars they cannot seem to end.
paras.zh: 这位中国领导人一直试图将自己描绘成一位稳定的全球领导人——在这次峰会上，他身边的两个人将卷入似乎无法结束的战争。

paras.en: So any unscripted moment could serve to highlight his preferred role as senior statesman.
paras.zh: 因此，任何即兴时刻都可以凸显他作为高级政治家的首选角色。

paras.en: For all the attention, this meeting of three men with vastly different agendas is unlikely to yield any significant outcomes.
paras.zh: 尽管备受关注，这次由议程截然不同的三人组成的会议不太可能产生任何重大成果。

paras.en: But the power it projects is important for Xi as he heads towards next year's Communist Party Congress, where he is expected to secure a historic fourth term as leader of the party and country.
paras.zh: 但它所投射的权力对习近平来说非常重要，因为他即将召开明年的中国共产党代表大会，预计他将在会上获得历史性的第四个党和国家领导人任期。

paras.en: He may hope to use this as propaganda at home, given the country is grappling with huge domestic challenges.
paras.zh: 鉴于该国正在应对巨大的国内挑战，他可能希望将此用作国内宣传。

paras.en: A country-wide property crisis has dented consumer confidence. Local governments are heavily in debt. Manufacturing has slowed and more of China's workforce has become dependent on flexible jobs with no pension or social security. One in five young people are thought to be struggling to find work. Frustration and anxiety about the future bubble up routinely.
paras.zh: 全国性的房地产危机削弱了消费者的信心。地方政府负债累累。制造业已经放缓，更多的中国劳动力开始依赖没有养老金或社会保障的灵活工作。据认为，五分之一的年轻人正在努力寻找工作。对未来的沮丧和焦虑经常出现。

paras.en: Xi does not have to deal with elections, and the country has not seen major protests in decades. But he will be concerned about his popularity within the party elite as these problems - and the palpable frustrations they produce - grow.
paras.zh: 习近平不必处理选举问题，而且该国几十年来也没有发生过重大抗议活动。但随着这些问题以及由此产生的明显挫败感的加剧，他将担心自己在党内精英中的受欢迎程度。

paras.en: At a time like this, a photo-op with Putin and Trump may offer him proof that his country's "century of humiliation" is over. China is no longer a rising power, he can argue - rather, it is increasingly shaping the rules of a new era.
paras.zh: 在这样的时刻，与普京和特朗普的合影可能会向他证明他的国家的“世纪耻辱”已经结束。他认为，中国不再是一个崛起中的大国，而是越来越多地塑造新时代的规则。

articles.title: Crimean Bridge attacked again, Russia says

paras.en: The Crimean Bridge has been attacked by Ukraine for the third time this week, Russia has said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯表示，克里米亚大桥本周已是乌克兰第三次袭击。

paras.en: The Moscow-installed head of Crimea, Sergei Aksyonov, said that traffic was temporarily suspended following another strike on the bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea.
paras.zh: 莫斯科任命的克里米亚领导人谢尔盖·阿克肖诺夫(Sergei Aksyonov)表示，连接俄罗斯和被占领克里米亚的桥梁再次遭到袭击后，交通暂时中断。

paras.en: The critical bridge had already been hit twice earlier in the week resulting in severe damage and part of the bridge collapsing into the water.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，这座关键的桥梁已遭受两次撞击，造成严重损坏，部分桥梁塌入水中。

paras.en: The important infrastructure has long been targeted by Ukraine because of its significance as a logistical and symbolic asset to Moscow's war effort.
paras.zh: 这一重要的基础设施长期以来一直是乌克兰的目标，因为它作为莫斯科战争努力的后勤和象征性资产具有重要意义。

paras.en: It comes as Russian President Vladimir Putin meets US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping on Thursday for landmark talks in China.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京周四在中国会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平，进行具有里程碑意义的会谈。

paras.en: Aksyonov confirmed the strike on the bridge in the early hours of Thursday via Telegram.
paras.zh: 阿克肖诺夫于周四凌晨通过 Telegram 证实了桥梁袭击事件。

paras.en: Russia's transport ministry said nobody had been hurt in the attack, and that specialists were assessing damage to the bridge.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯交通部表示，没有人在袭击中受伤，专家正在评估桥梁的损坏程度。

paras.en: "As a result of a nighttime drone attack, train services on the railway section of the Crimean Bridge have been temporarily suspended," the ministry said in a statement on Telegram.
paras.zh: “由于夜间无人机袭击，克里米亚大桥铁路段的火车服务已暂时停止，”该部在 Telegram 上的一份声明中表示。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Ukrainian sources have continued to issue air raid alert warnings overnight for districts just outside of the capital Kyiv.
paras.zh: 与此同时，乌克兰消息人士连夜继续向首都基辅郊外的地区发出空袭警报。

paras.en: At least four people were killed in a Russian drone attack on the southern city of Odesa on Wednesday, according to Odesa Governor Oleh Kiper. Officials described the attack as "brutal and deliberate... directly targeting people and their lives".
paras.zh: 敖德萨州州长奥莱·基佩尔表示，周三，俄罗斯无人机袭击了南部城市敖德萨，造成至少四人死亡。官员们称这次袭击是“残酷且蓄意的……直接针对人民及其生命”。

paras.en: President Volodymyr Zelensky called the initial strikes on the Crimean Bridge an "unprecedented operation" weeks in the making.
paras.zh: 总统泽伦斯基称，对克里米亚大桥的最初袭击是一场“史无前例的行动”，几周后就开始了。

paras.en: Ukraine used drones and missiles against it on 17 November which brought down a key section of the road.
paras.zh: 11 月 17 日，乌克兰使用无人机和导弹对其进行攻击，摧毁了该公路​​的一个关键路段。

paras.en: That section of the double-arched, 12-mile bridge now lies on the seabed, brought down by an arsenal of Ukrainian long-range weaponry in a seven-stage operation culminating in a dramatic collapse.
paras.zh: 这座 12 英里长的双拱桥的这一部分现在位于海底，在七阶段行动中被乌克兰远程武器库击落，最终导致戏剧性的倒塌。

paras.en: In response, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov has said the bridge "will be rebuilt, and it will be even better than before".
paras.zh: 作为回应，克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，这座桥“将被重建，而且会比以前更好”。

paras.en: While Ukrainian forces have struggled to close the bridge for good, recent attempts have brought them closer to destroying the bridge's crucial road and rail route for Russian soldiers heading towards the front line.
paras.zh: 虽然乌克兰军队一直在努力永久关闭这座桥，但最近的尝试使他们更接近摧毁这座桥对前往前线的俄罗斯士兵来说至关重要的道路和铁路。

paras.en: Russian forces have also targeted key bridge crossings over the Dnipro River in Kyiv in recent days.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯军队最近几天还瞄准了基辅第聂伯河上的主要桥梁。

paras.en: Russian strikes hit the Pivnichnyi (Northern) and Pivdennyi (Southern) bridges causing traffic closures, partial damage to the metro system and some power and water outages.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯的袭击袭击了皮夫尼奇尼（北部）和皮夫登尼（南部）桥梁，造成交通堵塞、地铁系统部分损坏以及部分电力和供水中断。

articles.title: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life

paras.en: Carlisle Launches EL121 Disc Brakes for Improved Performance and Wear Life
paras.zh: Carlisle 推出 EL121 盘式制动器，以提高性能和磨损寿命

paras.en: (MEDINA, OH, September 12, 2023) – Carlisle Brake & Friction is excited to announce the launch of EL121 Disc Brake Pads for mine haul truck applications. The new product series will be named Extended Life, or the EL Series, and EL121 will be the first friction formulation of the series to launch.
paras.zh: （俄亥俄州梅迪纳，2023 年 9 月 12 日）——Carlisle Brake & Friction 很高兴地宣布推出适用于矿用卡车应用的 EL121 盘式制动片。新产品系列将被命名为Extend Life，即EL系列，EL121将是该系列中首款推出的摩擦配方。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series friction material nearly doubles the service life of front-axle, mine haul truck brake pads. The result is increased equipment uptime, and reduced maintenance costs when utilizing the OEM calipers and rotors.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔的 EL121 系列摩擦材料使前轴、矿用运输卡车刹车片的使用寿命几乎延长了一倍。使用 OEM 卡钳和转子时，可以增加设备的正常运行时间并降低维护成本。

paras.en: Autonomous haul trucks experience higher pad temperatures, which drive elevated pad wear from increased braking cycles as the retarder and the service brake are applied. EL121 features a highly wear-resistant friction material blend that provides extended brake pad life with consistent and fade-resistant braking performance. EL121 is the ideal solution for today’s autonomous mine haul trucks (may also be used in manned mine haul trucks for increased performance and longevity).
paras.zh: 自动运输卡车的刹车片温度较高，当使用缓速器和行车制动器时，制动周期的增加会导致刹车片磨损加剧。 EL121 采用高度耐磨的摩擦材料混合物，可延长刹车片的使用寿命，并具有一致且防褪色的制动性能。 EL121 是当今自动矿用运输卡车的理想解决方案（也可用于载人矿用运输卡车，以提高性能和使用寿命）。

paras.en: “We understand that mine operators need to keep their haul trucks on the job and not in the shop for brake service. Our latest innovation allows for up to double the service life of the front-axle mine haul truck brake pads and are a will-fit replacement to existing OEM pads. These were thoroughly lab tested as well as field tested on Komatsu 830E-1 trucks,” said Ron Ratell, Product Line Director Friction Products at Carlisle Brake & Friction.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司摩擦产品产品线总监 Ron Ratell 表示：“我们了解矿山运营商需要让运输卡车继续工作，而不是在车间进行制动维修。我们的最新创新技术可将前轴矿用运输卡车制动片的使用寿命延长一倍，并且是现有 OEM 制动片的理想替代品。这些制动片经过了彻底的实验室测试以及小松 830E-1 卡车的现场测试。”

paras.en: EL121 friction has been dyno tested to replicate the application and is proven to deliver an innovative, high-energy material to meet market needs. EL121 disc brake pads also feature an industry-proven mechanical retention system with backing plate technology designed for superior bonding and durability, capable of withstanding abusive conditions in even the harshest Off-Highway environments.
paras.zh: EL121 摩擦力经过测功机测试以复制应用，并被证明可以提供创新的高能材料来满足市场需求。 EL121 盘式刹车片还采用经过行业验证的机械固定系统，采用背板技术，旨在实现卓越的粘合性和耐用性，甚至能够承受最恶劣的非公路环境中的恶劣条件。

paras.en: Carlisle’s EL121 Series disc brake pads are available now through authorized Carlisle dealers and distributors. To learn more, visit https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el. To locate an authorized Carlisle dealer near you, search our online distributor listing https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor.
paras.zh: Carlisle 的 EL121 系列盘式刹车片现已通过 Carlisle 授权经销商和分销商发售。要了解更多信息，请访问 https://www.carlislecbf.com/products/brake-friction/disc-brake-pads/off-highway-disc-brake-pads/el。要查找您附近的卡莱尔授权经销商，请搜索我们的在线经销商列表 https://www.carlislecbf.com/support/find-a-distributor。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是全球公认的高度创新制动和摩擦系统解决方案开发和制造领域的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。卡莱尔制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

articles.title: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag

paras.en: Carlisle Releases Video Highlighting Solutions for Ag
paras.zh: Carlisle 发布 Ag 视频突出显示解决方案

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction launches a new product solutions video: Carlisle Solutions for Tractor Applications, to showcase all of the latest motion control technologies available for agriculture equipment, specifically tractor applications.
paras.zh: 卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司推出了新产品解决方案视频：卡莱尔拖拉机应用解决方案，展示适用于农业设备（特别是拖拉机应用）的所有最新运动控制技术。

paras.en: From power valves, to disc brakes, to PTO and shuttle clutch friction options, this video breaks down all of the features and benefits of Carlisle’s newest brake system and powertrain solutions.
paras.zh: 从动力阀到盘式制动器，再到取力器和梭式离合器摩擦选项，该视频详细介绍了卡莱尔最新制动系统和动力总成解决方案的所有功能和优点。

paras.en: For improved visualization, the video features 3D animation and demonstrations of the product fitments within a standard tractor model.
paras.zh: 为了提高可视化效果，该视频采用 3D 动画和标准拖拉机模型中的产品配件演示。

articles.title: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification

paras.en: Carlisle Suzhou Achieves Caterpillar SER Certification
paras.zh: 卡莱苏州获得卡特彼勒 SER 认证

paras.en: (MEDINA, January 25, 2024) – Carlisle Brake & Friction announced its Suzhou facility has won a Supplier Excellence Recognition (SER) Certification from Caterpillar Inc. The Caterpillar SER is a new supplier management system featuring "Certified" and "Excellent" levels. Caterpillar officially launched the program in 2022. Carlisle's Suzhou manufacturing facility achieved a "Certified" level of recognition and celebrated the achievement alongside the Caterpillar team with a ceremony at the Carlisle Suzhou plant.
paras.zh: （梅迪纳，2024 年 1 月 25 日）——卡莱尔制动与摩擦公司宣布其苏州工厂获得卡特彼勒公司颁发的供应商卓越认可 (SER) 认证。卡特彼勒 SER 是一种新的供应商管理体系，具有“认证”和“优秀”级别。卡特彼勒于 2022 年正式启动该计划。卡莱尔苏州制造工厂获得了“认证”级别的认可，并与卡特彼勒团队在卡莱尔苏州工厂举行了仪式，庆祝这一成就。

paras.en: Of 27,000 suppliers, 250 were among the selected companies awarded by Caterpillar. Carlisle, a leading global supplier of brake, clutch, and transmission friction products, is the only friction products manufacturer worldwide to win the coveted certification.
paras.zh: 在 27,000 家供应商中，有 250 家入选卡特彼勒授予的奖项。 Carlisle 是全球领先的制动器、离合器和变速箱摩擦产品供应商，也是全球唯一一家获得这一令人垂涎的认证的摩擦产品制造商。

paras.en: "We are honored to be recognized by Caterpillar as a Certified level supplier," said Doug Wagner, Global VP of Sales, Carlisle Brake & Friction. "This award recognizes the superior efforts and dedication of the entire Suzhou team that supports our global business."
paras.zh: “我们很荣幸被 Caterpillar 认可为认证级供应商，”Carlisle 制动与摩擦部全球销售副总裁 Doug Wagner 说道。 “该奖项是对支持我们全球业务的整个苏州团队的卓越努力和奉献精神的认可。”

paras.en: Carlisle earned SER Certification in recognition of the company's exemplary commitment to supporting Caterpillar's global growth strategy goals.
paras.zh: Carlisle 获得了 SER 认证，以表彰该公司对支持 Caterpillar 全球增长战略目标的模范承诺。

The comprehensive nature of Carlisle’s brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
