articles.title: Wait, Feist’s ‘My Moon My Man’ Is Going Viral Again?
articles.author: Andrew Unterberger

paras.en: This week: An ’00s Feist single goes doubly viral, a 2013 Gucci Mane song becomes a hit for the first time in 2026, and a rising British R&B artist scores a streaming breakthrough
paras.zh: 本周：一首 00 年代 Feist 单曲倍受病毒式传播，一首 2013 年 Gucci Mane 歌曲在 2026 年首次成为热门歌曲，一位冉冉升起的英国 R&B 艺术家在流媒体上取得突破

paras.en: To the ‘Moon’: Decades-Old Feist Indie Favorite Goes Viral for the Second Time in the Past Year
paras.zh: 前往“月球”：几十年来最受喜爱的 Feist 独立音乐在过去一年中第二次走红

paras.en: If you weren’t old enough to catch Feist‘s piano-pounding indie staple “My Moon, My Man” — or its block-rocking Boys Noize remix — back in 2007, chances are still pretty good you’ve been exposed to it by now. First, the song was used in a memorable opening montage sequence in the fourth episode of Canadian TV phenomenon Heated Rivalry‘s first season in late 2025, resulting in a huge streaming bump for the song that has mostly lasted through the 2026 calendar year. Now, it’s gone doubly viral, thanks to TikTok and FINNEAS.
paras.zh: 如果你还没有到 2007 年听 Feist 钢琴震撼的独立主打歌曲《My Moon, My Man》或其摇滚摇滚 Boys Noize 混音版的年龄，那么你现在很可能已经接触过它了。首先，这首歌在 2025 年底加拿大电视现象剧《Heated Rivalry》第一季第四集中的令人难忘的开场蒙太奇序列中使用，导致这首歌的流媒体流量大幅增加，大部分时间持续到了 2026 年。现在，由于 TikTok 和 FINNEAS，它已经双重传播。

paras.en: The latter Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter covered the song for an Amazon Music original release back in September, in advance of Feist’s induction into the Canadian Hall of Fame. His version of the song has taken off as part of a couples TikTok trend with the “aaaaa”s from “my moon, my maaaaaaan” traveling from one slide in the post to the next. (Though according to reports, the trend is going just as viral for the people doing it wrong as those following the formula correctly.) It’s a complicated chain of events, as nearly every viral story is in 2026.
paras.zh: 这位格莱美提名歌手兼作曲家在 9 月份在费斯特入选加拿大名人堂之前，为亚马逊音乐原创版本翻唱了这首歌。他的这首歌版本已经成为情侣 TikTok 潮流的一部分，“我的月亮，我的玛阿阿阿阿安”中的“aaaaa”从帖子中的一张幻灯片传到下一张幻灯片。 （尽管据报道称，这种趋势对于错误做法的人和正确遵循公式的人来说都像病毒一样传播。）这是一个复杂的事件链，几乎每个病毒式故事都发生在 2026 年。

paras.en: The result of it, however, is that Feist’s original “My Moon, My Man” — which never really stopped going viral from its Heated Rivalry bump nearly a year ago, still pulling in millions of streams a week — has now jumped up yet another level on streaming. For the seven-day period from Nov. 10-16, the song racked up over 4.3 million official on-demand U.S. streams, up 61% from the 2.7 million it notched the seven day period before that (Nov. 3-9), according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 然而，其结果是，费斯特的原创《我的月亮，我的男人》——几乎一年前，它从未真正停止过从激烈的竞争中走红，每周仍吸引数百万次观看——现在在流媒体上又跃升了一个新的高度。据 Luminate 称，在 11 月 10 日至 16 日的 7 天内，这首歌在美国的官方点播播放量超过 430 万次，比之前 7 天（11 月 3 日至 9 日）的 270 万次增长了 61%。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the FINNEAS “Moon” remains an Amazon exclusive, so its streaming totals are more modest — but those have also seen a considerable uptick, notching 68,000 streams over that same Nov. 10-16 period, up 98% from the just-over-34,000 streams it collected the prior period. - ANDREW UNTERBERGER
paras.zh: 与此同时，FINNEAS“Moon”仍然是亚马逊的独家节目，因此其流媒体总数较为温和，但也出现了相当大的增长，在 11 月 10 日至 16 日期间，流媒体播放量达到了 68,000 次，比上一时期收集的 34,000 多流媒体播放量增长了 98%。 ——安德鲁·安特伯格

paras.en: Fast-Rising UK R&B Artist Season 25 Scores Viral Hit With “Shotta’s”
paras.zh: 英国快速崛起的 R&B 艺术家第 25 季凭借《Shotta’s》获得病毒式传播

paras.en: From RAYE and kwn to Jordan Adetunji, Odeal and Sasha Keable, the UK R&B scene is one of the hottest enclaves in mainstream music — and Season 25 is making his case to be added to that list with his viral hit “Shotta’s.”
paras.zh: 从 RAYE 和 kwn 到 Jordan Adetunji、Odeal 和 Sasha Keable，英国 R&B 音乐界是主流音乐中最热门的飞地之一，第 25 季的热门单曲《Shotta’s》让他跻身这一榜单。

paras.en: Season 25 debuted a snippet of the Tobiswag and Katzy-produced song in an Aug. 29 TikTok that has since garnered over 1.2 million views. Listeners immediately latched onto the song, citing elements such as its Partynextdoor-reminiscent production and lyrics that some described as “misogynistic.” “Look at how she treatin’, son, I know you’s a tender man/ When you call, she do not come, that is not your ho,” he sings at the top of the first verse. He officially dropped the song on Sept. 25, and it quickly became a favorite amongst TikTok influencers, fan cam creators and dancers. On Nov. 12, Billboard Hot 100-topping rapper Swae Lee brought Season 25 out for a surprise performance of “Shotta’s” at his London show.
paras.zh: 第 25 季在 8 月 29 日的 TikTok 上首次推出了 Tobiswag 和 Katzy 制作的歌曲片段，此后已获得超过 120 万次观看。听众立即迷上了这首歌，并引用了一些让人想起 Partynextdoor 的制作和歌词等元素，一些人称其为“厌恶女性”。 “看看她是如何对待的，儿子，我知道你是一个温柔的男人/当你打电话时，她不来，那不是你的霍，”他在第一节的开头唱道。他于 9 月 25 日正式放弃了这首歌，它很快成为 TikTok 影响者、粉丝视频创作者和舞者的最爱。 11 月 12 日，公告牌热门 100 强说唱歌手 Swae Lee 在其伦敦演出中带来了第 25 季的“Shotta’s”惊喜表演。

paras.en: According to Luminate, the song has explored by over 705% in streaming activity over the past five weeks. During the week leading up to his surprise appearance at Swae Lee’s show (Nov. 6-12), “Shotta’s” pulled in 1.83 million official on-demand U.S. streams, up 53% from the week prior (Oct. 20-Nov. 5), when it logged 1.19 million official streams. On TikTok, the official “Shotta’s” sound plays in over 3.4 million posts.
paras.zh: 据 Luminate 称，在过去五周内，这首歌的流媒体活动浏览量超过 705%。在他出人意料地出现在 Swae Lee 的节目前一周（11 月 6 日至 12 日），《Shotta’s》在美国的官方点播直播量达到了 183 万，比前一周（10 月 20 日至 11 月 5 日）的 119 万官方直播量增长了 53%。在 TikTok 上，超过 340 万条帖子中播放了官方的“Shotta”声音。

paras.en: Last week (Nov. 12), Music Business Worldwide reported that Season 25 signed a deal with London-based indie label Isekai Records and New York-based broke Records off the success of “Shotta’s.” — KYLE DENIS
paras.zh: 上周（11 月 12 日），Music Business Worldwide 报道称 Season 25 与总部位于伦敦的独立唱片公司 Isekai Records 签署了一项协议，总部位于纽约的 Records 打破了《Shotta’s》的成功。 — 凯尔·丹尼斯

paras.en: Gucci Mane & Lloyd’s 13-Year-Old Collaboration Finds New Life on TikTok
paras.zh: Gucci Mane 与 Lloyd 长达 13 年的合作在 TikTok 上重获新生

paras.en: If you’re of a certain age, you’ll remember Gucci Mane and Lloyd’s “Fly S—t” collaboration from the ATL rapper’s 2013 Trap God 2 mixtape. 13 years later, TikTok has introduced the smooth hip-hop-meets-R&B joint to a new generation.
paras.zh: 如果您到了一定年龄，您一定会记得 ATL 说唱歌手 2013 年 Trap God 2 混音带中 Gucci Mane 和 Lloyd 合作的“Fly S—t”。 13 年后，TikTok 将嘻哈与 R&B 的流畅结合引入了新一代。

paras.en: Most of the love is due to Lloy’d sultry hook, with that specific part of the song soundtracking a few disparate trends. Some users have used it for a dance challenge; members of the historically Black fraternity Kappa Alpha Psi have rallied around it to showcase their strolls (their Halloween posts were particularly popular), and others have hilariously pointed out that Lloyd’s voice sounds a bit like Steve from Family Guy. Searches for the song on TikTok were also driven by some users having difficultyfinding the song on Apple Music.
paras.zh: 大部分的喜爱归功于 Lloy 的性感旋律，歌曲配乐的特定部分体现了一些不同的趋势。一些用户用它来进行舞蹈挑战；历史悠久的黑人兄弟会 Kappa Alpha Psi 的成员聚集在它周围展示他们的漫步（他们的万圣节帖子特别受欢迎），其他人则搞笑地指出劳埃德的声音听起来有点像《恶搞之家》中的史蒂夫。一些用户在 Apple Music 上很难找到这首歌，这也推动了 TikTok 上这首歌的搜索。

paras.en: During the week of Oct. 23-29, the song pulled just 16,200 official U.S. streams. The following week (Oct. 30-Nov. 5), that figure leapt a whopping 1,296% to over 227,000 official streams. By Nov. 6-12, streams for “Fly S—t” jumped another 255% to over 806,00 official streams. That’s good enough for a two-week increase of 4,858%!
paras.zh: 10 月 23 日至 29 日这一周，这首歌在美国的官方播放量仅为 16,200 次。接下来的一周（10 月 30 日至 11 月 5 日），这个数字猛增了 1,296%，官方直播数量超过 227,000 次。截至 11 月 6 日至 12 日，“Fly ST”的官方直播数量又增加了 255%，达到 806,00 多个。这对于两周增长 4,858% 来说已经足够了！

paras.en: Trap God 2 tapped out at No. 20 on Top Rap Albums back in 2013, but maybe this “Fly S—t” resurgence could help it rewrite history. – KD
paras.zh: 《Trap God 2》早在 2013 年就在热门说唱专辑排行榜上名列第 20 位，但也许“Fly S—t”的复兴可以帮助它改写历史。 – KD

articles.title: Netflix to Adapt ‘Grendel’ Comic Books Into Adult Animated TV Series
articles.author: Katie Kilkenny

paras.en: The long-running comic book series Grendel is getting a TV series adaptation from Netflix.
paras.zh: Netflix 正在将长篇漫画系列《格伦德尔》改编成电视剧。

paras.en: The streamer announced the upcoming adult animation series on Wednesday as it revealed Widow’s Bay producer Bobak Esfarjani will showrun, write and executive produce.
paras.zh: 该流媒体于周三宣布了即将推出的成人动画系列，并透露寡妇湾制片人波巴克·埃斯法贾尼 (Bobak Esfarjani) 将担任该系列的剧集运营、编剧和执行制作。

paras.en: Grendel, created by veteran comics artist and writer Matt Wagner, follows the author Hunter Rose, whose world is turned upside down after the murder of the woman he loves. But as he becomes the revenge-obsessed vigilante Grendel, he faces the choice of whether to return to a more normal life or become something closer to a villain than a hero. While Comico debuted the series in 1982, Dark Horse Comics has recently published the title.
paras.zh: 《格伦德尔》由资深漫画艺术家兼作家马特·瓦格纳创作，讲述了作家亨特·罗斯的故事，他的世界在他所爱的女人被谋杀后发生了天翻地覆的变化。但当他成为痴迷于复仇的义务警员格伦德尔时，他面临着选择：是回归正常生活，还是成为更接近恶棍而不是英雄的人。 Comico 于 1982 年首次推出该系列，而 Dark Horse Comics 最近也出版了该系列。

paras.en: “Grendel has been at the forefront of independent comics for over forty years, and we’re thrilled to bring Matt Wagner’s creation to Netflix,” Netflix’s vp of animation series and kids and family John Derderian said in a statement. “Like the comic, this animated series will break the traditional superhero mold just as Matt’s time-honored comic book has always done. Bobak, Dark Horse Entertainment and Bobbypills are bold storytellers who love this world as much as its fans do, and we’re so excited to partner with them to bring this story to screen.”
paras.zh: “四十多年来，格伦德尔一直处于独立漫画的最前沿，我们很高兴将马特·瓦格纳的创作带到 Netflix，”Netflix 动画系列及儿童和家庭副总裁约翰·德德里安 (John Derderian) 在一份声明中表示。 “与漫画一样，这部动画剧集将打破传统的超级英雄模式，就像马特历史悠久的漫画书一直以来所做的那样。Bobak、Dark Horse Entertainment 和 Bobbypills 都是大胆的故事讲述者，他们和粉丝一样热爱这个世界，我们很高兴与他们合作，将这个故事搬上银幕。”

paras.en: Netflix’s adaptation of the series will be executive produced by Chris Tongue, Tim Wiesch and Jay Komas for Dark Horse Entertainment as well as Lydia Antonini and Wagner. Bobbypills will serve as the studio.
paras.zh: Netflix 对该剧的改编将由 Dark Horse Entertainment 的 Chris Tongue、Tim Wiesch 和 Jay Komas 以及莉迪亚·安东尼尼和瓦格纳担任执行制片人。 Bobbypills 将作为工作室。

paras.en: “It’s incredibly exciting to see my creation finally make this leap to the animated screen,“ Wagner added in a statement. “Netflix’s dynamic new series retains the source material’s dark adult themes and also brings a fresh and thrilling approach to the narrative. This is Grendel as I’ve always wanted to see the character portrayed — a hyper-kinetic level of action, bracing explosions of violence and a poignant engaging storyline.”
paras.zh: 瓦格纳在一份声明中补充道：“看到我的作品最终登上动画银幕，真是令人兴奋不已。” “Netflix 充满活力的新剧集保留了源材料的黑暗成人主题，同时也带来了新鲜而惊心动魄的叙事方式。这就是格伦德尔，因为我一直想看到所描绘的角色 - 超动感的动作水平、令人震惊的暴力爆发和令人心酸的引人入胜的故事情节。”

paras.en: When it is released, Grendel will join Netflix’s library of adult animated shows including BoJack Horseman, Big Mouth, Love, Death & Robots and Mating Season.
paras.zh: 该片上映后，格伦德尔将加入 Netflix 的成人动画节目库，包括《马男波杰克》、《大嘴巴》、《爱、死亡与机器人》和《交配季》。

articles.title: Kylie Cantrall Surprises Fans With Private Acoustic Set in Downtown L.A.
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: On the heels of her Valley Girl Problems Tour, Kylie Cantrall played a surprise intimate acoustic set in downtown Los Angeles on Tuesday night for a crowd of enthusiastic fans who sang along with all of her tunes.
paras.zh: 周二晚上，在她的 Valley Girl Problems 巡回演唱会之后，凯莉·坎特拉尔 (Kylie Cantrall) 在洛杉矶市中心为一群热情的歌迷演奏了一场令人惊讶的私密音响表演，他们和她一起唱了所有的歌曲。

paras.en: Cantrall took over Moxy Downtown Los Angeles for the special event, which also celebrated her EP, Valley Girl Problems, which debuted in July. The event was part of Moxy Hotels’ ongoing music series, which brings emerging and buzzy artists together with fans for intimate experiences at Moxy properties around the world (other recent events have featured Ayra Starr in the U.K.).
paras.zh: Cantrall 接管了洛杉矶市中心莫克西酒店 (Moxy Downtown Los Angeles) 举办的特别活动，该活动还庆祝了她于 7 月首次推出的 EP《Valley Girl Problems》。该活动是 Moxy 酒店正在进行的音乐系列活动的一部分，该系列活动将新兴艺术家与粉丝聚集在一起，在世界各地的 Moxy 酒店提供亲密的体验（最近的其他活动以 Ayra Starr 在英国为主角）。

paras.en: The actor-singer — who has starred in two of Disney’s Descendants movies, playing Red, daughter of the Queen of Hearts — noted onstage that Los Angeles was her hometown and she was “feeling the love” at Moxy DTLA that night.
paras.zh: 这位演员兼歌手曾出演过两部迪士尼的《后裔》电影，饰演红心皇后的女儿瑞德。她在舞台上指出，洛杉矶是她的家乡，那天晚上她在 Moxy DTLA “感受到了爱”。

paras.en: After asking how many people were also at her recent tour — many in the audience were — she shared: “That show was a mix of emotions. I was so sad,” she said, and then a fan said she had cried during the show. “I made you cry? That should be a disclaimer on my website: If you’re coming to a Kylie show, there’s a chance you’re going to cry. But you’re going to shake a little ass too,” she quipped. “It’s a mix of both. That’s me in a nutshell honestly — crying and shaking ass at the same time.”
paras.zh: 在被问到有多少人参加了她最近的巡演（其中有很多观众）后，她分享道：“那场演出是一种复杂的情绪。我很伤心，”她说，然后一位粉丝说她在演出期间哭了。 “我让你哭了？这应该是我网站上的免责声明：如果你来看凯莉的演出，你有可能会哭。但你也会摇晃小屁股，”她打趣道。 “这是两者的结合。老实说，这就是我——一边哭一边摇屁股。”

paras.en: Cantrall said she was missing being on tour when Moxy Hotels reached out about the surprise pop-up L.A. show, and she said jumped at the chance to perform in the intimate venue. Addressing the fans, she continued, “Thank you guys for coming at the last minute.”
paras.zh: 坎特拉尔表示，当莫克西酒店集团联系到洛杉矶快闪表演时，她很怀念巡演的时光，她说她抓住了在这个私密场地表演的机会。她对粉丝们继续说道：“谢谢你们在最后一刻赶来。”

paras.en: She performed four songs at the event, kicking off with “Carrie Bradshaw,” a tribute to Cantrall’s “favorite TV character,” the one played by Sarah Jessica Parker in Sex and the City. “She’s is a fashion icon; she’s kind of a mess as well, but we love her for it,” Cantrall said. (The bar at Moxy DTLA was serving special cocktails in honor of the event that included the Carrie Cosmo and the Valley Girl Martini.)
paras.zh: 她在活动中表演了四首歌，以《Carrie Bradshaw》拉开序幕，这是对坎特拉尔“最喜欢的电视角色”的致敬，即《欲望都市》中莎拉·杰西卡·帕克饰演的角色。 “她是一位时尚偶像；她也有点乱，但我们因此爱她，”坎特拉尔说。 （Moxy DTLA 的酒吧为庆祝这一活动提供了特别鸡尾酒，其中包括 Carrie Cosmo 和 Valley Girl Martini。）

paras.en: Next up was “Oversized,” from her previous EP, B.O.Y. (Deluxe). She revealed that she’s a “hoodie stealer,” joking that she had about five of her best friend’s hoodies at her house. In co-writing the song, “I was kind of inspired by this era I was in, dating and dealing with guys with hoodies. … I definitely still have two of (my ex’s) hoodies that I never gave back, but he never asked for them back. And they look better on me anyway,” she joked.
paras.zh: 接下来是她上一张EP《B.O.Y.》中的“Oversized”。 （豪华）。她透露自己是一个“连帽衫偷者”，开玩笑说她家里有大约五件她最好朋友的连帽衫。在共同创作这首歌时，“我受到了我所处的这个时代的启发，约会并与穿着连帽衫的男人打交道。……我肯定还有两件（我前任的）连帽衫，我从未归还过它们，但他从未要求归还它们。无论如何，它们在我身上看起来更好，”她开玩笑说。

paras.en: “You know we’re gonna get in our feels for a minute,” she said, introducing the next song, the emotional “Space Between” from Valley Girl Problems. “Now that I’ve been home, I’ve been writing the next album … but I haven’t written any ballads on it so far. That just goes to show you we’re healed. We’re healing slowly day by day. This song is very special to me. If you’re going through something right now, or maybe you’re healing through a situation, maybe even this song helped you heal a little bit.” After, a fan told her that song always makes her cry, to which Cantrall responded that it makes her emotional as well. She also gave the crowd a note of encouragement: “You are so entitled to feeling whatever you’re feeling … and I think the best thing we can do as humans is just try to embrace our imperfections and let that shit go, whether it’s writing it down, talking to someone, therapy, writing music, creating art. … You are never alone.” (Here she quipped that it was her first 18-and-older show, so she didn’t have to censor herself as when she was on tour.)
paras.zh: “你知道我们会暂时陷入困境，”她说道，并介绍了下一首歌曲，《Valley Girl Problems》中情感丰富的《Space Between》。 “现在我已经回家了，我一直在写下一张专辑……但到目前为止我还没有写过任何民谣。这只是表明我们已经痊愈了。我们一天天慢慢康复。这首歌对我来说非常特别。如果你现在正在经历一些事情，或者也许你正在经历某种情况，也许这首歌可以帮助你治愈一​​点。”之后，一位粉丝告诉她这首歌总是让她哭泣，坎特拉尔回应说这也让她情绪激动。她还向观众发出了鼓励的话：“你有权利感受到任何你所感受到的东西……我认为作为人类，我们能做的最好的事情就是尝试拥抱我们的不完美，放开那些狗屎，无论是写下来，与某人交谈，治疗，写音乐，创作艺术。……你永远不会孤单。” （她在这里打趣说，这是她第一次参加 18 岁以上的演出，所以她不必像巡演时那样审查自己。）

paras.en: Cantrall closed the show with “Elastic,” which she said was so frequently requested during her tour that she wound up adding it to her setlist. She wrapped with an a capella sing-along to a few verses of “Valley Girl Problems” to the delight of those inside Moxy DTLA.
paras.zh: 坎特拉尔以《Elastic》结束了演出，她说在她的巡演期间，人们经常要求这首歌，所以她最终将其添加到了她的歌单中。她以无伴奏合唱结束了“Valley Girl Problems”的几段歌词，让 Moxy DTLA 的人们感到高兴。

paras.en: Indeed, many of those in attendance sang along with her songs throughout the performance, and Cantrall engaged in some fun banter with the fans. Afterward, she asked the crowd to take a group photo before graciously signing autographs and taking selfies with fans’ phones.
paras.zh: 事实上，许多出席的人在整个表演过程中都跟着她的歌曲一起唱，坎特拉尔还与粉丝们进行了一些有趣的玩笑。随后，她请大家合影，然后慷慨地为粉丝签名并用手机自拍。

paras.en: Cantrall recently hit 15 cities across North America as part of her first-ever headlining tour, which kicked off Sept. 25 in Minneapolis and wrapped up Oct. 22 in Los Angeles, her hometown. Next, she’s set to appear on three dates of the Jingle Ball tour (Dec. 1 in Dallas, Dec. 14 in Washington, D.C. and Dec. 15 in Philadelphia). In summer 2025, she toured North America as part of Disney’s Descendants/Zombies: Worlds Collide Tour.
paras.zh: 坎特拉尔最近在北美 15 个城市进行了她的首次巡演，巡演于 9 月 25 日在明尼阿波利斯开始，并于 10 月 22 日在她的家乡洛杉矶结束。接下来，她将出现在 Jingle Ball 巡演的三个日期（12 月 1 日在达拉斯，12 月 14 日在华盛顿特区，12 月 15 日在费城）。 2025 年夏天，她作为迪士尼后裔/僵尸：世界碰撞巡演的一部分前往北美巡演。

paras.en: Valley Girl Problems, released via Republic Records, follows on the heels of her debut EP, B.O.Y. The new nine-track EP was produced by Grammy-winning hitmaker Tricky Stewart (Rihanna, Tyla) and written alongside acclaimed songwriter Tayla Parx.
paras.zh: 《Valley Girl Problems》是继她的首张 EP《B.O.Y.》之后通过 Republic Records 发行的。这张新的九首曲目 EP 由格莱美获奖热门制作人 Tricky Stewart（Rihanna、Tyla）制作，并与广受赞誉的词曲作家 Tayla Parx 共同创作。

paras.en: Moxy Hotels says that its music series aims to create a space where Gen Z can be connected with artists, events and moments shaping culture.
paras.zh: Moxy Hotels 表示，其音乐系列旨在创造一个空间，让 Z 世代能够与塑造文化的艺术家、活动和时刻联系起来。

articles.title: Florence Pugh Says It’s “Disturbing Having My Body Dissected,” Slams Surgery and Ozempic Accusations: “Be Mindful”
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Florence Pugh is speaking out about recent conversations that have emerged online about her body, pertaining to speculation that she’s had surgery and is on Ozempic.
paras.zh: 弗洛伦斯·皮尤 (Florence Pugh) 公开谈论了最近网上出现的有关她身体的对话，有关她接受过手术并服用 Ozempic 的猜测。

paras.en: The East of Eden star took to Instagram on Wednesday, writing that she finds it “so stressful waking up and have thousands of people talking about you and your body in ways that you can’t even comprehend. I’m aware that the culture on socials currently is very interested in talking about people’s surgery and ozempic changes, it’s clearly a part of our time right now, that there’s this frenzy of people picking apart what’s truth and what’s fake.”
paras.zh: 这位《伊甸之东》的明星周三在 Instagram 上写道，她发现“醒来压力很大，成千上万的人以你甚至无法理解的方式谈论你和你的身体。我知道社交媒体上的文化目前对谈论人们的手术和臭氧变化非常感兴趣，这显然是我们这个时代的一部分，人们疯狂地辨别真假。”

paras.en: “I woke up the other morning and quite a lot of you were discussing my face and body in such a disturbing way. I learnt online that I had been on ozempic? I learnt that I’d had upper bleph? Lower bleph? Filler? Face lipo? Buccal fat remover? Chin surgery? Nose surgery?!” Pugh continued, slamming the accusations.
paras.zh: “那天早上我醒来，你们很多人都在以一种令人不安的方式讨论我的脸和身体。我在网上得知我服用了奥西匹克？我得知我有上眼睑？下眼睑？填充剂？面部吸脂​​？颊脂去除术？下巴手术？鼻子手术？！”皮尤继续抨击这些指控。

paras.en: The actress said she is “disturbed” by “having my body dissected and pointed at again,” and that she has “spent my whole career defending and protecting bodies that just grow the way they grow” while also experiencing fat shaming “from the moment I started and I have loved everytime I get to tell someone to fuck off when they are being inappropriate about my weight, and I’m not changing that now just because you’ve all said so.”
paras.zh: 这位女演员说，她对“我的身体再次被解剖和指指点点”感到“不安”，她“用我的整个职业生涯来捍卫和保护那些按照生长方式生长的身体”，同时也经历着脂肪羞辱，“从我开始的那一刻起，我很喜欢每次当有人对我的体重不恰当时我告诉他们滚开，我现在不会因为你们都这么说而改变这一点。”

paras.en: In a recent Instagram video shared by Evie magazine, a woman analyzed Pugh’s face, placing a side-by-side image of her a few years past beside her recent appearance at the 2026 Governors Awards, saying, “People are saying Florence Pugh has fallen victim to Hollywood’s war on round faces. Don’t get me wrong, Florence Pugh still looks beautiful, but I think we can all collectively agree that Hollywood seems to have this thing against softer features.”
paras.zh: 在《Evie》杂志最近分享的 Instagram 视频中，一名女性分析了皮尤的脸，将她几年前的照片与她最近出席 2026 年州长颁奖典礼的照片放在一起，说道：“人们说弗洛伦斯·皮尤已经成为好莱坞圆脸战争的受害者。别误会，弗洛伦斯·皮尤看起来仍然很漂亮，但我想我们都可以一致认为，好莱坞似乎有这种反对柔和特征的东西。”

paras.en: The woman referenced Pugh’s “sculpted, snatched look,” and said that the actress used to have “full, beautiful cheeks,” but now that her “jaw is more defined, her chin is more pointier, her jaws more are sharp, it makes sense why people are wondering if she’s had any work done.” The actress herself commented on Evie’s Instagram post, writing, “Guys. I turned 30. I’m a woman. Body’s and faces change. It’s not that deep. The fact that people can’t even tell between what’s aging and what’s surgery is disturbing. Sadly puppy fluff doesn’t last forever.”
paras.zh: 这位女士提到了皮尤“雕刻般、抢夺的外观”，并表示这位女演员过去有“饱满、美丽的脸颊”，但现在她的“下巴更加轮廓分明，她的下巴更尖，她的下巴更锋利，这就是为什么人们想知道她是否做过任何工作是有道理的。”这位女演员本人在 Evie 的 Instagram 帖子上评论道，“伙计们。我已经 30 岁了。我是一个女人。身体和面孔发生了变化。变化并不那么深刻。人们甚至分不清什么是衰老，什么是手术，这一事实令人不安。可悲的是，小狗的绒毛不会永远持续下去。”

paras.en: The Oscar nominee denied having surgery or taking the weight-loss drug in her Instagram post. “I have never been on ozempic. I have NEVER done any face surgery. And don’t EVER say that I didn’t make my own nose, I’ve always had that beautiful ski slope. Even as a baby!” Pugh shared a photo of herself as a child on her Instagram Story, writing, “I’ve had that baby since day one. No surgery please and thank you very much.”
paras.zh: 这位奥斯卡提名者在她的 Instagram 帖子中否认做过手术或服用减肥药。 “我从来没有服用过 ozempic。我从来没有做过任何面部手术。也不要说我的鼻子不是我自己做的，我一直有那个美丽的滑雪坡。即使是在婴儿时期！” Pugh 在她的 Instagram Story 上分享了一张自己小时候的照片，写道：“我从第一天起就怀上了这个孩子。请不要做手术，非常感谢。”

paras.en: She further explained that after turning 30, her New Year’s resolution was “to change my relationship with alcohol, and to be able to do at least one pull up in the gym.” The actress also said it’s been “funny to see you all use reference images from times where I was really mentally unhappy and abusing my body and put it next to the image from the governors awards the other night where I am happy and truly respecting my body.”
paras.zh: 她进一步解释说，30岁之后，她的新年决心是“改变我与酒精的关系，并且能够在健身房至少做一次引体向上。”这位女演员还表示，“很有趣的是，看到你们都使用我精神上非常不开心、虐待自己身体的时候的参考图片，并将其放在前几天晚上州长颁奖典礼上的图片旁边，当时我很高兴，并且真正尊重自己的身体。”

paras.en: The Thunderbolts star said that “for the first time in my ENTIRE career, I have had the opportunity to be rested, to sleep, to wake up and work out and to eat regularly and healthily. I’ve WANTED to move my body and not take it for granted. Guess how much weight I’ve lost in all of that? 2 pounds.”
paras.zh: 这位霹雳明星说：“在我的整个职业生涯中，这是我第一次有机会休息、睡觉、起床、锻炼以及定期健康饮食。我想要活动一下我的身体，而不是认为这是理所当然的。猜猜我在这一切中减掉了多少体重？2磅。”

paras.en: She also explained that she’s been prioritizing growing muscle because “I think it’s the most important thing a woman can do. Build muscle and be strong. I can now do 6 pull ups and lift 110kg. Which I’m sure to many of you isn’t a lot.. but to me?! It’s everything.” On her Instagram Story, Pugh also posted a few videos of her training in the gym.
paras.zh: 她还解释说，她一直优先考虑增长肌肉，因为“我认为这是一个女人能做的最重要的事情。增强肌肉并变得强壮。我现在可以做 6 个引体向上并举起 110 公斤。我相信对你们很多人来说这并不是很多……但对我来说？！这就是一切。”在她的 Instagram Story 上，Pugh 还发布了一些她在健身房训练的视频。

paras.en: “I’ve fucking worked so hard to clean my head and clean my body because I don’t want to allow space for negativity in my mind to grow. I’m looking after myself, and that’s literally it,” Pugh wrote, urging her followers to “be mindful” as she’s also previously received negative comments in the past.
paras.zh: 普格写道：“我他妈的非常努力地清理我的头部和清理我的身体，因为我不想让消极情绪在我的脑海中滋长。我正在照顾自己，这就是事实。”她敦促她的追随者“保持警惕”，因为她过去也收到过负面评论。

paras.en: “I also want to point out that over the years I have been in the public eye, I have received comments or messages daily about how I look like a pig, that I’m fat and should go on a run, that I shouldn’t be proud of my body, that I SHOULD go on ozempic, that I shouldn’t show my midriff because I shouldn’t be proud of it. (The size of my thighs even made it into a movie review after I played Saraya the WWE wrestler which will never not be mind blowing),” Pugh added.
paras.zh: “我还想指出的是，这些年来我一直在公众的视线中，我每天都会收到关于我看起来像头猪的评论或信息，我很胖，应该去跑步，我不应该为自己的身体感到骄傲，我应该继续奥兹皮克，我不应该露出我的腹部，因为我不应该为此感到自豪。（在我扮演WWE摔跤手萨拉亚之后，我的大腿尺寸甚至出现在电影评论中，这永远不会不存在）令人兴奋），”Pugh 补充道。

paras.en: “I’ve always been aware that seeing a confident woman be happy in her skin is triggering to a lot of people and for long time just accepted that I will receive commentary like that. But now this..? I’m asking us all to just be mindful. We are all real people, living real lives,” she concluded.
paras.zh: “我一直都知道，看到一个自信的女人对自己的皮肤感到高兴会触发很多人，而且很长一段时间以来，我都接受了我会收到这样的评论。但现在……？我要求我们所有人都要保持警惕。我们都是真实的人，过着真实的生活，”她总结道。

articles.title: Anthropic IPO: AI lab considers increasing the offering as investor demand surges, sources say

paras.en: Anthropic is considering upsizing its initial public offering, people familiar with the details told CNBC, as the artificial intelligence lab weighs setting the price well above $80.
paras.zh: 知情人士告诉 CNBC，Anthropic 正在考虑扩大首次公开募股规模，该人工智能实验室正在考虑将发行价定为远高于 80 美元。

paras.en: The company closed its order books and locked in total demand on Tuesday, setting the stage for the Claude creator's eagerly awaited Nasdaq listing. Institutional demand for the offering is around $400 billion, while retail demand is approaching $100 billion, according to the people, who asked not to be named because they were not authorized to speak publicly.
paras.zh: 该公司周二关闭了订单并锁定了总需求，为克劳德创造者期待已久的纳斯达克上市奠定了基础。因无权公开发言而要求匿名的知情人士表示，机构对此次发行的需求约为 4000 亿美元，而散户需求则接近 1000 亿美元。

paras.en: The orders are indications of interest and are not binding. All of the details are subject to change, and Anthropic will make final decisions Wednesday afternoon, the people said. Anthropic is expected to set its final IPO price after market close Wednesday.
paras.zh: 该订单仅表明兴趣，不具有约束力。知情人士称，所有细节都可能发生变化，Anthropic 将在周三下午做出最终决定。 Anthropic 预计将在周三收盘后确定最终 IPO 价格。

paras.en: Demand for the offering is higher than it was for Elon Musk's SpaceX, even though the rocket maker had a bigger market offering. SpaceX debuted on the Nasdaq in June in by far the biggest IPO on record, ultimately raising $85.7 billion.
paras.zh: 尽管这家火箭制造商的市场产品更大，但对该产品的需求仍高于埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 SpaceX。 SpaceX 于 6 月在纳斯达克上市，这是迄今为止规模最大的 IPO，最终筹集了 857 亿美元。

paras.en: The AI lab said last week that it would offer 825 million shares in the IPO at a price range of between $70 and $78 per share, which would net up to $64.35 billion at the high end of that range.
paras.zh: 该人工智能实验室上周表示，它将在 IPO 中发行 8.25 亿股股票，价格范围为每股 70 美元至 78 美元，按该价格区间的上限计算，净值将达到 643.5 亿美元。

paras.en: A representative for Anthropic declined to comment.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的代表拒绝置评。

paras.en: Anthropic's listing is a major test for the AI industry, which has experienced a set of recent shocks, including a dramatic backlash that was felt at the polls in the midterm elections and last week's ouster of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The market was already jittery on concerns that rising interest rates will make debt unaffordable for many data center developers and neoclouds.
paras.zh: Anthropic 的上市是对人工智能行业的一次重大考验，该行业最近经历了一系列冲击，包括中期选举中的民意调查以及上周英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋被赶下台后所感受到的强烈反弹。由于担心利率上升将使许多数据中心开发商和新云公司无力承担债务，市场已经变得紧张不安。

paras.en: Tech's biggest companies have significant exposure to Anthropic, as an investor, partner or customer. Amazon and Google both own stakes valued at over $100 billion, and a group of tech companies, including Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices agreed to collectively invest $26 billion in the IPO. Anthropic, meanwhile, is a buyer of costly systems from Nvidia, Google, Amazon and AMD.
paras.zh: 科技界最大的公司作为投资者、合作伙伴或客户对 Anthropic 有很大的影响。亚马逊和谷歌均持有价值超过 1000 亿美元的股份，包括谷歌、微软、英伟达和 Advanced Micro Devices 在内的一批科技公司同意在 IPO 中集体投资 260 亿美元。与此同时，Anthropic 是 Nvidia、Google、Amazon 和 AMD 昂贵系统的买家。

paras.en: "I think if we do this right, we can create an age of miracles where humanity is able to solve problems that have eluded us for millennia," Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said in Anthropic's roadshow video. "We have to make sure that all the risks, all the ways that things can go wrong with this technology, we very carefully address those risks as we bring the benefits and as we have a viable business at the same time."
paras.zh: Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 在 Anthropic 的路演视频中表示：“我认为，如果我们做得正确，我们就可以创造一个奇迹时代，人类能够解决我们千年来一直困惑的问题。” “我们必须确保所有风险，以及这项技术可能出现问题的所有方式，我们都非常谨慎地解决这些风险，因为我们带来了好处，同时我们也拥有了可行的业务。”

paras.en: Amodei co-founded Anthropic alongside a handful of other researchers less than six years ago, after the group collectively defected from OpenAI. The company is best known for developing a family of AI models called Claude, and it primarily sells its products and services to other businesses.
paras.zh: 不到六年前，Amodei 与其他几位研究人员共同创立了 Anthropic，当时该团队集体叛逃了 OpenAI。该公司以开发一系列名为 Claude 的人工智能模型而闻名，主要向其他企业销售其产品和服务。

paras.en: Anthropic has been racing to maintain an edge over OpenAI and Google in the enterprise market, and it experienced a period of explosive growth in 2026, driven largely by the popularity of its AI coding tool, Claude Code. OpenAI has confidentially filed for an IPO and has said a debut is likely in 2027.
paras.zh: Anthropic 一直在企业市场上竞相保持对 OpenAI 和 Google 的优势，并在 2026 年经历了爆炸性增长期，这主要得益于其 AI 编码工具 Claude Code 的流行。 OpenAI 已秘密申请 IPO，并表示可能会在 2027 年首次公开募股。

paras.en: For the nine months ended Sept. 30, Anthropic said, it generated $33.24 billion in revenue, up roughly 1,200% from the same period last year, according to its prospectus. The company reported a $104 billion net loss during the nine-month period, though most of that was due to the change in fair value of convertible notes and derivative liabilities. Anthropic lost $25.1 billion over the same stretch in 2025, the filing said.
paras.zh: 根据其招股说明书，Anthropic 表示，截至 9 月 30 日的 9 个月，该公司创造了 332.4 亿美元的收入，比去年同期增长约 1,200%。该公司公布的前 9 个月净亏损为 1040 亿美元，尽管其中大部分是由于可转换票据和衍生负债公允价值的变化造成的。文件称，2025 年同期，Anthropic 损失了 251 亿美元。

paras.en: Anthropic said in an amended filing that its run-rate revenue was roughly $81 billion at the end of October, up $10 billion from the previous month.
paras.zh: Anthropic 在一份修改后的文件中表示，截至 10 月底，其运行收入约为 810 亿美元，比上个月增加了 100 亿美元。

paras.en: The company has faced plenty of challenges during its meteoric rise over its positions on safety, regulation and national security, leading to two high-profile disputes with the U.S. government this year. Its prospectus included more than 90 pages of risk factors for investors to consider ahead of its IPO.
paras.zh: 该公司在迅速崛起的过程中，在安全、监管和国家安全方面的立场面临着诸多挑战，导致今年与美国政府发生了两起备受瞩目的纠纷。其招股说明书包含超过 90 页的风险因素，供投资者在 IPO 之前考虑。

paras.en: "Our aim is to help humankind chart a safe course through this technological evolution, open new frontiers of discovery, and bring forth an age of miracles," Anthropic's co-founders wrote in the company's prospectus. "Everyone who owns our stock, whether an institution or an individual, becomes part of that effort."
paras.zh: Anthropic 的联合创始人在公司招股说明书中写道：“我们的目标是帮助人类在这一技术发展过程中制定一条安全的道路，开辟新的发现领域，并带来一个奇迹的时代。” “拥有我们股票的每个人，无论是机构还是个人，都成为这一努力的一部分。”

articles.title: Nvidia sinks after earnings, dragging down neoclouds CoreWeave, Iren

paras.en: Nvidia shares sank around 3% Wednesday after the company issued its first earnings report since the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang.
paras.zh: 英伟达股价周三下跌约 3%，此前该公司发布了前首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 离职后的第一份收益报告。

paras.en: Trading in the neocloud companies was volatile, as CoreWeave sank more than 4%, Iren fell about 4% and Nebius whipsawed.
paras.zh: Neocloud 公司的交易波动较大，CoreWeave 下跌超过 4%，Iren 下跌约 4%，Nebius 大幅下跌。

paras.en: Nvidia's third-quarter revenue came in at $115.84 billion, more than $6 billion above analysts' expectations of $109.10 billion, while fourth-quarter guidance of $130 billion topped the $125.1 billion consensus, according to LSEG.
paras.zh: 据 LSEG 称，英伟达第三季度营收为 1158.4 亿美元，比分析师预期的 1091 亿美元高出 60 亿美元以上，而第四季度指导为 1300 亿美元，高于市场普遍预期的 1251 亿美元。

paras.en: The semiconductor giant continues to navigate the fallout from Huang's resignation last week. Shortly before the results, Huang made his first public statement since resigning last week, saying that he was open to returning to the company, after an outpouring of support from prominent tech figures.
paras.zh: 这家半导体巨头继续应对黄上周辞职的影响。在结果公布前不久，黄仁勋发表了自上周辞职以来的首次公开声明，表示在知名科技人物的大力支持下，他愿意重返公司。

paras.en: But Harvey Jones, the new and first-ever chair of Nvidia's board, said on the earnings call that the board does not intend to reinstate him as CEO.
paras.zh: 但英伟达董事会新任首任主席哈维·琼斯在财报电话会议上表示，董事会不打算恢复他的首席执行官职务。

paras.en: ″[Hyperscalers] are the ones that are right now feverishly looking for more focus in terms of the compute that we have available," interim CEO Colette Kress told Jim Cramer on CNBC's "Mad Money."
paras.zh: 临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 在 CNBC 的“Mad Money”节目中对吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示：“[超大规模企业] 正在热切地寻求更多关注我们现有的计算能力。”

paras.en: "This concept that anything is changing in terms of any of our types of customers — that is just not true. They are all continuing to be with us, and we have a very deep breath of different customers."
paras.zh: “这种认为我们任何类型的客户都在发生变化的观念——这是不正确的。他们都继续与我们在一起，我们对不同的客户有非常深的了解。”

paras.en: The U.S. Commerce Department announced a legal change on Monday to try and stem China's access to the most advanced Nvidia chips — which are already under export controls effectively preventing their import into the country — by restricting Chinese companies' ability to access compute remotely in overseas data centers.
paras.zh: 美国商务部周一宣布了一项法律变更，试图通过限制中国公司远程访问海外数据中心计算的能力来阻止中国获得最先进的英伟达芯片——这些芯片已经受到出口管制，有效地阻止了它们进口到美国。

paras.en: In a letter Wednesday, the House Energy and Commerce Committee asked Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to appear to discuss chip export controls, and requested a briefing from interim CEO Colette Kress by Dec. 2.
paras.zh: 在周三的一封信中，众议院能源和商务委员会要求商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克出庭讨论芯片出口管制问题，并要求临时首席执行官科莱特·克雷斯在 12 月 2 日之前提供简报。

paras.en: Nvidia told investors in its earnings commentary that it was "not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in our outlook," in keeping with its recent language on the country.
paras.zh: 英伟达在其财报评论中告诉投资者，“在我们的展望中，没有假设任何数据中心计算收入来自中国”，这与其最近关于中国的言论一致。

paras.en: Huang is slated to appear before several Congressional committees in the coming weeks.
paras.zh: 黄计划在未来几周内出席几个国会委员会的听证会。

paras.en: Speaking to CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Tuesday, Senate Banking Committee Chair Tim Scott, R-S.C., said Huang and Lutnick have agreed to appear before the committee in December. It's slated to be Huang's second appearance on Capitol Hill in December, after the former Nvidia CEO reached an agreement with three House committees to appear for closed-door interviews on Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 参议院银行委员会主席、南卡罗来纳州共和党人蒂姆·斯科特 (Tim Scott) 周二在 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目中表示，黄仁勋和卢特尼克已同意于 12 月出席委员会会议。这将是黄仁勋在 12 月份第二次出现在国会山，此前这位前 Nvidia 首席执行官与三个众议院委员会达成协议，将于 12 月 1 日接受闭门采访。

paras.en: — CNBC's Caleigh Keating contributed to this report.
paras.zh: — CNBC 的卡利·基廷 (Caleigh Keating) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Dealbook Summit 2026 live updates: Altman says 'hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen'

paras.en: Artificial intelligence, trade tensions, and the need to create trust have been recurring themes at the New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 人工智能、贸易紧张局势和建立信任的必要性一直是周三纽约时报 DealBook 峰会上反复出现的主题。

paras.en: Andrew Ross Sorkin, founder and editor of DealBook and co-anchor of CNBC's "Squawk Box," has been sitting down in New York with prominent business, economic and political leaders to discuss a wide range of newsmaking issues.
paras.zh: DealBook 的创始人兼编辑、CNBC“Squawk Box”的联合主持人安德鲁·罗斯·索金 (Andrew Ross Sorkin) 一直在纽约与著名的商业、经济和政治领导人坐在一起讨论广泛的新闻问题。

paras.en: The conference comes as OpenAI rival Anthropic is about to make its public debut on Thursday, and it follows a series of widespread tech outages that have grounded airplanes, snarled email, and stymied banking transactions, among other disruptions — a dramatic reminder of society's dependency on these services.
paras.zh: 这次会议召开之际，OpenAI 的竞争对手 Anthropic 即将在周四公开亮相，此前发生了一系列大范围的技术中断，导致飞机停飞、电子邮件混乱、银行交易受阻等，这戏剧性地提醒人们社会对这些服务的依赖。

paras.en: In discussing the balancing act that tech leaders are confronting trying to push ahead with AI innovation while attempting to guarantee public safety, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said, "The race dynamic in the fog of war, I think, is a bad thing. I think this is a time where more caution, not less caution, is warranted."
paras.zh: 在讨论科技领导者在努力推动人工智能创新和保障公共安全的同时面临的平衡问题时，OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 表示：“我认为，战争迷雾中的竞争动态是一件坏事。我认为现在需要更加谨慎，而不是更少谨慎。”

paras.en: Skydance co-CEO David Ellison emphasized the need to rebuild trust in media organizations.
paras.zh: Skydance 联合首席执行官大卫·埃里森强调需要重建对媒体组织的信任。

paras.en: "In a world, you know, where very quickly you're not going to be able to believe your eyes, we think having institutions that earn trust every single day is incredibly important," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“你知道，在这个世界上，你很快就会无法相信自己的眼睛，我们认为拥有每天都能赢得信任的机构非常重要。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Canada Prime Minister Mark Carney expressed some frustration over trade relations with the U.S. He said a new deal "should have been done six months ago, but we're not going to sign something that doesn't make sense for Canada."
paras.zh: 与此同时，加拿大总理马克·卡尼对与美国的贸易关系表示了一些沮丧。他表示，新协议“本应在六个月前达成，但我们不会签署对加拿大没有意义的协议”。

paras.en: He said he's pressing on in forging other trade partnerships. "We got a lot to do, so we would like to do the deal. But if the U.S. doesn't want to do the deal, we're busy," he said.
paras.zh: 他表示，他正在努力建立其他贸易伙伴关系。 “我们有很多事情要做，所以我们愿意达成协议。但如果美国不想达成协议，我们就会很忙，”他说。

paras.en: Key guests yet to come Wednesday include SpaceX founder and CEO Elon Musk, Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev, New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella.
paras.zh: 周三尚未到来的主要嘉宾包括 SpaceX 创始人兼首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk)、Robinhood 首席执行官弗拉德·特内夫 (Vlad Tenev)、纽约市市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 和微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella)。
