articles.title: Ozempic and Mounjaro may have a surprising effect on your brain

paras.en: Ozempic and Mounjaro may have a surprising effect on your brain
paras.zh: Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 可能会对您的大脑产生惊人的影响

paras.en: - Blockbuster weight loss drugs like Ozempic and Mounjaro may do more than help people shed pounds, with growing evidence suggesting they could also influence brain health. Although studies have linked GLP-1 medications to a lower risk of dementia, major trials found that semaglutide did not slow Alzheimer's disease. Scientists suspect these drugs may be more effective at preserving memory and thinking abilities in people with obesity or diabetes, especially before cognitive problems appear.
paras.zh: - Ozempic 和 Mounjaro 等重磅减肥药的作用可能不仅仅是帮助人们减肥，越来越多的证据表明它们还可能影响大脑健康。尽管研究已将 GLP-1 药物与较低的痴呆风险联系起来，但主要试验发现索马鲁肽并不能减缓阿尔茨海默病。科学家怀疑这些药物可能更有效地保存肥胖或糖尿病患者的记忆和思维能力，尤其是在认知问题出现之前。

paras.en: Popular medications used to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes, including semaglutide and tirzepatide, may have effects that extend beyond weight loss and blood sugar control. These drugs also influence biological processes involved in brain function, raising questions about whether they could help preserve memory and thinking abilities.
paras.zh: 用于治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病的流行药物，包括索马鲁肽和替泽帕肽，其作用可能不仅仅限于减肥和控制血糖。这些药物还会影响涉及大脑功能的生物过程，引发人们对它们是否有助于保存记忆和思维能力的疑问。

paras.en: To examine this possibility, researchers from the University of Gothenburg and the University of Copenhagen reviewed the existing scientific evidence at the invitation of the journal Science.
paras.zh: 为了检验这种可能性，哥德堡大学和哥本哈根大学的研究人员应《科学》杂志的邀请审查了现有的科学证据。

paras.en: Studies involving animals suggest that GLP-1 medications can influence learning and memory. However, research involving humans has produced less consistent findings. Analyses of patient health records have found an association between GLP-1 treatment and a reduced risk of dementia among people with type 2 diabetes. These observational findings are encouraging, but they cannot determine whether the medications themselves are responsible for the lower risk.
paras.zh: 涉及动物的研究表明 GLP-1 药物可以影响学习和记忆。然而，涉及人类的研究得出的结果不太一致。对患者健康记录的分析发现，GLP-1 治疗与 2 型糖尿病患者患痴呆症的风险降低之间存在关联。这些观察结果令人鼓舞，但他们无法确定药物本身是否导致风险降低。

paras.en: More definitive results have also raised questions. In Novo Nordisk's EVOKE and EVOKE+ clinical trials, semaglutide failed to slow the progression of early Alzheimer's disease. Although the treatment affected several biological markers associated with Alzheimer's, those changes did not translate into a measurable slowing of the disease.
paras.zh: 更明确的结果也引发了疑问。在诺和诺德的EVOKE和EVOKE+临床试验中，索马鲁肽未能减缓早期阿尔茨海默病的进展。尽管治疗影响了与阿尔茨海默病相关的几种生物标志物，但这些变化并没有转化为可测量的疾病减缓。

paras.en: Why Weight Loss Drugs May Still Benefit the Brain
paras.zh: 为什么减肥药仍可能对大脑有益

paras.en: Despite the disappointing Alzheimer's results, researchers believe GLP-1 medications could still offer cognitive benefits to certain groups of patients.
paras.zh: 尽管阿尔茨海默病的结果令人失望，但研究人员认为 GLP-1 药物仍然可以为某些患者群体带来认知益处。

paras.en: People living with obesity or type 2 diabetes sometimes experience difficulties with attention, planning, and the speed at which they process information. These cognitive problems are often associated with metabolic health and blood vessel function, suggesting they may respond differently to treatment than the changes caused by Alzheimer's disease.
paras.zh: 肥胖或 2 型糖尿病患者有时会在注意力、计划和处理信息的速度方面遇到困难。这些认知问题通常与代谢健康和血管功能有关，这表明它们对治疗的反应可能与阿尔茨海默病引起的变化不同。

paras.en: Improving blood sugar regulation, metabolism, or vascular health could potentially help preserve cognitive abilities, even if the same medications cannot slow an established neurodegenerative disease.
paras.zh: 改善血糖调节、新陈代谢或血管健康可能有助于保持认知能力，即使相同的药物不能减缓已确定的神经退行性疾病。

paras.en: Stina Börchers, the review's first author and a researcher affiliated with both the University of Gothenburg and the University of Copenhagen, emphasizes the need to determine whether starting treatment earlier could make a difference.
paras.zh: 该综述的第一作者、哥德堡大学和哥本哈根大学的研究人员 Stina Börchers 强调需要确定尽早开始治疗是否会产生影响。

paras.en: "We need to find out whether these treatments can help people with obesity or diabetes preserve their cognitive abilities, particularly if treatment begins before cognitive problems become established. It is also important to identify which patients might benefit," says Stina Börchers.
paras.zh: “我们需要查明这些治疗是否可以帮助肥胖或糖尿病患者保持认知能力，特别是如果在认知问题出现之前开始治疗。确定哪些患者可能受益也很重要，”Stina Börchers 说。

paras.en: Unlocking New Treatments to Protect Memory
paras.zh: 解锁保护记忆的新疗法

paras.en: A central unanswered question is how GLP-1 medications might influence the brain. Their potential cognitive effects could result from improvements in metabolic health, direct actions within the brain, or a combination of both.
paras.zh: 一个尚未解答的核心问题是 GLP-1 药物如何影响大脑。它们潜在的认知效应可能来自代谢健康的改善、大脑内的直接作用或两者的结合。

paras.en: Understanding these mechanisms could help researchers identify which patients are most likely to benefit and potentially lead to medications designed specifically to support memory and other thinking abilities.
paras.zh: 了解这些机制可以帮助研究人员确定哪些患者最有可能受益，并可能导致专门设计用于支持记忆和其他思维能力的药物。

paras.en: Christoffer Clemmensen, the review's senior author and a research group leader at the University of Copenhagen, sees an opportunity to use increasingly advanced obesity treatments to explore the connection between metabolism and the brain.
paras.zh: 该评论的资深作者、哥本哈根大学研究小组组长克里斯托弗·克莱门森 (Christoffer Clemmensen) 看到了利用日益先进的肥胖治疗方法来探索新陈代谢与大脑之间联系的机会。

paras.en: "Obesity medicines are becoming increasingly sophisticated, offering new opportunities to understand how metabolic regulation influences brain function. By disentangling the direct and indirect effects of these drugs on the brain, we may ultimately be able to develop treatments specifically aimed at preserving cognitive function," says Christoffer Clemmensen.
paras.zh: “肥胖药物变得越来越复杂，为了解代谢调节如何影响大脑功能提供了新的机会。通过理清这些药物对大脑的直接和间接影响，我们最终可能能够开发出专门旨在保护认知功能的治疗方法，”克里斯托弗·克莱门森说。

paras.en: The researchers are calling for clinical trials that evaluate memory, attention, and other cognitive abilities beginning when patients first start treatment. Following these changes over time could help establish whether GLP-1 drugs genuinely protect brain function and clarify who might benefit most.
paras.zh: 研究人员呼吁从患者首次开始治疗时开始进行临床试验，评估记忆力、注意力和其他认知能力。随着时间的推移跟踪这些变化可以帮助确定 GLP-1 药物是否真正保护大脑功能并明确谁可能受益最大。

paras.en: They also stress that treatment is not without potential drawbacks, particularly for older adults and people who are physically frail. Rapid weight loss can lead to a reduction in muscle mass, which may weaken physical function and offset some of the possible benefits.
paras.zh: 他们还强调，治疗并非没有潜在的缺点，特别是对于老年人和身体虚弱的人。快速减肥会导致肌肉质量减少，这可能会削弱身体功能并抵消一些可能的好处。

paras.en: Careful monitoring will therefore be essential as researchers investigate whether today's weight loss and diabetes medications could eventually provide new ways to protect the brain.
paras.zh: 因此，当研究人员调查当今的减肥和糖尿病药物是否最终可以提供保护大脑的新方法时，仔细监测至关重要。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Gothenburg. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由哥德堡大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Stina BÃ¶rchers, Giulia Mazzini, Henrik Zetterberg, Christoffer Clemmensen. Obesity pharmacotherapies and cognition. Science, 2026; 394 (6824): 633 DOI: 10.1126/science.aek9987
paras.zh: - Stina Börchers、Giulia Mazzini、Henrik Zetterberg、Christoffer Clemmensen。肥胖药物疗法和认知。科学，2026； 394 (6824): 633 DOI: 10.1126/science.aek9987

articles.title: On this day in space! Nov. 17, 1967: NASA's Surveyor 6 moon probe makes 1st-ever successful launch and hop from the lunar surface
articles.author: Hanneke Weitering

paras.en: On Nov. 17, 1967, NASA's Surveyor 6 spacecraft made the first liftoff from the lunar surface.
paras.zh: 1967 年 11 月 17 日，美国宇航局的勘测者 6 号航天器首次从月球表面升空。

paras.en: Surveyor 6 was one of several robotic lunar missions NASA sent to scout the moon before sending humans there. It took television pictures of the surface and learned about the composition of lunar soil. Then came the big liftoff.
paras.zh: 勘测者 6 号是 NASA 在将人类送去月球之前派出的多项机器人月球任务之一。它拍摄了月球表面的电视照片并了解了月球土壤的成分。然后是大升空。

paras.en: First Surveyor 6 launched from the surface and hopped to another position about 8 feet (2 meters) away. Next, Surveyor 6 took pictures of its original landing site. Flight controllers on Earth could see the landing pad prints of Surveyor 6. They also saw an imprint from the rocket exhaust when Surveyor 6 lifted off.
paras.zh: 第一号测量员 6 号从地面发射并跳至约 8 英尺（2 米）外的另一个位置。接下来，测量者 6 号为其原始着陆点拍摄了照片。地球上的飞行控制人员可以看到测量者 6 号的着陆垫印记。他们还看到测量者 6 号升空时火箭排气留下的印记。

paras.en: Surveyor 6 showed that spacecraft could land on the moon, and lift off again. Less than two years later, humans did the same thing during Apollo 11.
paras.zh: 勘测者六号表明航天器可以登陆月球并再次升空。不到两年后，人类在阿波罗11号上做了同样的事情。

paras.en: NASA's Surveyor 6 spacecraft launched to the moon on Nov. 7, 1967 and made its first landing on the lunar surface on Nov. 10 of that year. It's primary mission was to make a soft landing on the moon in the Sinus Medii of the moon.
paras.zh: NASA 的勘测者 6 号宇宙飞船于 1967 年 11 月 7 日发射到月球，并于当年 11 月 10 日首次登陆月球表面。它的主要任务是在月球中窦软着陆。

paras.en: The probe took nearly 30,000 photos of the moon during its 16 days on the lunar surface, with the lander shutting down due to the onset of lunar night on Nov. 26. Surveyor 6 was the sixth and penultimate moon mission of NASA's Surveyor lunar program, so a lot of what it did (launching and landing on the moon) had been done before.
paras.zh: 该探测器在月球表面停留的 16 天里拍摄了近 30,000 张月球照片，着陆器因 11 月 26 日农历夜的到来而关闭。勘测者 6 号是 NASA 勘测者月球计划的第六次也是倒数第二次月球任务，因此它所做的很多事情（发射和登陆月球）之前都已经完成了。

paras.en: But a lunar liftoff? That was something new.
paras.zh: 但月球升空呢？那是新事物。

paras.en: "On November 17, as an engineering test to see if its rockets could be restarted on the Moon, Surveyor’s engines fired for 2.5 seconds, lifting the spacecraft 12 feet high and moving it 8 feet west of its original landing site, in the first powered liftoff from another celestial body," NASA wrote in a mission overview.
paras.zh: NASA 在一份任务概述中写道：“11 月 17 日，作为一项工程测试，看看其火箭是否可以在月球上重新启动，测量者号的发动机点火了 2.5 秒，将航天器提升到 12 英尺高，并将其移动到其原始着陆点以西 8 英尺，这是第一次从另一个天体进行动力升空。”

paras.en: The engineering test proved that a spacecraft could land on the moon, and then lift off and take flight once more. That capability was a core requirement for NASA's Apollo astronaut moon landings that followed, since astronauts needed a way to return home after visiting the moon.
paras.zh: 工程试验证明航天器可以登陆月球，然后升空并再次飞行。这种能力是随后美国宇航局阿波罗宇航员登月的核心要求，因为宇航员在访问月球后需要一种返回家园的方式。

paras.en: But there was critical science Surveyor 6 was able to do with the lunar hop.
paras.zh: 但勘测者 6 号能够对月球跳跃进行关键的科学研究。

paras.en: "This maneuver provided excellent views of the surface disturbances produced by the initial landing and the effects of firing rocket engines close to the lunar surface," scientists with the Lunar and Planetary Institute wrote in a summary. "Photography obtained after the hop contributed to the soil mechanics investigation."
paras.zh: 月球与行星研究所的科学家在一份总结中写道：“这次机动提供了关于初始着陆产生的表面扰动以及靠近月球表面发射火箭发动机的影响的绝佳视图。” “跳跃后获得的照片有助于土壤力学研究。”

paras.en: Surveyor 6 also had a bar magnet on its footpad that allowed scientists to test how magnetic the lunar regolith was at the landing site.
paras.zh: 勘测者 6 号的脚垫上还有一块磁条，科学家可以用它来测试着陆点月球风化层的磁性。

paras.en: Want more space history? Check out our full On This Day In Space Story archive and watch our On This Day In Space videos on YouTube.
paras.zh: 想要更多太空历史吗？查看我们完整的“太空中的这一天”故事存档，并在 YouTube 上观看“太空中的这一天”视频。

paras.en: Hanneke Weitering is a multimedia journalist in the Pacific Northwest reporting on the future of aviation at FutureFlight.aero and Aviation International News and was previously the Editor for Spaceflight and Astronomy news here at Space.com. As an editor with over 10 years of experience in science journalism she has previously written for Scholastic Classroom Magazines, MedPage Today and The Joint Institute for Computational Sciences at Oak Ridge National Laboratory. After studying physics at the University of Tennessee in her hometown of Knoxville, she earned her graduate degree in Science, Health and Environmental Reporting (SHERP) from New York University. Hanneke joined the Space.com team in 2016 as a staff writer and producer, covering topics including spaceflight and astronomy. She currently lives in Seattle, home of the Space Needle, with her cat and two snakes. In her spare time, Hanneke enjoys exploring the Rocky Mountains, basking in nature and looking for dark skies to gaze at the cosmos.
paras.zh: Hanneke Weitering 是西北太平洋地区的一名多媒体记者，在 FutureFlight.aero 和 Aviation International News 报道航空业的未来，此前曾担任 Space.com 的航天和天文学新闻编辑。作为一名拥有 10 多年科学新闻经验的编辑，她曾为学术课堂杂志、MedPage Today 和橡树岭国家实验室计算科学研究所撰写文章。在家乡诺克斯维尔的田纳西大学学习物理学后，她在纽约大学获得了科学、健康和环境报告 (SHERP) 研究生学位。 Hanneke 于 2016 年加入 Space.com 团队，担任专职撰稿人和制作人，涵盖航天和天文学等主题。她目前与她的猫和两条蛇住在太空针塔所在地西雅图。在业余时间，汉内克喜欢探索落基山脉，沐浴在大自然中，寻找黑暗的天空凝视宇宙。

articles.title: ULA lost a Vulcan Centaur rocket carrying 40 Amazon satellites 10 minutes after launch — but the failure began just after liftoff
articles.author: Mike Wall

paras.en: The failure of a Vulcan Centaur rocket carrying a full load of internet satellites for Amazon was caused by an anomaly in its first-stage booster, rocket maker United Launch Alliance said today (Nov. 17).
paras.zh: 火箭制造商联合发射联盟今天（11 月 17 日）表示，为亚马逊运载满载互联网卫星的火神半人马座火箭的故障是由其第一级助推器异常引起的。

paras.en: That failure — which led to the loss of 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites — was recognized about 10 minutes after liftoff, but the problems began much earlier than that, ULA said in a statement.
paras.zh: ULA 在一份声明中表示，这一故障导致 40 颗亚马逊 Leo 互联网卫星丢失，在升空大约 10 分钟后就被发现了，但问题的出现早得多。

paras.en: "While we appear to have lost telemetry and the mission at approximately 10 minutes into flight, early indications are that just after liftoff the launch vehicle experienced low booster performance, resulting in stage separation occurring when the vehicle was low in altitude and below minimal velocity to reach orbit," ULA wrote in today's update.
paras.zh: ULA 在今天的更新中写道：“虽然我们似乎在飞行大约 10 分钟时失去了遥测和任务，但早期迹象表明，运载火箭在升空后助推器性能较低，导致运载火箭高度较低且低于到达轨道的最低速度时发生级分离。”

paras.en: The two-stage Vulcan Centaur is the successor to ULA's workhorse Atlas V rocket, which will retire after just six more flights. Vulcan debuted in January 2024 and now has a total of five launches under its belt.
paras.zh: 两级 Vulcan Centaur 是 ULA 的主力 Atlas V 火箭的后继者，该火箭将在再飞行六次后退役。 Vulcan 于 2024 年 1 月首次亮相，目前已总共发布了五次。

paras.en: The new rocket has experienced problems on three of those missions. On both its second and fourth flights — which launched in October 2024 and February of this year, respectively — the nozzle of one of Vulcan's strap-on solid rocket boosters (SRBs) fell off about 30 seconds after liftoff.
paras.zh: 新火箭在其中三项任务中遇到了问题。在分别于 2024 年 10 月和今年 2 月发射的第二次和第四次飞行中，Vulcan 的一个绑带式固体火箭助推器 (SRB) 的喷嘴在升空后约 30 秒脱落。

paras.en: On both occasions, the rocket overcame the problem and successfully delivered its payloads to orbit. However, after the second occurrence, the U.S. Space Force paused national-security launches with Vulcan until ULA addressed the SRB nozzle issue. (The February 2026 flight was a Space Force mission.)
paras.zh: 这两次火箭都克服了问题，成功地将有效载荷送入轨道。然而，在第二次发生之后，美国太空军暂停了 Vulcan 的国家安全发射，直到 ULA 解决了 SRB 喷嘴问题。 （2026 年 2 月的飞行是太空部队的一项任务。）

paras.en: That work led to "design and process improvements to the nozzle," ULA said in an Oct. 28 update. And those tweaks apparently worked.
paras.zh: ULA 在 10 月 28 日的更新中表示，这项工作导致“喷嘴的设计和工艺改进”。这些调整显然奏效了。

paras.en: "All indications are that the solid rocket booster performance was nominal, following nozzle improvements implemented for this launch," the company wrote in today's update.
paras.zh: 该公司在今天的更新中写道：“所有迹象都表明，在这次发射实施喷嘴改进后，固体火箭助推器的性能是名义上的。”

paras.en: Vulcan's Centaur V upper stage, which features two RL-10C engines, did its job as well "but was unable to recover from the [booster] performance loss, resulting in loss of mission," ULA added.
paras.zh: ULA 补充说，配备两台 RL-10C 发动机的 Vulcan 半人马座 V 上级也完成了它的工作，“但无法从[助推器]性能损失中恢复，导致任务失败。”

paras.en: Vulcan's first-stage booster is powered by two BE-4 engines, which are built by Amazon founder Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin. Today's update did not identify the exact problem with the booster; doing so will require more time, as the investigation has just begun.
paras.zh: Vulcan 的第一级助推器由两台 BE-4 发动机提供动力，该发动机由亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯的蓝色起源制造。今天的更新没有确定助推器的确切问题；由于调查才刚刚开始，这样做将需要更多时间。

paras.en: If that investigation finds a serious issue with the BE-4, there could be broad ripple effects across the American space program. After all, that engine also powers the first stage of Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket, which is a key piece of hardware for NASA's Artemis program of moon exploration. (And New Glenn is currently recovering from a failure of its own — a massive explosion on the test stand that occurred on May 28.)
paras.zh: 如果调查发现 BE-4 存在严重问题，可能会对整个美国太空计划产生广泛的连锁反应。毕竟，该发动机还为蓝色起源的新格伦火箭的第一级提供动力，该火箭是美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯月球探索计划的关键硬件。 （新格伦目前正在从自身的故障中恢复过来——5 月 28 日在试验台上发生了一次大规模爆炸。）

paras.en: NASA plans to integrate the Centaur V upper stage into its Space Launch System moon rocket, the vehicle that launches Artemis astronauts to space. So the fact that the Centaur performed nominally on Sunday is a bit of good news for the space agency.
paras.zh: NASA 计划将 Centaur V 上部级集成到其太空发射系统月球火箭中，该火箭将阿耳忒弥斯宇航员发射到太空。因此，半人马座号在周日名义上的表演对航天局来说是个好消息。

paras.en: Vulcan's grounding is a big deal, no matter what the anomaly investigation ends up finding. The U.S. doesn't have a surfeit of powerful rockets, after all, and two of them — Vulcan and New Glenn — are out of commission at the moment.
paras.zh: 无论异常调查最终发现什么，瓦肯的搁浅都是一件大事。毕竟，美国并没有过多的强大火箭，其中两枚——火神号和新格伦号——目前已经停止使用。

paras.en: There's considerable pressure on both Vulcan and New Glenn to bounce back strong, for the nation faces an impending launch crunch in the next few years. SpaceX plans to retire its Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy rockets and shift its launch load over to the fully reusable Starship megarocket. SpaceX is expected to prioritize its own needs in Starship's early days, using the vehicle primarily to build out its next-gen Starlink broadband constellation and Starmind AI data center network.
paras.zh: 瓦肯和新格伦都面临着强劲反弹的巨大压力，因为该国在未来几年将面临即将到来的发射危机。 SpaceX 计划退役其猎鹰 9 号和猎鹰重型火箭，并将其发射负载转移到完全可重复使用的星舰巨型火箭上。预计 SpaceX 在 Starship 早期阶段将优先考虑自身需求，主要使用该车辆构建其下一代 Starlink 宽带星座和 Starmind AI 数据中心网络。

paras.en: The Vulcan failure also impacts Amazon — specifically, the company's plan to build out Amazon Leo, which will compete with SpaceX's Starlink. Amazon has booked about 100 launches on a variety of rockets to build its constellation, which will eventually consist of more than 3,200 satellites. Thirty-eight of those bookings are for Vulcan; Sunday's launch was the first of those.
paras.zh: Vulcan 的失败也影响了亚马逊——具体来说，该公司计划建造 Amazon Leo，该计划将与 SpaceX 的 Starlink 竞争。亚马逊已预订使用各种火箭进行约 100 次发射来建造其星座，该星座最终将由 3,200 多颗卫星组成。其中 38 份预订是针对 Vulcan 的；周日的发射是其中的第一个。

paras.en: The other rockets Amazon has booked are the Atlas V, New Glenn, Falcon 9 and Arianespace's Ariane 6. About 400 operational Amazon Leo satellites have reached orbit to date across 14 launches (not including Sunday's failure).
paras.zh: 亚马逊预订的其他火箭包括 Atlas V、New Glenn、Falcon 9 和 Arianespace 的 Ariane 6。迄今为止，大约 400 颗正在运行的 Amazon Leo 卫星已通过 14 次发射进入轨道（不包括周日的失败）。

paras.en: Michael Wall is the Spaceflight and Tech Editor for Space.com and joined the team in 2010. He primarily covers human and robotic spaceflight, military space, and exoplanets, but has been known to dabble in the space art beat. His book about the search for alien life, "Out There," was published on Nov. 13, 2018. Before becoming a science writer, Michael worked as a herpetologist and wildlife biologist. He has a Ph.D. in evolutionary biology from the University of Sydney, Australia, a bachelor's degree from the University of Arizona, and a graduate certificate in science writing from the University of California, Santa Cruz. To find out what his latest project is, you can follow Michael on Twitter.
paras.zh: Michael Wall 是 Space.com 的太空飞行和技术编辑，于 2010 年加入该团队。他主要报道人类和机器人太空飞行、军事太空和系外行星，但以涉足太空艺术领域而闻名。他关于寻找外星生命的书《Out There》于 2018 年 11 月 13 日出版。在成为科普作家之前，迈克尔曾是一名爬行动物学家和野生动物生物学家。他拥有博士学位。澳大利亚悉尼大学进化生物学博士学位、亚利桑那大学学士学位以及加州大学圣克鲁斯分校科学写作研究生证书。要了解他的最新项目是什么，您可以在 Twitter 上关注 Michael。

articles.title: NASA's Voyager 1 launched second, so how did it beat Voyager 2 to a light-day by nearly a decade?
articles.author: Elizabeth Howell

paras.en: Voyager 1 is about to reach a light-day of distance in space, but Voyager 2 won't hit the mark until about 2035. Why the big difference?
paras.zh: 航海者 1 号即将在太空中到达光日距离，但航海者 2 号要到 2035 年左右才能达到这一目标。为什么会有这么大的差异呢？

paras.en: On Nov. 18, Voyager 1 will be so far away from Earth that it will take a full light-day (24 hours) to send a signal to the distant spacecraft, at 16,094,799,096 miles (25,902,068,356 kilometers). Since light is essentially the maximum speed in the universe (absent using devices like wormholes, or quantum-physics puzzles), it's a big deal — so big that NASA will be celebrating the milestone by asking fans to shine Morse Code signals at the sky.
paras.zh: 11 月 18 日，航海者 1 号将距离地球如此遥远，以至于需要一个光日（24 小时）才能向距离地球 16,094,799,096 英里（25,902,068,356 公里）的遥远航天器发送信号。由于光本质上是宇宙中的最大速度（不使用虫洞或量子物理谜题等设备），这是一件大事——大到美国宇航局将通过要求粉丝向天空发出莫尔斯电码信号来庆祝这一里程碑。

paras.en: But why will Voyager 2 take nearly a decade longer? It comes down to choices made for speed and science during the twin missions' nearly 50-year journey, specifically during the first bit when they were flying by planets. The result is Voyager 1 is zooming out at a speed of 3.5 Earth-sun distances (astronomical units a year), while Voyager 2 has a more stately speed of 3.1 Earth-sun distances, according to NASA.
paras.zh: 但为何 Voyager 2 还要多花近十年的时间呢？这取决于这两个任务在近 50 年的旅程中，特别是在它们飞越行星的最初阶段，对速度和科学做出的选择。据 NASA 称，其结果是航海者 1 号以 3.5 倍地日距离（一年天文单位）的速度缩小，而航海者 2 号则以 3.1 倍地日距离的速度更加壮观。

paras.en: The original aim of both the spacecraft, which launched about two weeks apart in 1977 with Voyager 2 going first, was to look at Jupiter and Saturn. If funding persisted, which it did, the hope was to bring Voyager 2 past Uranus and Neptune, taking advantage of a rare planetary alignment. Voyager 1, by contrast, made a turn at Saturn to look at the planet's rings and the prebiotic (pre-life-chemistry) moon of Titan, before flying outside the plane of the solar system.
paras.zh: 两艘航天器于 1977 年发射，间隔约两周，航海者 2 号首先发射，最初的目的是观测木星和土星。如果资金持续存在（确实如此），人们希望利用罕见的行星排列优势，让航海家二号飞越天王星和海王星。相比之下，航海家一号在飞出太阳系平面之前，绕土星转了一圈，观察土星环和泰坦的生命起源（前生命化学）卫星。

paras.en: NASA had a range of trajectory options to consider when launching the spacecraft, and elected to bring Voyager 1 at a faster trajectory — as illustrated in this video by Britannica, where you can quickly see the spacecraft overtaking Voyager 2 on its way to Jupiter even though Voyager 1. Voyager 1 arrived at Jupiter on March 5, 1979 while Voyager 2 got there four months later on July 9.
paras.zh: NASA 在发射航天器时需要考虑一系列轨道选项，并选择以更快的轨道运行航海者 1 号 - 正如大英百科全书的这段视频所示，您可以很快看到航天器在前往木星的途中超越航海者 2 号，尽管航海者 1 号于 1979 年 3 月 5 日抵达木星，而航海者 2 号于四个月后的 7 月 9 日抵达木星。

paras.en: Each of the spacecraft then performed a "gravity assist"—a sort of slingshot around the planet in which they took a tiny bit of momentum from Jupiter to gain speed as the spacecraft flew to Saturn. This technique is used constantly, such as recently when the ESCAPADE Mars mission flew two spacecraft by Earth on the way to the Red Planet, as it allows spacecraft to gain speed while saving on fuel. The planets themselves don't slow down that much.
paras.zh: 然后，每艘航天器都执行了“重力辅助”——一种围绕行星的弹弓，当航天器飞向土星时，它们从木星获得了一点动量来获得速度。这项技术被不断使用，例如最近，ESCAPADE 火星任务在前往红色星球的途中驾驶两艘航天器经过地球，因为它可以使航天器在节省燃料的同时获得速度。行星本身的速度并没有减慢那么多。

paras.en: "Because the planet is so much more massive than the spacecraft, the transfer doesn't affect the planet to any measurable extent, but to the spacecraft it's a big deal," the Planetary Society wrote. "For example, we can calculate that during the Voyager encounters with Jupiter in 1979, Jupiter slowed down by roughly 10 to the -24th power kilometers per second — a change much too small to measure."
paras.zh: 行星协会写道：“由于行星比航天器质量大得多，因此转移不会对行星产生任何可测量的影响，但对于航天器来说这是一件大事。” “例如，我们可以计算出，在 1979 年航行者号与木星相遇期间，木星每秒减速了大约 10 的 -24 次方公里——这种变化太小而无法测量。”

paras.en: "But each Voyager gained about 10 km/s [6.2 miles/s], a pretty big number," the society continued about the Jupiter encounter. This was "enough to put them on a fast path to Saturn — and in the case of Voyager 2, to Uranus and Neptune as well — and eventual escape from the solar system."
paras.zh: “但是每个航行者号的速度增加了约 10 公里/秒 [6.2 英里/秒]，这是一个相当大的数字，”该协会继续谈论木星的遭遇。这“足以让他们走上通往土星的快速道路——对于旅行者二号来说，也可以到达天王星和海王星——并最终逃离太阳系。”

paras.en: With each flyby, the two spacecraft picked up speed with a single exception — during Voyager 2's encounter of Neptune. That's because the spacecraft made a turn to fly by Triton. The maneuver brought Voyager 2 over Neptune's north pole, before it turned and then was directed to begin "plunging down, out of the plane of the solar system," losing speed along the way.
paras.zh: 每次飞越时，两艘航天器都会加快速度，只有一次例外——航海家二号与海王星的相遇期间。那是因为飞船转弯飞过海卫一。这次机动使航行者二号飞越海王星北极，然后转向，然后被指示开始“从太阳系平面下降”，并沿途失去速度。

paras.en: Voyager 2, in fact, did not have enough speed to leave the solar system until it flew by Jupiter. "It gained about 10 km/s at Jupiter, about 5 km/s at Saturn, about 2 km/s at Uranus, and lost about 2 km/s at Neptune," the Planetary Society wrote of the speeds, which are 6.21 miles/s, 3.11 miles/s, 1.24 miles/s and a loss of 1.24 miles/s, respectively.
paras.zh: 事实上，航海者二号在飞过木星之前没有足够的速度离开太阳系。行星协会在描述速度时写道：“它在木星上加速了约 10 公里/秒，在土星上加速了约 5 公里/秒，在天王星上加速了约 2 公里/秒，在海王星上减速了约 2 公里/秒。”这些速度分别为 6.21 英里/秒、3.11 英里/秒、1.24 英里/秒和损失 1.24 英里/秒。

paras.en: At any rate, these fast speeds allowed both spacecraft not only to go fast, but to eventually reach interstellar space in 2012 (Voyager 1) and 2018 (Voyager 2), respectively. With the light-day milestone now reached by Voyager 1, it is anticipated the spacecraft could work into the 2030s, as long as their nuclear power sources can last.
paras.zh: 无论如何，如此快的速度使得这两个航天器不仅能够飞得更快，而且最终分别于 2012 年（航海者 1 号）和 2018 年（航海者 2 号）到达星际空间。随着旅行者 1 号现已达到光日里程碑，只要其核动力源能够持续运行，预计该航天器可以工作到 2030 年代。

paras.en: NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which manages the mission, has been carefully turning off instruments as required, and recently did a "Big Bang" procedure on both spacecraft to redistribute power supplies as best as possible. The idea is to maximize science return on both spacecraft, the only interstellar messengers we have, for as long as possible.
paras.zh: 负责管理此次任务的美国宇航局喷气推进实验室一直在根据需要小心地关闭仪器，并且最近对两艘航天器进行了“大爆炸”程序，以尽可能最好地重新分配电源。我们的想法是尽可能长时间地最大化这两个航天器（我们唯一的星际信使）的科学回报。

paras.en: Elizabeth Howell (she/her), Ph.D., was a staff writer in the spaceflight channel between 2022 and 2024 specializing in Canadian space news. She was contributing writer for Space.com for 10 years from 2012 to 2024. Elizabeth's reporting includes multiple exclusives with the White House, leading world coverage about a lost-and-found space tomato on the International Space Station, witnessing five human spaceflight launches on two continents, flying parabolic, working inside a spacesuit, and participating in a simulated Mars mission. Her latest book, "Why Am I Taller?" (ECW Press, 2022) is co-written with astronaut Dave Williams.
paras.zh: 伊丽莎白·豪威尔（Elizabeth Howell）（她/她）博士于 2022 年至 2024 年间担任太空飞行频道的特约撰稿人，专门报道加拿大太空新闻。从 2012 年到 2024 年，她在 Space.com 担任特约撰稿人长达 10 年。伊丽莎白的报道内容包括多份白宫独家报道、主导国际空间站失物招领太空番茄的全球报道、见证五次载人航天在两大洲的发射、抛物线飞行、在宇航服内工作以及参与模拟火星任务。她的最新书《为什么我更高？》 （ECW Press，2022 年）与宇航员戴夫·威廉姆斯 (Dave Williams) 共同撰写。

articles.title: Horizon Microtechnologies Targets Constellation-Scale Production As Esa Phi-Lab Selection Strengthens Industrialisation Push
articles.author: Horizon Microtechnologies

paras.en: (Karlsruhe, Germany, September 29th 2026) Horizon Microtechnologies is accelerating industrialisation of its metallised polymer micro-additive manufacturing platform through IP-MASS, a two-year scale-up project supported by €500,000 and reinforced by selection for ESA Phi-Lab Austria.
paras.zh: （德国卡尔斯鲁厄，2026 年 9 月 29 日）Horizo​​n Microtechnologies 正在通过 IP-MASS 加速其金属化聚合物微增材制造平台的工业化，这是一个为期两年的扩大项目，由 500,000 欧元支持，并得到 ESA Phi-Lab Austria 的选择加强。

paras.en: The programme is expanding Horizon’s printing, coating and process-verification capabilities for shielding housings and other passive RF hardware, targeting up to 50,000 precision-coated satellite components and a repeatable manufacturing framework suited to constellation-class demand rather than one-off prototype production.
paras.zh: 该计划正在扩展 Horizo​​n 的屏蔽外壳和其他无源射频硬件的印刷、涂层和工艺验证能力，目标是多达 50,000 个精密涂层卫星组件和适合星座级需求而不是一次性原型生产的可重复制造框架。

paras.en: Horizon combines precision polymer 3D printing with conformal metallisation and protective coatings. Polymer provides the precision bulk geometry, while metal is applied only to the thickness required. Replacing even lightweight metals such as aluminium with metallised polymer can reduce weight by 40%, while 3D printing can deliver further size, weight and design advantages alongside attractive economics compared with conventionally machined metal parts.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 将精密聚合物 3D 打印与保形金属化和保护涂层相结合。聚合物提供了精确的整体几何形状，而金属仅应用到所需的厚度。即使用金属化聚合物取代铝等轻质金属，也可以减轻 40% 的重量，而与传统加工的金属零件相比，3D 打印可以提供更大的尺寸、重量和设计优势，同时具有有吸引力的经济性。

paras.en: ESA Phi-Lab Austria’s “Industrialization by Design” focus supports upstream space technologies with commercial potential, reflecting the move towards scalable, reliable and cost-effective industrial products.
paras.zh: ESA Phi-Lab Austria 的“设计工业化”重点支持具有商业潜力的上游空间技术，反映了向可扩展、可靠和具有成本效益的工业产品迈进。

paras.en: Importantly, IP-MASS is not limited to shielding housings. Horizon is also seeking spacecraft and space-related terrestrial applications where polymer 3D printing and metallisation could address product requirements, manufacturing constraints or future volume demand.
paras.zh: 重要的是，IP-MASS 不仅限于屏蔽外壳。 Horizo​​n 还在寻求航天器和与太空相关的地面应用，其中聚合物 3D 打印和金属化可以满足产品要求、制造限制或未来的批量需求。

paras.en: “Horizon has proved that metallised polymer micro-AM can deliver far more than lightweight prototypes,” said Andreas Frölich, CEO of Horizon Microtechnologies. “The next challenge is industrial: achieving the prices, lead times, repeatability and throughput needed when a component is required not once or ten times, but thousands or tens of thousands of times.”
paras.zh: Horizo​​n Microtechnologies 首席执行官 Andreas Frölich 表示：“Horizo​​n 已经证明，金属化聚合物微型增材制造的性能远超轻型原型。” “下一个挑战是工业领域：当某个组件的需求不是一次或十次，而是数千或数万次时，实现所需的价格、交货时间、可重复性和吞吐量。”

paras.en: Frölich adds, “Shielding housings give us a strong first industrialisation case, but they are not the limit. We also want to address components where lightweight printed geometry and functional metallic surfaces could create a meaningful technical or manufacturing advantage.”
paras.zh: Frölich 补充道：“屏蔽外壳为我们提供了强大的第一个工业化案例，但它们并不是限制。我们还希望解决轻质印刷几何形状和功能性金属表面可以创造有意义的技术或制造优势的组件。”

paras.en: The move builds on Horizon’s space-readiness work, which subjected representative metallised polymer demonstrators to established LEO tests including outgassing, temperature shock, radiation, mechanical shock, material fatigue and atomic-oxygen exposure.
paras.zh: 此举建立在地平线太空准备工作的基础上，该工作对代表性金属化聚合物演示器进行了既定的低地球轨道测试，包括排气、温度冲击、辐射、机械冲击、材料疲劳和原子氧暴露。

paras.en: For high-volume satellite architectures such as phased-array payloads, components may be used hundreds of times per spacecraft and across hundreds of satellites, turning component-level mass and cost savings into significant programme-level gains.
paras.zh: 对于相控阵有效载荷等大容量卫星架构，每个航天器和数百颗卫星上的组件可能会使用数百次，从而将组件级质量和成本节省转化为显着的项目级收益。

paras.en: IP-MASS also provides scope to cooperate on applications with anticipated demand of 100 units per year or more. Partners do not need a fully developed component: early-stage concepts are welcome while design-for-manufacturability decisions can still be made.
paras.zh: IP-MASS 还提供了针对每年预计需求 100 台或更多的应用的合作范围。合作伙伴不需要完全开发的组件：欢迎早期概念，同时仍然可以做出可制造性设计决策。

paras.en: “We do not want to assume that we already know every application where this technology can create value,” Frölich says. “The organisations designing next-generation spacecraft know where their product and manufacturing constraints are. We want them to bring those challenges to us so we can explore whether the technology is relevant and, where it is, potentially shape the manufacturing route together.”
paras.zh: “我们不想假设我们已经知道这项技术可以创造价值的每一个应用，”Frölich 说。 “设计下一代航天器的组织知道他们的产品和制造限制在哪里。我们希望他们将这些挑战带给我们，这样我们就可以探索该技术是否相关，以及它在哪里，有可能共同塑造制造路线。”

paras.en: Horizon is moving beyond validation towards an industrial manufacturing platform for next-generation satellite hardware, while inviting the space community to help identify which applications it should industrialise next.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 正在超越验证，转向下一代卫星硬件的工业制造平台，同时邀请航天界帮助确定下一步应该工业化哪些应用。

paras.en: Horizon is a member of the Green Space Center, an initiative supported by the State of Baden-Württemberg and based at the Chamber of Commerce and Industry Reutlingen (IHK Reutlingen) that promotes innovation in water management, New Space, and intelligent systems.
paras.zh: Horizo​​n 是绿色空间中心的成员，该中心由巴登-符腾堡州支持，总部设在罗伊特林根工商会 (IHK Reutlingen)，旨在促进水管理、新空间和智能系统方面的创新。

paras.en: “We help SMEs in Baden-Württemberg internationalize space-related business models and products and support their entry into international markets,” said Marcin Bielecki, Head of Technology at the Green Space Center.
paras.zh: 绿色空间中心技术主管 Marcin Bielecki 表示：“我们帮助巴登-符腾堡州的中小企业实现太空相关商业模式和产品的国际化，并支持他们进入国际市场。”

paras.en: The initiative aims to position Baden-Württemberg as a sustainability-driven hub for space technology by fostering cross-sector collaboration and applying space technologies to create ecological impact.
paras.zh: 该倡议旨在通过促进跨部门合作和应用空间技术创造生态影响，将巴登符腾堡州定位为可持续发展驱动的空间技术中心。

paras.en: Baden-Württemberg hosts a dynamic and rapidly growing New Space ecosystem, including leading European companies such as ATMOS Space Cargo, HyImpulse, ConstellR and CELERES while supporting emerging innovators such as InSpacePropulsion Technologies (ISPTech) and Yugen Space.
paras.zh: 巴登符腾堡州拥有一个充满活力且快速发展的新太空生态系统，包括 ATMOS Space Cargo、HyImpulse、ConstellR 和 CELERES 等欧洲领先公司，同时支持 InSpacePropulsion Technologies (ISPTech) 和 Yugen Space 等新兴创新者。

articles.title: Moog Marks 25 Years Since ESPA Design Milestone: Innovating Space Rideshare
articles.author: Moog Inc.

paras.en: East Aurora, N.Y. — Moog Inc. (NYSE: MOG.A and MOG.B) marks 25 years since the Evolved Secondary Payload Adapter (ESPA) ring completed its Critical Design Review in 2001. The pioneering technology helped advance space rideshare by enabling multiple payloads to share a launch and broadening access to orbit for commercial, government, and defense missions.
paras.zh: 纽约州东奥罗拉 — 穆格公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：MOG.A 和 MOG.B）庆祝演进型辅助有效载荷适配器 (ESPA) 环于 2001 年完成关键设计审查以来 25 周年。这项开创性技术通过支持多个有效载荷共享发射并拓宽商业、政府和国防任务的轨道通道，帮助推进了太空共享出行。

paras.en: Development of ESPA began in 1999 through a collaborative government-industry initiative, culminating in the successful completion of its Critical Design Review on January 18, 2001. The ESPA ring enabled launch vehicles to carry multiple secondary payloads by efficiently using previously unused volume beneath primary satellites. This approach lowered costs and increased mission flexibility, supporting commercial satellite constellations, technology demonstrations, and critical defense operations.
paras.zh: ESPA 的开发始于 1999 年，通过政府与行业的合作倡议，最终于 2001 年 1 月 18 日成功完成了关键设计审查。ESPA 环使运载火箭能够通过有效利用主卫星下方以前未使用的空间来携带多个辅助有效载荷。这种方法降低了成本并提高了任务灵活性，支持商业卫星星座、技术演示和关键防御行动。

paras.en: “ESPA helped redefine access to space by enabling additional payloads to share a launch with primary missions. Its impact continues across commercial, government, and military space—and its story reflects the value of enduring collaboration between Air Force Research Lab (AFRL) and industry partners such as Moog,” said Dr. Darren Raspa, chief historian, AFRL Space and Directed Energy Systems.
paras.zh: AFRL 空间和定向能源系统首席历史学家达伦·拉斯帕 (Darren Raspa) 博士表示：“ESPA 通过启用额外的有效载荷与主要任务共享发射，帮助重新定义了太空访问。它的影响持续遍及商业、政府和军事太空，它的故事反映了空军研究实验室 (AFRL) 与穆格等行业合作伙伴之间持久合作的价值。”

paras.en: Over the past 25 years, the ESPA family has evolved into a versatile, modular platform supporting varied payload sizes and interface configurations. ESPA-derived designs have also served as the structural foundation for spacecraft buses. Today, the platform continues to support mission planning for NASA, the U.S. government, and commercial space ventures worldwide.
paras.zh: 在过去的 25 年里，ESPA 系列已发展成为一个多功能的模块化平台，支持各种有效负载大小和接口配置。 ESPA 衍生设计也成为航天器总线的结构基础。如今，该平台继续支持 NASA、美国政府和全球商业航天企业的任务规划。

paras.en: Moog continues to offer a family of ESPA configurations, including Standard ESPA, ESPA Heavy, and ESPA Grande, designed to accommodate evolving payload and mission requirements. The platform’s modular architecture and adaptable interfaces support rideshare missions, payload integration, and spacecraft applications across the growing space market.
paras.zh: 穆格继续提供一系列 ESPA 配置，包括标准 ESPA、ESPA Heavy 和 ESPA Grande，旨在适应不断变化的有效载荷和任务要求。该平台的模块化架构和适应性强的接口支持不断增长的太空市场中的乘车共享任务、有效载荷集成和航天器应用。

paras.en: “The ESPA ring began as a technical solution to a practical challenge: maximizing every launch opportunity,” said Timothy Pargett, general manager, Moog Payload Adapters and Isolation business. “Today, it stands as a cornerstone of how missions, large and small, gain cost-effective, reliable access to orbit through rideshare. Its enduring legacy reflects visionary innovation and trusted partnerships across the aerospace community.”
paras.zh: “ESPA 环最初是作为应对实际挑战的技术解决方案：最大化每个发射机会，”穆格有效负载适配器和隔离业务总经理 Timothy Pargett 说道。 “如今，它已成为大大小小的任务如何通过拼车获得具有成本效益且可靠的轨道访问的基石。它的持久遗产反映了整个航空航天界的富有远见的创新和值得信赖的合作伙伴关系。”

paras.en: In conjunction with the anniversary, a Moog flight-qualified ESPA ring will be on display at the National Museum of Nuclear Science & History in Albuquerque, N.M., from November 7, 2026, through January 10, 2027.
paras.zh: 为庆祝周年纪念日，一枚符合穆格飞行资格的 ESPA 环将于 2026 年 11 月 7 日至 2027 年 1 月 10 日在新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的国家核科学与历史博物馆展出。

paras.en: Museum visitors will have the opportunity to see firsthand the hardware that helped advance rideshare and enable diverse space missions.
paras.zh: 博物馆参观者将有机会亲眼目睹有助于推进乘车共享和实现多样化太空任务的硬件。

paras.en: As ESPA enters its next chapter, Moog continues to advance spacecraft payload integration and develop adaptable solutions that expand flexible, cost-effective access to orbit for future space exploration and defense missions.
paras.zh: 随着 ESPA 进入新篇章，穆格将继续推进航天器有效载荷集成，并开发适应性强的解决方案，为未来的太空探索和防御任务扩展灵活、经济高效的轨道接入方式。

paras.en: Moog is a worldwide designer, manufacturer, and systems integrator of high-performance precision motion and fluid controls and control systems. Moog’s high-performance systems control military and commercial aircraft, satellites, and space vehicles, launch vehicles, defense systems, missiles, automated industrial machinery, marine, and medical equipment. Additional information about the Company can be found at www.moog.com or www.moog.com/space.
paras.zh: 穆格是高性能精密运动和流体控制及控制系统的全球设计商、制造商和系统集成商。穆格的高性能系统控制军用和商用飞机、卫星和航天器、运载火箭、防御系统、导弹、自动化工业机械、船舶和医疗设备。有关公司的更多信息，请访问 www.moog.com 或 www.moog.com/space。

articles.title: Senate committee takes up nominees for NASA chief financial officer and inspector general
articles.author: Jeff Foust

paras.en: WASHINGTON — A Senate committee is set to advance nominations for NASA’s chief financial officer and inspector general.
paras.zh: 华盛顿——参议院委员会将推进对 NASA 首席财务官和监察长的提名。

paras.en: The Senate Commerce Committee held a hearing Nov. 10 to consider nominations for several posts, including that of Joshua Shoemaker to be NASA’s chief financial officer and Robert Steinau to be inspector general. Those are two of the four positions at the agency that require Senate confirmation; the others are administrator and deputy administrator.
paras.zh: 参议院商务委员会于 11 月 10 日举行听证会，审议多个职位的提名，包括提名约书亚·舒梅克 (Joshua Shoemaker) 担任 NASA 首席财务官，以及罗伯特·斯坦瑙 (Robert Steinau) 担任监察长。这是该机构需要参议院批准的四个职位中的两个。其他人为行政长官和副行政长官。

paras.en: Neither nominee received many questions during the hearing, which lasted a little more than an hour. Senators largely focused their attention on the nomination of Danielle Thumann to be a member of the Federal Communications Commission.
paras.zh: 在持续一个多小时的听证会上，两位提名人都没有收到很多问题。参议员们的注意力主要集中在丹妮尔·图曼 (Danielle T humann) 担任联邦通信委员会成员的提名上。

paras.en: Shoemaker is an accountant who has worked for more than 20 years in the private sector and in the Mississippi state government. Since August, he has been a senior adviser in NASA’s Mission Support Directorate, and before that was controller for the Republican National Committee.
paras.zh: Shoemaker 是一名会计师，在私营部门和密西西比州政府工作了 20 多年。自八月以来，他一直担任美国宇航局任务支持理事会的高级顾问，在此之前，他曾担任共和党全国委员会的财务总监。

paras.en: Steinau has worked since 2009 at NASA’s Office of Inspector General, and since December 2024 has served as the office’s senior official in the absence of a Senate-confirmed inspector general. He previously worked for the Department of Energy’s Office of Inspector General and for the U.S. Secret Service.
paras.zh: 斯坦瑙自 2009 年以来一直在 NASA 监察长办公室工作，并自 2024 年 12 月起在参议院确认监察长缺席的情况下担任该办公室的高级官员。他此前曾在能源部监察长办公室和美国特勤局工作。

paras.en: Shoemaker, in his opening statement at the nomination hearing, said he would focus on financial accountability, improved visibility into financial performance of NASA programs, transparency with Congress on that performance and modernization of NASA financial systems.
paras.zh: 舒梅克在提名听证会上的开场发言中表示，他将重点关注财务责任、提高 NASA 项目财务绩效的可见性、国会对该绩效的透明度以及 NASA 财务系统的现代化。

paras.en: “I believe the CFO has an important responsibility to give the administrator, NASA leadership and Congress an honest and timely picture of the agency’s financial position,” he said. He added that means how programs are performing against their planned budgets and schedules as well as ensuring effective management of resources.
paras.zh: 他说：“我认为首席财务官负有重要责任，要向行政长官、美国宇航局领导层和国会诚实、及时地介绍该机构的财务状况。”他补充说，这意味着项目如何根据计划预算和时间表执行，以及确保资源的有效管理。

paras.en: He deferred questions on specific programs as well as on the proposed U.S. Space Academy that a presidential commission, led by NASA, is studying. Shoemaker said that decisions on locating the academy will ultimately be made by the president.
paras.zh: 他推迟了有关具体计划以及由美国宇航局领导的总统委员会正在研究的拟议美国太空学院的问题。舒梅克表示，学院选址的决定最终将由总统做出。

paras.en: Steinau said that, as inspector general, he would focus on three critical challenges for NASA: returning humans to the moon, transitioning from the International Space Station to commercial stations and cybersecurity.
paras.zh: 斯坦瑙表示，作为监察长，他将重点关注美国宇航局面临的三个关键挑战：将人类送上月球、从国际空间站过渡到商业空间站以及网络安全。

paras.en: “NASA is moving with urgency, and it is imperative that accountability keep pace with ambition,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“美国宇航局正在紧急行动，责任必须与野心保持同步。”

paras.en: The Senate Commerce Committee announced Nov. 11 that it will meet Nov. 18 to vote on the nominees at the Nov. 10 hearing, sending them, if approved, to the full Senate for a confirmation vote.
paras.zh: 参议院商务委员会11月11日宣布，将于11月18日举行会议，在11月10日的听证会上对提名人进行投票，如果获得批准，将送交参议院全体会议进行确认投票。

paras.en: NASA has been without a Senate-confirmed chief financial officer since the start of the Trump administration in January 2025. The White House nominated Greg Autry for that position in the spring of 2025, but the nomination was returned by the Senate without acting on it at the end of the year. NASA has lacked a Senate-confirmed inspector general since the departure of Paul Martin in late 2023.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年 1 月特朗普政府上台以来，NASA 一直没有经过参议院确认的首席财务官。白宫于 2025 年春季提名格雷格·奥特里担任该职位，但参议院在年底未对提名采取行动，而是退回了该提名。自 2023 年底保罗·马丁离职以来，NASA 一直缺乏经参议院确认的监察长。

articles.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge Breaks Global Hackathon Records

paras.en: On Nov. 14 and 15, NASA held the annual Space Apps Challenge with a record-breaking 181,835 registered participants taking part in 593 events around the world. The annual hackathon invites participants to use NASA’s open data to address one of 14 challenges focused on space exploration or Earth science. This year, the hackathon drew 59% more registrants and was the 5th year in a row with increased participation.
paras.zh: 11 月 14 日至 15 日，NASA 举办了一年一度的太空应用挑战赛，全球 593 场活动的注册参与者达到破纪录的 181,835 名。一年一度的黑客马拉松邀请参与者使用 NASA 的开放数据来解决专注于太空探索或地球科学的 14 项挑战之一。今年，黑客松的报名人数增加了 59%，这也是参与人数连续第五年增加。

paras.en: Since 2012, NASA Space Apps Challenge has hosted the two-day event, which has included more than 600,000 people from more than 190 countries. The challenge provides an opportunity for hands-on experience with NASA science, mobilizing an engaged global community of technologists and space science enthusiasts to answer questions that benefit humanity and drive exploration.
paras.zh: 自 2012 年以来，NASA 太空应用挑战赛一直举办为期两天的活动，吸引了来自 190 多个国家的超过 600,000 人参加。该挑战提供了亲身体验 NASA 科学的机会，动员全球技术人员和空间科学爱好者积极参与，回答造福人类和推动探索的问题。

paras.en: Participants join events organized by local volunteers to work in teams and address one of the challenges and submit their project before the deadline. Projects are then judged to determine 10 global winners, to be announced in January.
paras.zh: 参与者参加当地志愿者组织的活动，以团队形式工作，解决其中一项挑战，并在截止日期前提交他们的项目。然后对项目进行评审，确定 10 名全球获奖者，并于 1 月份公布。

paras.en: “The Space Apps Challenge invites people with many different skillsets to leverage NASA’s gold-standard datasets to address real challenges facing us here on Earth and in space,” said Amy Kaminski, engagement branch chief, Science Mission Directorate, NASA Headquarters in Washington. “We’re thrilled to see more than 180,000 people tackling these challenges and helping to accelerate our ability to find solutions.”
paras.zh: “太空应用挑战赛邀请拥有多种不同技能的人们利用 NASA 的黄金标准数据集来解决我们在地球和太空中面临的真正挑战，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部科学任务理事会参与部门负责人艾米·卡明斯基 (Amy Kaminski) 说道。 “我们很高兴看到超过 180,000 人正在应对这些挑战并帮助我们提高寻找解决方案的能力。”

paras.en: Challenges also feature data from 17 international space agency partners, all Artemis Accord signatories. This year’s space agency partners are: Angola National Space Programme Management Office (GGPEN), Bahrain Space Agency, Brazilian Space Agency (AEB), CSA (Canadian Space Agency), ESA (European Space Agency), ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation), Italian Space Agency, JAXA (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency), KASA (Korea AeroSpace Administration), Mohammed Bin Rashid Space Center of the United Arab Emirates, National Space Activities Commission of Argentina (CONAE), Nigeria’s National Space Research and Development Agency, Paraguayan Space Agency, Senegalese Space Studies Agency, Spanish Space Agency, Turkish Space Agency, and UK Space Agency. Three agencies, GGPEN, AEB, and CONAE, also wrote challenges this year.
paras.zh: 挑战赛还包含来自 17 个国际航天局合作伙伴的数据，这些合作伙伴都是《阿耳忒弥斯协议》的签署方。今年的航天机构合作伙伴有：安哥拉国家航天计划管理办公室（GGPEN）、巴林航天局、巴西航天局（AEB）、CSA（加拿大航天局）、ESA（欧洲航天局）、ISRO（印度航天研究组织）、意大利航天局、JAXA（日本宇宙航空研究开发机构）、KASA（韩国航天局）、阿拉伯联合酋长国穆罕默德·本·拉希德航天中心、阿根廷国家航天活动委员会(CONAE)、尼日利亚国家空间研究与发展局、巴拉圭航天局、塞内加尔空间研究局、西班牙航天局、土耳其航天局和英国航天局。 GGPEN、AEB 和 CONAE 三个机构今年也提出了挑战。

paras.en: To learn more about NASA’s Space Apps Challenge, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关 NASA 太空应用挑战赛的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: NASA Launches Nuclear Power Systems Student Contest

paras.en: NASA’s Power to Explore Student Challenge kicked off Tuesday, Nov. 17. The science, engineering, technology, and mathematics (STEM) challenge invites kindergarten through 12th grade students in the United States to learn about space nuclear power systems and illustrate how these nuclear “batteries” could help power their lunar exploration vision.
paras.zh: NASA 的“探索力量学生挑战赛”于 11 月 17 日星期二拉开帷幕。这项科学、工程、技术和数学 (STEM) 挑战赛邀请美国幼儿园到 12 年级的学生了解太空核动力系统，并说明这些核“电池”如何帮助他们实现月球探索愿景。

paras.en: Students are also invited to write a short essay about a “superpower” of their own. Submissions are due March 1, 2027.
paras.zh: 学生们还被邀请写一篇关于自己的“超能力”的短文。提交截止日期为 2027 年 3 月 1 日。

paras.en: Every mission requires a power source. Some of the most interesting locations to study on our Moon face some of the harshest conditions. Nuclear power could sustain human life and allow researchers to study the resource-rich environment despite freezing temperatures, long nights, and deep craters that never see sunlight.
paras.zh: 每个任务都需要电源。月球上一些最有趣的研究地点面临着一些最恶劣的条件。核能可以维持人类的生命，并使研究人员能够研究资源丰富的环境，尽管有冰冻的温度、漫长的夜晚和永远见不到阳光的深坑。

paras.en: “As NASA returns to the Moon and establishes a lunar base where astronauts will live, work, and explore, we need to build an infrastructure to make it all possible. Nuclear power could enable exploration in the permanently shadowed regions near the Moon’s South Pole, carry robust science payloads over long distances, and keep instruments warm through the lunar night,” said Carl Sandifer, a program manager for NASA’s Space Reactors Division at the agency’s headquarters in Washington. “NASA’s Power to Explore Student Challenge prepares the next generation of explorers to use the unique power within themselves to dream up a nuclear-powered Moon base of their own design. We cannot wait to see what they come up with!”
paras.zh: “随着美国宇航局重返月球并建立宇航员居住、工作和探索的月球基地，我们需要建设基础设施来使这一切成为可能。核能可以实现对月球南极附近永久阴影区域的探索，长距离携带强大的科学有效载荷，并在月球之夜保持仪器温暖，”美国宇航局华盛顿总部空间反应堆部门的项目经理卡尔·桑迪弗说。 “美国宇航局的探索力量学生挑战赛为下一代探险家做好准备，让他们利用自己独特的力量来梦想自己设计的核动力月球基地。我们迫不及待地想看看他们想出什么成果！”

paras.en: Entries include a 200-word essay and an original illustration. Essays should describe one of the students’ unique powers that will help the mission. Illustrations should convey the students’ vision of a nuclear-powered lunar base that supports human and robotic exploration of the Moon’s surface using both radioisotope and fission-based power solutions and demonstrate the students’ understanding of the kinds of exploration nuclear energy can enable.
paras.zh: 参赛作品包括一篇 200 字的文章和一幅原创插图。论文应该描述学生的一项有助于完成使命的独特能力。插图应传达学生对核动力月球基地的愿景，该基地支持人类和机器人使用放射性同位素和基于裂变的动力解决方案探索月球表面，并展示学生对核能可以实现的探索类型的理解。

paras.en: Judges will review entries in three grade-level categories: K-4, 5-8, and 9-12. One grand prize winner from each grade category will receive a trip for two to NASA’s Glenn Research Center in Cleveland to learn about the people and technologies that enable NASA missions. Every student who submits an entry will receive a digital certificate and an invitation to a virtual event with NASA experts where they’ll learn about what energizes the NASA workforce to advance NASA’s missions and sustain America’s leadership in space.
paras.zh: 评委将评审三个年级类别的参赛作品：K-4、5-8 和 9-12。每个年级类别的一名大奖获得者将获得两人前往位于克利夫兰的美国宇航局格伦研究中心的旅行，以了解支持美国宇航局任务的人员和技术。每位提交参赛作品的学生都将收到一份数字证书和与 NASA 专家一起参加虚拟活动的邀请，他们将了解是什么激励 NASA 员工推进 NASA 的任务并维持美国在太空的领导地位。

paras.en: NASA and Future Engineers are seeking volunteers to help judge the thousands of contest entries anticipated from around the country. U.S. residents older than 18 who are interested in volunteering approximately three hours should register to judge at the Future Engineers website.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局和未来工程师正在寻找志愿者来帮助评判来自全国各地的数千份参赛作品。年满 18 岁、有兴趣参与大约三小时志愿服务的美国居民应在未来工程师网站上注册参加评委。

paras.en: The Power to Explore Student Challenge is funded by the NASA Science Mission Directorate and operates out of the Radioisotope Power Systems Program under the Research and Technology Mission Directorate. Future Engineers administers the challenge through a contract with the NASA Center of Excellence for Collaborative Innovation within the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate.
paras.zh: 探索学生挑战的力量由美国宇航局科学任务理事会资助，并在研究和技术任务理事会下的放射性同位素电力系统计划下运作。未来工程师通过与 NASA 研究和技术任务理事会内的卓越协作创新中心签订合同来管理这一挑战。

paras.en: To learn more about the challenge, visit:
paras.zh: 要了解有关挑战的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: Sierra Snow Season Spins Up

paras.en: California’s Sierra Nevada got an early taste of wintry weather when one of the first major snowfalls of the water year arrived on November 13, 2026. A moisture-laden storm delivered heavy rains to lower elevations in the Sacramento area and snow accumulations of around a foot to some mountainous areas. The recent bout of wet weather was the first in a quick succession of Pacific storms bringing rain, snow, and wind to the U.S. West in mid-November.
paras.zh: 2026 年 11 月 13 日，加州内华达山脉迎来了水年中的第一场大雪。一场潮湿的风暴给萨克拉门托地区的低海拔地区带来了大雨，一些山区积雪厚达一英尺左右。最近的潮湿天气是 11 月中旬给美国西部带来雨、雪和风的太平洋风暴中的第一场。

paras.en: The MODIS (Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer) on NASA’s Terra satellite captured this image (right) of fresh snow in the Sierra Nevada on the morning of November 14, during a lull between weather systems. Two days earlier (left), the mountains were mostly bare, with snow appearing only at the highest elevations.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局 Terra 卫星上的 MODIS（中分辨率成像光谱仪）于 11 月 14 日上午在天气系统间歇期拍摄到了内华达山脉新雪的图像（右）。两天前（左），山上大部分都是光秃秃的，只有最高海拔地区才出现积雪。

paras.en: Nearly 12 inches (30 centimeters) of snow fell at Donner Pass, northwest of Lake Tahoe, on November 13, according to the Central Sierra Snow Laboratory. The accumulation snarled traffic on Interstate 80 in the area, prompting officials to close the highway in both directions that evening. To the south, the ski resort at Mammoth Mountain reported 9 to 13 inches (23 to 33 centimeters) of new snow, and officials at Yosemite National Park closed several roads ahead of the storm.
paras.zh: 据中央山脉雪实验室称，11 月 13 日，太浩湖西北部的唐纳山口降雪量接近 12 英寸（30 厘米）。这些堆积物扰乱了该地区 80 号州际公路的交通，促使官员当晚关闭了双向高速公路。南部的猛犸山滑雪胜地报告降雪厚达 9 至 13 英寸（23 至 33 厘米），约塞米蒂国家公园的官员在风暴来临前关闭了几条道路。

paras.en: More wet weather and mountain snow are forecast to follow. The National Weather Service (NWS) issued a winter storm warning for portions of the Sierras above 5,000 feet (1,500 meters) in elevation from November 18 to 20. NWS warned of difficult-to-impossible travel conditions, gusty winds, and snow accumulations of around 4 feet (120 centimeters) possible above 8,000 feet (2,400 meters).
paras.zh: 预计接下来会出现更多潮湿天气和山雪。美国国家气象局 (NWS) 于 11 月 18 日至 20 日对海拔 5,000 英尺（1,500 米）以上的内华达山脉部分地区发布冬季风暴警报。国家气象局警告称，在海拔 8,000 英尺（2,400 米）以上，可能会出现难以甚至不可能的旅行条件、阵风和约 4 英尺（120 厘米）的积雪。

articles.title: WBC 'absolutely' backs Kabayel title unification with Fury-AJ winner

paras.en: WBC boss Mauricio Sulaiman 'absolutely' supports Agit Kabayel title unification for Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua winner
paras.zh: WBC老板毛里西奥·苏莱曼“绝对”支持阿吉特·卡巴耶尔统一泰森·富里与安东尼·约书亚的冠军头衔

paras.en: Tyson Fury meets Anthony Joshua for the WBA 'super' heavyweight title on December 11, while Agit Kabayel puts the WBC belt on the line against Nelson Hysa on November 28; WBC president Mauricio Sulaiman will "absolutely" back a unification with the Fury-AJ winner next
paras.zh: 泰森·富里将于 12 月 11 日与安东尼·约书亚争夺 WBA“超”重量级拳王头衔，而阿吉特·卡巴耶尔将于 11 月 28 日对阵尼尔森·海萨，争夺 WBC 拳王金腰带； WBC主席毛里西奥·苏莱曼将“绝对”支持与Fury-AJ冠军的合并

paras.en: The WBC will support a 2027 unification between its heavyweight champion and the winner of Tyson Fury’s vs Anthony Joshua.
paras.zh: WBC 将支持其重量级拳王与泰森·富里对阵安东尼·约书亚的胜者在 2027 年合并。

paras.en: Agit Kabayel will defend his WBC heavyweight title against Nelson Hysa on November 28, and if he successfully defends his belt the WBC will "absolutely" be in favour of a meeting with the winner of the huge all-British heavyweight showdown on December 11.
paras.zh: 阿吉特·卡巴耶尔将于 11 月 28 日对阵纳尔逊·希萨 (Nelson Hysa)，卫冕 WBC 重量级拳王头衔，如果他成功卫冕，WBC 将“绝对”支持在 12 月 11 日与全英国重量级对决的获胜者会面。

paras.en: Fury vs Joshua could have been a final eliminator for the WBC title, though Fury and Joshua will now box for the WBA 'super' heavyweight championship.
paras.zh: 富里与约书亚本可以成为WBC冠军的最终淘汰者，尽管富里和约书亚现在将争夺WBA“超”重量级冠军。

paras.en: "It was a natural final elimination for the mandatory, one against two [in the rankings], but the promoters did not request the fight to be a final elimination and they chose to do [it for] another organisation's title," WBC president Mauricio Sulaiman told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: WBC主席毛里西奥·苏莱曼告诉天空体育：“这是一场自然的强制性最终淘汰赛，一对二（在排名中），但主办方并没有要求这场比赛成为最终淘汰赛，而是选择为另一个组织的冠军头衔这样做。”

paras.en: "The industry likes unifications, people like to see undisputed and we don't get in the way. We like to support that."
paras.zh: “这个行业喜欢统一，人们喜欢看到无可争议的情况，而我们不会妨碍。我们喜欢支持这一点。”

paras.en: Kabayel won't be under the obligation of an immediate mandatory defence.
paras.zh: 卡巴耶尔不会承担立即强制辩护的义务。

paras.en: "Kabayel is going to defend at the end of the month and then he is free - we did not mandate any fight [for the winner] because we believe the mandatory contender must be the highest available real mandatory," Sulaiman said.
paras.zh: 苏莱曼说：“卡巴耶尔将在月底进行卫冕，然后他就自由了——我们没有强制要求为获胜者进行任何战斗，因为我们相信强制竞争者必须是可用的最高的真正强制者。”

paras.en: "We will see if we're going to order a final elimination or if there's a unification or if there's something else that can be done."
paras.zh: “我们将看看是否要下令进行最终淘汰，或者是否进行统一，或者是否可以做其他事情。”

articles.title: What's still to play for in 2026 as F1 hits Vegas?

paras.en: Las Vegas GP: What's still to play for over final three races of F1 2026 season with battles in drivers' and constructors' championships
paras.zh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛：F1 2026 赛季最后三场比赛还有哪些车手和车队冠军争夺战

paras.en: Both world championship battles may already be settled for this year, but other key questions are still be answered in the three rounds that remain; watch the Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 4am on Saturday and the race at 4am on Sunday
paras.zh: 今年的两场世界冠军争夺战可能已经尘埃落定，但其他关键问题仍需在剩下的三轮比赛中得到解答；在天空体育 F1 上观看拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末，周六凌晨 4 点排位赛，周日凌晨 4 点正赛

paras.en: The 2026 Formula 1 season has three races left to go with the Las Vegas Grand Prix opening the final triple header of the year this weekend.
paras.zh: 2026 年一级方程式赛季还剩三场比赛，拉斯维加斯大奖赛将在本周末拉开今年最后一场三连冠的帷幕。

paras.en: For the first time since the final five rounds of 2023, both world championship battles are settled before the end of the season after Mercedes wrapped up the Constructors' Championship last time out in Brazil to go with Kimi Antonelli's winning of the drivers' crown the week before in Mexico.
paras.zh: 自 2023 年最后五轮比赛以来，这是自 2023 年最后五轮比赛以来首次，两场世界冠军争夺战在赛季结束前分出胜负，此前梅赛德斯上次在巴西夺得了车队冠军，基米·安东内利上周在墨西哥赢得了车手桂冠。

paras.en: But that doesn't mean there aren't other important battles to be won, and key questions to be answered, elsewhere through the field before the chequered flag falls on this season in Abu Dhabi on December 6...
paras.zh: 但这并不意味着在 12 月 6 日阿布扎比本赛季的方格旗落下之前，在其他地方没有其他重要的战斗需要赢得，也没有关键问题需要回答......

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream F1 with no contract 📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 F1 📺

paras.en: While the battle to be world champion is the only one that truly matters for drivers each year, there is personal and competitive pride at stake in finishing as high up as possible in the standings, even if the drivers may not always talk this fact up.
paras.zh: 虽然争夺世界冠军的战斗是每年对车手来说唯一真正重要的一场比赛，但在积分榜上获得尽可能高的成绩会带来个人和竞争自豪感，即使车手可能并不总是谈论这一事实。

paras.en: While the new world champion holds a mighty and unassailable lead of 111 points, his rivals behind are more tightly packed together in the battle for the best-of-the-rest positions.
paras.zh: 尽管这位新晋世界冠军以 111 分的优势遥遥领先，无可争议，但他身后的对手在争夺最佳位置的争夺中更加紧密地团结在一起。

paras.en: Just 18 points covers the drivers in second, third and fourth places in the championship, while second through to sixth are split by 33 points.
paras.zh: 积分榜第二、第三和第四位的车手积分只有 18 分，而第二至第六位的车手则相差 33 分。

paras.en: In a position that had looked highly unlikely at mid-season, it is Max Verstappen (279 points) who holds second place heading into the final three rounds thanks to a run of eight consecutive podium finishes that has included three race wins.
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘（Max Verstappen）（279分）在赛季中期看起来不太可能取得第二名，他连续八次登上领奖台，其中包括三场比赛的胜利，进入最后三轮比赛时排名第二。

paras.en: That kind of form will make the Dutchman hard to dislodge from what would be a sixth successive top-two championship finish stretching back to 2021.
paras.zh: 这种状态将使荷兰人难以摆脱自 2021 年以来连续第六次进入前两名的冠军头衔。

paras.en: But George Russell (262 points) and Lewis Hamilton (261 points) are close enough to still harbour hopes of each finishing second themselves.
paras.zh: 但乔治·拉塞尔（262 分）和刘易斯·汉密尔顿（261 分）足够接近，仍然抱有获得第二名的希望。

paras.en: For Russell, regaining the second place he has held for much of the year would at least provide a positive note to end a difficult season in team-mate Antonelli's wake, while Hamilton would be able to point to a four-place improvement on his 2025 campaign as showing firm signs of progress for both himself and Ferrari heading towards 2027.
paras.zh: 对于拉塞尔来说，重新获得他在今年大部分时间保持的第二名至少将为结束队友安东内利之后的艰难赛季提供积极的信息，而汉密尔顿将能够指出他在 2025 年赛季中排名第四的进步，这表明他本人和法拉利在迈向 2027 年时都取得了明显的进步。

paras.en: One of Verstappen, Russell and Hamilton is most likely to finish second as it stands, but neither fifth-placed Charles Leclerc (249 points) nor sixth-placed Lando Norris (246 points), the winner of the last race in Brazil, can yet be definitely counted out of that battle with a maximum of 75 points left up for grabs.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘、拉塞尔和汉密尔顿中的一个最有可能获得第二名，但无论是第五名查尔斯·勒克莱尔（249分）还是第六名兰多·诺里斯（246分）（上一场巴西站的冠军）都无法确定出局，最多还剩75分可供争夺。

paras.en: In all this is also the sub-plot of which Ferrari driver finishes higher in the standings. Hamilton has been their lead championship runner since the Canadian Grand Prix in May, but Leclerc - who was comfortably the team's top scorer in 2025 - cut the gap to his team-mate to 12 points in Brazil.
paras.zh: 这也是法拉利车手在积分榜上获得更高成绩的次要情节。自 5 月份的加拿大大奖赛以来，汉密尔顿一直是他们的冠军领跑者，但勒克莱尔——轻松地成为 2025 年车队的最佳射手——在巴西将与队友的差距缩小到了 12 分。

paras.en: Will Red Bull or McLaren finish third in lucrative teams' battle?
paras.zh: 红牛或迈凯伦会在利润丰厚的车队之战中获得第三名吗？

paras.en: While trophies are also on offer for the drivers who finish second and third in the standings, which will be presented at the FIA Awards in Shanghai in December, the battle for places between the 11 teams in the Constructors' Championship offers a more substantial prize.
paras.zh: 虽然还为排名第二和第三的车手颁发了奖杯（将于 12 月在上海举行的国际汽联颁奖典礼上颁发），但 11 支车队之间争夺车队锦标赛席位的争夺战提供了更丰厚的奖励。

paras.en: It is the finishing order in the standings which determines teams' prize money. That means that every extra position gained, or place retained, equates directly to a team's money earned at the end of the season.
paras.zh: 积分榜上的名次决定了球队的奖金。这意味着获得的每一个额外位置或保留的位置都直接等于球队在赛季结束时赚取的钱。

paras.en: Ferrari are not yet officially secure in second but, with a buffer over third place of 95 points, that position could be confirmed in Las Vegas.
paras.zh: 法拉利尚未正式锁定第二名，但凭借 95 分的优势领先第三名，这一位置可能会在拉斯维加斯得到确认。

paras.en: But the battle for third between Red Bull and McLaren will run potentially all the way to the chequered flag in Abu Dhabi.
paras.zh: 但红牛和迈凯伦之间的第三名争夺战可能会一直持续到阿布扎比的方格旗。

paras.en: At one point in late summer, outgoing champions McLaren had been looking likely to make a fist at chasing down Ferrari for second, but a troubled triple header across Azerbaijan, Malaysia and Singapore dropped them into the clutches of a resurgent Red Bull, who then overtook them for third at the United States Grand Prix.
paras.zh: 夏末的某个时刻，即将离任的冠军迈凯轮车队一度看起来有可能追赶法拉利获得第二名，但在阿塞拜疆、马来西亚和新加坡的三重头球却陷入困境，让他们落入了复兴的红牛手中，红牛随后在美国大奖赛上超越了他们，获得了第三名。

paras.en: They both scored 33 points last time out in Brazil and are separated by 17 points.
paras.zh: 上一场巴西比赛，两人都得到了33分，差距为17分。

paras.en: Elsewhere, and while not officially secure, Racing Bulls are on course for a best-ever finish of fifth with Red Bull's sister team holding a 45-point buffer over Alpine.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，虽然还没有正式确定，但公牛队有望获得有史以来最好的第五名，红牛队的姊妹队领先阿尔派队 45 分。

paras.en: Alpine will almost certainly finish sixth, but seventh place is still up for grabs with just three points separating Haas and Audi.
paras.zh: 阿尔派几乎肯定会获得第六名，但第七名仍有待争夺，哈斯和奥迪仅相差三分。

paras.en: Williams, Aston Martin and Cadillac all looked poised to stay in their current respective positions of ninth, 10th and 11th barring some unexpected big end-of-season results.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯、阿斯顿·马丁和凯迪拉克看起来都准备好保持目前各自的第九、第十和第十一的位置，除非赛季末出现一些意外的大成绩。

paras.en: Who will finish with crucial momentum for 2027?
paras.zh: 谁将为 2027 年带来关键动力？

paras.en: While 'momentum' certainly isn't as easy to measure as world championship placings, it's something all teams will be hoping to feel they carry into this winter off the back of the season's final three races.
paras.zh: 虽然“势头”当然不像世界冠军排名那么容易衡量，但所有车队都希望在本赛季最后三场比赛后感受到他们在今年冬天的表现。

paras.en: That's particularly important this year as, unlike last winter, the rule changes afoot for 2027 are not revolutionary. There are changes to the both aerodynamic and engine regulations, which will see the power split shift to 58-42 in favour of the internal combustion engine, but they are not as substantial as the complete reset we saw at the start of 2026.
paras.zh: 今年这一点尤其重要，因为与去年冬天不同，2027 年即将发生的规则变化并不是革命性的。空气动力学和发动机法规都发生了变化，动力分配将转变为 58-42，有利于内燃机，但这些变化并不像我们在 2026 年初看到的完全重置那么实质性。

paras.en: Late-season performance in 2026 has more chance of being maintained into 2027, while upgrades brought by teams across the final months of this season will have been with a view to development direction for next year too.
paras.zh: 2026年赛季末的表现更有可能维持到2027年，而球队在本赛季最后几个月进行的升级也将着眼于明年的发展方向。

paras.en: The fact that the season is finishing with a battle at the front in which the competitive order from race to race between Mercedes, Ferrari, Red Bull and McLaren is not predictable, certainly bodes well for next year.
paras.zh: 事实上，本赛季即将结束，梅赛德斯、法拉利、红牛和迈凯轮之间的竞争顺序难以预测，这无疑是明年的好兆头。

paras.en: Indeed, fresh from securing the team's first constructors' championship in five years, Mercedes boss Toto Wolff cautioned: "It looks like the most maybe competitive era that is about to start because the teams have become so professional in capability and resource that these kind of runaway seasons, I don't see them anymore."
paras.zh: 事实上，在车队刚刚获得五年来的第一个车队冠军后，梅赛德斯老板托托·沃尔夫警告说：“看起来最具竞争力的时代即将开始，因为车队在能力和资源方面已经变得如此专业，以至于我再也看不到这种失控的赛季了。”

paras.en: Ferrari boss Frederic Vasseur sees it a similar way, saying of the competitive end to 2026: "I think it's good for the championship, good for the show.
paras.zh: 法拉利老板 Frederic Vasseur 也有类似的看法，他在谈到 2026 年的竞争结束时表示：“我认为这对冠军、对比赛都有好处。

paras.en: "Probably it will be true next year and the following years with the convergence of performance."
paras.zh: “随着性能的趋同，明年和接下来的几年可能会出现这种情况。”

paras.en: New champions Mercedes have only won one of the last five races since introducing an aerodynamic upgrade at the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia which they had hoped would reassert their dominance from earlier in the season. It hasn't. The Silver Arrows are now set to introduce their long-awaited ADUO-allowed turbo upgrade in Vegas, although have played down the likely performance gain it will deliver.
paras.zh: 自从在马来西亚巴林大奖赛上引入空气动力学升级以来，新冠军梅赛德斯只赢得了过去五场比赛中的一场，他们原本希望这能重新确立他们在本赛季早些时候的统治地位。还没有。银箭队现在准备在维加斯推出他们期待已久的 ADUO 允许的涡轮升级，尽管他们淡化了其可能带来的性能提升。

paras.en: Wolff added: "It's four teams that can win races and will be challenging for a world championship.
paras.zh: 沃尔夫补充道：“这四支球队能够赢得比赛，并且将挑战世界冠军。

paras.en: "And I have no doubt that it's going to be very difficult for us next year. So, for me, the 2027 season has started now."
paras.zh: “我毫不怀疑明年对我们来说会非常困难。所以，对我来说，2027 年赛季现在已经开始了。”

paras.en: Today on Sky Sports Racing: Supreme hero Old Park Star makes chasing debut at Ffos Las
paras.zh: 今日天空体育竞速：至尊英雄老公园之星在 Ffos Las 首次亮相

paras.en: Having finished as winner and runner-up in last season's Supreme Novices' Hurdle, Old Park Star and Sober Glory make there first foray into Chase action when they go to post at Ffos Las today - live on Sky Sports Racing
paras.zh: 在上赛季的 Supreme Novices' Hurdle 中获得冠军和亚军后，Old Park Star 和 Sober Glory 今天在 Ffos Las 发球时首次涉足追逐赛 - 天空体育赛车直播

paras.en: All eyes will be on Ffos Las today as Old Park Star jumps a fence in public for the first time against his Supreme rival Sober Glory.
paras.zh: 今天，所有的目光都将集中在 Ffos Las 身上，老公园之星 (Old Park Star) 首次在公开场合跳过栅栏，对阵他的至尊对手 Sober Glory。

paras.en: 1.48 Ffos Las - Old Park Star and Sober Glory clash over fences
paras.zh: 1.48 Ffos Las - Old Park Star 和 Sober Glory 因围栏发生冲突

paras.en: Supreme Novices' Hurdle winner Old Park Star faces Sober Glory as he makes his eagerly-anticipated debut over fences in this Golwg Gwendraeth Beginners' Chase at Ffos Las.
paras.zh: 在 Ffos Las 举行的 Golwg Gwendraeth 初学者追逐赛中，Supreme Novices 跨栏冠军 Old Park Star 面对 Sober Glory，这是他万众期待的跨栏首秀。

paras.en: Nicky Henderson's star novice was unbeaten in four starts over hurdles last season, and all eyes will be on this exciting prospect as he embarks on this new discipline. Favourite for the Arkle already, he could put down a marker for the campaign ahead under regular rider Nico de Boinville.
paras.zh: 尼基·亨德森的明星新秀上赛季在四场跨栏比赛中保持不败，当他开始这项新的训练时，所有的目光都将集中在这个令人兴奋的前景上。他已经是 Arkle 的最爱，他可以在常规骑手 Nico de Boinville 的带领下为即将到来的赛季留下一个标记。

paras.en: Supreme second Sober Glory is a huge danger for the Hobbs and White team. He has long been viewed as a fencing type, and it will be fascinating to see how to takes to it.
paras.zh: 至尊第二清醒荣耀对于霍布斯和怀特队来说是一个巨大的危险。长期以来，他一直被视为击剑类型，看看如何适应这一点将会很有趣。

paras.en: - Pioneer Pete sparks jubilant Greatwood scenes at Cheltenham
paras.zh: - 先锋皮特 (Pete) 在切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 引发了欢乐的 Greatwood 场景

paras.en: - Meetmebythesea gives McManus a first Paddy Power Gold Cup
paras.zh: - Meetmebythesea 为麦克马纳斯赢得了第一个 Paddy Power 金杯

paras.en: Alan King's Baron Noir, fourth at Cheltenham and ahead of Sober Glory at Aintree, cannot be ruled out, while Carlenrig and Bobby's Nelson complete the quintet.
paras.zh: 不能排除艾伦·金 (Alan King) 的 Baron Noir 在切尔滕纳姆 (Cheltenham) 获得第四名，领先于安特里 (Aintree) 的清醒荣耀 (Sober Glory)，而卡伦里格 (Carlenrig) 和鲍比 (Bobby) 的尼尔森 (Nelson) 则完成了五重奏。

paras.en: 2.48 Ffos Las - Smart bumper performer Merry Away makes hurdling debut
paras.zh: 2.48 Ffos Las - 聪明的大咖 Merry Away 首次跨栏亮相

paras.en: Merry Away will be fancied to make a winning hurdles debut in this Support Your Oncourse Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle.
paras.zh: Merry Away 将有望在“支持您的球场博彩公司首次跨栏”比赛中首次获胜。

paras.en: The Ben Pauling-trained five-year-old claimed fourth in the Grade 2 bumper at Aintree and Ben Jones has recently put him up as his horse to follow on the At The Races website.
paras.zh: 这匹经过本·鲍林 (Ben Pauling) 训练的五岁马在安特里 (Aintree) 的二级赛中获得第四名，本·琼斯 (Ben Jones) 最近在 At The Races 网站上将他列为自己的坐骑。

paras.en: In opposition, Dan Skelton sends Big John Ollie up in trip after he was comprehensively beaten twice over two miles. Another stepping up in distance is Valiant Soldier, who boasts the services of Paddy Power Gold Cup-winning rider Harry Cobden.
paras.zh: 在反对派中，丹·斯凯尔顿(Dan Skelton)在两英里的比赛中两次被全面击败后，将大约翰·奥利(Big John Ollie)送上摔跤场。另一个在距离上有所进步的是Valiant Soldier，他拥有Paddy Power金杯冠军骑手Harry Cobden的服务。

paras.en: 1.03 Hexham - Classy pair Julius Des Pictons and Derryhassen Paddy headline
paras.zh: 1.03 Hexham - 优雅的组合 Julius Des Pictons 和 Derryhassen Paddy 头条新闻

paras.en: A cracking clash at Hexham sees Julius Des Pictons and Derryhassen Paddy lock horns in this Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase at 1.03pm.
paras.zh: 下午 1 点 03 分，朱利叶斯·德斯·皮克顿 (Julius Des Pictons) 和德里哈森·帕迪 (Derryhassen Paddy) 在赫克瑟姆 (Hexham) 的韦瑟比斯和小鸟日历 (Weatherbys And Birdie Calendars) 的“追求卓越”初学者追逐赛中展开了激烈的对决。

paras.en: Julius Des Pictons took Grade 1 glory when last seen in the Sefton Novices' Hurdle at Aintree 593 days ago and must be watched as he tackles fences for the first time.
paras.zh: 朱利叶斯·德斯·皮克顿 (Julius Des Pictons) 最后一次出现在安特里 (Aintree) 的塞夫顿新手跨栏 (Sefton Novices' Hurdle) 上是 593 天前，他获得了一级荣誉，必须观看他第一次越过围栏。

paras.en: Derryhassen Paddy skipped Cheltenham at the weekend and looks the obvious threat having shaped with promise on two fencing starts to date.
paras.zh: 德里哈森·帕迪在周末跳过了切尔滕纳姆，在迄今为止的两次击剑比赛中都表现出了明显的威胁。

paras.en: Fishery Lane and Pinot Rouge complete the line-up for Dan Skelton and Jessica Bedi respectively.
paras.zh: Fishery Lane 和 Pinot Rouge 分别完善了 Dan Skelton 和 Jessica Bedi 的产品阵容。

paras.en: At Ffos Las, the card gets underway with an intriguing Dandara Maiden Hurdle at 12.48pm. No Walkover was a useful operator in the bumper sphere and could progress further tackling obstacles for the first time. The second division of the race at 1.18pm features Diamond Street, who is sure to be popular for the on-song Skelton operation.
paras.zh: 在 Ffos Las，下午 12 点 48 分，有趣的丹达拉少女跨栏 (Dandara Maiden Hurdle) 正式开始。 No Walkover 在保险杠领域是一个有用的操作员，并且可以在第一次处理障碍时取得进一步的进展。下午 1.18 分，第二组比赛的主角是 Diamond Street，他肯定会因歌曲 Skelton 行动而受到欢迎。

articles.title: Adelaide woman guilty of manslaughter after neighbour stabbed 34 times
articles.author: Evelyn Leckie

paras.en: Cynthia Ellen Rigney has been found guilty of manslaughter after fatally stabbing a 61-year-old Adelaide woman in 2018.
paras.zh: 辛西娅·艾伦·里格尼 (Cynthia Ellen Rigney) 在 2018 年刺死一名 61 岁的阿德莱德妇女后被判犯有过失杀人罪。

paras.en: An updated psychiatric report has been ordered ahead of Rigney's sentencing.
paras.zh: 在里格尼宣判之前，已下令提供最新的精神病学报告。

paras.en: An Adelaide woman who stood trial for stabbing another woman 34 times because the victim refused to sell cannabis to her has been found not guilty of murder, but guilty of manslaughter.
paras.zh: 一名阿德莱德妇女因受害人拒绝向另一名妇女出售大麻而刺伤她 34 刀，目前被判无谋杀罪，但犯有过失杀人罪。

paras.en: South Australia's Supreme Court today found Cynthia Ellen Rigney killed Maria Luis in December 2018 at the victim's home on Goodman Avenue at Kilburn.
paras.zh: 南澳大利亚州最高法院今天裁定，辛西娅·埃伦·里格尼 (Cynthia Ellen Rigney) 于 2018 年 12 月在基尔本 (Kilburn) 古德曼大道 (Goodman Avenue) 受害人家中杀害了玛丽亚·路易斯 (Maria Luis)。

paras.en: The court found Rigney, who was then aged 19 and lived on the same street, had treatment-resistant schizophrenia.
paras.zh: 法庭认定，当时 19 岁、住在同一条街上的里格尼患有难治性精神分裂症。

paras.en: Rigney appeared in court via video link from forensic mental health facility James Nash House and smiled as the verdict of "manslaughter by an unlawful and dangerous act" was handed down.
paras.zh: 里格尼通过法医精神卫生机构詹姆斯·纳什之家的视频连线出庭，在“非法和危险行为造成的过失杀人”的判决下达时，他微笑着。

paras.en: In her published reasons for the verdict, Justice Anne Bampton said she could not find Rigney stabbed Ms Luis with the specific intent to kill or cause really serious bodily harm.
paras.zh: 安妮·班普顿法官在公布的判决理由中表示，她找不到里格尼刺伤路易斯女士的具体意图，即杀人或造成真正严重的身体伤害。

paras.en: She noted Rigney had been captured on CCTV arriving at the address and leaving three minutes later.
paras.zh: 她指出，闭路电视拍到了里格尼到达该地址并在三分钟后离开的画面。

paras.en: Justice Bampton said Ms Luis had lived in the area for "quite some time" and was known in the local community as a cannabis dealer.
paras.zh: 班普顿法官表示，路易斯女士在该地区生活了“相当长一段时间”，在当地社区以大麻经销商而闻名。

paras.en: She said Ms Luis's husband told police his wife did not sell cannabis to Aboriginal or young people.
paras.zh: 她说路易斯女士的丈夫告诉警方，他的妻子没有向原住民或年轻人出售大麻。

paras.en: A neighbour had also reported days before the incident Rigney was screaming on Ms Luis's porch, and had told Rigney to "snap out of it" and "have some respect".
paras.zh: 一位邻居也在事件发生前几天报告说，里格尼在路易斯女士的门廊上尖叫，并告诉里格尼“振作起来”并“给予一些尊重”。

paras.en: Justice Bampton noted that Rigney had then asked the neighbour if she could "get me a bag then".
paras.zh: 班普顿法官指出，里格尼随后询问邻居是否可以“给我一个袋子”。

paras.en: According to the ruling, Rigney was arrested a short time after the stabbing incident.
paras.zh: 根据裁决，里格尼在刺伤事件发生后不久就被捕。

paras.en: Specialised police officers had forced entry into her home where she was found sleeping with a plastic bag containing cannabis attached to her leg.
paras.zh: 专业警察强行进入她家，发现她睡觉时腿上绑着一个装有大麻的塑料袋。

paras.en: Judge acknowledges Rigney's mental health
paras.zh: 法官承认里格尼的心理健康状况

paras.en: Justice Bampton said medical experts in the trial had identified a non-psychotic, alternative explanation for Rigney's conduct, which is why she was not considered unfit to stand trial.
paras.zh: 班普顿法官表示，审判中的医学专家已经为里格尼的行为找到了一种非精神病的替代解释，这就是为什么她不被认为不适合受审。

paras.en: "She had a history of buying cannabis from Maria Luis, had conflict with her in the days leading up to the stabbing, and had possibly attempted to buy or had bought cannabis from Maria Luis but had some form of disagreement with her in the course of that interaction," Justice Bampton wrote.
paras.zh: 班普顿法官写道：“她有从玛丽亚·路易斯那里购买大麻的历史，在刺伤前几天与她发生了冲突，并且可能曾试图或已经从玛丽亚·路易斯那里购买过大麻，但在互动过程中与她产生了某种形式的分歧。”

paras.en: "It is likely that if such a disagreement had occurred, in her psychotic state, Ms Rigney would have been predisposed to react in a paranoid, impulsive, and aggressive manner."
paras.zh: “如果发生这样的分歧，在她的精神病状态下，里格尼女士很可能会做出偏执、冲动和攻击性的反应。”

paras.en: Justic Bampton said one of the medical expert's concluded Rigney would have acted on impulse and in a heightened emotional state but would nonetheless have "known the wrongfulness of her behaviour."
paras.zh: 贾斯蒂克·班普顿表示，一位医学专家得出的结论是，里格尼的行为可能是出于冲动和情绪激动，但她“知道自己的行为是错误的”。

paras.en: But Justice Bampton said she considered Rigney's mental condition when taking into account the "specific intent" element of murder.
paras.zh: 但班普顿法官表示，在考虑谋杀的“特定意图”因素时，她考虑了里格尼的精神状况。

paras.en: "The number and location of the stab wounds inflicted is undoubtedly suggestive of specific intent," she said.
paras.zh: “刺伤的数量和位置无疑暗示了具体意图，”她说。

paras.en: But she said that since Rigney had treatment‑resistant schizophrenia and was likely suffering from psychosis at the time of the stabbing, she could not be satisfied that "the reasonable possibility the stabbing was the result of a psychotic motive in the context of a delusion held has been excluded".
paras.zh: 但她表示，由于里格尼患有难治性精神分裂症，并且在刺伤时很可能患有精神病，因此她不能确信“刺伤是在妄想背景下的精神病动机结果的合理可能性已被排除”。

paras.en: "Ms Rigney must be found not guilty of murder,"
paras.zh: “里格尼女士必须被判无谋杀罪，”

paras.en: Justice Bampton granted the defence time to seek an updated psychiatric report ahead of Rigney's sentencing.
paras.zh: 班普顿法官给予辩方时间，以便在里格尼宣判之前寻求最新的精神病学报告。

paras.en: The matter will return to court in December.
paras.zh: 此事将于十二月返回法庭。

articles.title: Albanese says dialogue 'good' ahead of Trump, Xi and Putin talks
articles.author: Clare Armstrong

paras.en: Anthony Albanese has arrived in Shenzhen ahead of the APEC leaders summit where he says he is likely to appear in a family photo alongside Russian President Vladimir Putin.
paras.zh: 安东尼·艾博内塞 (Anthony Albanese) 在亚太经合组织领导人峰会之前抵达深圳，他表示，他可能会与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 一起出现在一张全家福照片中。

paras.en: The prime minister says he will make Australia's position on Russia's illegal invasion of Ukraine clear.
paras.zh: 总理表示，他将明确澳大利亚对俄罗斯非法入侵乌克兰的立场。

paras.en: Mr Putin is expected to meet with US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of the APEC summit on Thursday.
paras.zh: 预计普京将于周四在亚太经合组织峰会期间会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平。

paras.en: Anthony Albanese says Moscow's illegal war must end on "Ukraine's terms" as he calls for a de-escalation of global conflicts ahead of landmark talks between the US, China and Russia.
paras.zh: 安东尼·阿尔巴内塞表示，莫斯科的非法战争必须按照“乌克兰的条件”结束，他呼吁在美国、中国和俄罗斯之间举行具有里程碑意义的会谈之前缓和全球冲突。

paras.en: The prime minister arrived in Shenzhen on Tuesday afternoon ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit where he reiterated Australia's opposition to Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
paras.zh: 总理于周二下午在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会之前抵达深圳，他在峰会上重申了澳大利亚反对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的立场。

paras.en: But Mr Albanese also indicated he would likely appear in the traditional APEC family photo alongside Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday, describing it as a matter of "respect" for China as host of the summit.
paras.zh: 但阿尔巴内塞还表示，他可能会在周四与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京一起出现在传统的亚太经合组织家庭合影中，并称这是对中国作为峰会东道主的“尊重”。

paras.en: "I will bear in mind the wishes of our host," he said.
paras.zh: “我会牢记东道主的意愿，”他说。

paras.en: "If you are invited to an event … I respect that, but we'll also make our position very clear when it comes to Ukraine."
paras.zh: “如果你被邀请参加一个活动……我尊重这一点，但在乌克兰问题上我们也会非常明确地表明我们的立场。”

paras.en: Asked whether he would follow Tony Abbott's confrontational approach to Mr Putin, Mr Albanese said he would not take lessons in diplomacy from the former prime minister.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否会效仿托尼·阿博特（Tony Abbott）对普京采取对抗态度时，阿尔巴内塞表示，他不会从这位前总理那里吸取外交教训。

paras.en: Mr Abbott said he would "shirt front" Mr Putin if he saw him at the G20 summit in 2014.
paras.zh: 阿博特表示，如果他在 2014 年 G20 峰会上见到普京，他会“站在他面前”。

paras.en: Instead, Mr Albanese said he would use his time at APEC to make clear Australia's position on Russia's invasion, which he said was unchanged.
paras.zh: 相反，阿尔巴尼斯表示，他将利用在亚太经合组织的时间阐明澳大利亚对俄罗斯入侵的立场，他表示这一立场没有改变。

paras.en: "This is a big power intervening in an illegal way to try and assert its will and underestimate the will and courage and conviction of the Ukrainian people to fight for their national sovereignty," he said.
