paras.zh: 他说：“这是一个以非法方式进行干预的大国，试图维护其意志，低估了乌克兰人民争取国家主权的意愿、勇气和信念。”

paras.en: PM says trilateral dialogue a 'good thing'
paras.zh: 总理称三边对话是“好事”

paras.en: The annual gathering of 21 economies from around the Asia Pacific is at risk of being overshadowed by a trilateral summit between Mr Putin, US President Donald Trump and China President Xi Jinping due to take place on the same day.
paras.zh: 来自亚太地区 21 个经济体的年度盛会面临着被普京、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普和中国国家主席习近平定于同一天举行的三边峰会蒙上阴影的风险。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned against the three leaders deciding his country's future without Kyiv at the table, likening the trilateral to a modern-day Yalta conference where in 1945, allies negotiated post-war settlements in Europe.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基警告三位领导人不要在没有基辅参加谈判的情况下决定乌克兰的未来，他将三边会谈比作现代的雅尔塔会议，1945年，盟国在会上就欧洲的战后解决方案进行了谈判。

paras.en: Asked if it was appropriate for Ukraine to be discussed at the meeting between the US, China and Russia, Mr Albanese said it was "not up to Australia to determine who people have met with".
paras.zh: 当被问及在美国、中国和俄罗斯之间的会议上讨论乌克兰问题是否合适时，阿尔巴内塞表示，“不由澳大利亚决定与谁会面”。

paras.en: "We do say that any solution and peace, which we want to see in Ukraine, needs to be on Ukraine's terms," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“我们确实说过，我们希望在乌克兰看到的任何解决方案与和平都必须符合乌克兰的条件。”

paras.en: But Mr Albanese said "in general" it was a "good thing that dialogue happens" between countries.
paras.zh: 但阿尔巴内斯先生表示，“总的来说”，国家之间“进行对话是一件好事”。

paras.en: "At a time when there are more conflicts than at any time since the Second World War … we want to see more dialogue, less military conflict," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“目前冲突比二战以来任​​何时候都多……我们希望看到更多对话，更少军事冲突。”

paras.en: Mr Albanese is due to sit down with Mr Xi on the sidelines of APEC on Friday morning but would not foreshadow the issues he planned to raise with China's leader.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴内塞将于周五上午在亚太经合组织会议期间与习近平会面，但不会预示他计划向中国领导人提出的问题。

paras.en: Asked if Labor would be able to deliver on its election promise to return the Port of Darwin lease into Australian hands before the next election in 2028, Mr Albanese said the commitment was unchanged though he could not guarantee a timeline.
paras.zh: 当被问及工党是否能够兑现其选举承诺，在 2028 年下一次选举之前将达尔文港租约交还澳大利亚人手中时，Albanese 先生表示，尽管他无法保证时间表，但这一承诺没有改变。

paras.en: "Of course, there are processes [that] take place there, including some international processes," he said.
paras.zh: “当然，那里正在发生一些流程，包括一些国际流程，”他说。

paras.en: Mr Albanese said there might also be "legal consequences and actions".
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼斯表示，还可能会产生“法律后果和行动”。

paras.en: The port is leased to Chinese-owned company Landbridge, with the government's push to return it to Australian control a sensitive issue in the bilateral relationship.
paras.zh: 该港口已租给中资公司岚桥集团，政府推动将其交还澳大利亚控制权是双边关系中的一个敏感问题。

paras.en: Mr Albanese also signalled he would continue pressing China to remove barriers to Australian agricultural exports after being asked about tariffs on beef exports that exceeded an annual quota.
paras.zh: 在被问及对超过年度配额的牛肉出口征收关税后，阿尔巴尼斯先生还表示，他将继续敦促中国消除澳大利亚农产品出口壁垒。

paras.en: "We'd rather not have any quotas on Australian goods anywhere in the world," he said.
paras.zh: “我们宁愿不对世界任何地方的澳大利亚商品实行任何配额，”他说。

paras.en: But he said strong demand for Australian beef demonstrated the appeal of local products to Chinese consumers.
paras.zh: 但他表示，对澳大利亚牛肉的强劲需求证明了当地产品对中国消费者的吸引力。

paras.en: Earlier, Mr Albanese visited a supermarket in Shenzhen that stocked Australian products including apples, cherries, beef and lobster.
paras.zh: 早些时候，Albanese先生参观了深圳的一家超市，那里备有苹果、樱桃、牛肉和龙虾等澳大利亚产品。

paras.en: The prime minister said trade with China was important for Australian jobs and economic growth.
paras.zh: 总理表示，与中国的贸易对澳大利亚就业和经济增长非常重要。

articles.title: Sydney's Papley banned for three games after roadside drug test

paras.en: Thu, 3 Sept, 8:10 pm, Final score, Dockers 40, Hawks 72
paras.zh: 9 月 3 日星期四，晚上 8:10，最终比分，码头工人 40，老鹰 72

paras.en: Sydney Swan Tom Papley banned for three matches for conduct unbecoming after roadside drug test
paras.zh: 悉尼天鹅汤姆·帕普利因路边药检后行为不当而被禁赛三场

paras.en: Sydney's Tom Papley has apologised to his family, the Swans and the wider football community after he was banned for a positive roadside drug test.
paras.zh: 悉尼球员汤姆·帕普利因路边药检呈阳性而被禁赛，他向家人、天鹅队和更广泛的足球界道歉。

paras.en: The AFL found him guilty of conduct unbecoming after a secondary sample from his November 2 test proved the presence of cocaine and MDMA.
paras.zh: 在他 11 月 2 日测试的二次样本证明他体内含有可卡因和 MDMA 后，AFL 认定他行为不当。

paras.en: He will miss Sydney's preseason match and the first three rounds of the 2027 season.
paras.zh: 他将缺席悉尼的季前赛和2027赛季的前三轮比赛。

articles.title: Appeals court blocks Pentagon from forcing transgender troops out of the U.S. army

paras.en: Appeals court blocks Pentagon from forcing transgender troops out of the U.S. army
paras.zh: 上诉法院阻止五角大楼强迫变性人部队退出美国军队

paras.en: Ruling could set the stage for the issue to go back to the Supreme Court
paras.zh: 裁决可能为该问题回到最高法院奠定基础

paras.en: A U.S. federal appeals court on Tuesday blocked the Pentagon from forcing more than two dozen transgender troops out of the military, several months after it found that President Donald Trump's administration unlawfully imposed the ban.
paras.zh: 美国联邦上诉法院周二阻止五角大楼强制两打跨性别军人退出军队，几个月前，该法院发现唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府非法实施了该禁令。

paras.en: The decision — implementing an earlier ruling by the same appeals court panel — could set the stage for the issue to return to the U.S. Supreme Court, which previously allowed the ban to go forward for now in a different case.
paras.zh: 这一决定——执行同一上诉法院小组早些时候的裁决——可能为该问题返回美国最高法院奠定基础，美国最高法院此前允许在另一起案件中暂时推进该禁令。

paras.en: Trump's administration had asked the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit to delay the June 1 ruling's implementation while it petitions the Supreme Court to take up the case. A three-judge panel voted 2-1 on Tuesday to reject the administration's request for a stay of the circuit's decision.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府已要求美国哥伦比亚特区巡回上诉法院推迟执行 6 月 1 日的裁决，同时请求最高法院受理此案。周二，一个由三名法官组成的小组以 2 比 1 的投票结果驳回了政府要求暂缓巡回法院裁决的请求。

paras.en: The Supreme Court had ruled in the administration's favour last year, allowing the Pentagon to start enforcing the ban while the litigation proceeded.
paras.zh: 最高法院去年做出了对政府有利的裁决，允许五角大楼在诉讼进行期间开始执行禁令。

paras.en: Circuit Judge Robert Wilkins, partially joined by Judge Judith Rogers, ruled in June that the Pentagon's policy was designed to exclude people from the military based on their gender identity. Their majority decision would bar the military from kicking out current service members named in the lawsuit, but it wouldn't allow new transgender recruits to join.
paras.zh: 巡回法官罗伯特·威尔金斯（Robert Wilkins）和法官朱迪思·罗杰斯（Judith Rogers）部分参与，于 6 月裁定，五角大楼的政策旨在根据性别认同将人们排除在军队之外。他们的多数决定将禁止军方开除诉讼中提到的现役军人，但不允许新的跨性别新兵加入。

paras.en: Plaintiffs' attorneys challenging the Pentagon ban say 27 service members are covered by Tuesday's order. Shannon Minter, legal director of the National Centre for LGBTQ Rights, said the plaintiffs are all "decorated troops who have met every standard the military sets."
paras.zh: 对五角大楼禁令提出质疑的原告律师表示，周二的命令涵盖了 27 名军人。国家 LGBTQ 权利中心法律主任香农·明特 (Shannon Minter) 表示，原告都是“符合军方规定的所有标准的受过勋章的军人”。

paras.en: "The Trump administration asked the court to let it keep pushing these service members toward the door while it tries to get a different answer from the Supreme Court. Today, the D.C. Circuit said no," Minter said in a statement.
paras.zh: 明特在一份声明中表示：“特朗普政府要求法院继续将这些军人推向门口，同时试图从最高法院得到不同的答案。今天，华盛顿特区巡回法院拒绝了。”

paras.en: - Hegseth defends record as Pentagon chief, slams 'sham' push for his impeachment
paras.zh: - 赫格斯捍卫五角大楼负责人的记录，抨击弹劾他的“虚假”努力

paras.en: - Roles for trans and non-binary characters are vanishing, actors and experts warn
paras.zh: - 演员和专家警告说，跨性别者和非二元角色的角色正在消失

paras.en: On Tuesday, Wilkins said the administration hasn't shown how retaining the plaintiffs currently serving in the military would cause any irreparable harm to the government or endanger national security. Wilkins also noted that the scope of the June 1 majority opinion was narrower than the injunction that the Supreme Court stayed last year.
paras.zh: 威尔金斯周二表示，政府尚未表明保留目前在军队服役的原告将如何对政府造成任何不可挽回的伤害或危及国家安全。威尔金斯还指出，6 月 1 日多数意见的范围比最高法院去年搁置的禁令要窄。

paras.en: "To the extent the government suggests that any injunction against the Executive Branch imposes irreparable harm, I am also unpersuaded," Wilkins wrote.
paras.zh: 威尔金斯写道：“就政府而言，任何针对行政部门的禁令都会造成不可挽回的伤害，我也没有被说服。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for U.S. War Secretary Pete Hegseth's office declined to comment on the court's ruling.
paras.zh: 美国战争部长皮特·赫格斯办公室发言人拒绝对法院的裁决发表评论。

paras.en: In January 2025, Trump signed an executive order that claims the sexual identity of transgender service members "conflicts with a soldier's commitment to an honourable, truthful, and disciplined lifestyle, even in one's personal life" and is harmful to military readiness.
paras.zh: 2025年1月，特朗普签署了一项行政命令，声称变性军人的性别认同“与士兵对光荣、诚实和有纪律的生活方式的承诺相冲突，甚至在个人生活中也是如此”，并且不利于军事准备。

paras.en: In response to that, Hegseth issued a policy that presumptively disqualifies people with gender dysphoria from military service. Gender dysphoria is the distress that a person feels because their assigned gender and gender identity don't match. The medical condition has been linked to depression and suicidal thoughts.
paras.zh: 作为回应，赫格斯颁布了一项政策，推定取消患有性别不安的人服兵役的资格。性别焦虑症是指一个人因为指定的性别和性别认同不匹配而感到的痛苦。这种健康状况与抑郁和自杀念头有关。

articles.title: Would AI have come up with a better word of the year than the Cambridge Dictionary?

paras.en: Would AI have come up with a better word of the year than the Cambridge Dictionary?
paras.zh: 人工智能会想出比《剑桥词典》更好的年度词汇吗？

paras.en: The publication has chosen 'human' in response to concerns around artificial intelligence
paras.zh: 该出版物选择“人类”来回应对人工智能的担忧

paras.en: The Cambridge Dictionary has chosen "human" as its word of the year, reflecting concerns about artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 《剑桥词典》选择“人类”作为年度词汇，反映了人们对人工智能的担忧。

paras.en: The choice announced Wednesday in the U.K. highlights the debate over how AI blurs the lines between machines and people.
paras.zh: 周三在英国宣布的这一选择凸显了关于人工智能如何模糊机器和人之间界限的争论。

paras.en: Explaining the choice, the dictionary said, "Throughout history, the adjective human has signified people, as opposed to animals and gods (and, more recently, machines). Increasingly seen in compounds such as human-written, human-generated, and human-made, it now also denotes that something is created by or typical of people as opposed to AI."
paras.zh: 字典在解释这一选择时表示，“纵观历史，人类这个形容词一直表示人，而不是动物和神（以及最近的机器）。它越来越多地出现在诸如人类书写、人类生成和人造等复合词中，现在它也表示由人类创造的或典型的东西，而不是人工智能。”

paras.en: Colin McIntosh, the dictionary's lexicographer, notes that though AI has been a growing presence in society for years, in 2026, it seemed to be everywhere — and changed how people talk about being human.
paras.zh: 该词典的词典编纂者科林·麦金托什 (Colin McIntosh) 指出，尽管人工智能多年来在社会中的应用日益广泛，但到 2026 年，它似乎无处不在，并改变了人们谈论人类的方式。

paras.en: "2026 has been all about a refound appreciation of the human factor in what we consume (with a consequent human premium)," he said in a statement, "and a new value is being placed on the human element in our lives in general: all confirmed by our analysis of the language data, internet trends, and search habits."
paras.zh: 他在一份声明中表示：“2026 年，我们对消费中的人为因素进行了重新认识（随之而来的是人的溢价），我们的生活中的人为因素正在被赋予新的价值：我们对语言数据、互联网趋势和搜索习惯的分析都证实了这一点。”

paras.en: Given that, he said, human was the perfect choice.
paras.zh: 他说，鉴于此，人类是完美的选择。

paras.en: Last year's word of the year was also AI-related. Cambridge Dictionary chose "parasocial," explaining that "as social media intensifies the intimacy that fans feel with their adored celebrities, and with the rise in popularity of AI companions that can take on personalities, the word for these one-way relationships — parasocial — is having its own moment."
paras.zh: 去年的年度词汇也与人工智能有关。剑桥词典选择了“准社会”，并解释说，“随着社交媒体增强了粉丝与他们崇拜的名人的亲密感，并且随着具有个性的人工智能伴侣的流行，描述这些单向关系的词——准社会——正在迎来它自己的时刻。”

paras.en: Four other words made the shortlist for the 2026 word of the year: analogue, agent, wholesome and chic.
paras.zh: 另外四个词入围 2026 年度词汇：analogue（模拟）、agent（代理）、wholesome（健康）和chic（别致）。

articles.title: Mary Peltola wins U.S. Senate seat in Alaska for Democrats

paras.en: Mary Peltola wins U.S. Senate seat in Alaska for Democrats
paras.zh: 玛丽·佩尔托拉 (Mary Peltola) 为民主党赢得阿拉斯加州参议院席位

paras.en: Democrats now emerge with a 56-44 margin in Senate after Alaska win
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加州获胜后，民主党目前在参议院以 56 比 44 领先

paras.en: Democrat Mary Peltola defeated two-term Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in Alaska, overcoming allegations that members of her campaign helped recruit a candidate who shares the incumbent's name and completing a political comeback in a state U.S. President Donald Trump repeatedly won by wide margins.
paras.zh: 民主党人玛丽·佩尔托拉在阿拉斯加州击败了两届共和党参议员丹·沙利文，克服了有关她的竞选团队成员帮助招募一名与现任总统同名候选人的指控，并在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次以大幅优势获胜的州完成了政治东山再起。

paras.en: The Alaska race is the last U.S. Senate contest to be resolved in this year's midterm elections, and Peltola's victory expands the Democrats' majority after they retook control of the chamber. The party already won campaigns in conservative states including South Carolina, Texas, Kansas and, most recently, Mississippi.
paras.zh: 阿拉斯加竞选是今年中期选举中最后一场美国参议院竞选，佩尔托拉的胜利扩大了民主党重新控制参议院后的多数席位。该党已经在南卡罗来纳州、德克萨斯州、堪萨斯州以及最近的密西西比州等保守州赢得了竞选胜利。

paras.en: With Peltola's victory, Democrats flipped nine Senate seats, the most since 1958. Republicans entered the midterms with a 53-47 majority, while Democrats now emerge with a 56-44 margin.
paras.zh: 随着佩尔托拉的胜利，民主党翻转了 9 个参议院席位，这是自 1958 年以来最多的一次。共和党以 53 比 47 的多数进入中期选举，而民主党现在以 56 比 44 的优势脱颖而出。

paras.en: Messages seeking comment were left with both campaigns Tuesday night.
paras.zh: 周二晚上，两个竞选团队都留下了寻求评论的消息。

paras.en: - Mississippi's Scott Colom secures Senate seat in another midterm win for Democrats
paras.zh: - 密西西比州的斯科特·科洛姆 (Scott Colom) 获得参议院席位，这是民主党在中期选举中的又一次胜利

paras.en: - Ohio and Texas went from red to blue in the midterms but may not stay that way in 2028
paras.zh: - 俄亥俄州和德克萨斯州在中期选举中从红色变为蓝色，但到 2028 年可能不会保持这种状态

paras.en: Peltola, in a statement on social media, said there "is no greater honour than having Alaskans' support in our fight to take on corporate greed, lower costs and put Alaska first. Thank you, Alaska. Let's get to work."
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉在社交媒体上的一份声明中表示，“在我们打击企业贪婪、降低成本和把阿拉斯加放在第一位的斗争中，得到阿拉斯加人的支持是最大的荣幸。谢谢你，阿拉斯加。让我们开始工作吧。”

paras.en: Peltola previously held the state's lone House seat. She lost her bid for a second full term to a Republican in 2024, but she became central to Democrats' plans to retake the Senate in 2026.
paras.zh: 佩尔托拉此前曾担任该州唯一的众议院席位。她在 2024 年第二个完整任期的竞选中输给了共和党人，但她成为民主党 2026 年重新夺回参议院的计划的核心。

paras.en: In the campaign's final stretch, however, she faced allegations that her team helped recruit a retired teacher named Dan J. Sullivan to run in order to siphon votes from the incumbent.
paras.zh: 然而，在竞选的最后阶段，她面临指控，称她的团队帮助招募一位名叫丹·J·沙利文(Dan J. Sullivan)的退休教师参加竞选，以从现任者手中夺取选票。

paras.en: Trump called for Peltola's prosecution after the New York Times first reported the allegation less than a week before the Nov. 3 election. Peltola denied any involvement.
paras.zh: 在距离 11 月 3 日大选不到一周的时间《纽约时报》首次报道了佩尔托拉的指控后，特朗普呼吁起诉佩尔托拉。佩尔托拉否认有任何参与。

paras.en: "I knew nothing about any other candidates on the ballot except for me and the incumbent," Peltola told supporters in Juneau days before the election.
paras.zh: “除了我和现任候选人之外，我对选票上的其他候选人一无所知，”佩尔托拉在选举前几天对朱诺的支持者说。

paras.en: Dan J. Sullivan has denied any contact with Peltola's campaign or running at the Democrats' behest. He has not responded to messages from The Associated Press since the Times article was published.
paras.zh: 丹·J·沙利文否认与佩尔托拉的竞选活动有任何联系，也否认按照民主党的要求参加竞选。自《泰晤士报》文章发表以来，他尚未回复美联社的消息。

paras.en: The Times report was based partly on text messages and other documents and interviews with Peltola's former campaign manager, who was fired shortly before this year's open primary and later sought to recant her statements. But the second Sullivan had already been on Trump's mind. He referred to him multiple times during a rally in support of the senator in mid-October.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》的报道部分基于短信和其他文件以及对佩尔托拉前竞选经理的采访，她在今年公开初选前不久被解雇，后来试图撤回她的言论。但第二个沙利文已经在特朗普的脑海中了。在十月中旬支持这位参议员的集会上，他多次提到他。

paras.en: Later, the U.S. Department of Justice filed a lawsuit that Trump said he ordered. It sought to block certification of the race if the incumbent were to lose, pending an investigation into possible voter confusion. Peltola called the lawsuit "flagrant corruption."
paras.zh: 随后，美国司法部提起了特朗普称是他下令的诉讼。如果现任者失败，它会试图阻止对竞选的认证，等待对可能的选民混乱进行调查。佩尔托拉称该诉讼为“公然腐败”。

paras.en: The case was dismissed by a federal judge, but the Justice Department appealed. Attorneys for the state sought dismissal, saying officials should be able to conduct the election "without unwarranted interference by the United States." They also argued the ballot was designed to distinguish the two Sullivans as much as possible and that Alaska's ranked choice voting process would allow any voters who might be confused to rank them.
paras.zh: 该案被联邦法官驳回，但司法部提出上诉。该州律师寻求解雇，称官员应该能够“不受美国无端干涉”地进行选举。他们还认为，投票的目的是尽可能区分两位沙利文，阿拉斯加州的排名选择投票程序将允许任何可能感到困惑的选民对他们进行排名。

articles.title: Rights court rules Turkey must release jailed lawmaker Atalay

paras.en: The European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) ruled against Turkey over the detention of human rights lawyer and elected lawmaker Can Atalay.
paras.zh: 欧洲人权法院（ECHR）就土耳其拘留人权律师和当选议员坎·阿塔莱一事做出了不利于土耳其的裁决。

paras.en: The ECHR published its decision on Tuesday, saying that Turkey must release Atalay and allow him to take up his seat in the Turkish parliament.
paras.zh: 欧洲人权法院周二公布了决定，称土耳其必须释放阿塔莱并允许他在土耳其议会就任。

paras.en: The court ruled that his continued detention had been intended to silence him and undermine political pluralism.
paras.zh: 法院裁定，继续拘留他的目的是为了让他保持沉默并破坏政治多元化。

paras.en: It ordered Turkey to pay him €32,500 (about $35,700) in compensation.
paras.zh: 它命令土耳其向他支付 32,500 欧元（约合 35,700 美元）的赔偿金。

paras.en: The judges stressed that Atalay's case should not be considered separately, but rather in the wider context of the detention of political opponents, human rights activists and journalists in Turkey.
paras.zh: 法官们强调，阿塔莱案不应单独考虑，而应放在土耳其拘留政治反对派、人权活动人士和记者的更广泛背景下考虑。

paras.en: Turkey was among the original signatories of the European Convention on Human Rights. Yet it has previously refused to comply with the court's decisions in the cases of rights activist Osman Kavala and prominent Kurdish politician Selahattin Demirtas.
paras.zh: 土耳其是《欧洲人权公约》的最初签署国之一。然而，它此前曾拒绝遵守法院对人权活动家奥斯曼·卡瓦拉和著名库尔德政治家塞拉哈丁·德米尔塔斯案件的裁决。

paras.en: From leading activist to a jailed member of parliament
paras.zh: 从主要活动家到被监禁的议会议员

paras.en: As a lawyer, Atalay represented victims in numerous social and political cases in Turkey, as well as in freedom of speech cases involving journalists and writers.
paras.zh: 作为一名律师，阿塔莱在土耳其众多社会和政治案件以及涉及记者和作家的言论自由案件中代表受害者。

paras.en: He was also among the leading voices in the 2013 Gezi protests, which the government called an attempted coup.
paras.zh: 他也是 2013 年盖齐抗议活动的主要声音之一，政府称这次抗议为未遂政变。

paras.en: Because of his involvement in the protests, Atalay, along with seven others, was sentenced to 18 years in prison in April 2022 for "aiding and abetting an attempted coup."
paras.zh: 由于参与抗议活动，阿塔莱与其他七人一起于 2022 年 4 月因“协助和教唆未遂政变”被判处 18 年监禁。

paras.en: Continuing his struggle from the infamous Silivri prison, Atalay ran as a candidate for the Workers' Party of Turkey (TIP) in the 2023 parliamentary elections.
paras.zh: 阿塔莱在臭名昭著的锡利夫里监狱中继续进行斗争，并作为土耳其工人党 (TIP) 的候选人参加 2023 年议会选举。

paras.en: A candidate for the earthquake-hit province of Hatay, he won his seat but was denied release despite multiple rulings by the Constitutional Court, Turkey's top court.
paras.zh: 作为受地震影响的哈塔伊省的候选人，他赢得了席位，但尽管土耳其最高法院宪法法院做出了多项裁决，但仍被拒绝释放。

paras.en: His parliamentary status was revoked in 2024, a decision the Constitutional Court later overturned. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan's party stopped the opposition from formally reading the decision in parliament.
paras.zh: 2024年，他的议员地位被取消，宪法法院后来推翻了这一决定。总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安的政党阻止反对派在议会正式宣读该决定。

paras.en: Although a year later an opposition lawmaker read the decision in parliament, Atalay remains in jail.
paras.zh: 尽管一年后，反对派议员在议会宣读了这一决定，但阿塔莱仍被关押在监狱中。

paras.en: After the ECHR's ruling was published, TIP leader Erkan Bas took to social media to call for Atalay's release and the restoration of his parliamentary mandate.
paras.zh: 欧洲人权法院的裁决公布后，TIP 领导人埃尔坎·巴斯 (Erkan Bas) 在社交媒体上呼吁释放阿塔莱并恢复他的议会授权。

articles.title: Back to 1997: Russia wants NATO to roll back its eastern expansion

paras.en: During talks on ending the war in Ukraine, Russian representatives in Abu Dhabi presented a document containing far-reaching demands, The New York Times reports.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，在结束乌克兰战争的会谈中，俄罗斯驻阿布扎比代表提交了一份包含影响深远的要求的文件。

paras.en: Dated November 10, the document reportedly calls not only for an end to Western arms deliveries to Ukraine but also for NATO to withdraw its troops and bases and move them back to where they were in 1997.
paras.zh: 据报道，这份日期为 11 月 10 日的文件不仅呼吁西方停止向乌克兰提供武器，还要求北约撤军和基地，并将其移回 1997 年的位置。

paras.en: The year 1997 refers to the NATO alliance before its first eastward expansion, according to the Kremlin. At the time, NATO had 16 members. Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary had already been invited to join but did not formally become members of the defense alliance until two years later. In the following years, more countries in Central, Eastern and Southeastern Europe joined, followed most recently by countries in Scandinavia. Today, NATO has 32 member states in Europe and North America.
paras.zh: 据克里姆林宫称，1997年是北约联盟第一次东扩之前的一年。当时，北约有16个成员国。波兰、捷克共和国和匈牙利已被邀请加入，但直到两年后才正式成为防务联盟成员。在接下来的几年里，更多的中欧、东欧和东南欧国家加入，最近紧随其后的是斯堪的纳维亚国家。如今，北约在欧洲和北美拥有 32 个成员国。

paras.en: According to the report, Russia is not explicitly demanding that Central and Eastern European countries leave , but rather that the NATO alliance end its military presence in those countries.
paras.zh: 报道称，俄罗斯并未明确要求中东欧国家离开，而是要求北约联盟结束在这些国家的军事存在。

paras.en: What would be the consequences of a NATO withdrawal?
paras.zh: 北约撤军会产生什么后果？

paras.en: A withdrawal of NATO troops and bases from member states that joined the alliance after 1997 would significantly weaken their defense capabilities. For example, since 2004, NATO allies, including Germany, have taken turns policing the airspace over Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania.
paras.zh: 北约部队和基地从1997年后加入该联盟的成员国撤出将大大削弱其防御能力。例如，自2004年以来，包括德国在内的北约盟国轮流监管爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛上空。

paras.en: Because the Baltic states do not have fighter jets of their own for independent air policing, NATO provides the capability. Since 2026, the mission has been part of a broader air defense presence. The planned deployment of the German Lithuania Brigade, which is expected to be fully operational by the end of 2027, would also have to be halted.
paras.zh: 由于波罗的海国家没有自己的战斗机来进行独立的空中警务，因此北约提供了这种能力。自 2026 年以来，该任务一直是更广泛的防空存在的一部分。德国立陶宛旅的部署计划预计将在 2027 年底全面投入使用，但也必须停止。

paras.en: In Romania, meanwhile, the Mihail Kogalniceanu Air Base near Constanța on the Black Sea is currently being expanded. Once completed, it is set to become Europe's largest NATO air base by area — even larger than Ramstein in Germany.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在罗马尼亚，黑海康斯坦察附近的米哈伊尔科加尔尼恰努空军基地目前正在扩建。一旦建成，它将成为欧洲面积最大的北约空军基地，甚至比德国的拉姆施泰因空军基地还要大。

paras.en: "Under no circumstances will we allow anyone to establish new security rules for this part of the world over the heads of Poland and Europe," Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk told TVP World. His Bulgarian counterpart, Rumen Radev, called a NATO withdrawal "unthinkable and unrealistic." No country should be forced by external pressure to reverse its decision on which alliance to join.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克对 TVP World 表示：“在任何情况下，我们都不会允许任何人超越波兰和欧洲为世界这一地区制定新的安全规则。”保加利亚外长鲁门·拉德夫称北约撤军“不可想象且不现实”。任何国家都不应迫于外部压力而改变加入哪个联盟的决定。

paras.en: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal also rejected any Russian say in changes to Europe's security order: "We have nothing to discuss with Russia about Europe's security order; it is working well."
paras.zh: 爱沙尼亚总理克里斯汀·米哈尔也拒绝了俄罗斯对欧洲安全秩序变化的任何发言权：“我们没有什么可与俄罗斯讨论欧洲安全秩序的；它运作良好。”

paras.en: The strong rejection from the capitals of NATO's eastern members, however, masks fears along the alliance's eastern flank that a deal between Washington and Moscow could turn their security into a bargaining chip.
paras.zh: 然而，北约东部成员国首都的强烈拒绝，掩盖了该联盟东翼的担忧，即华盛顿和莫斯科之间的协议可能会将其安全变成讨价还价的筹码。

paras.en: Why isn't the mutual-defense clause enough?
paras.zh: 为什么共同防御条款还不够？

paras.en: In the event of an armed attack on a NATO member, the other alliance members are obligated under Article 5 to come to its aid. Each member decides for itself what measures it considers necessary, which may include the use of military force.
paras.zh: 如果北约成员国遭受武装袭击，其他联盟成员国根据第五条有义务提供援助。每个成员国自行决定其认为必要的措施，其中可能包括使用军事力量。

paras.en: For the mutual defense commitment to deter a potential aggressor, that country must believe NATO can intervene militarily quickly and effectively in a crisis. The deployment of allied troops along the eastern flank serves precisely this purpose. A withdrawal would make defense more difficult and could lead Russia to believe that an attack on NATO territory would involve fewer risks for Moscow.
paras.zh: 为了共同防御承诺阻止潜在的侵略者，该国必须相信北约能够在危机中快速有效地进行军事干预。盟军在东翼的部署正是为了这个目的。撤军将使防御变得更加困难，并可能导致俄罗斯认为对北约领土的攻击会给莫斯科带来更少的风险。

paras.en: Who decides which alliances a country can join?
paras.zh: 谁决定一个国家可以加入哪些联盟？

paras.en: As part of their security framework, European countries have agreed that states are free to decide which alliances they wish to join. NATO points to Article 10 of its founding treaty, which enshrines its open-door policy for European countries. The 1997 NATO-Russia Founding Act also explicitly stated that neither side had the right to veto the other's decisions.
paras.zh: 作为安全框架的一部分，欧洲国家同意各国可以自由决定加入哪些联盟。北约援引其创始条约第10条，其中规定了其对欧洲国家的开放政策。 1997年的北约-俄罗斯成立法案也明确规定，双方均无权否决对方的决定。

paras.en: Back in November 1990, the participating states of the Conference on Security and Cooperation in Europe (CSCE), including the Soviet Union, had already agreed in the Charter of Paris to respect each country's freedom to choose its own security arrangements.
paras.zh: 早在1990年11月，包括苏联在内的欧洲安全与合作会议成员国就已在《巴黎宪章》中同意尊重各国选择本国安全安排的自由。

paras.en: Was there a promise not to expand NATO eastward?
paras.zh: 是否曾承诺北约不向东扩张？

paras.en: During the negotiations surrounding German reunification, then-US Secretary of State James Baker and German Foreign Minister Hans-Dietrich Genscher used language that suggested putting limits on NATO's eastward expansion.
paras.zh: 在围绕德国统一的谈判中，时任美国国务卿詹姆斯·贝克和德国外长汉斯·迪特里希·根舍使用了建议限制北约东扩的言论。

paras.en: Their remarks came during discussions about unified Germany's membership in NATO and the possible deployment of NATO forces on the territory of the former East Germany. However, no written, legally binding general promise was ever agreed that NATO would never expand to include other former Warsaw Pact countries.
paras.zh: 他们是在讨论德国统一加入北约以及在前东德领土上部署北约部队的可能性时发表上述言论的。然而，并没有达成书面的、具有法律约束力的一般性承诺，即北约永远不会扩大到包括其他前华约国家。

paras.en: In the 1997 NATO-Russia Founding Act, both sides declared that they no longer considered each other adversaries. NATO stated that, under the security conditions prevailing at the time and in the foreseeable future, it intended to ensure its collective defense through reinforcement rather than the additional permanent stationing of "substantial combat forces." The agreement explicitly gave Moscow no veto over NATO decisions.
paras.zh: 在1997年的北约-俄罗斯成立法案中，双方均宣布不再视对方为对手。北约表示，在当时和可预见的未来的安全条件下，它打算通过加强而不是额外永久驻扎“大量作战部队”来确保其集体防御。该协议明确规定莫斯科对北约的决定没有否决权。

paras.en: In the 1994 Budapest Memorandum, Russia, the United States and the United Kingdom reaffirmed their commitment to respect Ukraine's independence and existing borders and to refrain from the use of force. These assurances were linked to Ukraine's decision to give up its nuclear weapons. However, the memorandum did not oblige the United States or the United Kingdom to defend Ukraine militarily in the event of an attack. NATO membership was not addressed at the time.
paras.zh: 在1994年的布达佩斯备忘录中，俄罗斯、美国和英国重申了尊重乌克兰独立和现有边界以及不使用武力的承诺。这些保证与乌克兰放弃核武器的决定有关。然而，该备忘录并没有要求美国或英国在乌克兰遭受袭击时进行军事保卫。当时没有讨论北约成员资格问题。

paras.en: Just over two months before Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the Kremlin presented two draft treaties to the United States and NATO. In them, Russia demanded an end to further NATO enlargement. The draft agreement with NATO also proposed that Russia and NATO members that had already joined the alliance as of May 27, 1997, refrain from deploying additional troops or weapons on the territory of other European countries beyond the levels stationed there on that date.
paras.zh: 就在俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰前两个多月，克里姆林宫向美国和北约提交了两项条约草案。其中，俄罗斯要求停止进一步扩大北​​约。与北约的协议草案还提议，俄罗斯和截至1997年5月27日已加入该联盟的北约成员国不得在其他欧洲国家领土上部署超出该日驻扎人数的额外部队或武器。

paras.en: Security guarantees for the postwar period and a future security framework for Europe were also on the agenda in Abu Dhabi. Negotiating NATO troop deployments and alliance enlargement alongside an end to the war in Ukraine would give Moscow additional leverage. Russia has long maintained that the "root causes" of the war must be addressed. The Kremlin includes NATO enlargement and the alliance's military presence in Eastern Europe among those causes.
paras.zh: 战后时期的安全保障和欧洲未来的安全框架也在阿布扎比的议程上。在结束乌克兰战争的同时进行北约部队部署和联盟扩大谈判将给莫斯科带来额外的影响力。俄罗斯长期以来一直认为必须解决战争的“根源”。克里姆林宫将北约东扩和该联盟在东欧的军事存在纳入其中。

paras.en: So far, no significant Western player has expressed willingness to accept Russia's demands in Abu Dhabi. On the contrary, former Polish intelligence coordinator Stanislaw Zaryn viewed the talks as an attempt to buy time and weaken the West ahead of another confrontation.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，还没有重要的西方国家表示愿意接受俄罗斯在阿布扎比的要求。相反，前波兰情报协调员斯坦尼斯瓦夫·扎林（Stanislaw Zaryn）认为这次会谈是为了在另一场对抗之前争取时间并削弱西方。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: APEC summit: What Trump, Xi and Putin want

paras.en: The leaders of China, the United States and Russia are due to hold their first trilateral meeting on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit this week.
paras.zh: 中国、美国和俄罗斯领导人将于本周在亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会期间举行首次三边会议。

paras.en: Separately, US President Donald Trump will also hold talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping during the November 18-19 gathering in Shenzhen, China.
paras.zh: 另外，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也将于11月18日至19日在中国深圳与中国国家主席习近平举行会谈。

paras.en: Several experts interviewed by DW do not expect any breakthroughs on US-China trade, technology or other issues. Maintaining the existing trade truce and preventing bilateral relations from deteriorating further may be the more realistic shared objectives.
paras.zh: 接受德国之声采访的多位专家预计中美贸易、技术或其他问题不会取得任何突破。维持现有的贸易休战、防止双边关系进一步恶化可能是更现实的共同目标。

paras.en: Patricia M. Kim, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, believes neither leader is looking to significantly expand the bilateral agenda, as both have an incentive in maintaining the existing trade truce.
paras.zh: 布鲁金斯学会高级研究员帕特里夏·金 (Patricia M. Kim) 认为，两位领导人都不打算大幅扩大双边议程，因为双方都有维持现有贸易休战的动机。

paras.en: Over the next two years, Kim expects to see "neither uncontrolled escalation in tensions between the US and China nor a dramatic improvement in ties, but rather the continuation of the transactional détente we see today."
paras.zh: 金正恩预计，在未来两年内，“美中之间的紧张局势既不会失控升级，也不会出现关系的显着改善，而是我们今天看到的交易缓和局势将继续下去”。

paras.en: Zhang Lun, a professor at CY Cergy Paris University, believes Trump is under pressure both at home and abroad.
paras.zh: 巴黎塞尔吉大学教授张伦认为，特朗普在国内外都面临着压力。

paras.en: "Domestically, Trump faces the prospect of becoming a lame-duck president following the Republicans' heavy losses in the midterm elections," Zhang told DW.
paras.zh: 张告诉德国之声：“在国内，共和党在中期选举中惨败，特朗普面临着成为跛脚鸭总统的前景。”

paras.en: "Internationally, damage to relations with allies, the weakening of the US-led international order, indifference toward democratic values and freedoms, and the difficulties encountered in the Iran war have all reduced America's leverage, resources and influence."
paras.zh: “在国际上，与盟友关系的损害、美国主导的国际秩序的削弱、对民主价值观和自由的漠视以及伊朗战争中遇到的困难，都削弱了美国的筹码、资源和影响力。”

paras.en: Zhang believes strained ties with US allies and the war in Iran have weakened Trump's hand with Beijing, making him more eager to secure diplomatic wins and Xi's cooperation on key policy priorities.
paras.zh: 张认为，与美国盟友的紧张关系以及伊朗战争削弱了特朗普与北京的关系，使他更加渴望获得外交胜利以及习近平在关键政策优先事项上的合作。

paras.en: Contentious issues may be left for later
paras.zh: 有争议的问题可能会留待以后处理

paras.en: Jia Hui Tee, a senior trade policy analyst at the Hinrich Foundation, expects Trump and Xi to focus on stabilizing their fragile trade relationship.
paras.zh: 辛里奇基金会(Hinrich Foundation)高级贸易政策分析师贾慧·泰(Jia Hui Tee)预计，特朗普和习近平将重点关注稳定两国脆弱的贸易关系。

paras.en: She says the two leaders could make progress on reciprocal tariff cuts covering goods worth $30 billion (€27.3 billion) on each side. "While the list of products has been announced, the timeline has not been set and an indicative implementation timeline would be an easy win" for both governments.
paras.zh: 她表示，两国领导人可能会在互惠关税削减方面取得进展，涉及双方价值 300 亿美元（273 亿欧元）的商品。 “虽然产品清单已经公布，但时间表尚未确定，对于两国政府来说，指示性实施时间表将是一个轻松的胜利”。

paras.en: Washington wants Beijing to accelerate purchases of US agricultural products and increase exports of rare earths and other critical minerals. But Tee believes that "China would likely be cautious with delivering on its commitments especially when Trump is weaker at home after the midterms with Democrats pushing back on his tariffs."
paras.zh: 华盛顿希望北京加快购买美国农产品，并增加稀土和其他关键矿产的出口。但蒂认为，“中国可能会在兑现承诺方面持谨慎态度，尤其是当特朗普在中期选举后在国内表现较弱、民主党人反对他的关税时。”

paras.en: She also points out that neither side would want to cede their bargaining chips easily, including rare earth exports and technology export controls.
paras.zh: 她还指出，双方都不想轻易放弃谈判筹码，包括稀土出口和技术出口管制。

paras.en: With another meeting between the two leaders is expected in December at the G20 summit in Miami, "there is room to push more contentious issues to a later date and further extend the trade truce in the next meeting," Jia told DW.
paras.zh: 贾庆林对德国之声表示，预计两国领导人将于 12 月在迈阿密举行的 G20 峰会上再次会面，“有空间将更多有争议的问题推迟到晚些时候，并在下次会议上进一步延长贸易休战期限。”

paras.en: China, the US and Russia: three leaders, three agendas
paras.zh: 中国、美国和俄罗斯：三位领导人，三个议程

paras.en: Russia hopes that talks with the leaders of the US and China will enhance its diplomatic standing and help secure a settlement to the war in Ukraine on terms favorable to Moscow.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯希望与美国和中国领导人的会谈将增强其外交地位，并有助于以有利于莫斯科的条件解决乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Yun Sun, director of the China Program at the Stimson Center, told DW that Moscow wants to create the impression that Washington is willing to sit down with Russia and negotiate. This, in turn, could undermine confidence in Europe and Ukraine.
paras.zh: 史汀生中心中国项目主任孙韵告诉德国之声，莫斯科希望给人留下华盛顿愿意与俄罗斯坐下来谈判的印象。这反过来可能会削弱人们对欧洲和乌克兰的信心。

paras.en: "Trump wants trilateral nuclear talks," she said, while Beijing "wants the optics of China hosting the unprecedented historical meeting among the three."
paras.zh: 她说：“特朗普希望进行三边核谈判，而北京则希望中国能够主办三方之间史无前例的历史性会晤。”

paras.en: Alicja Bachulska, a policy fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations, believes Beijing wants to use the meeting to demonstrate its ability to bring major powers together and facilitate international dialogue.
paras.zh: 欧洲外交关系委员会政策研究员阿利恰·巴楚斯卡(Alicja Bachulska)认为，北京希望利用此次会议展示其将大国聚集在一起并促进国际对话的能力。

paras.en: "Russia wants recognition, the US wants arms control, and China wants status without strings attached," she said. "I expect each leader to restate their own positions rather than produce real solutions."
paras.zh: “俄罗斯想要得到承认，美国想要军备控制，中国想要不附加条件的地位，”她说。 “我希望每位领导人重申自己的立场，而不是提出真正的解决方案。”

paras.en: Ukraine: why Beijing is reluctant to mediate
paras.zh: 乌克兰：北京为何不愿调解

paras.en: Michael Kimmage, director of the Kennan Institute in the United States, told DW last month that China may be more concerned with the survival of Russian President Vladimir Putin's regime than with actively bringing the war in Ukraine to an end.
paras.zh: 美国凯南研究所所长迈克尔·金马奇上个月对德国之声表示，中国可能更关心俄罗斯总统普京政权的生存，而不是积极结束乌克兰战争。

paras.en: Russia remains an important source of energy and a key diplomatic partner for Beijing, Kimmage noted.
paras.zh: 金马奇指出，俄罗斯仍然是北京的重要能源来源和重要外交伙伴。

paras.en: An outright Russian victory may not necessarily be Beijing's objective, he said. "More important to China is the political survival of Vladimir Putin." For that reason, Kimmage does not expect China to pressure the Russian president into ending the war if Putin is unwilling to do so.
paras.zh: 他说，俄罗斯的彻底胜利不一定是北京的目标。 “对中国来说更重要的是弗拉基米尔·普京的政治生存。”因此，如果普京不愿意，金马奇预计中国不会向俄罗斯总统施压以结束战争。

paras.en: Zhang Lun believes the current situation is "most in line with Beijing's interests."
paras.zh: 张伦认为，目前的情况“最符合北京的利益”。

paras.en: The Trump administration's pro-Putin stance has made it harder for Ukraine to resist Russia, Zhang said, while Europe has been forced to bear greater costs and has been weakened.
paras.zh: 张说，特朗普政府的亲普京立场使乌克兰更难抵抗俄罗斯，而欧洲则被迫承担更大的成本并被削弱。

paras.en: He argued that the United States has also "lost moral authority" and "the postwar international order and the alliances built around Washington have been further eroded," making China's "position and influence more prominent."
paras.zh: 他认为，美国也“失去了道德权威”，“战后国际秩序和围绕华盛顿建立的联盟受到进一步侵蚀”，使中国的“地位和影响力更加突出”。

paras.en: He believes Beijing wants to keep Russia from collapsing, but not support it so openly or extensively that it alienates Europe and other Western countries.
paras.zh: 他认为北京希望阻止俄罗斯崩溃，但又不想公开或广泛地支持俄罗斯，以免疏远欧洲和其他西方国家。

paras.en: "At the same time, China does not want Ukraine to be defeated, because that would reduce Russia's dependence on Beijing," he told DW.
paras.zh: “与此同时，中国不希望乌克兰被击败，因为这将减少俄罗斯对北京的依赖，”他告诉德国之声。

paras.en: "For now, China is unlikely to intervene directly. Instead, it will wait for a more favorable moment and then potentially step in as a neutral mediator in order to maximize its gains."
paras.zh: “目前，中国不太可能直接干预。相反，它会等待更有利的时机，然后可能作为中立调解者介入，以实现利益最大化。”

paras.en: Iran: little sign of substantive cooperation
paras.zh: 伊朗：几乎没有实质性合作的迹象

paras.en: W.A. Figueroa, an assistant professor of history and international relations at the University of Groningen in the Netherlands, told DW that there is little indication of any real cooperation between China and the US on Iran.
paras.zh: 荷兰格罗宁根大学历史与国际关系助理教授W.A. Figueroa告诉德国之声，几乎没有迹象表明中美之间在伊朗问题上有任何真正的合作。

paras.en: The two countries do share some interests, "including opposition to a toll system in the Strait of Hormuz and opposition to nuclear proliferation," Figueroa noted, but "China has consistently called for negotiations and denounced both sanctions and military force as a way to achieve these or any other objectives."
paras.zh: 菲格罗亚指出，两国确实有一些共同利益，“包括反对霍尔木兹海峡的收费制度和反对核扩散”，但“中国一直呼吁进行谈判，并谴责制裁和军事力量是实现这些或任何其他目标的一种方式。”

paras.en: Figueroa says China does not want further escalation or prolonged instability in the Middle East. However, Beijing has been able to manage the current situation without too much difficulty, leaving it with little pressure to change its position.
paras.zh: 菲格罗亚表示，中国不希望中东局势进一步升级或长期不稳定。然而，北京方面能够在没有太大困难的情况下处理好当前的局势，几乎没有改变立场的压力。

paras.en: "China continues to provide Iran with crucial financial support through its purchases of Iranian oil," Figueroa noted, adding that Beijing's diplomatic support has so far brought no substantial change, largely because China has little leverage over either Iran or the US in the region.
paras.zh: 菲格罗亚指出：“中国继续通过购买伊朗石油向伊朗提供重要的财政支持。”他补充说，北京的外交支持迄今为止没有带来实质性改变，这主要是因为中国在该地区对伊朗或美国的影响力微乎其微。

articles.title: How the Houthis fund war effort and tighten grip on Yemen

paras.en: Sanaa, Yemen – Mohammed, 19, joined the fighting on Yemen’s Red Sea coast in March this year, battling alongside Houthi forces. The fighting has been relentless over the past few months, as the Houthis advance. The Houthis have faced pro-government forces, as well as Saudi-led coalition air strikes.
paras.zh: 也门萨那——19 岁的穆罕默德今年 3 月参加了也门红海沿岸的战斗，与胡塞武装并肩作战。过去几个月，随着胡塞武装的推进，战斗持续不断。胡塞武装面临亲政府部队以及沙特领导的联军空袭。

paras.en: They have also faced international sanctions and attempts by Saudi Arabia and the Yemeni government to restrict their access to funds.
paras.zh: 他们还面临国际制裁，以及沙特阿拉伯和也门政府试图限制他们获得资金的机会。

paras.en: And yet, speaking during a recent visit to Sanaa, Mohammed said the Houthis were able to continue getting supplies to their fighters.
paras.zh: 然而，穆罕默德在最近访问萨那时表示，胡塞武装能够继续向其武装人员提供物资。

paras.en: “It is not always war and death on the battlefield. We have a good time. We eat the best food. We can chew khat. If injured or sick, we will be taken care of. Our commander on the ground makes sure we have the supplies we need,” Mohammed told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “战场上并不总是战争和死亡。我们玩得很开心。我们吃最好的食物。我们可以咀嚼卡塔叶。如果受伤或生病，我们会得到照顾。我们的地面指挥官确保我们拥有所需的物资，”穆罕默德告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Throughout a decade of war, Yemen’s Houthi group has developed a range of funding streams, which have enabled it to finance its military operations and tighten its grip on areas under its control.
paras.zh: 在十年的战争中，也门胡塞组织开发了一系列资金流，使其能够为其军事行动提供资金，并加强对其控制地区的控制。

paras.en: The Mokha Center for Strategic Studies said in a July report this year that the Houthi financial system generates direct and indirect financial resources and costs worth approximately $2.5bn annually.
paras.zh: 莫卡战略研究中心在今年7月的一份报告中表示，胡塞金融体系每年产生的直接和间接金融资源和成本约为25亿美元。

paras.en: That includes around $800m from taxes and customs, $600m from additional fees and levies, $300m from cash and in-kind contributions to the war effort, and about $100m linked to mobilisation events, according to the report.
paras.zh: 报告称，其中包括约 8 亿美元的税收和关税、6 亿美元的额外费用和征税、3 亿美元的战争现金和实物捐助，以及与动员活动相关的约 1 亿美元。

paras.en: A May research paper from the same institution estimated that nearly 60 percent of collected revenues in Houthi-controlled areas are directed to the security and military sectors.
paras.zh: 该机构 5 月份的一份研究论文估计，胡塞武装控制地区近 60% 的收入都流向了安全和军事部门。

paras.en: As the Houthis’ war grinds on against Yemen’s internationally recognised government and Saudi-led coalition forces, Houthi authorities have employed more fund-generating techniques. Ali Naji, a Sanaa resident, often receives messages on his mobile phone, urging him to contribute to the missile and drone air forces.
paras.zh: 随着胡塞武装与国际公认的也门政府和沙特领导的联军的战争愈演愈烈，胡塞当局采用了更多的筹集资金的手段。萨那居民阿里·纳吉经常收到手机短信，敦促他为导弹和无人机空军做出贡献。

paras.en: “I do not contribute, but thousands of people do, even with 100 Yemeni riyals [$0.19 at the exchange rate set by Houthi authorities in Sanaa]. When these small contributions add up, they make millions, and this funds the war efforts,” Naji, a father of three, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “我不捐款，但成千上万的人捐款，即使有 100 也门里亚尔（按萨那胡塞武装当局设定的汇率计算为 0.19 美元）。当这些小额捐款加起来时，他们会赚到数百万美元，这为战争提供了资金，”三个孩子的父亲纳吉告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: Another method is distributing envelopes to solicit contributions. Last week, Naji was watching the funeral procession of more than 40 civilians who were killed in Sanaa in what the Houthis said were Saudi air strikes.
paras.zh: 另一种方法是分发信封以征求捐款。上周，纳吉在萨那观看了 40 多名平民的送葬队伍，这些平民在胡塞武装所说的沙特空袭中丧生。

paras.en: A Houthi member approached him and handed him an envelope, requesting that he give a voluntary contribution to the war effort. “I did not feel comfortable refusing or returning it empty. I put 1,000 Yemeni riyals (around $1.90) inside the envelope and gave it back.”
paras.zh: 一名胡塞武装成员走近他，递给他一个信封，请求他为战争努力做出自愿捐款。 “我不愿意拒绝或退回空的信封。我在信封里放了 1,000 也门里亚尔（约合 1.90 美元），然后将其退回。”

paras.en: When mass rallies are held, a large sheet of cloth is spread on the ground, and people can contribute what they can. “Some give cash. Some donate weapons such as rifles and pistols, or jambiyas [traditional daggers]. From one rally, millions of Yemeni riyals can be raised,” said Naji.
paras.zh: 举行群众集会时，地上会铺一大块布，人们可以尽自己的绵薄之力。 “有些人捐赠现金。有些人捐赠步枪和手枪等武器，或传统匕首。一次集会就可以筹集到数百万也门里亚尔，”纳吉说。

paras.en: In addition, imported oil has been a major source of revenue for the Yemeni group. In January, the US Department of the Treasury said the Iranian government sold and provided a free monthly shipment of oil to the Houthis using Iranian-owned or affiliated companies based in Dubai, in the United Arab Emirates.
paras.zh: 此外，进口石油一直是也门集团的主要收入来源。一月份，美国财政部表示，伊朗政府利用位于阿拉伯联合酋长国迪拜的伊朗拥有或附属公司向胡塞武装出售并每月免费提供石油。

paras.en: With the shipments of Iranian oil, the Houthis continued to acquire a significant amount of revenue through illicit oil sales, generating over $2bn annually, according to the US Department of the Treasury.
paras.zh: 据美国财政部称，随着伊朗石油的运输，胡塞武装继续通过非法石油销售获得大量收入，每年创收超过 20 亿美元。

paras.en: Yazeed Al-Jeddawy, a research manager at the Sanaa Center for Strategic Studies, told Al Jazeera that the Houthis have established a self-reinforcing system in which “economic control finances coercion, and coercion enables further economic control”.
paras.zh: 萨那战略研究中心的研究经理亚兹德·杰达维告诉半岛电视台，胡塞武装已经建立了一个自我强化的体系，其中“经济控制为胁迫提供资金，而胁迫又促成了进一步的经济控制”。

paras.en: Their income sources include taxes, customs duties, zakat religious levies, and additional levies, and fuel and telecommunications, said Al-Jeddawy.
paras.zh: 杰达维说，他们的收入来源包括税收、关税、天课宗教税和附加税，以及燃料和电信。

paras.en: “Their control over import permits, fees, and access to foreign currency also gives them considerable leverage over traders and businesses. These resources sustain the security apparatus and patronage networks through which the movement enforces compliance and consolidates its authority,” he added.
paras.zh: “他们对进口许可证、费用和外汇获取的控制也使他们对贸易商和企业拥有相当大的影响力。这些资源维持着安全机构和赞助网络，该运动通过这些网络强制遵守规定并巩固其权威，”他补充道。

paras.en: Al-Jeddawy noted that the Houthi financial system supports recruitment amid shrinking employment opportunities and unpaid public-sector salaries.
paras.zh: 杰达维指出，胡塞武装的金融系统在就业机会减少和公共部门工资拖欠的情况下支持招募。

paras.en: “Joining Houthi forces has become one of the few sources of income available to some young men. Recruitment is accompanied by ideological indoctrination, extending the movement’s influence from military camps into families and local communities. Economic deprivation therefore does more than facilitate mobilisation: it helps the group militarise everyday life and reinforce their authority at the social level.”
paras.zh: “加入胡塞武装已成为一些年轻人可获得的少数收入来源之一。招募伴随着意识形态灌输，将运动的影响力从军营扩展到家庭和当地社区。因此，经济匮乏不仅促进了动员：它还帮助该组织将日常生活军事化，并加强了他们在社会层面的权威。”

paras.en: A 2024 United Nations panel of experts estimated that Houthi fighters numbered around 350,000, bolstered by the recruitment of fighters sometimes aged under 18.
paras.zh: 2024 年联合国专家小组估计，由于招募了一些年龄在 18 岁以下的武装人员，胡塞武装人数约为 35 万人。

paras.en: These resources fund more than recruitment and mobilisation. “The group has expanded its security apparatus, developed increasingly sophisticated weapons, and invested in fortifications, trenches, tunnels, underground facilities, and weapons workshops. This level of continuous militarisation requires considerable and sustained expenditure,” said Al-Jeddawy.
paras.zh: 这些资源不仅仅用于招募和动员。杰达维表示：“该组织扩大了安全机构，开发了日益先进的武器，并对防御工事、战壕、隧道、地下设施和武器车间进行了投资。这种持续军事化水平需要大量持续的支出。”

paras.en: Wafiq Saleh, an economic researcher and executive director of the Taiz Centre for Yemeni-Gulf Studies, said Houthi-run civilian institutions are starved of funds, salaries are not paid regularly, and basic services, such as health and education, continue to deteriorate.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹也门海湾研究中心经济研究员兼执行主任瓦菲克·萨利赫表示，胡塞武装运营的民间机构资金匮乏，工资无法定期支付，卫生和教育等基本服务持续恶化。

paras.en: “About one million Yemeni public employees have not received their salaries regularly since 2016. Meanwhile, the group has developed its arsenal and funded its war efforts. When war is a priority, the living conditions of the population become miserable,” Saleh told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 萨利赫告诉半岛电视台：“自 2016 年以来，大约有 100 万也门公职人员没有定期领取工资。与此同时，该组织开发了自己的武器库并为其战争活动提供资金。当战争成为优先事项时，人民的生活条件就会变得悲惨。”

paras.en: Roughly 80 percent of the population in Yemen lives below the poverty line, and nearly 22.3 million people depend on some form of humanitarian assistance, according to United Nations reports.
paras.zh: 据联合国报告，也门约 80% 的人口生活在贫困线以下，近 2230 万人依赖某种形式的人道主义援助。

paras.en: For Mohammed, the Houthi soldier, funding military operations is “a duty” and “a long-term investment”.
paras.zh: 对于胡塞士兵穆罕默德来说，资助军事行动是“责任”和“长期投资”。

paras.en: “Liberating the country and expelling foreign forces is not free,” said Mohammed. “So, funding fighters and military operations should be every patriot’s priority.”
paras.zh: “解放国家和驱逐外国势力并不是免费的，”穆罕默德说。 “因此，资助战士和军事行动应该是每个爱国者的首要任务。”

articles.title: Africa’s economic future cannot depend on Washington

paras.en: On September 2 , United States President Donald Trump signed legislation extending the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) through the end of 2028, following overwhelming support in Congress. Yet just two months later, on November 2 , his administration announced plans to terminate the eligibility of South Africa and Rwanda for the programme from January 1, 2027.
paras.zh: 9 月 2 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在国会压倒性支持下签署了将《非洲增长与机会法案》(AGOA) 延长至 2028 年底的法案。然而仅仅两个月后，即 11 月 2 日，他的政府宣布计划从 2027 年 1 月 1 日起终止南非和卢旺达参与该计划的资格。

paras.en: The decision lays bare the fundamental weakness of AGOA: African economies depend on trade privileges that Washington can withdraw whenever its political priorities change.
paras.zh: 这一决定暴露了《非洲增长机会法案》的根本弱点：非洲经济依赖于贸易特权，只要其政治优先事项发生变化，华盛顿就可以撤销这些特权。

paras.en: AGOA is a US trade law that currently covers 33 eligible sub-Saharan African countries. It was enacted on May 18, 2000, to allow these countries to export thousands of products to the US market duty-free, and was promoted as a strategic mechanism to foster economic growth, expand trade between the US and the continent and encourage economic and political reforms.
paras.zh: AGOA 是一项美国贸易法，目前涵盖 33 个符合条件的撒哈拉以南非洲国家。它于2000年5月18日颁布，允许这些国家向美国市场免税出口数千种产品，并被作为促进经济增长、扩大美国与非洲大陆之间的贸易以及鼓励经济和政治改革的战略机制予以推广。

paras.en: AGOA initially delivered promising results. It is estimated to have supported more than 300,000 direct jobs across Africa and 1.3 million indirect jobs. According to a 2024 US Trade Representative report, two-way goods trade between the US and sub-Saharan Africa reached $47.5bn in 2023, including $9.7bn in imports under AGOA and the Generalized System of Preferences (GSP), of which $5.5bn consisted of non-oil products such as apparel and agricultural goods.
paras.zh: AGOA 最初取得了可喜的成果。据估计，它为非洲各地提供了超过 30 万个直接就业岗位和 130 万个间接就业岗位。根据2024年美国贸易代表报告，2023年美国与撒哈拉以南非洲之间的双向货物贸易额达到475亿美元，其中包括AGOA和普惠制(GSP)下的进口额97亿美元，其中55亿美元是服装和农产品等非石油产品。

paras.en: However, recent figures point to growing challenges, with some even suggesting a decline. A Congressional Research Service report shows that US imports receiving AGOA duty-free treatment dropped sharply from $7.9bn in 2024 to $5bn in 2025. Another analysis by the German Institute of Development and Sustainability (IDOS) noted that the share of US imports from sub-Saharan Africa benefiting from AGOA and GSP preferences plummeted from more than 80 percent in 2008 to roughly 24.7 percent in 2021 amid eligibility uncertainty and short renewal windows.
paras.zh: 然而，最近的数据表明挑战越来越大，有些甚至表明挑战正在下降。美国国会研究服务部报告显示，接受 AGOA 免税待遇的美国进口商品从 2024 年的 79 亿美元大幅下降至 2025 年的 50 亿美元。德国发展与可持续发展研究所 (IDOS) 的另一项分析指出，由于资格不确定，受益于 AGOA 和普惠制优惠的美国从撒哈拉以南非洲进口的份额从 2008 年的 80% 以上骤降至 2021 年的约 24.7%和较短的更新窗口。

paras.en: Only a few eligible sub-Saharan African countries capture most of the programme’s benefits. South Africa is its largest beneficiary, with exports to the US worth billions of dollars annually, while most other eligible countries struggle to make full use of its preferences.
paras.zh: 只有少数符合条件的撒哈拉以南非洲国家获得了该计划的大部分好处。南非是其最大的受益者，每年对美国的出口额达数十亿美元，而大多数其他符合条件的国家却难以充分利用其优惠。

paras.en: Furthermore, because the US administers the programme’s preferences unilaterally, rather than through a bilateral treaty, Washington can exclude or reinstate any eligible country based on its own assessments and criteria, including market reforms, human rights and labour standards.
paras.zh: 此外，由于美国单方面管理该计划的优惠，而不是通过双边条约，华盛顿可以根据自己的评估和标准，包括市场改革、人权和劳工标准，排除或恢复任何符合资格的国家。

paras.en: Since the programme’s inception, some countries suspended from AGOA have criticised the impact of their removal. Ethiopia’s suspension in 2022, for instance, led to the loss of thousands of garment sector jobs.
paras.zh: 自该计划启动以来，一些被暂停加入 AGOA 的国家批评了取消其会员资格的影响。例如，埃塞俄比亚于 2022 年停摆，导致服装行业数千个工作岗位流失。

paras.en: In practice, Washington’s geopolitical interests often carry more weight in eligibility decisions than AGOA’s stated criteria.
paras.zh: 实际上，华盛顿的地缘政治利益在资格决定中往往比 AGOA 规定的标准更重要。

paras.en: The Trump administration’s decision to terminate South Africa’s and Rwanda’s AGOA eligibility is a clear case in point. Both countries have pursued policies that conflict with Washington’s interests and that the administration regards as a threat. South Africa has strengthened its economic and political ties with US rivals such as China and Russia, while facing accusations from Washington of obstructing American trade and investment, alongside Trump’s allegations of a “white genocide”.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府决定终止南非和卢旺达的 AGOA 资格就是一个明显的例子。两国都奉行与华盛顿利益相冲突且被美国政府视为威胁的政策。南非加强了与中国和俄罗斯等美国竞争对手的经济和政治联系，同时面临华盛顿阻碍美国贸易和投资的指控，以及特朗普对“白人种族灭绝”的指控。

paras.en: Rwanda’s alleged support for the M23 rebel group in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has also brought it into conflict with US interests in the region’s critical minerals.
paras.zh: 卢旺达据称支持刚果民主共和国东部的“M23”叛乱组织，这也使其与美国在该地区关键矿产的利益发生冲突。

paras.en: Sharp declines in AGOA import values, unstable US trade policies, and short-term extensions leave African exporters highly vulnerable. Losing AGOA access triggers immediate customs setbacks, including tariff increases of 15 to 20 percent on some products. Ultimately, these unpredictable extensions prevent AGOA from building a self-sustaining African industrial base, making accelerated implementation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) an urgent priority for the continent.
paras.zh: 《非洲增长和机会法案》进口值的急剧下降、美国贸易政策的不稳定以及短期延期使非洲出口商非常脆弱。失去 AGOA 准入会立即引发海关挫折，包括某些产品的关税提高 15% 至 20%。最终，这些不可预测的延期阻碍了 AGOA 建立自给自足的非洲工业基础，从而使加速实施非洲大陆自由贸易区 (AfCFTA) 成为非洲大陆的当务之急。

paras.en: Africa’s economic vision cannot remain hostage to changing administrations’ policies or unilateral decisions made abroad, as the continent needs to build strategic resilience and economic independence. The AfCFTA is a historic trade agreement signed under the auspices of the African Union (AU) on March 21, 2018, in Kigali, Rwanda, which officially entered into force on May 30, 2019, with trading beginning on January 1, 2021.
paras.zh: 非洲的经济愿景不能继续受制于不断变化的政府政策或国外单方面决定，因为非洲大陆需要建立战略弹性和经济独立。 AfCFTA是非洲联盟（AU）主持下于2018年3月21日在卢旺达基加利签署的历史性贸易协定，于2019年5月30日正式生效，并于2021年1月1日开始交易。

paras.en: The agreement aims to bring African Union member states into a unified market of over 1.3 billion people, with a combined gross domestic product (GDP) exceeding $3.4 trillion.
paras.zh: 该协议旨在将非盟成员国纳入一个拥有超过13亿人口、国内生产总值（GDP）超过3.4万亿美元的统一市场。

paras.en: Relying on a vast regional market would mitigate the impact of external shocks, such as the revocation of preferential trade agreements like AGOA or the sudden imposition of steep tariffs. Given that trade between African nations currently accounts for only about 15–18 percent of the continent’s total trade, the AfCFTA aims to progressively eliminate tariffs on 90 percent of tariff lines, thereby stimulating internal commerce and providing a buffer against declines in Western markets caused by tariff fluctuations.
paras.zh: 依靠广阔的区域市场将减轻外部冲击的影响，例如撤销《非洲增长机会法案》等优惠贸易协定或突然征收高额关税。鉴于目前非洲国家之间的贸易仅占非洲大陆贸易总额的15%至18%左右，AfCFTA的目标是逐步取消90%的关税细目的关税，从而刺激内部贸易，并为西方市场因关税波动造成的下滑提供缓冲。

paras.en: AGOA and many other external agreements have largely kept Africa in the role of a raw material supplier. In contrast, the AfCFTA encourages the development of regional value chains, where one African nation might produce raw materials, another processes them into finished goods, and the final product is sold to consumers within the continent, with fewer tariff barriers.
paras.zh: AGOA 和许多其他外部协议在很大程度上使非洲保持了原材料供应国的角色。相比之下，非洲大陆自由贸易区鼓励区域价值链的发展，其中一个非洲国家可以生产原材料，另一个非洲国家将其加工成制成品，最后产品以较少的关税壁垒出售给非洲大陆的消费者。

paras.en: AfCFTA has made notable progress in developing the instruments needed for continental trade. The number of countries participating in trade initiatives under the agreement has grown to include South Africa, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Rwanda and Tunisia, making use of its preferential tariff arrangements.
paras.zh: 非洲大陆自由贸易区在开发大陆贸易所需的工具方面取得了显着进展。参与该协议贸易倡议的国家数量不断增加，包括南非、埃及、尼日利亚、加纳、肯尼亚、卢旺达和突尼斯，利用其优惠关税安排。

paras.en: The Pan-African Payment and Settlement System (PAPSS), launched on January 13, 2022, enables banks and financial institutions to conduct cross-border transactions in African currencies, reducing reliance on foreign currencies such as the US dollar.
paras.zh: 泛非支付结算系统（PAPSS）于2022年1月13日启动，使银行和金融机构能够以非洲货币进行跨境交易，减少对美元等外币的依赖。

paras.en: The African Union also adopted protocols on competition policy in February 2023 and digital trade in February 2024, aimed at promoting fair competition and facilitating e-commerce. In August 2026, the AfCFTA Secretariat signed an agreement to modernise and digitise customs systems. The AfCFTA Adjustment Fund has also been activated, with an estimated financing requirement of $8bn–$10bn, to support developing countries and small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as they adapt to the requirements of the single market.
paras.zh: 非洲联盟还于2023年2月通过了竞争政策议定书，并于2024年2月通过了数字贸易议定书，旨在促进公平竞争和促进电子商务。 2026 年 8 月，非洲大陆自由贸易区秘书处签署了一项海关系统现代化和数字化协议。非洲大陆自由贸易区调整基金也已启动，预计融资需求为80亿至100亿美元，以支持发展中国家和中小企业适应单一市场的要求。

paras.en: For AfCFTA to serve its purpose and reduce dependence on volatile global trade agreements that prioritise Western interests over those of Africa, the continent still needs to accelerate economic integration by removing tariff and non-tariff barriers and harmonising trade and regulatory policies to facilitate the smooth movement of goods and services.
paras.zh: 为了使非洲大陆自由贸易区实现其目的并减少对将西方利益置于非洲利益之上的不稳定的全球贸易协定的依赖，非洲大陆仍然需要通过消除关税和非关税壁垒以及协调贸易和监管政策来加速经济一体化，以促进商品和服务的顺利流动。

paras.en: To improve local markets, African countries must undertake the costly and risky investments involved in building cross-border infrastructure to reduce the cost of moving goods and services between African countries. Digital energy grids will be essential to this infrastructure, alongside roads and railways.
paras.zh: 为了改善当地市场，非洲国家必须进行昂贵且有风险的投资，建设跨境基础设施，以降低非洲国家之间货物和服务的运输成本。数字能源网与公路和铁路一样，对于这一基础设施至关重要。

paras.en: Africa must shift from simply exporting raw materials to building strong regional value chains focused on local manufacturing and innovation. Meeting the needs of the continent’s vast market would strengthen its economic self-sufficiency and reduce its vulnerability to external political decisions and the expiration of unilateral trade agreements.
paras.zh: 非洲必须从单纯出口原材料转向建立专注于本地制造和创新的强大区域价值链。满足非洲大陆广阔市场的需求将加强其经济自给自足，并减少其受外部政治决策和单边贸易协定到期影响的脆弱性。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Hungry, unpaid and afraid: Africa’s journalists pushed to the brink

paras.en: How can a hungry journalist be expected to deliver the facts the public needs? Across Africa, journalists are struggling to survive, working for months without pay and reporting without contracts or protection. This is not just a workplace crisis. It is an attack on the very conditions that make independent journalism possible.
paras.zh: 一个饥肠辘辘的记者怎么能提供公众需要的事实呢？在整个非洲，记者们都在为生存而苦苦挣扎，他们连续数月无薪工作，在没有合同或保护的情况下进行报道。这不仅仅是工作场所危机。这是对使独立新闻成为可能的条件的攻击。

paras.en: Yet journalists are expected to expose corruption, scrutinise power and verify claims while wondering how they will pay for food, rent or transport to their next assignment. For many, journalism has become a struggle for survival. The consequences are visible in every delayed salary, every unpaid assignment and every story abandoned because the reporter cannot afford to pursue it.
paras.zh: 然而，记者们被期望揭露腐败、审查权力并核实说法，同时想知道他们将如何支付下一次任务的食物、租金或交通费用。对于许多人来说，新闻业已经成为一种生存斗争。其后果在每一次拖欠的工资、每一次无薪的任务以及每一个因为记者无力继续报道而被放弃的报道中都是显而易见的。

paras.en: With UNESCO’s support, the Federation of African Journalists (FAJ) and its affiliated unions and associations across Africa’s five regions carried out the first journalist-led, continent-wide survey of journalists’ working conditions, labour rights, safety and media freedom. It drew responses from 1,586 journalists in 45 African countries. Among those surveyed, 61 percent said their income from journalism did not meet their basic living needs, 58 percent reported delayed salaries and 62 percent had no written contracts.
paras.zh: 在教科文组织的支持下，非洲记者联合会（FAJ）及其在非洲五个地区的附属工会和协会开展了首次由记者主导的全非洲范围的记者工作条件、劳工权利、安全和媒体自由调查。它得到了 45 个非洲国家 1,586 名记者的回应。在受访者中，61%的人表示新闻收入不能满足基本生活需求，58%的人表示工资被拖欠，62%的人没有书面合同。

paras.en: Behind these numbers are journalists expected to perform an essential public service without the means to make a decent living. In Central Africa, 55 percent of respondents reported salary arrears lasting three to eight months within a single year.
paras.zh: 这些数字的背后是记者们被期望提供基本的公共服务，但却无法过上体面的生活。在中部非洲，55% 的受访者表示一年内拖欠工资持续三到八个月。

paras.en: The deprivation extends beyond pay. Many respondents also reported having no health insurance or paid leave. Freelancers and contributors are among the most exposed. Many lack contracts, predictable incomes and social protections yet are expected to produce regular work and take risks similar to those faced by newsroom staff.
paras.zh: 这种剥夺不仅限于工资。许多受访者还表示没有健康保险或带薪休假。自由职业者和贡献者是最容易受到影响的人之一。许多人缺乏合同、可预测的收入和社会保障，但仍有望从事正常工作并承担与新闻编辑室工作人员类似的风险。

paras.en: This widespread precarity is corroding the quality of journalism. Investigations require time, travel, secure communications, access to documents and careful verification. Poverty and unpaid work deprive reporters of these basic tools. A newsroom under financial strain has less capacity to check claims, protect sources and follow a story beyond the first official statement. Stories are dropped. Errors are harder to catch. The public is left with a thinner, weaker account of events.
paras.zh: 这种普遍存在的不稳定正在侵蚀新闻业的质量。调查需要时间、差旅、安全通信、获取文件和仔细核实。贫困和无酬工作剥夺了记者这些基本工具。面临财务压力的新闻编辑室检查声明、保护消息来源和跟踪第一份官方声明之外的报道的能力较弱。故事被丢弃。错误更难发现。公众对事件的描述更加薄弱。

paras.en: The consequences for information integrity are grave. The FAJ report describes journalists relying on side businesses, borrowed money and allowances from outside sources, including political “per diems”. This does not mean that journalists in precarious work are dishonest. It means poverty wages and financial exposure can create openings for outside interests to influence what gets covered and how. These conditions can allow “brown envelope” practices to flourish. When a journalist’s ability to survive depends on money from a person or institution with a stake in a story, independent reporting is placed under pressure.
paras.zh: 信息完整性的后果是严重的。 FAJ 的报告描述了记者依赖副业、从外部来源借钱和津贴，包括政治“每日津贴”。这并不意味着从事不稳定工作的记者不诚实。这意味着贫困工资和财务风险可以为外部利益创造机会，影响覆盖范围和覆盖方式。这些条件可以让“棕色信封”做法蓬勃发展。当记者的生存能力取决于与报道有利害关系的个人或机构的金钱时，独立报道就会面临压力。

paras.en: The survey shows that these abysmal conditions are already shaping coverage. Eighty-four percent of respondents said they practised self-censorship frequently or occasionally. Sixty-nine percent said threats had led them to avoid certain stories. When a journalist fears losing an already inadequate income, censorship does not need to arrive as a formal ban. It can be the decision not to investigate because the personal cost feels too high.
paras.zh: 调查显示，这些糟糕的情况已经影响了报道范围。百分之八十四的受访者表示，他们经常或偶尔进行自我审查。百分之六十九的人表示威胁导致他们回避某些故事。当记者担心失去本已不足的收入时，审查制度不需要以正式禁令的形式出现。可能会因为个人成本太高而决定不进行调查。

paras.en: The danger is physical as well as economic. Sixty-five percent of journalists who took part in the survey had experienced work-related threats or intimidation in the previous three years. More than half rarely or never felt safe reporting, and 78 percent said they had no workplace access to legal support. Journalists are sent to report on dangerous events and uncover uncomfortable truths that powerful interests would rather keep hidden, then are left to face the perilous consequences alone.
paras.zh: 这种危险既有物质上的，也有经济上的。参与调查的记者中有 65% 在过去三年中经历过与工作相关的威胁或恐吓。超过一半的人很少或从未感到安全举报，78% 的人表示他们无法在工作场所获得法律支持。记者被派去报道危险事件，揭露强大利益集团宁愿隐藏的令人不安的真相，然后独自面对危险的后果。

paras.en: Online attacks deepen the crisis. Journalists reported online harassment, digital surveillance and hacking attempts, often without access to digital safety training. Female journalists face additional risks, including sexual harassment, online gender-based violence, unequal pay and exclusion from leadership. When women are driven out of public debate by threats, journalism loses their reporting and the public loses the perspectives they bring. The strain is also evident in journalists’ wellbeing: 44 percent reported frequent burnout, and 47 percent had considered leaving journalism.
paras.zh: 在线攻击加剧了危机。记者报道了网上骚扰、数字监控和黑客攻击，但他们往往没有接受过数字安全培训。女记者面临着额外的风险，包括性骚扰、网络性别暴力、不平等报酬和被排斥在领导层之外。当女性因威胁而被赶出公共辩论时，新闻业就失去了报道，公众也失去了她们带来的观点。这种压力在记者的健康状况中也很明显：44% 的人表示经常感到倦怠，47% 的人曾考虑离开新闻业。

paras.en: The survey’s regional findings highlight delayed or inadequate pay in West, Central and Southern Africa and political intimidation, arrests and legal harassment in East and North Africa. There is no single African newsroom experience: In some places poverty is the most immediate threat; in others, repression and physical danger dominate. Often journalists face both.
paras.zh: 该调查的区域调查结果突显了西非、中非和南部非洲的拖欠工资或工资不足，以及东非和北非的政治恐吓、逮捕和法律骚扰。非洲新闻编辑室没有单一的经验：在一些地方，贫困是最直接的威胁；在另一些情况下，镇压和人身危险占主导地位。记者常常面临这两个问题。

paras.en: Country examples also show that democratic credentials alone do not guarantee decent conditions. The report describes Ghana as having relatively strong democratic credentials yet cites research from 2023 finding that many media workers there earned as little as G500 cedis ($38.80) to 1,000 cedis ($77.61) a month. Freelancers often relied on transport reimbursements, commissions or sponsored content to survive. Elections and democratic institutions matter, but without labour rights, fair pay and protection from pressure, journalists can remain economically vulnerable even in a more open political environment.
paras.zh: 国家的例子还表明，仅凭民主资格并不能保证体面的条件。该报告称加纳拥有相对较强的民主资质，但引用了 2023 年的研究发现，该国许多媒体工作者的月收入仅为 500 塞地（38.80 美元）至 1,000 塞地（77.61 美元）。自由职业者通常依靠交通报销、佣金或赞助内容来生存。选举和民主制度很重要，但如果没有劳工权利、公平报酬和免受压力的保护，即使在更加开放的政治环境中，记者在经济上也可能仍然脆弱。

paras.en: There are, however, practical examples of progress. In Mauritania, a government decision in 2025 regularised 1,860 media workers at public media institutions after a sustained campaign by the Association of Mauritanian Journalists with the backing of FAJ and the International Federation of Journalists. These journalists gained permanent contracts, equal pay and benefits, medical coverage, paid leave and retirement benefits after more than 30 years of campaigning for professional and social recognition. In Morocco, a collective agreement signed in February 2023 and negotiated by the National Syndicate of Moroccan Journalists secured a net monthly salary increase of 2,000 dirhams ($201) for eligible journalists with more than four years of experience. These changes show how government action and collective bargaining can put real protections into journalists’ working lives.
paras.zh: 然而，也有一些实际进展的例子。在毛里塔尼亚，毛里塔尼亚记者协会在 FAJ 和国际记者联合会的支持下持续开展活动，并于 2025 年做出了一项决定，让公共媒体机构的 1,860 名媒体工作人员正规化。经过 30 多年的职业和社会认可活动，这些记者获得了永久合同、同工同酬、医疗保险、带薪休假和退休福利。在摩洛哥，摩洛哥全国记者联合会于 2023 年 2 月签署并谈判达成的一项集体协议，确保具有四年以上经验的合格记者月净工资增加 2,000 迪拉姆（201 美元）。这些变化表明政府行动和集体谈判如何能够为记者的工作生活提供真正的保护。

paras.en: Namibia offers another important lesson. Journalists in the survey still described long hours, unpaid overtime and stagnant salaries. But formal registration of the Namibia Media Professionals Union gave media workers a recognised way to organise and bargain collectively. This month, the union secured a substantially improved settlement for workers facing retrenchment at The Namibian newspaper. This does not resolve the wider crisis, but it shows how collective representation can defend workers’ rights in practice.
paras.zh: 纳米比亚提供了另一个重要的教训。调查中的记者仍然描述了工作时间长、加班无薪和工资停滞不前的情况。但纳米比亚媒体专业人员联盟的正式注册为媒体工作者提供了一种公认的组织和集体谈判的方式。本月，工会为《纳米比亚报》面临裁员的工人提供了大幅改善的解决方案。这并不能解决更广泛的危机，但它表明集体代表如何在实践中捍卫工人的权利。

paras.en: In Somalia, long one of Africa’s most dangerous countries for journalists, the National Union of Somali Journalists led the development of a national action plan on journalists’ safety adopted in September 2022 after consultations involving journalists, the government and international partners. It sets out a Somali-led framework to strengthen journalists’ safety, media freedom, access to information and protection for female journalists. Its adoption was an important step towards safer working conditions for journalists.
paras.zh: 索马里长期以来一直是非洲对记者来说最危险的国家之一，在与记者、政府和国际合作伙伴协商后，索马里全国记者联盟牵头制定了一项关于记者安全的国家行动计划，并于 2022 年 9 月获得通过。它制定了一个由索马里主导的框架，以加强记者安全、媒体自由、信息获取和对女记者的保护。它的通过是迈向记者更安全工作条件的重要一步。

paras.en: Across the continent, the African Union and its organs have also taken steps to address journalists’ safety and media freedom. Ambassador Bankole Adeoye, AU commissioner for political affairs, peace and security, has been a vocal advocate for media freedom and journalists’ safety and a leading voice in affirming that professional media are indispensable to democracy and good governance. Over the past three years, the AU Peace and Security Council has increasingly addressed Africa’s media environment. In October, it called for greater protection of journalists, action against impunity and stronger safeguards for access to information.
paras.zh: 在整个非洲大陆，非洲联盟及其机构也采取措施解决记者安全和媒体自由问题。非盟政治事务、和平与安全事务专员班科尔·阿德奥耶大使一直大力倡导媒体自由和记者安全，并带头申明专业媒体对于民主和善政不可或缺。过去三年来，非盟和平与安全理事会越来越多地关注非洲的媒体环境。十月，它呼吁加强对记者的保护，采取行动打击有罪不罚现象，并加强对信息获取的保障。

paras.en: These examples show what governments, media organisations and multilateral institutions must do. Enforce labour protections. Pay wages on time. Provide written contracts, social protection and legal support. Protect the right to organise and bargain collectively. Treat freelance journalists as workers with enforceable labour rights. Investigate attacks and stop using laws to intimidate reporters. Democratic safeguards and labour protections must advance together. Neither can substitute for the other.
paras.zh: 这些例子表明政府、媒体组织和多边机构必须做什么。强化劳动保护。按时支付工资。提供书面合同、社会保护和法律支持。保护组织和集体谈判的权利。将自由记者视为具有可执行劳工权利的工人。调查袭击事件并停止利用法律恐吓记者。民主保障和劳动保护必须同步推进。两者都不能替代对方。

paras.en: When journalists are forced to choose between pursuing the truth and securing their own survival, the public pays the price: Investigations go unfinished, abuses escape scrutiny and vital facts remain hidden. Fair pay, secure employment and safety are essential to media freedom and the public’s right to know.
paras.zh: 当记者被迫在追求真相和确保自身生存之间做出选择时，公众就会付出代价：调查未完成、侵权行为逃避审查、重要事实仍然被隐藏。公平薪酬、稳定就业和安全对于媒体自由和公众知情权至关重要。

paras.en: The views expressed in this article are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect Al Jazeera’s editorial stance.
paras.zh: 本文表达的观点是作者自己的观点，并不一定反映半岛电视台的编辑立场。

articles.title: Trump to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin for joint summit
articles.author: Deepa Shivaram

paras.en: Trump to meet Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin for joint summit
paras.zh: 特朗普将与中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京举行联合峰会

paras.en: President Trump is off for a series of meetings in Asia that will cover trade, security and a rare trilateral meeting with China and Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统将前往亚洲参加一系列会议，内容将涵盖贸易、安全以及与中国和俄罗斯举行的罕见三边会议。

paras.en: President Trump's plane has landed in Manila to meet with allies at the ASEAN summit.
paras.zh: 特朗普总统的专机已降落在马尼拉，在东盟峰会上与盟友会面。

paras.en: It's a short visit. Tomorrow he's headed to Shenzhen, China, for another summit. He will meet with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russia's Vladimir Putin. It's the first time those three have had a joint summit.
paras.zh: 这是一次短暂的访问。明天他将前往中国深圳参加另一场峰会。他将会见中国领导人习近平和俄罗斯总统普京。这是三人首次举行联合峰会。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Lots of meetings. NPR White House correspondent Deepa Shivaram is awaiting the president's arrival in Shenzhen, which is one of China's big tech cities. Hi there, Deepa.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：很多会议。 NPR 白宫记者迪帕·希瓦拉姆 (Deepa Shivaram) 正在等待总统抵达中国大城市之一的深圳。你好，迪帕。

paras.en: INSKEEP: OK. The president's been spending a fair amount of time with China's leader. I guess they'll spend some more together.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：好的。总统与中国领导人相处了相当长的时间。我想他们会花更多时间在一起。

paras.en: SHIVARAM: Yeah, that's right. This is going to be the third time that Trump and Xi meet. Trump went to China earlier this year and then later on hosted Xi at the White House. This meeting, though, will be a little different because it's on the sidelines of the APEC summit that Xi is hosting here in Shenzhen. If you recall, about a year ago, Steve, Trump and Xi met on the sidelines of this same summit in Busan, South Korea, but at that time, tensions between the U.S. and China were really high because of the escalating trade war.
paras.zh: 希瓦拉姆：是的，没错。这将是特朗普和习近平第三次会面。特朗普今年早些时候访问了中国，随后又在白宫接待了习近平。不过，这次会议将有所不同，因为它是在习近平在深圳主持的亚太经合组织峰会期间举行的。如果你还记得，大约一年前，史蒂夫、特朗普和习近平在韩国釜山举行的同一场峰会期间进行了会面，但当时，由于贸易战不断升级，中美之间的紧张局势确实非常严重。

paras.en: And what came out of that meeting last year was, one, an agreement to keep meeting and, two, a sort of economic truce called the Busan Agreement. That involved things like the U.S. lowering tariffs and China loosening controls on rare earths. And it's generally cooled down the temperature between the U.S. and China, but both sides still have some issues. One expert described the agreement to me as not perfect but functional. So what's expected to come from the meeting this week between Xi and Trump is working to extend that agreement, which is set to expire in January.
paras.zh: 去年那次会议的结果是，一是达成了继续举行会议的协议，二是达成了一种名为《釜山协议》的经济休战协议。这涉及美国降低关税和中国放松对稀土的控制等。中美之间的关系总体上有所降温，但双方仍存在一些问题。一位专家向我描述该协议并不完美，但很实用。因此，习近平和特朗普本周的会晤预计将努力延长该协议，该协议将于一月份到期。

paras.en: INSKEEP: OK. Just maintaining the status quo.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：好的。只是维持现状。

paras.en: INSKEEP: But we mentioned the president is stopping in the Philippines on the way to China. How does that stopover fit in with the broader U.S. focus on China?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：但我们提到总统在前往中国的途中经停菲律宾。这次过境与美国对中国的更广泛关注有何契合？

paras.en: SHIVARAM: Yeah, it's a good question. Trump there is expected to meet with the leaders of the Quad. So in addition to the U.S., that includes India, Australia and Japan. These are major democratic nations, and this group was formed to balance power in the Pacific region against China. So timing-wise, it's pretty significant that Trump is able to meet with them before he meets with Xi in China. That will be one part of it. The other part is another trade agreement. The White House says Trump will sign a trade deal with Thailand while he's in the Philippines.
paras.zh: 希瓦拉姆：是的，这是一个很好的问题。特朗普预计将在那里会见四方领导人。除了美国之外，还包括印度、澳大利亚和日本。这些都是主要的民主国家，这个组织的成立是为了平衡太平洋地区与中国的力量。因此，从时间上看，特朗普能够在中国与习近平会面之前与他们会面是非常重要的。这将是其中的一部分。另一部分是另一项贸易协定。白宫表示，特朗普将在菲律宾期间与泰国签署贸易协议。

paras.en: INSKEEP: I guess, in a way, it comes across as a show of respect. You stop with the allies before you go and talk with the adversaries.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：我想，在某种程度上，这给人一种尊重的表现。在你去与对手交谈之前，你先与盟友停下来。

paras.en: INSKEEP: So he meets with China's leader then, eventually, where you are in Shenzhen. He's going to meet the regional allies on the way. Why also meet in a single room with both President Xi and President Vladimir Putin of Russia?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：所以他最终在深圳会见了中国领导人。他将在途中会见地区盟友。为什么还要与习主席和俄罗斯总统普京在一个房间会面？

paras.en: SHIVARAM: Right. So this is going to be a pretty historic meeting. These three leaders have never met together. Trump has been saying for a while now that he wants to discuss denuclearization with Xi and Putin. But I will say it's not really a topic that China is keen to get into. Trump has also said he wants to discuss with them, you know, about the war in Iran. And on Friday, the White House told reporters that the issue of Ukraine was not going to be on the agenda in this trilateral meeting.
paras.zh: 希瓦拉姆：对。因此，这将是一次非常具有历史意义的会议。这三位领导人从未见过面。一段时间以来，特朗普一直表示他想与习近平和普京讨论无核化问题。但我要说的是，这并不是中国热衷于讨论的话题。特朗普还表示，他想与他们讨论伊朗战争。周五，白宫告诉记者，乌克兰问题不会列入本次三边会议的议程。

paras.en: That has shifted possibly slightly because when Trump was leaving the White House on Monday, he told reporters that they'll talk about his, quote, "favorite subject" of Ukraine. This is going to be interesting to watch, Steve, because how Ukraine gets discussed in this meeting and what might come out of it has Europe really concerned, has Ukraine very concerned because their president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, will not be at APEC, and recently, Trump has been more lenient towards Putin and Russia.
paras.zh: 这种情况可能略有改变，因为当特朗普周一离开白宫时，他告诉记者，他们将谈论他“最喜欢的话题”乌克兰。史蒂夫，这将会很有趣，因为乌克兰在这次会议上如何讨论以及可能产生什么结果让欧洲真正担心，乌克兰非常担心，因为他们的总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基不会参加亚太经合组织，而最近，特朗普对普京和俄罗斯更加宽容。

paras.en: INSKEEP: Wow. One more thing to ask about. Could the president, since he's meeting with so many other people, also have a meeting with Kim Jong Un of North Korea?
paras.zh: 因斯基普：哇。还有一件事要问。既然总统会见了这么多人，他是否也能与朝鲜金正恩会面呢？

paras.en: SHIVARAM: He says that that might happen. It's probably not going to happen. We're still watching to see how things develop. The White House said that they're not planning for this to happen. Logistically, it would be very complicated. But Trump, you know, kind of did this last year, too, saying that he might meet with him in Korea, and that did not end up happening.
paras.zh: SHIVARAM：他说这可能会发生。这可能不会发生。我们仍在观察事态的发展。白宫表示，他们不打算让这种情况发生。从逻辑上讲，这将非常复杂。但特朗普去年也这么做了，说他可能会在韩国与他会面，但这最终没有发生。

paras.en: INSKEEP: NPR's Deepa Shivaram. Thanks so much.
paras.zh: 因斯基普：NPR 的迪帕·希瓦拉姆 (Deepa Shivaram)。非常感谢。
